title: The impact of human activity on global rainfall
text:
The results of a climate study show that human activity has affected global rainfall levels.
A new study suggests that human activity and climate change are the main drivers of extreme rainfall and events such as flooding and landslides around the world.
In recent years, numerous cases of flooding and landslides have been reported: excessive rainfall, meaning large amounts of rain or snow that are higher than normal for an area, could be the cause of such incidents.
Natural changes in weather conditions such as El Nino affect rainfall levels.
In the study, US researchers studied global climate records to determine whether human-caused climate change affects the amount of heavy rainfall.
By looking at multiple datasets of observed precipitation, the researchers were able to come up with a global picture and found evidence that human activity influences precipitation intensity.
The researchers stressed that it is essential to identify changes in rainfall patterns caused by human activity compared to changes caused by natural climate variability.
This will allow us to manage water resources and plan adaptation to climate change.
According to the Guardian, climate change caused by human activities has caused the temperature of the Earth to rise.
Different mechanisms link higher temperatures with rainfall intensity.
The dominant mechanism for increasing precipitation in most regions around the world is that warmer air can hold more water vapor, which can lead to storms.
End of message.

title: Flight 752: Canada and Ukraine demand transparency and compensation from Iran
text:
The foreign ministers of Ukraine and Canada met on Wednesday to discuss the issue of compensation from Iran for the families of the victims of Ukrainian Airlines Flight 752, which was shot down by the Iranian Revolutionary Guard in January 2019.
Canada ’ s foreign ministry said in a report that Foreign Minister Mark Garneo and Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dimitro Kolba stressed the two countries ’ commitments to work together, bring justice, clarify the incident and receive compensation for the families of the passengers.
The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Ukrainian Reform Conference in Vilnius, the capital of Lithuania.
Ukrainian media quoted the Foreign Ministry as saying that Mr. Kulba and Mr. Garneo also discussed the deepening of special relations between the two countries in the defense, political and humanitarian fields.
Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, on January 8, 2019, shortly after takeoff from Imam Khomeini Airport, near Tehran, was targeted by IRGC air defense missiles and all 176 passengers, some of them Canadian citizens, were killed.
Iran says it was caused by "human error," but the governments of Canada and Ukraine have repeatedly accused Islamic Republic officials of secrecy and demanded full information.
Some of the families of the victims also said that the IRGC had “deliberately ” targeted the plane, which the Islamic Republic has denied.
Meanwhile, the military court said it had issued arrest warrants for 10 people, but the families of the victims of the flight say that these 10 people are all "unnamed" people and "the main perpetrators of this crime, who are the top officials of the government, have been issued a ban on prosecution."
According to the families, “the lawyers of the families to study the case, to learn about the expert ’ s methods, interrogations and statements of the accused and to find their names have also gone nowhere. ”
The issue of compensation to families remains unresolved.
In June, four countries, Canada, Britain, Sweden and Ukraine formed a Canada-led group, calling on Iran to start formal negotiations on compensation for survivors of the Ukrainian plane, stressing that the Islamic Republic should accept its legal responsibility in this regard.
The Iranian government had previously approved the payment of $150,000 to Iranian and non-Iranian survivors of the downing of the Ukrainian plane, but many families had rejected it.
Using reports from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Canada and Radio Farda / S.N. / K.R.

title: Medical Suitcase in the Hands of Providers!
text:
"One of the important concerns and challenges in the field of medical tourism is the proper and proper guidance of foreign patients to Iranian medical centers, that medical tourists from the moment of arrival in the country will not be caught by the dealers, non-medical interventions by physicians for applicants for cosmetic surgeries will not be done, and finally, medical tourists will be able to advertise Iranian medical services by receiving standard medical services in reputable centers."
According to ISNA, Iran's newspaper wrote: "Medical tourists can be described as the phenomenon of traveling to different countries to access medical services.
On this basis, in the description of medical tourism, patients from developed countries travel to undeveloped countries in search of medical treatment.
The reason is clear.
The cost of treatment in underdeveloped countries is three times lower than in developed countries.
Medical tourism in India is growing rapidly.
In 2004, 1.2 million patients visited India for health care and 1.1 million medical tourists visited Thailand.
While increasing GDP, economic development, job opportunities are among the advantages of this industry, and Iran can also be referred to as a combination of medical and recreational tourism and the existence of historical and ancient monuments, pilgrimage centers and natural beauty and natural remedies (traditional medicine) at the top of the patients of the Persian Gulf countries, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Europe, Turkey, Azerbaijan and...
But the lack of advertising and branding of overseas medical tourism, as well as the presence of unauthorized intermediaries and institutions of health tourism, has put the industry in serious harm ’ s way.
The issue that has recently become a significant point for top managers of the country, following the increase in exchange rates, and even the officials of the Ministry of Health have been thinking about the development of the medical tourism industry.
As activists in this field say, one of the important concerns and challenges in this regard is the proper guidance of foreign patients to Iranian medical centers, that medical tourists from the moment of arrival in the country will not be caught by dealers, non-medical interventions by physicians for cosmetic surgery applicants, and finally, medical tourists will be able to advertise Iranian medical services by receiving standard medical services in reputable medical centers.
About the role and general policies of the Ministry of Health in the development of medical tourism, challenges and opportunities to attract and follow patients from the country of origin to Iran, we spoke with Dr. Saeed Hashemzadeh, the head of the health tourism department of the Ministry of Health, which you can read below.
How are medical tourists attracted to Iranian treatment centers?
I mean, because of the presence of intermediaries, foreign patients are not properly directed to medical centers and do not reach the hands of specialists, and sometimes we hear that they fall into the hands of dealers and unauthorized institutions, and they also direct applicants for these types of surgeries to people who are not qualified.
Is there a specific model for guiding the patient to the medical centers that the medical tourist does not receive non-standard medical services and does not lead to invalid medical centers?
We at the Ministry of Health believe that dealers are not causes, but effects.
Therefore, if we want to deal with the phenomenon of brokerage in the field of health tourism, we will simply ask the police to stop the work of dealers, but we believe that this approach will not eliminate the work of dealers.
So we tried to identify the problems that exist in the supply chain in health tourism, and then, based on that, brokers out of the industry.
Of course, I should say that the country ’ s medical centers have capabilities and capabilities, but they have not been able to properly introduce and present these capabilities abroad, where our customers are present.
Who gives the foreign patient the information at which medical center and under what conditions and at what cost?
The answer to this question is clear: an element found in the name of the dealer.
Because of this gap or lack of information between health centers and patients applying abroad, an element called a broker plays this role.
In order to reduce the activity of brokers in principle, we need to see who is acting in successful models of the world and who is going to give this information to the patient to reduce the activity of brokers.
When you look at successful models in West Asia, including India, Turkey and Jordan, there is an actor here called “Facilitator Company. ”
The main task of facilitating companies is to provide the necessary medical information from health centers and physicians and to inform about transparent prices to foreign patients. With this knowledge, we designed a regulation to form companies based on this bylaw that work in this area, that is, these companies play a role in making decisions for patients who enter the country, then facilitate the entry of the patient to the country and after receiving medical services from the patient. Outside, follow up after treatment.
Of course, follow-up after treatment is an important part of the work that has been forgotten in our country, that is, we did not have a regular and structured follow-up, so we started to do the same.
The companies facilitating the recruitment of medical tourism have a specific channel for attracting foreign patients, how do these companies cut the hands of brokers and intermediaries in this field?
These companies, with the permission of the Ministry of Health, attract different types of foreign patients to Iranian medical centers.
They start their activities in cyberspace, including websites and social networks, and inform the people of foreign countries about the capabilities of their contractual health centers in cyberspace.
The second solution is to attend national and international exhibitions and events of health tourism.
The third option is to join similar companies in the target markets.
That is, Iranian companies connect with similar companies in Iraq and Afghanistan and refer the patient to our country.
A very important solution is to join the facilitators with insurance companies on the other side of the border, which, of course, has not been paid attention to in our country.
That is, there is a lack of actors here, and that is the connection of foreign insurance companies to Iranian facilitators in order to attract patients in an organized manner in international markets.
This is a model that is used in all countries.
In our country, which of the channels you mentioned provides the way to attract foreign patients?
Other than the type of brokerage, the type that is very emphasized is the attraction of the patient through cyberspace.
Does it seem like there ’ s more to attract foreign patients?
Do you have any statistics about how many medical tourists enter Iran ’ s treatment centers through dealers?
It is not more than 5 months since the notification of the regulations of the Facilitating Companies should take some time to make a proper comparison.
The vast majority of patients entering treatment centers are owned by these dealers, but the balance shifts in favor of companies.
Between 80% and 90% of patients are brought by brokers and the share of direct patient visits is less than 10%.
At the moment, the weight is shifting towards companies.
Medical centers have reported the same to us, that is, the centers that previously said that 90 percent of foreign patients come to Iran through dealers now say that 70 percent of them enter the country through dealers.
The trend of change, although small, has begun, that is, 10% of the market is owned by companies, while we only allowed 15% of these companies to operate.
If insurance is added to the supply chain, this will happen quickly.
You mentioned the connection of Iranian facilitators to foreign insurance companies to attract medical tourism.
Since the arrival of medical tourists in Iran, what is the process of receiving their services?
Please let me know if medical visas are issued for patients.
Do you offer unpaid and VIP services to them?
On the basis of what process the patient enters the medical center of a foreign country, let me first say the model of the world.
It is usually the case that the patient travels to another country to receive a special service that is not covered by his or her insurance.
For example, in Europe, if a person with a doctor ’ s diagnosis needs a knee replacement and this service is not covered by insurance, the insurance office suggests that the patient use the services of a consultant facilitator and go to India or Turkey for knee surgery, in which case the knee replacement service is covered by the insurance of the country of origin, that is, this person does not have insurance coverage for joint replacement in Europe, but in India and Turkey. The insurance mode not only covers the costs of the patient, but also the airline ticket and accommodation costs.
In the United States, for example, a knee replacement costs $220,000, but if the patient goes to India with the best hotel, plane and service, it costs $15,000 for his insurance company.
In our country, almost the same cycle must be carried out.
We will be successful in medical tourism when we can implement the same general cycle, for now, the process is like this: a patient who has been recommended to do medical work in Iraq will enter Iran.
If it is in a healthy cycle, with the advertisements that the facilitator companies have in cyberspace, the patient chooses which city and hospital to enter, then the patient contracts with the facilitator company, and the company coordinates the visa, ticket, accommodation and transportation of the patient, and the patient enters Iran and returns to his home country after receiving the service, of course his treatment is followed by the facilitator company.
What we need to do is for the patient to decide in his or her place of residence which Iranian medical center he or she should go to.
It is interesting to know that since the creation of new generation facilitators that the Ministry of Health authorizes, we have faced an increase in patient visits from Europe.
European patients who choose to perform Iranian cosmetic surgeries and get all their information from cyberspace and enter Iran through facilitating companies, our model of attracting European patients is closer to the international model of health tourism.
This pattern should also be extended to neighboring patients so that patients can enter through a healthy corridor.
As far as insurance is concerned, it has not played an important and fundamental role in the field of health tourism, except in the case of specific European patients.
What are the reasons for medical tourists to choose Iranian medical centers? What types of surgeries are they most likely to do, and from what countries do applicants often enter Iranian medical centers?
According to the statistics about hospitalized patients in the medical centers, most of our health tourists from Afghanistan, Iraq, Azerbaijan, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, India and Turkmenistan enter Iran.
Of course, Iranians living abroad also come to Iran for their health care, which is scientifically considered by this group to be health tourists.
The citizens of these countries refer to which cities of the country or universities of medical sciences, respectively, Iran University of Medical Sciences, Mashhad, Qom, Shahid Beheshti University, Shiraz, Ahvaz, Urmia, Tabriz, Tehran and Semnan.
For which diseases they come to our country more often, gynecological and obstetric diseases, IVF treatment and eye surgeries are among the top reasons for referring foreign patients to Iran.
Usually the same sequence exists, but in the last two years, the main reasons for medical tourism, cardiovascular disease and beauty have been replaced with the above.
Recently, following the wave of Iraqi patients entering Iran, news was published that due to the large number of visits by Iraqi patients, doctors arrive late to Iranian patients, as well as Iranian patients complain about hospitalization and non-appointment visits of foreign patients.
What percentage of beds are allowed for foreign patients?
I disagree with this statement because it has been considered, because the Ministry of Health has issued a directive stating that each state hospital should allocate 10% of its bed surplus to foreign patients, if the patient is not Iranian, if this is not observed in the center, it is a violation of the law.
That is, if a government hospital has 100 beds, it is not like to give 90 Iranian beds and 10 beds to foreigners, but should give 100 beds to Iranians and make 10 other beds for foreign patients.
In the complaint process, we also deal with the complaint of foreign patients.
In your talk, you mentioned the healthy path of attracting medical tourism how the unhealthy path is formed, for example, medical tourism applicants for cosmetic and plastic surgeries are often caught by doctors.
For example, they do hair transplants in the basement of houses.
The unhealthy path is that the patient enters the country without knowledge and decision, from this stage, different things happen.
Dealers are often present as taxi drivers at the border, and sometimes foreign applicants are related to the taxi drivers.
From this point on, drivers at the border offer different offers to applicants, for example, they take the patient to a center that does not have the necessary qualifications and permits even for the Iranian patient, they are not trained or have the necessary expertise, so the service they receive is not valid from our point of view and will naturally suffer from complications, while the service is more expensive than normal.
For example, we have had many outpatients who have been taken to unauthorized centers for hair transplantation or other beauty services, which we do not have any sign of these centers, and unfortunately normal and non-doctor people do hair transplantation and cosmetic surgeries.
There have also been reports that these people have had head and face symptoms.
Of course, this is not much compared to the volume of our tourists, but the small number of cashes also has bad advertising against the country.
One of the concerns in this field is advertising and branding. What kind of advertising is suitable for the development of the medical tourism industry and can help attract more patients?
What do you also have in mind for medical tourism outbound marketing?
If you mean as the Ministry of Health, it is essential to attend meetings with foreign delegations, especially neighboring countries, that enter the country.
In proportion to the work of different delegations from neighboring countries, we tried to make health tourism one of the topics discussed in these meetings.
In addition, in this way, we try to provide a safe route for patients, while we try to make a list of international events in neighboring countries related to the field of health tourism, and we encourage health centers to attend these exhibitions to get acquainted with regional competitors and target countries.
We also encouraged hospitals to produce written and visual content in order to present their capabilities to neighboring countries.
Are there accurate and reliable statistics on medical tourism and how much the revenue from medical tourism is worth for medical universities and the government?
In 2017, we had about 300 thousand health tourists and the income is estimated to be one billion and 200 million dollars.
In 1997, this number reached about 550,000 people and its income was about one to two billion dollars, I think we can easily increase this income to six to seven billion dollars a year.
Of course, the Iranian healthcare system can respond to up to two million people per year in terms of numbers; especially in the outpatient sector, we have this capacity and we can easily reach these numbers.
If we all join hands and the ministries that are in this cycle do their job and accept that health tourism is a specialized industry, we can reach higher numbers of $10 billion a year.
I believe we can turn health tourism into the most important non-oil income in Iran.
How much the sanctions have affected the discussion of the entry of medical tourists to Iran.
Given that sanctions have affected access to certain medicines and medical equipment, has this caused a negative mentality among health tourists?
It can make an impact, but in the short term.
Especially in the field of equipment, where many investments have already been made in the country.
In health tourism, because it brings currency to the country, it may open the private sector to buy equipment and supplies.
This is not the case with neighboring countries, a group of people may be affected by these advertisements, but neighboring countries have so much interaction with us that they are not affected by them.
In the case of European patients, it is the duty of the facilitators to introduce Iran through the correct channel.
One of the important issues related to the recruitment of medical tourism is the presence of trained and expert personnel in medical centers that can at least properly address the respect of the client. Is the planning that is in the UAE, Jordan and Turkey also implemented in Iran?
Are there any interpreters in hospitals that the patient can communicate with?
You mentioned a very important topic.
Perhaps it was necessary to ask this as the first question because it is the biggest challenge that exists in our tourism industry.
Studies show that the biggest problem with our health tourism is the presence of dealers.
I would say that his biggest problem is the lack of trained and professional personnel in the field of health tourism, whether in companies or hospitals.
In fact, after this gap, we designed workshops, and in the long run, we even offered to create master ’ s courses to train the ministry, but now what we are doing is three-day workshops held by the Ministry of Health in cooperation with the Faculty of Management of Iran University of Medical Sciences.
In these workshops, applicants who attend companies and hospitals are trained.
We held 24 introductory and advanced workshops, more than 500 people have been trained in these workshops, and these people have been able to be a good source of health tourism in their workplace.
The management staff of health centers, facilitators, nurses and doctors treating international patients have participated in training workshops.
How important is the presence of prominent doctors and top faculty members in Iran to attract medical tourism?
In any case, such capacity helps to create competition with neighboring countries.
When a foreign patient arrives in Iran, does it matter which doctor will treat him or does the medical center introduce a special and prominent doctor to treat these patients?
It is 100% important that one of the tasks that we have assigned to the facilitator companies is the issue of introducing the list of top doctors to the medical tourist, and the patient chooses from among the physicians and takes his service from the prominent physicians.
In general, the medical, nursing and administrative staff of our health centers in the region do not lack anything of international standards in terms of professional work.
Can medical tourists after surgery and treatment and leaving the country still be in contact with their doctor online?
One of our standards is this issue. We have asked health centers and facilitator companies to establish this connection and provide the physician and the medical staff with ways to contact the patient so that the tourist can communicate with the doctor after visiting his country. Of course, the doctors who help the physicians are also online in contact with the patients.
One of the reasons for the referral of medical tourists, especially from the Persian Gulf countries, is the practice of sex change in Iran due to the lack of surgery in neighboring countries.
Do you confirm this?
Yes, we have crutches.
A patient who is a candidate for gender reassignment surgery after legal procedures in his / her own country and obtaining the necessary permits documents related to legal issues and medical work and submit his / her request to our medical center, in our medical centers through the presence of plastic surgeons who work on this issue, such as Labbafi Nejad and Moheb Kowsar, who have good plastic surgery, accepts the patient.
Most applicants are from Iraq, Oman and the Persian Gulf and have high satisfaction.
End of message.

title: Emirates gas on the road to normalization with Israel on the path of reconciliation
text:
Joe Biden ’ s administration continues to insist on a two-state solution as the only compromise between the Palestinians and Israel, a solution that Mahmoud Abbas has recently offered to revive, but Arab governments and Israel are still running on a different road, the so-called Ibrahim agreement that was founded by former US President Donald Trump.
Ten days after the opening of the Israeli embassy in Abu Dhabi, the UAE embassy in Tel Aviv opened yesterday.
The PA, which itself is refusing to compromise with the Zionist regime, has called the Emiratis ’ work a “betrayal. ”
According to Javan, the Americans have two separate solutions to what they call the Israeli-Palestinian problem; the historical solution is the process of reconciliation, or so-called Middle East peace, which began with the restoration of the democrats and the Israeli left in Oslo in 1993 and stopped with the rise of the extremist Zionists over the past two decades.
Egypt and Jordan have been key players in this trend for the past three decades.
This solution, also known as a “two-state ” solution, emphasizes that resolving the conflict between the Palestinians and the Zionist regime requires an internal transformation in the relations between the two sides.
For this reason, it focuses on the Palestinian Authority ’ s relations with Israel.
The second solution, launched during the presidency of Donald Trump, emphasizes an external solution to the dilemma.
The Abraham Accords was a joint statement of Israel, the United Arab Emirates and the United States signed on August 13, 2020, followed by an agreement to normalize relations between Bahrain and Israel.
The players in the deal are the United States, the Republicans, the right in Israel, and among Arab states, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.
After the crisis in Sudan and Morocco, after the Biden administration entered the White House in January 2021, Democrats are seeking to revive the historic Oslo Accords, which focus on a two-state solution.
Speaking to Sky News on Tuesday night, the US State Department ’ s regional spokesman reiterated the Biden administration ’ s commitment to reviving the two-state solution, saying the US president believes there is no other solution in the Middle East except the two-state solution.
He said that the US government is in deep talks with the Palestinians and Israel on this issue, while Yair Lapid, the foreign minister of the coalition government, which is mainly based on right-wing parties, said at a meeting of EU foreign ministers in Brussels: “The two-state solution (Palestine alongside Israel) is not applicable at the moment. ”
Speaking about the opening of the Israeli embassy in Abu Dhabi 10 days ago, Lapid said: “We hope that in the next few weeks our embassy will be opened in Morocco, followed by Bahrain and Sudan. ”
It was not a day after Lapid ’ s speech that the UAE embassy in Tel Aviv was opened with the presence of Yitzhak Herzog, the head of the Zionist regime and Mohammed al-Khajeh, the UAE ’ s ambassador in Tel Aviv.
The UAE waved its flag over the embassy, and the Emirati ambassador said in a speech that the establishment of the UAE embassy in Israel is the cornerstone of continued cooperation between the two sides.
Since the normalization of relations between the UAE and Israel, we will witness for the first time discussions and consultations, investment and trade opportunities and scientific and medical cooperation.
The new Embassy of the United Arab Emirates is located in the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange building.
On Tuesday night, half a day before the opening of the embassy, the first agricultural cooperation agreement between the Zionist regime and the UAE was also signed.
The UAE ’ s Minister of Food and Water Security said: “The UAE and Israel have many challenges in terms of food security.
"We are finding creative and practical solutions to these challenges."
In response to the opening of the UAE embassy, the spokesman for the Palestinian Islamic Jihad said the embassy may have been built on the ruins of the home of a Palestinian family displaced in 1948.
Tariq Salami, spokesman for the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, said that it will be recorded in history when the crimes of the occupation regime in Jerusalem, the destruction of houses and the raid on the Al-Aqsa mosque intensified, the UAE leaders will open their embassy in occupied Palestine.
Even the Palestinian Authority, which is pursuing the activation of the reconciliation process with the Zionist regime, has called the UAE ’ s action a “betrayal ”.
Abbas Zaki, a senior member of the Palestinian Fatah movement, pointed out that the UAE has granted Emirati citizenship to 7,000 Israelis after signing a normalization agreement with the Zionist regime, warning about the influence of the Zionist movement in the UAE.
Zaki went on to address Arab leaders, including Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, saying, “If the doors of the United Arab Emirates are opened to grant citizenship to the Zionists, you will perish and you will not be able to stop the expansion of the Zionist movement. ”
The Fatah member at the end separated the account of the nation of the UAE from the account of the government of the country, saying that the traitor is the only person of Mohammed bin Zayed.
This is while Mahmoud Abbas, within the framework of a committee affiliated with the PA, has proposed a plan to revive so-called peace talks with Israel.
The reopening of the Beit al-Sharq Institute and other Palestinian institutions that have been closed in East Jerusalem since 2001, the return to the old status of the Al-Aqsa Mosque, stopping the displacement of Palestinians from their homes in Jerusalem, and the halt of settlement development, including construction in Jerusalem, are some of the clauses of this plan.

title: Climate Change: From Iran to the World
text:
The Hamshahri newspaper published a note by Seyyed Mohammad Mehdi Mirzaei Qomi, the head of the National Center for Climate Change, and wrote: According to the latest report of the World Economic Forum, out of the five main risks to human life, four risks are related to the environment and climate change.
In recent years, climate change and global warming have caused irreparable damage to some countries.
Studies have shown that the Middle East and North Africa region will suffer the most economic losses from global warming, while European and North American countries will suffer the least.
In Iran, evidence such as increasing average temperature in the country, decreasing rainfall, increasing frequency and severity of severe environmental events (such as floods and droughts) indicate the increasing incidence of global warming and climate change effects in the country.
Extensive environmental studies show that Iran is more vulnerable to climate change than the world average.
On the other hand, climate change has tangible effects on Iran; increasing the frequency of severe environmental events such as heat waves (very hot days) in the southeast and very cold days in the northwest, a 40% increase in torrential rains and dry days in the west and southeast of the country, drought and the creation of dust springs in the country and the region, which has led to an increase in the occurrence of dust in the cities of the southwest and southeast of the country.
Reduction of surface water runoff in the spring and reduction of hydropower generation, soil erosion and poverty of vegetation cover of the country ’ s rangelands, and the emergence of social issues such as economic consequences in the villages and the growth of migration from the villages to the periphery of the cities and the adverse social and economic consequences of marginalization and loss of rural capital.
Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide have the ability to absorb infrared waves from sunlight reflecting off the Earth ’ s surface.
The absorption of energy by gas molecules causes the molecule to move and increase its energy.
When this happens on a large scale, it ’ s like covering the ground with a blanket.
Rising temperatures in the Earth ’ s atmosphere will warm the Earth ’ s land, oceans, and temperatures, resulting in changes on the planet.
Polar glaciers are melting and sea levels are rising.
The climate, which has been stable for a long period of time, has undergone dramatic changes, leading to increased heat waves and changes in rainfall patterns that have led to phenomena such as drought, fires and floods.
After carbon dioxide is released, it remains in the atmosphere for about 40 years, and the more it is released on the surface of the Earth, the more severe the changes caused by rising temperatures.
All of these results are seen in conditions where the temperature change of the Earth during the last two centuries has been about one degree Celsius.
According to forecasts, it is very likely that with the doubling of carbon dioxide concentrations in the atmosphere, the temperature increase in the remaining years until the end of the 21st century in Iran will be 4.5 degrees Celsius.
This increase in temperature will naturally lead to more severe consequences of climate change in the country.
Considering the depletion of underground water resources, which in the current situation provide more than 55% of the country ’ s water needs, the drought crisis in the future will be one of the serious risks of economic and social development in the country due to climate change and global warming.
In such a situation, monitoring and managing the impacts of climate change can reduce these damages to some extent and prevent the total destruction of production capacity.
Therefore, now changing and modifying the production pattern of agricultural products to produce less water, reforming the pattern of water consumption in different sectors, especially agriculture, reforming the consumption pattern of food and agricultural products towards optimal consumption and reduction of waste, management and control of soil erosion, improving the productivity of production resources, using more non-fossil energy, managing the construction of water structures, is not a choice but an inevitable necessity in the face and management of the consequences of climate change. It's in the country.
Also, addressing the different levels of people ’ s knowledge, perception, and practice about climate change must first be done at the local level and where specific changes can be calculated to provide a basis for shaping decisions and policies at higher levels.
According to the latest estimates, Iran in terms of carbon dioxide emissions, after China, the United States, India, Russia, Japan and Germany, with 0.72 gigatons per year, ranks seventh of the countries with the highest emissions and per capita greenhouse gas emissions relative to the population, after countries such as Japan, Germany and Poland, ranked 11th in the world.
The study of the country ’ s greenhouse gas emissions period shows that although at some point, reduction in final energy demand and reduction in crude oil production during 1393 and 1394 led to a small reduction in greenhouse gas emissions in these years, overall, Iran ’ s greenhouse gas emissions have doubled over the past 16 years (2009-2017).
On average, about 75% of the world ’ s greenhouse gas emissions are related to the combustion of fossil fuels from the energy sector (energy production and conversion in the supply and consumption of energy carriers in the demand sector), compared to more than 83% in Iran.
Therefore, much attention to reducing greenhouse gas emissions needs to be focused on optimizing the energy sector.
Forecasts suggest that the energy sector will account for more than 80% of greenhouse gas emissions in the coming years.
According to the results of the third national report, the key sub-sectors of the energy sector in greenhouse gas emissions are power plants, transportation, industries (especially steel and cement) and the domestic sector.
The modeling shows that by 2030, the transportation subsector will surpass the power subsector, accounting for more than 25% of the energy sector ’ s greenhouse gas emissions.
According to the report, assuming the current trend of greenhouse gas emissions growth in the country (independent of the country ’ s economic and demographic planning), the expected emissions in the energy sector, from about 670 in 2010, will reach about 1100 million tons of carbon dioxide equivalent in 2030.
According to the studies, taking into account macroeconomic development plans such as economic growth of 5.5% and population growth of 1.5% per year by 2030, the amount of emissions from the energy sector will be over 1800 million tons of carbon dioxide in 2030.
Also, assuming the reduction of energy intensity in accordance with the law of consumption pattern correction from 2020, the emissions will reach about 615.4 million tons of equivalent carbon dioxide in 2030.
Most emissions-reduction measures in Iran, while requiring initial investment, are economically profitable and will be accompanied by a return on investment.
For example, estimates indicate the need for an investment of about $750 million to collect flares and inject them into the line, with a return of about $1,600 million per year (six-month return period) and a 7% reduction in the country ’ s greenhouse gas emissions.
In another case, it is estimated that with an investment of $12 billion in power plants, the return on investment of $450 million per year will occur and reduce the country ’ s greenhouse gas emissions by 5%.

title: We need a strategic policy in the field of home theater – the next decade, the decade of the image
text:
Seyed Abbas Salehi attended the public meeting of the Islamic Consultative Assembly on Monday in response to the question of Seyed Mojtaba Mahfouzi, the representative of the people of Abadan about the lack of control, supervision and observance of Islamic rules and the promotion of social anomalies in the home theater network, explained: The subject of home serials has opportunities and risks from different angles.
In the field of opportunities and platforms that have home serials, in the space of the economy of culture and art, a significant part of the culture and art economy is focused on this area.
The US $100 billion revenue from Salehi ’ s home series at the initial opportunity to answer the question of the Abadan representative stated: “In recent years, in the United States, on average, $100 billion a year is the revenue of this field. ”
In the area of our neighboring countries, Turkey is today the largest producer of domestic and television series after the United States, with 150 Turkish series exported to more than 100 countries.
Perhaps a small, unnamed town like Sugut, with a population of 12,000, became a familiar city in the world for appearing in the 150-episode series The Artoghl Uprising, two hours to two and a half hours each.
Therefore, the discussion of domestic production series has found an important place in the world, both from an economic and cultural perspective.
Our country cannot be indifferent to this process, both from an economic and cultural perspective.
That is, if we cannot place our domestic production in a space, we will naturally be a growing consumer of regional or Western products.
Salehi continued: Add to these issues the conditions of the coronavirus that we have been in for the past one and a half years, and quarantine conditions have required that people stay more at home, less in crowded environments, and naturally, in such conditions, home serials have become doubly important.
He added that along with these platforms, opportunities, necessities and requirements, there should also be a pathological look and attention to risks.
The Ministry of Culture and Islamic Guidance advances these two views together.
There are three main risks in the home series, the Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance said: In the field of hazards, three main risks can be raised in the space of home serials.
The first is the content risk.
Weakness of content, superficial and vulgar content, as well as possible anomalies and deviations from moral, religious, political and social regulations.
The second issue is consumer rights.
If a series is not so stretch and wants to prolong it by watering it; just as water in the tap is a waste of consumer rights, a series that does not have the content, content, story and form necessary and just wants to continue for income, is a waste of consumer rights.
Answer: The third issue is the economics of serialization.
That serialization funding sources are transparent financial sources and at least relative reliability.
Given these three main issues in the space of the Ministry of Culture and Islamic Guidance, it has taken some measures in the past two years and has done a more fundamental work, which is to present a regulation to the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution in areas where it wants wider powers and needs to be regulated.
The representative of the people of Abadan continued: Why does the Ministry of Culture and Islamic Guidance not pay attention to the culture and not to any program for Islamic Guidance?
Does the Ministry have a plan to curb the ultra-imagined vagueness of the home theater network, which is currently engaged in the promotion and normalization of prostitution and the promotion and propagation of Westernized culture, or does the Ministry assume that this is not one of its duties?
A ministry that has no name and no title.
Emphasizing on receiving the full screenplay of Salehi series in the second part, in response to the question of the safe, pointed to the actions of the Ministry of Culture and Islamic Guidance, adding: "There are two councils" license making "and" license showing "in the field of the home screen network, and first, any screenplay that should be licensed must first receive a principled agreement, that its initial plan approved and in the second stage is required to be submitted to the full script.
The Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance explained: "Previously, the general idea of the series or the film should have been presented as a passing review, but now the entire script should be presented to the council and the members of the council see and during the scriptwriting, which is the main essence of the series of films and series, during its construction, consultants come to the help of the screenwriter to solve the problems as much as possible."
The primary focus is to have a good script, and this good script is carefully read by the licensing council.
Salehi pointed out that before, sometimes a version or a first ring that was presented to the Butterfly Council would continue, but now they must bring at least five or six loops of the series to receive the issue of the license to screen and show, in addition, at each stage at least three copies must be presented in advance in the Council of the Show, if there is a reform opportunity.
He pointed to the corrective records in the home show series and added: "Usually, the series are shown weekly, if there is a correction in the same week that there is a chance to correct two or three weeks later, so when we get five or six rings at the beginning and receive at least three rings of the show, it helps in this way to be more confident."
Transparency of financial resources for the production license / ownership license Salehi said about the financial issues of films and series: Currently, any film and TV series that wants to receive a production license must first have a financial self-statement that clearly indicates where the financial resources of the film are provided.
The Minister of Culture emphasized that after making the film, obtaining the ownership license is also a requirement because it should be determined who the owners of the film or series are the shareholders and investors; these are the path that we have taken over the past year according to the authorities of the ministry itself.
Referring to the presentation of a regulation to the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution in the year 99, he added: "This regulation has been discussed in two sessions at the Council, and we hope that its final stages will be passed and the main scene of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution will be approved, which will provide more confidence to take advantage of the many opportunities of domestic series and, on the other hand, its threats and risks will be reduced."
The necessity of forming a supranational council emphasized: The supervising and licensing council for films and series of home shows should be a supranational council.
The Ministry of Culture should have the title of secretarial responsibility and chairmanship of a meeting, but a council similar to the press supervision board should be formed and along with the Ministry of Culture, representatives from the seminaries, the Cultural Commission of the Majlis, the Broadcasting and the Islamic Propaganda Organization should be present to build trust in a timely manner.
The Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance stated that investment in industry (home theater) requires investment security and should not be changed by changing governments.
It is an economy that needs a secure backing that we can guarantee with a potential council.
The present and future decade is the decade of images and serials.
Both the economics of culture and art, as well as the identity and diplomacy of countries, depend on the series, as exemplified in Turkey, South Korea and the United Kingdom, which carry out their cultural expansion and cultural influence and cultural diplomacy through the series.
The Minister of Culture stated, “If we want to create a defensive diplomacy against the consumption of foreign series, as well as aggressive diplomacy to export our revolutionary, Islamic and Iranian culture in the region of the world, we need a strategic policy in the field of serials and home shows. ”
He said: “We are looking to create a combination of opportunity and attention to risks.
We have taken steps with the authority of the Ministry itself, but there are steps that are related to the regulation.
We hope that the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution will review and approve it sooner.
After the explanations and answers of the Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance, the Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly said that the points raised about cultural issues and the damage of the home network series were right and proper.
Mr. Mahfouzi said he would not put the question to a vote because in this regard, responsibility has been taken from the Ministry of Culture and given to IRIB, and it is expected that IRIB will pay serious attention.

title: UK and France work together to tackle illegal immigration
text:
Under the agreement, which was published on the British government ’ s website, the French agreed to double the number of agents along the seashore and increase the area under surveillance by buying appropriate equipment to prevent migrants from crossing into the UK.
They will also use British funding to create more shelters for refugees in France to discourage them from immigrating to the UK.
The agreement was signed between Gerald Darmanin and Priti Patel, the French and British foreign ministers.
Under the deal, most of the operations are to be focused in France to stop the flow of migrants in the first place.
France says it has blocked 7,500 migrants from moving to the UK.
According to official figures from the UK government, around 8,000 people have illegally immigrated to the UK on 345 boats.
The last time it reached 416,000 was in September, a new record.
A French MP says Britain ’ s coastal border with France is long and £54m is not enough to prevent migrants from entering the country.
He also believes that Paris is not responsible for tracking migrants in the waters between the two countries.
Britain insists the French side should intervene and return the migrants.
Meanwhile, the UK is trying to make the country an unattractive place for migrants with strict rules.
The Home Office says it has taken significant steps to tackle the problem of illegal immigration.
Last April, the ministry made changes to the immigration system to make it harder for people who enter the country illegally.
According to Home Secretary Priti Patel, people who enter the UK illegally will not have the same rights as people who enter the UK legally.
Many refugees, including women and children, have died en route to the UK, claiming the new asylum system will work faster and more fairly and better to protect vulnerable people.
Britain ’ s interior minister said that the way to prevent the death of refugees is to prevent human trafficking, claiming that the new measures by the London government have created a safe and legal route for immigration to the country.
“So if you enter the UK illegally through a safe country where you could apply for asylum, you ’ re not actually seeking asylum to escape an immediate danger, you ’ re choosing the UK as your destination. ”
The bill is currently under consideration in the UK Parliament, and if passed, intentional illegal immigration to the UK would be criminalized, with a maximum penalty of four years.
Meanwhile, activists and human rights activists called the British proposal “inhumane ” and similar to the policies of the former US president and warned against repeating the fate of Donald Trump.
During his four years in office, Trump has implemented the most severe immigration policies against Muslim-majority countries.

title: Britain and France agree to stop asylum seekers crossing the English Channel
text:
The French government will double the number of police patrols on its shores as part of an agreement with Britain to stop migrants from crossing the Channel, PA Media said.
The plan coincides with an unprecedented increase in illegal crossings across the English Channel.
The French and British interior ministers announced the deal, saying Britain would pay France £54 million as a contribution to the cost of increased police patrols.
The Home Office said the two countries would also improve information sharing and use better technology to identify and deal with organizers of the illegal passage of asylum seekers and migrants through the Channel.
The number of people crossing the English Channel from the French coast to Britain has risen sharply this year.
Last year, the number of people who made it to Britain in this way reached 8,461 for the entire year, a significant increase from the previous year's figure of 1850.
This year, the number was higher in the first seven months of the year.
At least 430 migrants crossed the canal on Monday alone, a new record in a single day.
The highest single day crossing ever recorded was 416 people in September last year.
The Home Office said 287 migrants who had crossed the Channel by boat had reached the British coast yesterday.
Image source, PA Media explaining the picture, Priti Patel has said the new law will be effective in reducing illegal crossings of Manche On Tuesday, British and French interior ministers Priti Patel and Gerald Darmanen announced the achievement of an agreement to “strengthen bilateral cooperation ” in this regard.
The Home Office said France, with Britain ’ s support, doubled the number of police officers stationed on its northern coast last year.
According to the report, French authorities have been able to double the number of blocked migrants crossing the Channel in the first seven months of the year to the same number last year.
The report added that “people who organise illegal Channel crossings and facilitate the arrival of migrants to the UK ’ s shores have also changed their methods.
"They no longer limit this risky journey to places on the French coast as close to the UK as they are to the UK, and they are sending migrants from further afield and on riskier journeys."
The Home Office said Britain ’ s new assistance to France would allow the government to “respond to new human traffickers ’ methods by sending more security forces and installing and using the latest surveillance equipment across France ’ s northern coast. ”
Ms Patel has previously pledged to make it “impractical ” for asylum seekers and irregular migrants to cross La Mancha, and to do so she plans to pass a new law that would make it a criminal offence to enter the UK without permission.
Under the Citizenship and Borders Act, currently under consideration in the UK Parliament, there is a prison sentence of up to four years for migrants entering the UK without a permit.
The government hopes a major reform of asylum laws will deter migrants from using the Channel Pass.
But the comment has been criticized by refugee charities, which have described it as "extremist, involving unwarranted and vile acts."
In contrast, Dan O'Mahoney, head of the British Interior Ministry's Covert Channel Threat Directorate, said: "Due to the increase in illegal immigration across Europe, there has been a significant increase in Channel crossings destined for the UK using small and dangerous boats."
"Refugees should seek asylum in the first safe country they arrive in, not risk their lives by going through these dangerous crossings."
Mr O'Mahoni warned the organizers of the illegal passage that "we will continue to pursue and prosecute the criminals behind these perilous journeys".
According to the official, the Citizenship and Borders Act “protects human life and breaks the cycle of illegal passage. ”
He has said the government will continue to bring back people who do not have the legal right to remain in the UK.
In contrast, Amnesty International ’ s Steve Valdez Simmonds told the BBC that the new law represents an “extremely reckless and dangerous reaction ” to the phenomenon and does not address the main problem of smuggling refugees and migrants.
He believes the new approach could cause those who arrive illegally to the UK to fear contact with authorities and public and official organisations, thus exposing them to exploitation and enslavement by abusers.
Nick Thomas Simmonds, Labour ’ s shadow interior minister, slammed the interior ministry ’ s announcement, saying it was “a continuation of the Conservative government ’ s empty talk about a deal with France that apparently should target human trafficking gangs. ”

title: Britain and France agree £54 million to stop illegal immigration
text:
The UK government has announced a £54 million agreement with the French government to coordinate between the two countries to prevent migrants from crossing the French border and entering the UK.
A new agreement has been signed between French Interior Minister Gerald Darmanin and British Interior Minister Priti Patel and will come into force in the coming days.
Under the agreement, the number of police officers guarding French beaches will double and surveillance will increase.
The UK is trying to stop migrants from crossing the French border and entering the UK illegally.
The agreement extends patrols in coastal areas throughout northern France between Boulogne and Dunkirk and the northwest around Dieppe.
Patel told the British Parliament on 19 July: “For years people have risked their lives to enter our country illegally, who cross the canal in dangerous little boats to seek asylum.
If there were simple or straightforward solutions, the problem would have been solved by now.
"But illegal entry into the UK and its subsequent claims of asylum have become a complex matter of nature."
He said it was illegal to enter British waters without permission.
Those who bring them here and facilitate illegal entry are now sentenced to life imprisonment.
This criminal and exploitative behavior can now be punished with the severity and competence that the Interior Minister deserves.

title: The best films of the second decade of the 21st century, selected by critics, are also Farhadi ’ s separation
text:
Metacritic lists films that have been released in the past decade, from 2010 to 2019, and have received the highest ratings from critics on Metacritic.
These films may have won an Oscar or been overlooked in the awards season, but critics and analysts consider them to be the best films of the past decade, with critics writing the most positive reviews and loving them.
The interesting thing is that we have among the first 15 films of the list of the two films of 2019.
“Parasite ” by Bong Joon Ho and“ The Irishman ” by Martin Scorsese.
In the first 15 films, there was a documentary called “I ’ m Not Your Negro. ”
But the most important thing for us is the presence of an Iranian film among the first 15 films of the last decade.
Asghar Farhadi ’ s “A Rare Separation from Simin ” was the 12th most popular film by critics in the past decade.
Learn about the first fifteen films on the critics list, and at the end of the article you can read the names of the sixteenth and fifteenth films, respectively.
Boyhood Original Title: Boyhood Director: Richard Linklater Cast: Ethan Hawke, Patricia Arquette Metacritic Rating: 100 out of 100 Critics fell in love with him from the first film release.
Part of this interest was due to the film production process, which lasted more than a decade.
When production began, the lead actor, Alaar Coltran, was six years old, and Linklater spent twelve years portraying different parts of his life.
Filming began without the full film.
There is no story in that sense in “boyhood, ” only to follow the daily life of a boy whose parents are separated.
From childhood until college.
The film received Oscar nominations in major categories, but only Arquette received the award for Best Supporting Actress.
Moonlight Original Title: Moonlight Director: Barry Jenkins Cast: Mahershala Ali, Naomi Harris Metacritic Score: 99 out of 100 Barry Jenkins' second feature film became a big deal.
The film tells the story of a young African-American man struggling with his identity and gender.
In addition, we see his challenges in childhood, adolescence and adulthood.
He has many cultural and family problems and lives in a slum.
Her father abandons them and her mother is an addict until she is guided by a man who is a drug dealer.
The film won three Oscars for Best Screenplay, Best Actor and Best Picture.
Critics say, like Brokeback Mountain a decade ago, Moonlight is a piece of art that can change the lives of its audience.
Roma Original Title: Roma Director: Alfonso Cuarón Cast: Yalitz Aparicio Metacritic Score: 96 out of 100 Mexican director Alfonso Cuarón returned to his hometown in Hollywood after making films like “Gravity ” and“ Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban ” and made a very personal film this time.
The film is about the poor nanny of a middle-class family, what happens in the early 1970s in the political and social situation in Mexico, and the impact on the woman and the family.
The film is black and white, and Cuaron has been able to provide a completely realistic feel with an experimental narrative of those days.
Everything takes place in a relaxed and intimate way, and critics love the details that Cuarón takes into account when making the film.
Manchester by the Sea Original title: Manchester by the Sea Director: Kenneth Lonergan Cast: Casey Affleck, Michelle Williams Metacritic Score: 96 out of 100 Best Screenplay and Best Actor This tragic drama tells the story of a man who is forced to return to his hometown after years because of his nephew.
In flashbacks, we learn how and why he left his home and has lived like a doorman all these years.
But the man begins to get along with the townspeople and manages to get along with his nephew.
The film has a few minutes of Adagio music in which Casey Affleck ’ s performance is brilliant and one of the best sequences in the film.
Lonergan is an expert at creating a different and breathtaking sequence with a familiar start.
12 Years a Slave Director: Steve McQueen Cast: Brad Pitt, Dee Gardner, Michael Fassbender Metacritic Score: 96 out of 100 Solomon Northrop is a free African-American man who works as a violin player and lives in New York City with his wife and children.
Two white men offer him to come to Washington and perform with them.
They poison and kidnap Solomon and take him south.
Where slavery is still in vogue, Solomon is now a slave whose misfortune befalls bad men.
The movement for black people at the Oscars almost started with this film.
Critics highly praised the film.
They believe McQueen has turned a historic event into a tragic piece of art.
Gravity Director: Alfonso Cuaron Cast: George Clooney, Sandra Bullock Metacritic Score: 96 out of 100 movies about space and what happens outside of Earth entered a new phase with Alfonso Cuaron ’ s “Gravity ” in 2013.
The film tells the story of two astronauts who find their spacecraft in trouble outside the Earth's atmosphere, and the two are released into space.
One of them dies, and the other must find his way back to Earth on his own.
The film won seven Oscars.
His most important award was the Academy Award for Best Director, and beyond that, he won all the technical categories.
The cinematography of Emmanuel Lubetsky is astounding, and Cuaron is one of the most ambitious films of the last decade.
Original title Parasite Director: Bong Joon Ho Actors: Kang Hoo Sung Metacritic Score: 96 out of 100 South Korean director Bong Joon Ho was featured in Hollywood with “Snow Shredder ”, but“ Parasite ” is a big deal for him and Korean cinema.
The film “Parasite ” deals with Bong Joon-ho ’ s favorite subject of class difference.
The son of a very poor family, who is not much of a workaholic, happens to be the tutor of the daughter of a rich family.
He gradually introduces all his family members to the rich family and finds work for them.
But these lies have a terrible ending.
A film that critics believe is both a sociological and artistic work on the psychology of money and class difference.
Carol Original Title: Carol Director: Todd Haines Actors: Cate Blanchett, Ronnie Mara Metacritic Rating: 95 out of 100 bold independent films made in 2015, Todd Haines was surprisingly impressed by the awards season.
Despite its unusual subject for Academy members, the film was nominated for six Oscars, and the two main actors really deserved to take home the Oscars, which they didn ’ t.
Set in 1950s New York City, Ronnie Mara plays an aspiring photographer who happens to meet a woman who has a daring spirit and is a few years older than her.
Critics say that the directors and actors are at the top of their power.
It ’ s a beautiful film that slowly leads and the use of reflection in mirrors and glass is brilliant.
Director: David Fincher Cast: Jesse Eisenberg, Justin Timberlake, Andrew Garfield Metacritic Score: 95 out of 100 Mark Zuckerberg is a Harvard student.
He has problems with his girlfriend and is completely isolated.
One day, he comes up with the idea of a social network through which people all over the world can become friends.
But two twin brothers sue him and believe he stole their idea.
In court, Zuckerberg does not value the judge, the jury, or them.
He is pursuing his own dreams.
The film won three Oscars and actually deserved the Best Picture Oscar.
With a wonderful rhythm and a sharp, biting script.
He is one of David Fincher ’ s most powerful directors.
I Am Not Your Negro Original Title: I Am Not Your Negro Director Raoul Peck Narrator: Samuel L. Jackson Metacritic Rating: 95 out of 100 The 93-minute documentary is inspired by an unfinished manuscript by James Baldwin.
A collection of notes and letters he wrote in the 1970s.
Memories of how his close friends and leaders of the anti-discrimination movement, including Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, lived and what they did for human rights equality.
The film was nominated for an Oscar, but ultimately failed to take home the Oscar.
Critics say the film was shocking when it came to telling its story.
One of the best films ever made about human rights.
30 Minutes Midnight Original Title: Zero Dark Thirty Director: Kathryn Bigelow Cast: Jessica Chastain, Chris Pratt, Joel Edgarton Metacritic Score: 95 out of 100 Kathryn Bigelow made “30 Minutes Midnight ” after“ The Panic Locker ” about the US presence in Iraq and a bomb disposal.
Thirty Minutes of Midnight tells the story of a decade of trying to capture or kill the head of al-Qaeda terrorist Osama bin Laden, who was responsible for the 9 / 11 attacks.
The film shows how a decade later he is killed by the US Air Force.
The camera on hand conveys a lot of tension, and Bigelow ’ s directorial style gives you an accurate sense and a real understanding of the operation to find and kill bin Laden.
A Separation from Simin Original Title: A Separation Director: Asghar Farhadi Actors: Leila Hatami, Peyman Maadi Metacritic Score: 95 out of 100 years 2011 was a big event for Iranian cinema.
Asghar Farhadi made the film “A Separation from Simin ” which was able to add an Oscar to the list of honors of Iranian cinema for the first time.
The film reflects the concerns of Iran ’ s middle class.
Simin wants to emigrate from Iran for their daughter, but Nader, whose father has Alzheimer ’ s, is against it.
Nader and Simin decide to separate, while a nurse who comes to take care of Nader ’ s father makes an incident that questions morality.
Critics praise the film ’ s strong drama and believe it depicts a nerve-wracking slice of people ’ s lives.
Before Midnight Original Title: Before Midnight Director: Richard Linklater Cast: Julie Delpy, Ethan Hawke Metacritic Score: 94 out of 100 Richard Linklater ’ s love trilogy on how people connect with each other ends Before Midnight.
Jesse and Celine are now married and have been married for years.
The point is that they still talk to each other about different things in life, and of course, now that the early days of love are over, they have disagreements about everyday life, like many other couples.
But they learned to listen to each other.
The film is a rare cinematic achievement that offers a new understanding of the secrets of intimate communication.
That ’ s the end of the road that Linklater and his actors started with “Before Dawn ” in 1995 and ended in 2013.
Director: Christopher Nolan Cast: Mark Rylance Metacritic Score: 94 out of 100 Allied soldiers from Belgium, England and France are besieged by German forces in Dunkirk Bay.
They have a short period of time to retreat or a large number of people will be destroyed and the war will almost vanish.
Christopher Nolan ’ s film depicts the battle in three lines: air, sea and land.
It ’ s a movie that takes place more often in Long Shot, and it ’ s not like any of the other war movies you ’ ve seen.
It ’ s a masterpiece by Christopher Nolan that makes great movies, and it ’ s incredibly impressive.
Director Martin Scorsese Cast: Joe Pesci, Robert De Niro, Al Pacino Metacritic Score: 94 out of 100 movies that many moviegoers have been waiting for for years.
Looking forward to seeing two movie giants Robert De Niro and Al Pacino reunite on camera, waiting for Pacino to be directed by Scorsese for the first time, and waiting for the Goodfellas team to come back together and make a great gangster movie.
Scorsese ’ s final film is the story of Frank Sheeran.
One of the Mafia leaders who gets into a fight with Jimmy Hoffa.
Hoffa was a member of the board of a group that once Sheeran helped them solve their problems using mafia facilities.

title: Artin Irannejad, a young Kurdish refugee, Armeed with his family after a year
text:
Artin Irannejad, a young Kurdish refugee, was buried in the arms of his grandmother Artin Irannejad, a 15-month-old Iranian Kurdish refugee who was buried next to his mother, father, sister and brother in Sardasht after a year.
Rasoul Irannejad (35), Shiva Mohammad Panahi (35), Anita (9), Armin (6), and Artin (15) died on October 27 while crossing the English Channel.
At that time, the bodies of four family members were returned to the city of Sardasht, West Azerbaijan, but there was no sign of Artin.
Two months later, he was found in southwestern Norway, 1,000 kilometers away.
After the end of the Norwegian police investigation and the assurance of his identity, Artin Irannejad ’ s body was returned to Iran and buried yesterday morning, Friday, the first of August.
Image source, family handout Image description, Nian (right) says he kept the dress he wore in Artin ’ s last days, Nian Nian, Artin ’ s mother ’ s aunt who lives in Norway and whose DNA sample helped clarify Artin ’ s identity, told the BBC he kept the dress he wore at the time of his death, and Artin was left forever. His heart and mind will live on.
She says Artin is a symbol for refugees all over the world.
A member of the Irannejad family who visited Artin ’ s body in Sardasht told the BBC that Artin ’ s return was both pleasant and painful.
He said Artin is not the only child of the Iranian family and is the son of all the people of Kurdistan and Iran.
At the funeral of the toddler, the imam of one of Sardasht ’ s mosques lamented the death of the family, saying that hundreds of Kurdish citizens have left Iran for Europe this year, most of them young.
Since the death of Irannejad ’ s family in the English Channel, hundreds of refugees from Iran and Afghanistan have arrived in Britain in small inflatable boats.
The UK government says 8,460 asylum seekers have arrived by sea in the past eight months.
On Monday, 430 people arrived in the UK by boat from France, the highest number ever recorded in a single day.
The economic crisis in Iran and the Taliban ’ s advances in Afghanistan are expected to lead to more citizens from the two countries migrating to Europe.

Masoud Latifian, in an interview with ISNA, said that changes in Iran ’ s climate, including increased temperatures, reduced precipitation, increased atmospheric and climatic extremes, have caused widespread droughts, dust, severe floods, increased water needs of agricultural products and reduced water resources in the country, adding: “Such conditions have adverse socio-economic consequences and lead to a sharp decline in the country ’ s economic growth, which requires adaptation methods. ”
Floods and drought; affecting the increase of the population, agricultural damage factors continued: climate change and environmental events that arise suddenly in temporal and spatial conditions, significantly cause changes in habitat conditions and the distribution of resources required for pests and plant diseases.
Extreme changes, such as floods and drought, are among the most important factors affecting population increase, susceptible and aggressive damage factors for agricultural systems.
Weeds, pests and plant diseases are affected directly and indirectly after natural disasters such as floods and drought.
Latifian said that some species strategically change their lives in a way that leads to greater adaptation to environmental events.
The response of these species to environmental changes is that they change their relationship with other active species in the habitat for proper utilization of energy and food.
The effects of industrial and human activities on demographic changes of damage factors Deputy of Pest Control of Plant Protection Organization added: In addition to environmental events, environmental disturbances caused by industrial and human activity, which often cause serious changes in the ecosystem, affect the population changes of plant damage factors.

On the other hand, the effects of weather events depend on the population of damage factors depending on the type, severity, frequency and extent of the accident.
Investigating a series of events in the environment is similar to a piecemeal puzzle, whose effects on population changes of plant damage factors vary depending on the history of the events.
Latifian pointed out that the flooding and widespread drought in recent years and the general trend of drying the surface waters of the country can cause unpleasant events in the damage intensity of weeds, pests and plant diseases.
These events have created a specific sequence of environmental changes that will greatly affect the species of plant damage factors in the country.

This is because the living and non-living organisms of the environment are affected by the accident in such a way that they predispose the conditions for some plant pests in large areas.
However, such outbreaks are often possible as a result of providing more favorable feeding conditions for the remaining herbivorous pest species.
But there are also significant interactions between pest outbreaks and environmental physical factors as a result of environmental changes.
Excessive rainfall has negative effects on the pest population, pointing out that although rainfall increases the availability of water or adjusts the temperature during fires.
But excessive rainfall and flooding have negative effects on pest populations, adding that locust flooding in some parts of the world has been linked to events such as floods and droughts.
A 1,000-year history of locust flooding in China shows that destruction of locust habitat in the floodplains of the region and lack of adequate vegetation and egg-laying areas during the years of drought and the years after the occurrence of severe floods were the causes of locust flooding.

Stating that climate change adaptation is a fundamental principle for implementing risk management strategies and reducing the potential risk of climate change impacts on the country ’ s plant protection management, Latifian said, “The development of the capacity of adaptation of pest control systems to climate change conditions depends on various biological, economic and social factors. ”
