title: Japan resumes commercial whaling after three decades
text:
Japanese fishermen ’ s decision to catch whales starting Monday has sparked anger from environmental groups for the first time in more than three decades after Tokyo ’ s controversial exit from the International Whaling Commission (IWC).
While partially protected from international waters, these planned fisheries have also angered countries where whaling is considered obsolete and harmful.
But Japan, while welcoming the return of the practice, has called it a tradition not to be subjected to foreign interference and has defended it.
The whaling issue has been a diplomatic problem for Japan for years, which has been under attack by the International Whaling Commission for using loopholes as "scientific targets."
While many critics believe that Japan has no scientific value in whaling under the guise of science, the Tokyo government has continued to push for the return of commercial whaling rights in the country.
But last year, the country announced it would simply step down from the International Whaling Commission (IWC) and no longer accept a decades-long ban on commercial whaling.
The decision comes into effect on July 1, when a small fleet of ships formerly responsible for whaling for scientific purposes will begin commercial whaling from the port of Shimonoseki in western Japan.
Elsewhere in Japan, five small whaling boats from all over the country gather at the port of Kushiro for about a week in a symbolic move to celebrate the resumption of the tradition.
Japan ’ s decision to withdraw from the IWC in December sparked a wave of criticism from environmentalists and anti-whaling countries such as Australia, New Zealand and Canada.
The decision comes after years of efforts by Japan to persuade the International Whaling Commission to resume commercial whaling on the grounds that some species are sufficient to support re-fishing.
The decision means Japan will end its controversial expeditions in Antarctic waters and instead catch minke and other whales commercially near its shores.
Japan has been whaling for centuries and used its meat as a key source of protein in the post-World War II years when the country was in extreme poverty.
But consumption of whale meat has declined significantly in recent decades, and many Japanese say they rarely or never eat it.
Therefore, environmental activists have been pressuring Japan to stop the practice.
Wildlife conservation groups from around the world have sent a letter to G20 leaders, who met in the Japanese city of Okasa last week, calling for an immediate end to commercial whaling.
The president of the International Compassion Association has said that Japan ’ s withdrawal from the International Whaling Committee and its refusal to comply with international law to achieve its ambitious trade goals is treacherous and short-sighted.
Japanese authorities also claim that the scale of whaling off beaches for commercial purposes is too small compared to whaling in the northern ocean for scientific purposes.
End of message.

title: Japan has stopped hunting.
text:
Japan is officially resuming commercial whaling and plans to kill 227 whales this year.
While many environmentalists have objected to the restoration of commercial hunting licenses, others see it as part of a policy of “the honorable end ” of the decaying whaling industry.
Japanese ships were allowed to resume their whaling activities on Monday.
It was only a day after Tokyo officially withdrew from the International Whaling Commission.
The International Whaling Commission includes countries that have come together to support whale populations and promote what is called the “right whaling industry. ”
The United States, China, Russia, India and most European countries are members of the Commission.
Japan ’ s exit from the commission comes after the international body rejected Tokyo ’ s offer to hunt unendangered species of whales.
Meanwhile, Japan has announced that it is ending its controversial Antarctic whaling campaign.
The hunt brought with it widespread international protests.
Last year, Japanese whale-hunting vessels caught at least 333 minke whales, or small fin whales, for what they described as "scientific research."
Minke whales are one of the smallest toothless whales, up to 10 meters long and weigh between 4 and 5 tons.
Japan ’ s official return to commercial whaling has been met with protests from activists and environmentalists.
The protests have also been echoed in Japan itself, though activists are working harder in that country than outside of Japan.
Takayo Yamaguchi, an anti-whaling activist in Japan, once told The Times of Japan that he was facing online harassment, cyberattacks and even death threats.
However, fishing, whaling, and other aquatic species are also tied to the “nationalist ” feelings of the Japanese people, with Japan ’ s non-conservative parties calling for the preservation of the“ whaling tradition. ”
On the other hand, attacks and protests by foreign activists have been repeatedly construed as “racism ” against the Japanese people, which in turn creates widespread reactions in the country.
In some cases, the activities of some foreign anti-fishing groups, such as the “shepherd of the sea ” led by Captain Paul Watson, have also become sensitive.
The Japanese government and even Greenpeace have accused the group of “eco-terrorism ” or violent activities.
The group says it is not enough to simply observe and inform the hunt, and that "practical action" must be taken against the hunters.
Countries and anti-whaling groups are calling for a ban.
Countries such as Japan, Norway and Iceland kill nearly 1,500 whales and tens of thousands of dolphins each year for their meat and oil.
Some of these whales took about 25 minutes to die.
Greenpeace says commercial whale hunting for its oil has led to the threat of many of its species.
The Japanese government's resumption of commercial whaling licences is seen by a group as a "honorable way" to end a declining whaling industry.

title: Austria becomes first EU country to ban glyphosate herbicide
text:
For years, environmental protection agencies have been warning about the carcinogenicity of glyphosate.
In some EU countries, the use of this chemical is restricted to some extent.
On July 2, the Austrian parliament voted to ban glyphosate altogether.
Glyphosate is a chemical toxin that kills all grass and does not only work on genetically modified seeds.
It is used on farms where crops are grown.
Glyphosate was produced by the American Monsanto Company in 1974.
Germany ’ s Bayer bought Monsento in September 2018, so Bayer now faces 13,400 complaints from people who blame their cancer on glyphosate.
The call by the Austrian Social Democratic Party for a complete ban on glyphosate was approved by a majority of votes, with the support of the Austrian Freedom Party.
Austria ’ s transitional government does not currently have a fixed majority, and decisions in parliament are made by varying majorities.
Pamela Rendi-Wagner, president of the Austrian Social Democratic Party, said of her party ’ s proposed bill: “There is more scientific evidence proving that this herbicide is carcinogenic. ”
Doubts about the use of glyphosate increased especially when the World Health Organization classified it as “a substance that can cause cancer. ”
However, Bayer does not accept this accusation.
A general ban on glyphosate in the EU is currently not possible, as its use has already been allowed in the EU until the end of 2022.
According to a spokesman for the Austrian Ministry of Environmental Protection, the "absolute" prohibition of glyphosate in Austria is in principle contrary to EU law.
The EU has allowed its members to limit the use of the substance, rather than completely ban it.
Glyphosate is one of the most widely used herbicides in the world and is currently produced by several chemical consortia.
In Germany, Chancellor Angela Merkel announced last week that the German government would decide to ban glyphosate by September at the latest.
Glyphosate has been used in Iran for a long time.
According to Iranian media reports, companies supporting GMOs in the Islamic Republic are encouraging farmers to use GMOs and glyphosate without clarifying the risks.

title: Japan is not the only country in commercial whaling.
text:
Japan resumed commercial whaling earlier this week after leaving the International Whaling Commission (IWC), a global organization committed to protecting whales, but Japan is not the only country that has been fishing despite a ban since 1986.
According to the International Whaling Commission (IWC), Norway and Iceland continue to hunt commercial whales even though they are still members of the committee, although they object or withhold a “10-year moratorium on whaling in order to revive their populations. ”
However, these countries should hunt only within their exclusive economic zones and provide scientific data and information about their catch to the International Whaling Commission.
According to the IWC, Russia has also objected to the deadline but has not resumed commercial whaling.
In December 2018, Japan announced that it is hunting three species of whales, including the Minky, Bride and Sei.
While Minke and Bride whales are abundant, Seie whales are classified as “endangered ” according to the International Union for Conservation of Nature ’ s Red List of Threatened Species.
Experts say these animals live long and are slowly reproducing, and the added pressure of their commercial fishing, along with risk factors such as climate change and water pollution, is very dangerous for them.
According to reports, five Japanese fishing vessels caught two minke whales on Monday and took them to Japan.
The International Whaling Commission has set limits for commercial whaling in international waters.
The organization currently has 88 member states, including Australia, Brazil, China, Greenland, India, the United States and Russia.
While some countries have been members of the IWC since its founding in 1946, many such members as Mongolia, Morocco, Poland and Uruguay have joined it over the past 20 years.
Japan has long been accused of abusing the IWC exemption for "scientific whaling", which allows countries to catch whales for scientific purposes, though most of the meat is eventually sold for human consumption.
According to National Geographic, Japan killed more than 300 whales in 2016 alone, including more than 200 pieces of pregnant females.
With the withdrawal of Japan from the International Whaling Commission, they will be deprived of scientific exemptions in international waters, which means that they will have to catch whales only in their own waters.
Japan ’ s Fisheries Agency said Japan ’ s fishing quota for the rest of the year was 227 whales, far less than when it was doing “scientific fishing. ”
End of message.

title: Animal Husbandry in the World + Pictures
text:
They send a boat to find whales and dolphins in front of them.
After finding a flock of animals, other boats make terrible noises and sound walls as they move.
Frightened whales and dolphins swim to the bay, after the animals are exhausted, spears are thrust into their bodies, and the entire sea turns red.
Images of the sea of blood and the slaughter of animals have been repeatedly published in the media.
Japan is one of the countries that, as a tradition, kill large numbers of whales and dolphins.
Although environmental groups have repeatedly protested the move, the country withdrew from the International Whaling Commission (IWC) last year and resumed whaling.
Japan has been whaling for centuries, and its meat has been used as a key source of protein in the post-World War II years when the country was in extreme poverty.
Japanese fishermen also killed more than 300 large finned whales in the Antarctic Ocean last year, including 122 pregnant whales.
The country says it hunts for scientific research, while critics argue that killing whales is for commercial use and Japan sells and uses them for food.
In 2014, the International Court of Justice ruled that Japan ’ s Antarctic whaling program was not for scientific and research purposes and therefore had to be stopped.
However, Japanese authorities claim that the scale of whaling off beaches for commercial purposes is very small compared to whaling in the northern ocean for scientific purposes.
Apart from Japan, many other countries offer different animal sacrifices each year.
The killing of cows after bullfights in Spain, animal sacrifices in Haiti, the killing of whales in Denmark, and the killing of cows and sheep in Nepal and Africa are still held around the world, and in some cases, people are injured or killed.
Photographs published by Alistair Ward, a 22-year-old student at the University of Cambridge, of whaling in Sandavago Bay have received a lot of media attention.
People from the Faroe Islands in Denmark kill whales every year, and this tradition has been going on for centuries.
The Faroe Islands lie in northern Europe between the Norwegian Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean and are made up of 18 small islands.
Whale meat and tallow are a source of food for the nearly 59,000 islanders who are said to be spending the winter there.
The hunters at this ceremony guide the whales to the bay with their oars, and when they get close enough, the killing begins.
Even children participate in the ceremony.
Residents of the area consider whaling a collective activity that everyone can participate in.
They say this is done under national regulations and laws, so that the whales suffer the least amount of pain and suffering.
Many Faroe Islanders believe whaling is not incompatible with the ecosystem, and they hunt 800 pilot whales each year out of the 100,000 whales that surround the island.
Images of this massacre on social media caused a lot of reactions, and some of them, in response to the reaction of European animal rights defenders to the slaughter of animals in East Asia and Africa, wrote sarcastically: “Because Europeans are blond and white, the name of this work is not barbarism and the supply of meat, but the religious slaughter of Muslims is barbaric! ”
The Gadhimai Festival is another event in which thousands of cows and sheep are sacrificed.
The ceremony takes place every five years over two days in Nepal and is inspired by a Hindu religion in the village of Baryapur, which believes that sacrificing to the goddess Gadhimai will capture the devil and bring them happiness.
What animal rights advocates have been protesting at the festival is an unusual form of victimization.
In this place, the cattle are gathered in a field, and they are slashed from the back of the neck.
Animal rights advocates call it the largest animal slaughterhouse in the world because of its remarkable violence.
In addition to the whaling, the Gadhimai festival in Japan has another 3,500-year-old ceremony that takes place in Taiji.
This event is known for the hunt of dolphins by the people of the world.
The people of this city have long been engaged in fishing and whale or dolphin hunting.
Despite opposition, Taijis continue to do so for their food, claiming it has long been a source of livelihood and a part of their cultural identity.
Taiji ’ s history shows the existence of 400-year-old whaling weapons.
The World Health Organization (WHO) studied dolphin meat and declared the amount of toxins and mercury in the meat to be very high, warning people that high levels of mercury in dolphin meat cause diseases such as cancer, infertility and suppression of the immune system.
However, traditional Taiji fishermen continue to slaughter the animal, and its products can be seen in the city ’ s stores.
The people of Taiji send a boat out to hunt for the dolphins in the first place.
After finding a flock of dolphins, the other boats are arranged in the shape of an English letter V, making terrifying sounds and sound walls as they move.
Scared dolphins swim to the bay.
Then other boats chase them to throw their frightened dolphins ashore and crash into the rocks.
After the dolphins are exhausted, the spears are thrust into the bodies of these animals and the entire sea turns red.
Among the wounded dolphins, the more beautiful ones are hunted for aquariums and circuses.
In Taiji, Haiti, there is also a ceremony in which animals are killed.
Voodoo believers gather in the country in April and declare their obedience to their gods by sacrificing animals, dancing and playing music.
After the sacrifice, they pour the warm blood of the animal into a container and drink it.
Those present in the ceremony, dressed in white, shed some of this blood on themselves, and while believing that they are under the control of the spirits, they jump into the water and continue to worship.
Wearing white clothes with blood symbolizes adherence to voodoo.
Followers of the cult have combined drum dancing as an African tradition with traditional elements of the Catholic religion.
Millions of Haitians believe in voodoo, and the government adopted it as an official religion in 1960.
But in 2012, the Haitian Senate and House of Representatives decried Voodoo as the official religion with a constitutional amendment approved by their president, a move that caused widespread discontent among Haitian followers.
In Spain, bullfighting is also one of the most popular entertainment in the world.
San Fermin in Spain attracts many tourists every year.
The celebration of the release and running of angry cows among the crowd through the narrow alleys lasts a few minutes, but the celebration lasts for hours.
Cows enter the stadium after passing through the city center to witness the matador battle with the bulls.
In the past, due to the narrow streets and the lack of possibility of passing the cart, ranchers had to drive the cows on a short path to the stadium.
Over time, young people started running in front of the cows to show their courage.
Those who run in front of cows traditionally wear white shirts and trousers and a red necktie around their necks.
Every year, the ceremony leaves a number of injured and even killed.
At the end of the festivities in Spain, bullfighters circle the animals and kill them with decorated spears and knives.
Due to opposition to the ceremony, bullfighting festivals were banned in some Spanish cities, including the Canary Islands.
It is not only in rituals that animals are abused and slaughtered, but also in pictures and videos of the slaughter of pregnant cows in France, sheep in Australian slaughterhouses, the killing of goats in Thailand, the slaughter of camels in Mauritania, and the cooking of live pigs in Europe.

title: Cosmetic surgery, self-esteem auction
text:
According to the analysis, interpretation and news research group IRNA, the percentage of people, and especially young people, tendency to change their appearance by cosmetic surgery is increasing day by day.
Cosmetic surgery is one of the types of plastic surgery that has been done more or less by specialist physicians in the past, but at the beginning of such operations, the aim of such operations was to remove the fundamental defects in the face or body of the applicants or to repair the defects created in the appearance of people due to accidents such as burns.
In today ’ s society, beauty and its defining criteria have changed over the past years.
Although we cannot deny the innate human desire for beauty, this innate tendency is also not a good justification for the countless acts of beauty.
Meanwhile, contrary to popular belief, Iran is not the world record holder in the number of cosmetic procedures, and according to the latest report of the International Society of Plastic Surgery (ISAPS), three countries, the United States, Brazil and South Korea, are the leaders in this field, although Iran is also in the top ten.
"Self-obscenity," a disorder in favor of beauty clinics, all human beings may have experienced cosmetic defects throughout their lives.
It doesn ’ t matter how big the revenue looks.
Self-obscenity is a disorder that magnifies the smallest imperfections in the eyes of patients.
This mental disorder keeps sufferers in front of the mirror for hours so that they spend several hours a day thinking about their physical imperfections and suffering.
These people always hide their appearance from others for fear of being judged, and in many cases, they resort to cosmetic surgery to permanently remove them.
Although cosmetic surgery because it can bring the face or body closer to the mental ideals of people and relieve them of a problem that causes some discomfort, but excessive changes in the face or body by surgery can cause irreparable complications that people are not aware of before going under the knife.
As a result, many of those who have undergone cosmetic procedures for any reason express dissatisfaction with the results and wish to return to their natural and original state.
Also, since the root of the syndrome is not in large or small apparent defects, but rather in a mental disorder, the improvement of the defects that people think exist in their face or body by surgery cannot bring satisfaction and satisfaction to these patients.
As a result, some of them may decide to try several other surgeries in hopes of achieving a perfect look or feeling of inner satisfaction.
Meanwhile, the number of beauty clinics is constantly increasing; some of which have been sealed in recent years due to violations or illegal activities; clinics that in the hot and turbulent market of beauty operations, these days earn millions of dollars.
Media advertising lowers self-esteem: Although self-confidence is rooted in beliefs that a person comes to as a result of past experiences, environmental factors can also be effective in increasing or decreasing self-esteem.
Hence, widespread media advertising, including that cyberspace, can make the audience feel ugly and, as a result, lower the self-confidence of the individual.
These days, in the virtual pages, newspapers and magazines, there are advertisements for a variety of beauty operations; some of them, such as nose surgery, gel and Botox injections, jaw angling and sculpting, may be familiar to the ear, and some of them are in the category of unconventional beauty operations.
For example, cat ’ s eye surgery, changing the shape of the ear, or donkey ’ s ear surgery!, implanting jewelry in the eye, or permanently changing the color of the eye, are some of the less well-known cosmetic procedures.
Although it seems unlikely that unconventional surgeries have a lot of applicants, the reality is that some beauty clinic clients want to do it.
Many beauty service advertisers do not have a legal license to provide advertising, but they have been able to attract a number of people, especially young people, who lack confidence as a result of these advertisements, to the operating rooms of their clinics.
They convince their clients with the promise of becoming more beautiful at the lowest cost to give themselves to the surgical blade.
Apart from the fact that many people do not feel a change in their mood and confidence level after cosmetic surgery, they may also face new challenges.
The high percentage of dissatisfaction with cosmetic procedures, unforeseen complications such as asthma, sinusitis, shortness of breath, as well as serious damage to one ’ s health and even beauty, indicate that cosmetic surgery cannot be a good choice for increasing self-confidence in people.
Therefore, as experts and some officials say, the level of health literacy of people in the field of cosmetic surgery is very low, so it is necessary to inform the public about the serious and irreparable complications of some cosmetic surgeries, especially in non-reputable clinics and by doctors who are not specialized in cosmetic surgery, and promote the knowledge of the community in this vital issue.

title: The authenticity of the missing Klimt ’ s work has been confirmed.
text:
Italian authorities on Friday confirmed the authenticity of a painting by Gustav Klimt, a famous Austrian artist, that was stolen in 1997 and was recently discovered in the same Italian gallery where it was stolen.
In December, workers discovered the painting in a plastic bag hidden in one of the walls of the Ricci Odi Gallery in Piacenza.
The mayor of Piacenza and the city ’ s cultural director described the painting, which depicts a “portrait of a young woman, ” as the heart of the city ’ s cultural heritage.
The painting disappeared in February 1997.
At the time, police said that thieves used a device similar to a fishing rod to remove the painting from the wall and took it out of the gallery through a skylight that had been removed from the glass.
According to the head of cultural affairs in Piacenza, it was the second most valuable art stolen in Italy after a Caravaggio painting stolen from a church in Sicily in 1969.
Gustav Klimt was born in January 1862.
He excelled in painting, murals, drawing and other art works.
Many of his works are in the Vienna Secession gallery.
The famous Austrian painter died in 1918 at the age of 55.
End of message.

title: The sign found in the crack of the wall was an original work by Gustave Klimt
text:
Getty Images Image caption Gustav Klimt painted "Portrait of a Lady" in 1916-17, Italian authorities have confirmed that the painting, accidentally discovered last month, is an original painting by Gustav Klimt, an Austrian painter.
According to the report, the painting was stolen 23 years ago.
Portrait of a Lady was stolen from a gallery in Piacenza, northern Italy in 1997.
While cleaning the gallery ’ s garden ivy, gardeners found the painting embedded in one of the garden walls.
The painting is valued at least $66 million (£51 million).
Why the painting was hidden in a wall in the Ricci Odie Gallery of Modern Art is still unclear.
Prosecutor Ornilla Chika confirmed the painting ’ s authenticity.
He also said further tests would reveal whether the painting had been inside the wall since the theft or if it had been placed there later.
Ms Chika added that after these tests, the artwork will be displayed to the public.
Experts have confirmed its authenticity by examining the panel under infrared and ultraviolet radiation and comparing it with images taken in 1996.
Photo copyright RAI TV Image caption The painting was found inside the crack in a wall in the gallery, London's National Gallery bought a female painter's painting after 27 years, a trip of 50 Iranian paintings to London by art expert Guido Kazi, who said the work was in "relatively good" condition and only required some routine care.
Portrait of a Lady was painted in 1916-17 by Gustav Klimt, a Viennese painter.
Giuseppe Ricci Odi bought the painting in 1925 and kept it in the gallery.
On February 22, 1997, the painting was stolen in preparation for a special exhibition.
The frame of the painting was thrown away on the roof of the gallery building to make it look like thieves broke the frame to pass the painting through the window overlooking the roof.
But this window was too small to pass the painting.
In December last year, gardeners who were cleaning the ivy noticed a crack in the wall, inside which was a black bag containing the missing painting.
The ivy that covered the wall had not been cut in nearly 10 years.
Shortly before the painting was stolen, an art student discovered that it had been painted on another painting by Gustav Klimt, Portrait of a Young Lady, which had not been seen since 1912.
To prove his theory, the student persuaded the director of the Piacenza Gallery to take an X-ray of the painting.
The original painting belonged to a young girl from Vienna who had died.
Following her sudden death, Gustav Klimt painted "Portrait of a Lady" on "Portrait of a Young Lady" to forget her death.

title: Changing the way food is produced for the benefit of the earth
text:
At recent meetings of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) in Geneva, environmental scientists have warned that efforts to address the climate crisis “solely by reducing carbon emissions from cars, factories and power plants ” are doomed to fail.
A leaked draft report on climate change and land use, now being discussed by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) in Geneva, stressed that keeping global temperatures at safe levels would be impossible without changing how the world produces food and uses.
The report warns that humanity is currently exploiting 72 percent of the world ’ s ice-free surface to feed, clothe and support the planet ’ s growing population.
Agriculture, forestry and other land uses account for about a quarter of greenhouse gas emissions.
In addition, almost half of all methane emissions, one of the most important greenhouse gases, come from cattle ranches and rice fields, and deforestation and loss of peat land emits significant levels of carbon emissions.
The impact of intensive agriculture, which has contributed to the world ’ s growing population, has also increased soil erosion and reduced the amount of organic matter in the land.
These problems are likely to escalate in the future.
Climate change increases land degradation through increased rainfall intensity, flooding, the intensity and frequency of droughts, heat stress, winds, sea level rise and wave yield.
These analyses reveal the risks facing our planet as greenhouse gas emissions rise, following the onset of a range of extreme climate events.
These include a fall in Arctic sea ice cover in July, heatwaves that recently swept Europe, and a rise in global temperatures 1.2 ° C above pre-industrial levels last month.
These statistics are very dangerous and worrisome, as a global temperature rise of more than 1.5 ° C increases the risk of climate instability and a 2 ° C increase leads to a variety of climate events.
The new IPCC report emphasizes that land needs to be managed more sustainably to release much less carbon than it does now.
Peat fields should be reduced by halting drainage programs, reclamation, meat consumption to reduce methane production, and food waste should be reduced.
Among the measures outlined in the report is the proposal for a radical shift towards vegetarian diets.
Consuming healthy, sustainable diets, such as programs based on grains, legumes, vegetables, nuts and seeds, are key opportunities to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
There needs to be a big change in the way land is used.
These policies should include better access to markets, the empowerment of women farmers, expanding access to agricultural services, and strengthening the security of land ownership.
Early warning systems for weather, crop yields and seasonal weather events are also important.
However, the chances of politicians and scientists achieving these goals are unclear.
Countries are set to hold a key conference in the UK in late 2020, with delegates planning how to achieve effective zero-carbon emission policies over the next few decades.
End of message.

title: About 50 Iranian and Iraqi refugees arrested near British coast
text:
Photo copyright PA Media Image caption HMC Reicher is one of four UK Border Guard patrol boats patrolling the Port of Dover in Kent province, and about 50 refugees who were boat bound for the UK were stopped and arrested by the British Coast Guard at separate events near the coast of Kent and Sussex in the south of the UK.
They said they have Iranian and Iraqi nationality.
Twenty of these illegal immigrants were arrested on the beach of the village of Dungenes in Kent, England.
In the second case, British Coast Guard forces intercepted a small boat with 11 men on board as it crossed the English Channel and transported the passengers to Dover Harbor.
Sussex police have arrested six illegal immigrants, including three children, on the coast of the province.
In another incident, the Home Office reported that at noon yesterday, 10 asylum-seekers, including eight men and two women, were taken ashore by border guards from another boat crossing the Channel.
All 47 illegal immigrants said they had Iranian and Iraqi nationality.
Since 3 November 2018, at least 976 people, including 89 children, have crossed the English Channel, the shortest water route between France and Britain, to reach the UK.
In November last year there was a significant increase in the number of asylum seekers trying to cross the English Channel to Britain, with the Home Secretary calling the issue a "serious incident" and calling for the French government to work together to resolve the issue.
A significant number of the refugees were Iranian, Afghan and Syrian.
A Home Office spokesman told the BBC: "People crossing the Channel in these small boats are putting their lives and their children at risk."
He added that since December, two British patrol ships have been patrolling the area from their overseas missions to protect the waterfront.
It has also been agreed with the French authorities that the border authorities of the two countries will increase their activities at the Information and Cooperation Centre in the French port of Calais.
“Under current practice, people in need of protection and seeking asylum must apply for asylum in the first safe country they arrive in, and more than 50 asylum seekers who arrived in the UK illegally have been returned to Europe since January, ” the Home Office said.
Calais, France ’ s closest port to Britain, has been the main route for illegal immigration for more than three decades.
Nearly three years after the destruction of the Jungle camp in the port of Calais, nearly 1,000 refugees are still in the city to make their way to Britain.

title: The Austrian Symbolist Painter ’ s Originality Confirmed
text:
Last year, workers found the painting in a plastic bag hidden in the wall of the Ricci Oddi Gallery, where it was stolen in 1997.
On the wall, the gallery workers came to a small door where the masterpiece, Portrait of a Lady, was hidden.
The painting is important because, before it was stolen, an art student discovered that it had been painted on another design.
Klimt painted a portrait of a lady at the end of her life.
Beneath the portrait of a lady was a picture of a Viennese girl who died young, and Klimt created another work to forget the pain of her death.
In addition to his artistic activities, Klimt was a prominent member of the Viennese separatist movement.
The movement was formed in 1897 by a group of Austrian artists who had resigned from the Association of Artists.
Klimt was the first leader of the movement.
Communicating and exchanging ideas with artists outside Austria, sparking artistic nationalism, reviving decorative arts and opposing the dominance of the Vienna Academy of Arts were among the goals of the movement.
He was also a great designer.
He has more than three thousand designs left to show his keen eye and powerful hand.
His bold and agile pen for human figures and postures inspired younger artists.

title: UN warns of crisis on Earth
text:
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) said in its latest report that the Earth is currently under increasing human pressure and that climate change is adding to these pressures.
At the same time, limiting global warming to less than 2 ° C can only be achieved by reducing greenhouse gas emissions across all sectors, including land and food.
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is a global body of assessment of the status of scientific knowledge about climate change, its possible future impacts and risks, and possible response options.
The panel saw a summary prepared for policymakers of the Special Report on Climate Change and Land (SRCCL), which was approved by world governments on Wednesday in Geneva, Switzerland.
It will be a key scientific input for future negotiations on climate and the environment.
These include the UN Convention on Climate Change (COP14) in New Delhi in September and the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP25) in Santiago, Chile in December.
Hu Sung Lee, chairman of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, said governments challenged the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change to take the first comprehensive look at the entire land-climate system.
We have done this through the collaboration of many experts and governments around the world.
It is the first time in the history of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change reports that a majority of the authors (53%) are from developing countries.
The report suggests that better land management can help tackle climate change, but that ’ s only part of the solution.
If global warming is to be kept below 2 ° C, or even better below 1.5 ° C, reducing greenhouse gas emissions across all sectors is essential.
In 2015, governments supported the Paris Agreement ’ s goal to strengthen the global response to climate change.
According to the agreement ’ s goal, the global average temperature rise from pre-industrial levels should be limited to less than 2 ° C, and efforts should be made to limit the increase to 1.5 ° C.
The land must remain fertile in order to maintain food security despite increasing population and increasing negative impacts of climate change on vegetation.
That means there are limits to land ’ s contribution to tackling climate change, including through the cultivation of energy-producing crops and forestry.
Trees and soil also need time to store carbon efficiently.
Bioenergy requires careful management in order to avoid risks that may pose to food security, biodiversity and land degradation.
Achieving the desired results depends on appropriate local policies and governance systems.
The Earth is a critical resource in the report on climate change and the Earth states that the world is most prepared to deal with climate change when a comprehensive attention is paid to sustainability.
Jim Skia, vice president of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’ s Third Working Group, said that land plays an important role in the climate system.
Agriculture, forestry and other land uses account for 23% of human greenhouse gas emissions.
At the same time, Earth ’ s natural processes absorb about a third of the carbon dioxide emitted from fossil fuels and industry.
Hans-Otto Pörtner, vice president of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Working Group II, said the report shows how sustainable management of land resources can help solve the climate change problem.
The land currently in use can provide the world with the food it needs in a changing climate and provide the biomass needed for renewable energy.
But early and extensive action is needed in different regions.
Conservation and restoration of ecosystems and biodiversity also require such measures.
Desertification and land erosion When land erosion occurs, its productivity decreases, which limits the ability to grow crops and reduces the ability to absorb carbon from the soil.
This exacerbates climate change, while climate change also exacerbates land erosion in many ways.
Kyoto Tanabe, vice president of the National Greenhouse Gas Task Force, said our choices about sustainable land management can help mitigate and, in some cases, reverse these negative impacts.
In the future, due to more intense rains, the risk of soil erosion on farms increases.
In such circumstances, sustainable land management is a strategy to protect communities from the harmful effects of soil erosion and landslides.
However, there are limits to what can be done, so in some cases the destruction may be irreversible.
About 500 million people live in areas that experience desertification.
Arid regions and regions affected by desertification are more vulnerable to climate change and extreme events, including droughts, heat waves and dust storms.
The increase in global population puts more pressure on these regions.
The report presents options for dealing with land erosion and making it adaptable or preventing exacerbations of climate change.
The report also examines the possible impacts of different levels of global warming.
Valerie Masson-Delmuth, vice president of the first working group of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, said the new findings show that even with global warming reaching 1.5 degrees Celsius, the risks of water scarcity for dry-farming, fire damage, permafrost degradation and food system instability increase.
If 2 ° C of global warming is achieved, there are many risks associated with the destruction of the permafrost and the instability of the food system.
Coordinated action to tackle climate change problems can simultaneously improve land, food security and nutrition, and help end hunger.
The report emphasizes that climate change affects all four pillars of food security: availability (crop production), affordability (food prices and purchasing power), consumption (nutrition and cooking), and stability (barriers to availability).
Predarshi Shakla, vice-president of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’ s Third Working Group, said food security will be increasingly affected by climate change in the future by declining yields, particularly in the tropics, rising prices, falling food quality and disrupting supply chains.
We will see different effects in different countries.
But low-income countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean will be most affected.
According to the report, about a third of the food produced is lost or turned into waste.
The reasons for food waste are fundamentally different in developed countries with developing countries, as well as between regions.
Reducing the volume of this waste could reduce greenhouse gas emissions and improve food security.
According to Debra Roberts, vice president of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Working Group II, some diets require more land and water, causing more greenhouse gas emissions, and balanced diets based on plant-based foods (such as grains, legumes, fruits and vegetables) and animal-sourced foods (produced renewably in low-emissions systems) provide important opportunities to adapt and limit climate change. They give.
The report concludes that there are ways to manage risks and reduce vulnerability in the land and food systems.
Crisis management can increase the resilience of communities against extreme events affecting food systems.
This could be the result of changes in diet or ensuring a variety of crops to prevent further land erosion and increase resilience to extreme or variable weather.
Reducing inequalities, improving incomes and ensuring equitable access to food so that some areas (where land cannot produce enough food) are not deprived of food, are other ways to cope with the negative effects of climate change.
There are also ways to manage and share risks, some of which are already available, such as early warning systems.
An all-encompassing focus on sustainability coupled with early action provides the best chance of tackling climate change.
This requires low population growth, reduced inequality, improved nutrition and reduced food waste.
This could provide a more resilient food system, make more land available for bioenergy, and at the same time protect forests and natural ecosystems.
However, without early action in this area, more land will be needed for bioenergy, leading to challenging decisions about land use and food security in the future.
Eduardo Calvo, vice-chairman of the Special Working Group on the National Greenhouse Gas Index, said policies are important that support sustainable land management, ensure food supplies for vulnerable communities while reducing greenhouse gas emissions and keeping carbon in the ground.
Land responses and climate change policies outside the land and energy spheres, such as the transport and environmental sectors, can also make a fundamental difference in tackling climate change.
Early action will be more cost-effective by preventing losses.
Panama Ujai, vice president of the first working group of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, said: “There are things we are doing right now.
We use good technologies and practices, but they need to be used more broadly and in other appropriate places that are not currently in use.
Here are the real capacities that through sustainable land use, reducing overconsumption and food waste, eliminating the destruction and burning of forests, preventing overharvesting of fuel wood and reducing greenhouse gas emissions can help tackle climate-related problems on Earth.
About the report ’ s full name is the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’ s Special Report on Climate Change, Desertification, Land Erosion, Sustainable Land Management, Food Security and the Flow of Greenhouse Gases in Earth Ecosystems.
This is one of three special reports the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is preparing during the period of its Sixth Assessment Report.
The report was prepared with the scientific supervision of all three working groups of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change in cooperation with the Special Working Group on the National Greenhouse Gas Index and supported by the Technical Support Unit ’ s Third Working Group.

title: One million animal and plant species are at risk of extinction.
text:
On Wednesday afternoon at the fourth national conference on climate change and its impact on agriculture and the environment in Urmia, Alexander Zand said that two climate change and biodiversity crises are taking place in the current environment, some chemical elements, including nitrogen, have crossed the standard boundary. Phosphorus acidification is normal, and among these indicators, two indicators that cross the standard boundary, one is climate change and the other is biodiversity. These interactions represent two serious crises on the planet.
He added that biodiversity is not in a good state of extinction, and a report published this year indicates that one million of the eight million animal and plant species estimated to exist on the planet is at risk of extinction.
The same thing happened only once during the Ice Age, but today it happens through human intervention, with an eighth of the known species on the verge of extinction.
The head of national reference to the Convention on Biological Diversity of the country, referring to the causes of species extinction and the reduction of biodiversity, said: “Overexploitation is 37% of the causes and most of the resources on the planet are overused. ”
Destruction and change of use (32%), diseases (2%), habitat loss (13%), pollution (4%) and invasive species (5%), and climate change (7%) directly contribute to species extinction and biodiversity loss.
Stating that one of the seven factors affecting biodiversity loss is climate change, Zand said: "One of the factors that occurs as a result of climate change is the temperature that is increasing and the rainfall system is also changing, extreme phenomena are one of the characteristics of climate change in nature, which are examples of severe floods and storms and fires.
Advisor to the Minister of Agriculture emphasized that the quality and level of the oceans are changing, and these five events affect the entire ecosystem, species, population and community, and climate change directly affects all of these.
Referring to the fact that climate change affects genetics, he said: "When nature is in excess, it affects natural selection, and the length of the growth and migration of organisms and susceptibility to diseases and the time of migration of organisms also changes."
Advisor to the Minister of Agriculture added: If climate change occurs, the gender ratio, quantity and quality of habitats will be disrupted and the territory of the organisms will be displaced; the amount of biomass in the ecosystem will also be displaced and many problems will be created for the organisms, which will result in complex work in the ecosystem.

title: Dozens of mostly Iranian refugees detained on their way to Britain
text:
The arrest of dozens of mostly Iranian refugees who tried to reach Britain by boat from France on Thursday has prompted foreign ministry officials from both countries to revisit the case.
At midnight on Thursday, a coastal patrol detained eight men and a woman (all Iranians) in a small boat on the water.
An hour later, another stray boat was discovered carrying people from Iran, Guinea, Kuwait and Ivory Coast.
Border patrols also found two other small boats on Thursday morning, all aboard, including two children, Iranian nationals.
Over the past few months, the number of asylum seekers and migrants detained in the waters of the Channel between France and Britain has risen, many of them Iranian.
Britain, which had previously warned that the events had become a “serious issue, ” has now announced that the Home Secretary will discuss the matter with his French counterpart soon.
Many asylum seekers and migrants who have arrived in France are reportedly trying to cross the Channel by boat, especially as police and border guards on roads, including in the Channel Tunnel, have increased surveillance, making it harder to hide in cars and trucks.

title: A secret message sent back after the theft.
text:
Two men confessed to stealing and then returning a painting by Gustav Klimt, the famous Austrian artist.
Thieves of a stolen painting by Gustav Klimt, which was recently discovered in the same Italian gallery where it was stolen after 22 years, have admitted to returning the artwork to the scene of the theft.
On Friday, experts confirmed the authenticity of the painting "Portrait of the Lady".
The artwork was discovered in December while hiding in a plastic bag in one of the walls of the Ricci Odie Gallery in Piacenza.
Police are questioning the two men, who appear to be members of a large gang, after the local newspaper Libertà received a confession from the two men about the 1997 robbery.
In a letter sent to the newspaper in their 60s, the two men wrote: “We are the thieves of Gustav Klimt ’ s Portrait of a Lady, and we have given the city a gift by bringing it back. ”
A lawyer for the two men told The Guardian: “They say the painting was put on the wall four years ago.
But we still don ’ t have the full details or information on where the artwork has been kept all these years.
They had confessed to stealing it years ago, but no one believed them. ”
The lawyer added: “Their statements about the painting are vague, but they claim that the artwork has not been hidden in the wall all these years; I am not a specialist, but if the painting had been kept in that hole all these years, it would not have remained so healthy. ”
After one of Caravaggio ’ s paintings stolen from a church in Sicily in 1969, it is considered the second most valuable art stolen in Italy.
The thieves are said to have stolen the artwork in the process of preparing the gallery for an exhibition of the portrait.
At the time, police said that thieves used a device similar to a fishing rod to remove the painting from the wall and took it out of the gallery through a skylight that had been removed from the glass.
The painting was especially important when, shortly before her disappearance, an art student noticed that the portrait of the young woman had been painted on the portrait of another young woman.
It became the only painting by Gustav Klimt in the art world that has been painted twice.
Gustav Klimt was born in January 1862.
He excelled in painting, murals, drawing and other art works.
Many of his works are in the Vienna Secession gallery.
The famous Austrian painter died in 1918 at the age of 55.
End of message.

title: It is necessary to formulate the optimal cultivation pattern with regard to climate change in Mazandaran
text:
ISNA / Mazandaran, a faculty member of the Department of Agriculture of Sari University of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources, said: Given the occurrence of events such as climate change and climate of Mazandaran province, it is necessary to develop an optimal and appropriate cultivation model.
In an interview with ISNA, Hematollah Pir Dashti pointed to the specific consequences of climate change and said: “The occurrence of maximum hot and cold temperatures, low or abundant rainfall and mainly flooding and high drought are the consequences of climate change, which is why the allocation of optimal cultivation pattern in the province is necessary. ”
He also expressed the issue of adaptation as a strategy to deal with climate change, saying: Based on the information and land use, many products and some new species can be placed in this pattern of cultivation and introduced.
The faculty member of the Department of Agriculture of Sari University of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources noted: In this optimal pattern, based on land zoning and climate change scenarios, only the places and lands planted crops will be altered and each crop will be planted in a place that has the least risk and the highest yield.
Pirdashti said the most important condition for the realization of a successful cultivation model is the completeness of the product chain and added: "When this action is positive and appropriate, both in terms of economic and nutritional value, especially after the harvest phase, the cycle is complete, that is, there are ancillary industries and post-harvest industries, and the farmer or producer is not concerned with selling his product and its cost-effectiveness."
In response to the question about which plants are recommended for brackish soils in the east of the province, he said: "The issue of advancing sea water and salinity of coastal and plain lands due to digging authorized and unauthorized wells due to indiscriminate harvesting of underground water resources should first be considered and important, and in the first step, it is necessary to prevent further sea water advance."
The member of the faculty of the Razanat University of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources added: In the next step, soil reform should be on the agenda, measures such as modification of irrigation methods, proper drainage methods and cultivation of salinity resistant plants with high yield potential in these soils, provided that the production cycle of those products can be effective.
Pointing to the lack of water and how to deal with this problem, Pir Dashti noted: for the problem of water scarcity cannot be prescribed a general and reproducible prescription, depending on the areas with the highest risk, the plants with low water needs should be used, for example in summer soybeans and sesame, which have low water consumption is suggested.
He said that in some areas, it is possible to change the rice cultivation system using direct planting and dryness in order to deal with water scarcity, adding that such measures can be realized in the long term, so it requires a long-term and prospective planning.
The faculty member of the Department of Agriculture of Sari University of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources considered the differences in cultivation pattern dependent on the region and its zoning and noted: The cultivation pattern and determination of suitable plants for each region based on geographical and meteorological information, water and soil studies and depending on the data of the zones are specified, otherwise the proposal of a specific plant based solely on the market will not be a good recommendation.
Pir Dashti considered the implementation of the pattern of cultivation with a 10-or 20-year plan subject to different scenarios and emphasized: geographical information and soil data, natural facilities of each region, potentials, labor, ancillary industries and product market prediction based on future studies and research are factors of a suitable cultivation pattern that if there is a suitable terminal for exporting agricultural products, suitable products can be selected and invested on them.
End of message.

title: Literary nudity and taciturnity are among the most admirable features of the works of Minimalism
text:
ISNA / Khuzestan, writer and critic of fiction literature, said: "The verbal nudity and lack of speech are among the most noble features of the works of Mini Malism.
Mohammad Javad Jazini on Friday night (February 24, 2019) in the specialized workshop of fiction writing titled "The Age of Story", which was held in the lateral part of the 14th Khuzestan Book Fair, examined the phenomenon of mini-malism and said: "mini-malism was a literary movement that happened in the West and now the society has welcomed this kind of writing."
He said that some believe that mini-malism has nothing to do with literature, adding that literary analysts have pointed to economic crises, especially the energy crisis, the issue of public struggle in energy consumption and the national decline of studying against new media, including cinema and television, and a kind of philosophical frustration.
Jazini went on to say that, on the other hand, the Minimalist was a critical art movement organized against the Maximalists, so that they proceed in a compact way to the extent that only the essential elements of the work remain in the smallest, simplest and shortest form.
The storyteller stated: lexical nudity and taciturnity are among the most important features of the Mini-Malist works, and for the first time the Mini-Males printed their works on food boxes and wanted to communicate with people in the simplest form and language possible.
According to ISNA, quoting the General Directorate of Khuzestan Guidance, he continued by stating that the prevalence of storytelling is rooted in the tendency to minimalism or minimalism in the contemporary world: This type of writing is considered as a movement in art and is based on two bases of simplicity and simplicity.
Jazini added: The authors of such works, by removing unnecessary elements, try to present the literary work in the smallest volume and shortest form, and in fact, one of the important features of most minimalist stories is having a simple and straightforward layout.
He said: “In most of the minimalist stories, the author ’ s goal is to show an external event.
The singer feels that events are happening in front of her.
The literary critic commented on the themes of minimalist stories: the themes of these stories are often general human concerns such as death, love, loneliness, etc., and those stories are less about climate events.
He said that political, philosophical and religious ideas do not have a way to the world of these stories, because the short volume of the story does not allow the author to address these ideas.
Jazini emphasized that in the development of the structure of minimalist stories, the works of two writers have had the most impact, one of which is Antoine Chekhov.
He invented a form of short story in which a slice of life was narrated.
Another writer is Ernest Hemingway, who gave his short stories on this subject.
The storyteller stated: A short story is a slice of life that has attracted the attention of Persian-speaking storytellers in recent decades and has been popularized and expanded in Iran.
End of message.

title: Spider art theft / art theft that shocked the world
text:
According to the Guardian, a painting by Gustav Colmett was found 23 years ago in the museum where it was stolen.
The painting cost about $60 million, and a few days ago those who stole it confessed to their crimes.
The painting was strangely hijacked with a fishing rod, and its thieves were nicknamed Spider-Man.
Here are some of the most famous art heists that can sometimes surprise you: In 2000, a group of thieves blew up several cars in Stockholm to draw the attention of police from an armed robbery at the city ’ s National Museum.
The group, who had stolen a Rembrandt painting and two other Renoir paintings, fled in a motorboat.
All of these works were returned to the museum by 2005.
As a daring heist, Leonardo da Vinci ’ s Mona Lisa painting stolen from the Louvre in 1911 was ranked number one.
The painting was stolen by a museum employee, Vincenzo Perugia, who believed it to be in his home country, Italy.
He had hidden the painting under his clothes and left the museum.
He had kept the painting in his home for two years and was arrested when he tried to deliver it to Italy.
He spent several months in prison, but was hailed as a national hero in Italy.
The painting returned to the Louvre in 1913.
In 1997, a painting of a woman painted by Kalmett was stolen from an art gallery.
The theft left police and art enthusiasts confused until the gallery ’ s gardeners found the painting hidden there.
Two men claimed responsibility for the theft and claimed to have returned the painting to the city as a gift.
In 2010, a French thief known as Spider-Man stole five paintings from the Museum of Modern Art in Paris, including Modigliani ’ s “Woman with a Fan. ”
All of these paintings were destroyed by him and his accomplice in order to serve as an eight-year prison term.
In 1961, a bus driver who entered the National Gallery of London through a bathroom window stole a painting by Francisco Goya.
The painting was supposed to sell for $392,000, and the thief wanted the same amount to return the painting.
He voluntarily returned the painting.
Two different versions of Edward Munch ’ s The Scream have been stolen over the past 20 years.
One version was targeted in 1994, the same day the Winter Olympics began in Lillehammer.
Four men entered the Norwegian National Gallery and stole the painting, leaving a note.
The letter said, “Thank you for your poor security. ”
The painting was returned in 1996.
Another version was stolen from the Munch Museum in 2004.
In the photo above, a man runs towards a car with a painting.
Upon entering the museum, the robbers began to threaten the staff and visitors, and eventually escaped with a painting.
Perhaps the biggest art theft was the Gardner Museum robbery, where thieves stole 13 artifacts from the Isabel Stuart Gardner Museum in Boston.
All of these items were worth $500 million.
Among them is Johannes Vermeer ’ s “The Concert, ” which is said to be the most valuable lost painting in history.
The theft, many years later and a $5 million reward for its discoverer, is still an unsolved mystery.
End of message.

title: SpaceX is sending the first group of astronauts to space.
text:

Crew Dragon will be used in the near future to send NASA astronauts to the International Space Station and other long-term space missions.
The successful launch of the Crew Dragon capsule took place on January 19 from NASA ’ s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
During the test launch, the Crew Dragon capsule's emergency landing system was examined.
SpaceX sacrificed one of its Falcon 9 rockets to make the test real.
A space rocket exploded in the sky.
According to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, the Crew Dragon spacecraft had twice the speed of sound at Mach 2.2 when separated from the rocket and reached an altitude of 40 km above the Earth's surface.
According to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, the Crew Dragon spacecraft had twice the speed of sound at Mach 2.2 when separated from the rocket and reached an altitude of 40 km above the Earth's surface.
The remains of the space rocket have crashed in Florida and into the ocean, despite strong winds.
The separation of the capsule from the rocket occurred 84 seconds after launch.
According to the researchers, one of the many dangers during the launch of space capsules occurs in the first seconds of the launch, and to prevent injury and death of astronauts, an emergency system is designed to safely return the capsule carrying astronauts.
After the retirement of the space shuttle, NASA will send its astronauts using the Russian Soyuz capsule.
Since 2014, NASA has signed contracts with SpaceX and Boeing to build a new generation of space capsules for NASA astronauts.
SpaceX successfully delivered the uncrewed capsule to the International Space Station last year, while Boeing ’ s first Starliner mission failed.
Among the features of the Crew Dragon space capsule is its body ’ s resistance to fire and heat.

A technical glitch during the launch of space capsules is rare, but it can happen.

title: Thousands of complaints against Bayer, Germany
text:
The German company Bayer is seeking to stop the sale of glyphosate herbicides to people.
The German company has faced thousands of lawsuits alleging that the herbicides cause cancer.
According to a German newspaper, the move by the German company Bayer to halt the supply of herbicides containing glyphosate is a prelude to negotiating a compromise with the plaintiffs.
The wave of lawsuits in the United States against Bayer came after the company acquired Monsanto, a producer of seeds and pesticides, in 2018, a $63 billion deal that was the company ’ s largest foreign transaction in Germany.
Glyphosate is the main herbicide of the Monstanto Company Randup.
The herbicide has been repeatedly criticized for allegedly causing cancer, causing Bayer ’ s value to drop by tens of billions of euros.
However, Bayer has denied all of these allegations and pointed his finger at those researchers who have called glyphosate dangerous in these toxins.
According to Fars, the German company Bayer has left Iran after the recent sanctions.
The German company, which recently acquired Monsanto, is accused of producing genetically modified crops as well as pesticides and herbicides containing carcinogenic glyphosate.
Monsanto is said to be producing the world ’ s seeds exclusively for bioterrorism.

title: Qaani in talks with two Palestinian groups: We are ready to defeat the ‘ Deal of the Century ’
text:
The new commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Quds Force, in a phone call with the heads of Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, has said that "the Islamic Republic of Iran is ready to defeat the Deal of the Century".
In an interview with Ismail Haniyeh, head of Hamas' political office, and Ziad Nakhala, secretary general of the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, Ismail Qaani said: "Iran is ready to confront the dangers of the deal of the century alongside the Palestinian people and especially the resistance forces."
According to ISNA, the leaders of these two Palestinian movements praised Iran ’ s position in opposing the Deal of the Century.
Ismail Qaani did not provide details on the strategies for “defeating the Deal of the Century ”.
Although Ismail Haniyeh and Ziad Nakhala met with his successor last month on a trip to Iran to attend the funeral of Qasem Soleimani, the slain commander of the Quds branch of the IRGC, but Ismail Qaani ’ s Saturday night talks with them were the first contact of senior Iranian military officials with the heads of two main organizations of the “Resistance Front ” after the US unveiling the peace plan called the Deal of the Century.
US President Donald Trump, whose administration has been working on a plan to resolve the decades-old Israeli-Palestinian conflict for the past three years, called it a “great deal ” and a“ historic opportunity ” for the Palestinians at a White House ceremony alongside Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu when he announced the plan and expressed hope that the Palestinians would be able to form an independent state by accepting it.
But the Islamic Republic of Iran, which considers Israel ’ s existence “illegitimate, ” has insisted that the US plan is doomed to fail.
In a statement, Iran ’ s Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) called the US plan a “grand conspiracy ” and stressed that the end of“ this evil treaty ” is to “sink into the dustbin of history. ”
The Revolutionary Guards ’ statement said they were “ready to play appropriate roles ” in the new conditions of the region and called on“ Islamic countries, especially their armed and faithful forces, ” to “stand up against the conspiracy of the“ Deal of the Century ” with a great and historic decision. ”
Iran ’ s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei ’ s version, which is “Palestine, from the sea to the river, the return of Palestinian refugees, and free, legitimate and inclusive elections, ” is the only viable strategy to resolve the Palestinian issue.
Prior to the IRGC ’ s statement, Mohammad Bagheri, the chief of staff of Iran ’ s armed forces, in a message on Feb. 10, warned the defense ministers and military chiefs of Islamic countries about “the consequences of any failure and silence ” against the“ cruel plan of the deal of the century. ”
President Hassan Rouhani, who said “Trump ’ s plan is the most hated plan of the century ” one day after the unveiling of the US plan, on Sunday, February 4, called the plan“ disgraceful and repulsive for all Muslims and freedom seekers of the world ” in the tomb of the founder of the Iranian regime.
Ali Akbar Velayati, Ali Khamenei ’ s adviser on international affairs, told a news conference in Tehran on the plan that “the disturbed sleep of the president of the United States will turn into a nightmare. ”
But at the same time as Iran's firm stance against the US peace plan, according to Turkish media, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan also strongly criticized the US peace plan during a meeting with Ismail Haniyeh, who is traveling to countries in the region on Saturday.
In a phone call with Abbas on Friday, Erdogan criticized Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain and other Arab countries that did not have a “clear position ” against the US plan, saying they are betraying humanity.
He said to the chief priests, “Shame on you. ”
In a speech on Friday, the Turkish president said: “Jerusalem will never be handed over to a terrorist state; Jerusalem is Turkey ’ s red line and it will never come to terms with this plan. ”
Erdogan, who recently met Donald Trump at the White House, called Israel a “terrorist state ” while Ankara has full diplomatic relations with Israel at ambassador level.
Mahmoud Abbas announced the severance of relations with the United States and Israel on Saturday, in continuation of the actions and positions of the Palestinian Authority against the US peace plan, and on Saturday evening announced the suspension of his government's relations with Israel and the United States.
Abbas said the suspension included all security cooperation with the United States and Israel.
According to him, Israel must “accept its responsibility as an occupier. ”
Speaking at an emergency meeting of Arab League foreign ministers in Cairo on Saturday, Abbas said he agreed to a plan to establish a Palestinian state on 22 percent of Palestinian territory in 2007, but because Prime Minister Ehud Olmert was on the verge of trial, he stopped the negotiations, but the current US plan only speaks of 15 percent of the land belonging to the Palestinians and wants us to renounce Jerusalem as a state. We know the Jewish people.
Abbas added, “His name will not be recorded in history as the one who sold Jerusalem. ”
Abbas confirmed that he had made his decision in letters to the US and Israeli governments.
In the final statement of the Cairo meeting, the Arab League rejected the deal of the century, saying it would not cooperate with the United States in implementing the plan.
The Arab League also "warned" Israel of the consequences of unilateral implementation of the plan.
The Arab League statement was issued while Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, which are also members of the League, apparently welcomed the US action, and the presence of ambassadors of some of these countries at the White House unveiling of the plan was seen as a sign of their governments ’ support for the program.
Jason Greenblatt, a former U.S. diplomat who co-authored the deal of the century with President Donald Trump ’ s top adviser Jared Kushner, said Saturday in response to remarks made by the head of the Palestinian Authority at the Arab League summit that “President Abbas rejects a plan that could create a bright future for the Palestinians. ”
A senior US administration official said the Arab League could end years of suffering for the Palestinian people only by taking a new approach, because "the past decisions of the Arab League have not brought peace or progress."
An Israeli Channel 12 report alleges that Gina Haspel, the head of the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), held a secret meeting in Ramallah on Wednesday with the aim of “reducing the severity of Palestinian opposition ” to the Washington government ’ s peace plan.
The United States has not confirmed or denied the report.
Israeli officials criticized Mahmoud Abbas ’ s comments at the Arab League meeting, especially when he said that “the majority of immigrants from Russia to Israel are not Jewish, and a very small percentage of immigrants from Ethiopia are Jewish. ”
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said: “Mahmoud Abbas has not heard of the Jewish tribes; they are brothers and sisters, of our blood and flesh, who for generations have dreamed of returning to the land of Zion. ”
Israeli opposition leader Benny Gantz said Abbas ’ s comments on migrants from the former Soviet Union and Ethiopia were “ignorant, petty and shameful, and they do not build peace that way. ”
According to Mahmoud Abbas, the chief rabbi of Israel, Yitzhak Yusuf, said last month that “hundreds of thousands or tens of thousands of people who are not Jews at all ” were brought to Israel as Jewish immigrants.
According to the US plan, the Palestinians should recognize Israel as a “state for the Jews. ”
Abbas said the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) recognized Israel under the Oslo Accords and that what it is is is an internal matter for them.

Atiq Rahimi, who has won the French Goncourt literary award for his novel The Patience Stone in his artistic and cultural career, after getting to know the author of the novel The Lady of the Nile and proposing to make a film, by asking whether only in my country there is continuous war and conflict, he remembers the thought of his distant years to understand the mechanism of violence.

title: Health tourists destined for Iran / Travel for treatment and tourism
text:
Rasoul Lotfi, the director of the documentary "The Way of Health", told Mehr reporter about the subject of this series, which is aired on the documentary network: "There is a term in the field of health called" health tourism "and it refers to those who enter a country for treatment.
This issue has a lot of importance, including the value of the country.
In fact, this industry is the only place where its exports are patient imports, and Iran is one of the countries that is a destination for health tourists in the world due to its medical advantages and special tourist attractions.
I must say that in the last few years, due to the medical advances we have made and the measures taken, the number of tourists visiting our country has increased.
The “Healthy Way ” is built on this.
Each episode narrated a tourist who has arrived in Iran, Lotfi pointed to the narration of the documentary and said: “We considered each of the subjects separately, and on this basis, an 11-part series, each of which is 40 minutes, has been made. ”
Each episode tells the story of a tourist who has arrived in the country and wants to pursue his or her treatment.
We follow the process of “from home to home ” with him, and from his arrival at the hospital to his treatment, we depict his leisure time and visiting tourist attractions.
The purpose of this documentary is to portray the medical advantages of our country that have attracted health tourists to the country.
Note that we are competing with other countries in the region and they are advertising heavily.
I think we ’ ve been a bit overwhelmed in this regard, and by making this documentary, we ’ re going to fill that gap.
Commenting on his motivation for making a documentary on such a subject, the filmmaker said: “Our goal is to show the medical advances after the revolution from the language of others who are foreign tourists.
When a person from Germany who is a kind of medical center has chosen Iran to pursue his treatment in our country, he shows the strength of our country and our development.
After the revolution in the field of medicine, there was a tremendous revolution.
There was a time when Indian and Pakistani doctors had to come to our country to treat patients, but today we have experts who have a say in the world and are well known.
Cheap medical costs and qualified doctors are the reason for the increase in health tourists, he said about the country ’ s medical capabilities in the years after the revolution: “We have experienced physicians who are known throughout the world and many tourists travel to our country for treatment by these people. ”
In addition, the tourist attractions of our country are also very high; someone who comes to Iran for treatment also thinks that he can spend a pleasant leisure time in Iran.

Cosmetic surgery, dental work, corneal grafts, etc.
