It was the idea of the network and I think it has a lot of work to do.
The 11-part documentary series "Salamat Way" is a documentary produced by the network and will be broadcast on Thursdays (except February 17) at 22: 00.

title: It is the largest illegal migrant detention operation on the south coast of England.
text:
British sources claim it was the largest single day of arrests of illegal immigrants to the UK.
According to the Home Office, migrants used seven boats at different times on Thursday to try to reach the southeast coast of the country.
At 2: 15 a.m., two boats carrying 26 migrants were seized, who identified themselves as Syrian, Yemeni and Egyptian nationals.
Then, around 7: 40 p.m., two other boats carrying 28 people who identified themselves as Iraqis and Iranians were seized, and an hour later, 12 migrants were arrested on another boat, whose identities have not yet been disclosed.
According to the report, another boat was intercepted by British border forces at 10: 20 p.m. and the seventh boat carrying Iraqi, Yemeni and Iranian nationals was captured at 11: 20 p.m.
According to the Home Office, 15 of the migrants were children.
The number of migrants arriving in the UK has been increasing over the past two years.
Migrants from the coast near the French port of Calais are trying to make their way to the country before British immigration laws become stricter.
Last September, British sources reported a record 86 people migrating through the English Channel in a single day.
The British and French governments have taken special measures to tackle illegal crossings, but Paris has refused to accept migrants who have crossed the border.
The Conservative government is trying to tighten immigration laws in the UK.
The rules, which will come into force soon, will drastically reduce the chances of applicants lacking professional skills to immigrate to the UK.

title: ‘ Wild wheat can be resistant to climate change ’
text:
Eviatar Nevo Image caption The discovery of "beneficial mutations" in wild wheat has led researchers to believe that wild samples of crops, such as wheat, contain a rich set of genetic material that will help these plants resist climate change.
A study conducted over 28 years found that wild wheat varieties have evolved resistance to adversity, including rising temperatures, with genetic “beneficial mutations. ”
The researchers say the results, published in the journal National Integrative Science Practices, strengthen our understanding of how plants respond to global warming.
Jung Bi-Fu, a researcher from the Canadian Ministry of Agriculture, said: “We have achieved very exciting results.
"One of these results is that over 28 years and 28 generations, the accumulation of genetic mutations in wild samples of the plant was observable, and we found that most varieties of wheat were still adaptable."
Although the team found that there were individual samples in the study that did not survive the conditions associated with the warmer environment, there were other samples that adapted to such changes.
The study included 10 populations of smear wheat (or "emir") in Israel.
Dr Fu said the temperature rise in the study was equivalent to two degrees Celsius over the past three decades.
The Paris climate agreement aims to prevent temperatures from exceeding one and a half degrees Celsius by 2050 relative to pre-industrial times.
Last year, scientists identified the location of 100,000 wheat genes, which was a major step in efforts to develop climate-resistant samples.
The United Nations estimates that to feed the world ’ s population, which will grow to 9.6 billion by 2050, wheat production will need to increase by 60 percent.
Scientists are also developing mathematical models to identify genetic material that could help improve the adaptability of these crops to climate change.
The researchers hope the models will speed up the process of identifying characteristics such as drought resistance and allow the cultivation of climate-resistant crops.
There are about 1,700 genetic banks of crops in the world, containing more than seven million samples, a vast resource that the researchers said made it a difficult task to search for desirable traits among them.
A 2016 study published in the journal Royal Biological Society Letters highlighted the risk of climate change for our ability to grow enough food.
In that study, a team of US researchers found that projected changes in climate by 2070 would be faster than different species of wheat could adapt.
Species facing an uncertain future include wheat, maize, rice and sorghum, which account for half of the calories consumed by humans.

title: Flight 752: $1.1 billion lawsuit against Iran in Canada
text:
Canadian lawyers on behalf of relatives of the victims of Ukraine ’ s Flight 752, which was shot down by Revolutionary Guard forces around Tehran, have opened a case in the country ’ s courts for $1.5 billion (US $1.1 million) in compensation.
Mark Arnold, a well-known Canadian lawyer who has previously successfully represented the seizure of Iranian assets in the country along with his lawyer ’ s father, is now moving forward with the compensation case for Canadian victims of the Ukrainian plane.
Reuters reported on Friday that the name of the main plaintiff was kept secret so that his family in Iran would not face government pressure, but the defendants in the case include the Islamic Republic, Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, and a number of government officials, including Amir Ali Hajizadeh, the commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Aerospace Force.
Fearing threats from the Islamic Republic, the plaintiff has been identified as John Dow, a first-class member of the Jack Dow family.
The downing of the Ukrainian plane following the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) attack killed 176 people, including 57 Canadians, mainly dual nationals, as well as several Ukrainians, Afghans and Britons, and Iranians themselves.
After three days of secrecy, Iran finally, under pressure from the public opinion and information provided by foreign satellite systems of the targeting of the aircraft, announced that the cause of the crash was the wrong firing of the IRGC ’ s air defense system.
Canada had previously seized and sold the Islamic Republic ’ s assets in another case, including two buildings, and it is unclear whether the Islamic Republic has any other assets to be seized in Canada.
Arnold says the case will remain open for years and that a warrant for the seizure of Iranian assets will be pursued in the future.
In the case, Iran was accused of a “deliberate and deliberate terrorist act ” against the Ukrainian plane.
Mr Arnold says it is important to be the voice of the victims' families and that the pursuit of compensation is one of the basic things that needs to be done.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said: “The Iranians immediately paid $80,000 to the families of each victim.
That amount is too little.
We will pay them more than they deserve. ”
Under Canada ’ s revised law in 2012, countries on the country ’ s list of sponsors of terrorism could be seized and sold by plaintiffs.
Only Iran and Syria are on the list.
The compensation case for survivors of the plane crash opened in Toronto on January 24.
Using Reuters and Radio Farda reports; F.K. / S.N.

title: Hundreds of refugees arrested in the Channel
text:
According to a statement released by the Home Office on Friday, 102 migrants were arrested on this day alone as they crossed the English Channel from France to enter the UK.
The number of those arrested in the last two days has risen to about 200.
British border police arrested at least 90 migrants on Thursday, including 15 minors.
Many of those arrested said they were Iranian citizens.
A number have also come from Afghanistan, Pakistan, Syria and Iraq.
They are expected to be returned to France under the Dublin agreement.
According to the agreement, asylum seekers who have entered Europe are only allowed to apply for asylum at their place of entry.
If they go to another European country, they will be returned to their country of origin in Europe.
The number of migrants crossing the Channel has fallen, according to security minister Brandon Lewis, as the number of migrants and asylum seekers entering the UK via the English Channel has fallen.
He said on Friday that a large number of migrants crossing the English Channel illegally into the UK had been "stopped".
Lewis said only close to 25 percent of migrants who attempted to cross the waterway this year were successful, a significant decrease compared to the same period last year (48 percent).
French police have warned migrants not to use small boats to cross the blue border.
Some reports suggest that the reason why migrants are safe in unsafe boats has been the calm of the sea in recent days.
The English Channel (English Channel) is a canal in northern France and southern England that connects the Atlantic Ocean to the North Sea.

title: Crew Dragon capsule takes first astronaut into space

title: The great champion will be sold in Berlin.
text:
A new drama by the twice Oscar-winning Iranian director Asghar Farhadi will warm up the Berlinale Film Festival (European Film Market) next week.
The French film company Momento, which has supported Farhadi ’ s last three films, will present the Hero ’ s film in Berlin with the release of an English-language version of the original script written in Persian.
The project comes at a particularly good time, as last Sunday, Bong Joon-ho ’ s Parasite was the first non-English language film to win the Academy Award for Best Picture.
Like Bong, Farhadi is an internationally acclaimed director who has produced films outside his home country but has achieved his greatest success with films that remind him of the qualities of his homeland.
The Separation of Nader from Simin was a 2011 drama film about divorce that premiered at the Berlin Film Festival and the Golden Bear won best film and accolades for acting.

title: Member of Tehran City Council: Women seek to create equal opportunities in public space
text:
Zahra Nejad Bahram on Saturday on the occasion of Lady Zahra ’ s birthday and Women ’ s Day, in an interview with IRNA reporter, added: Women want public spaces to be transformed from spaces dependent on gender and gender and into a space that all citizens can use.
Stating that we, as urban management, are obliged to take the necessary measures in these areas, he said: "In fact, once again, we need to redefine the dedicated spaces of women, such as women's or women's gardens."
Referring to the definition of public spaces, she said: “In the past, they were just streets or very public places, but today, most cafes with large windows facing the street or a chair on the sidewalk are more welcomed by women.
Bahram said: "It seems that these types of cafes, because they are both subject to social surveillance and are a possibility to participate in society, are more attractive to women."
A member of the Tehran City Council emphasized that we should review the construction of such spaces within the city and review their function.
Security is one of the most serious demands of Nejad Bahram women: One of the most serious issues of women is the issue of “security ”; that is, women feel that they want to be in a place where there is security, but at the same time, they want to have a social presence.
He said: “Based on surveys conducted in both 1994 and 96, the issue of ‘ security ’ has been emphasized by women.
The presence of women in urban spaces is usually more than 60 percent to meet the necessity of life and less than 20 to 25 percent of it is for social communication.
He said: “It seems that we need to pay attention to whether gardens have been able to create opportunities for social interaction.
Nejad Bahram continued: Women are using other spaces to address this issue; spaces that, while they are closed and in fact public, have the necessary security.
Parks have more role in sports for women, he pointed to a research in the field of women in 1396 and stated that while security is very important, the role of spaces that are purely feminine, such as women parks, is considered to be a more sporting function, and in fact, in the past, privatization of women ’ s spaces, which in the past was limited only in the field of the home, this time this space has become a larger and turned into women ’ s parks.
This means that they have made private spaces larger in scale and value, but it is the same privatization and privatization space, while women tend to have social interaction.
Nejad Bahram added: Women tend to be present in society and distance themselves from private spaces, and this is an issue that we need to pay more attention to in the direction of the budget.
Creating security for women within the framework of cultural and religious beliefs, the member of the Tehran Council emphasized that this security and safety should be provided within the framework of our cultural, social and religious beliefs, adding: "It is true that the welcoming of gardens is done by women, but they are mostly an open sports space and we can create it on a smaller scale in all neighborhoods."
Elimination of defenseless urban spaces for women members of the Board of Directors of the Islamic City Council of Tehran, referring to defenseless urban spaces in the capital, added: The issue of defenseless urban spaces is a topic that is related to women ’ s security and the sense of security that women have.
Stating that the issue of removing defenseless urban spaces should be part of the serious agenda of urban managers, he said: “These defenseless spaces should be investigated in terms of lack of light (at night), social supervision, capacities for communication development and in such a way that women feel more secure. ”
She stressed that this sense of security makes women more likely to have social presence and social interactions.
Nejad Bahram, emphasizing that the redefinition of women ’ s private spaces is necessary, added: the removal of defenseless spaces complements the redefinition of creating private spaces for women.

title: A friendship with a bear!
text:
Every film festival or festival has its own policy or approach that is sometimes or very specific, or not, because its purpose is not clear, it lives in a realm of political, social and human rights complexities.
Online Young Art and Culture Service: For someone who is more or less involved in cinema, it is not difficult to know and understand what each of the foreign film festivals have, their policies and, as they are known, their relationship.
Every film festival or festival has its own policy or approach that is sometimes or very specific, or not, because its purpose is not clear, it lives in a realm of political, social and human rights complexities.
One of the most important film festivals in the world, which is also one of the "Mother" festivals, is the Berlin Film Festival, known as the Berlinale, which is held almost every year at the same time as the Fajr Film Festival in Berlin.
Berlinale is celebrating its 70th year this year, and in this regard, it is one of the oldest and oldest festivals of world cinema.
Iranian cinema has always been the focus of this festival for many years and has won small and large prizes.
Since 1974, Iran has always participated in one of the sections of the Berlin Film Festival.
Samuel Khachkian and Houshang Shafti attended the festival twice in 1958 and 1963 with the films “Nocturne in Hell ” and“ Burning Anemone ”.
But the record for most appearances in Berlinale is for Jafar Panahi, who has had the most appearances in Berlin with eight films, a number of which were shown in the framework of the commemoration program.
Apart from the silver bear, which has been won by Iranian filmmakers several times, Iranian cinema has won the Golden Bear twice with the films “A Separation from Simin ” (Asghr Farhadi) and“ Taxi ” (Jafar Panahi).
But precisely after the year of 2009 and the political events and events of that year in Iran, the approach of this festival to Iranian cinema became completely political and literally anti-Iranian.
It is an undeniable fact that the Berlin Film Festival has taken an anti-Iranian approach in recent years and has not been afraid to express it.
Even the award for a poor, sloppy film like “Taxi ” is due to this approach, or the spoilt act of keeping Jafar Panahi ’ s seat empty.
What was the film selection process like?
In recent years, Anke Louie was the representative of the Berlin Film Festival, who came to Iran to watch films in cinematic offices and unofficially selected films for the Berlin Film Festival.
Anke Louie, the representative of Berlin, but Louike, who came to Iran every year to choose a film, was arrested by security forces in 2016, along with copies of several movies and leaving the country.
Security forces confiscated and inspected Levike ’ s suitcase.
In this situation, Levike also decides not to get on the plane.
The suitcase full of Levike ’ s film is emptied of the films and the works he selected for review are taken from him.
Levike has been told he has no problem leaving Iran, and he, who initially refused to leave Iran without films, left Iran on Monday, December 28, 2016.
After this incident, Berlin no longer sent a representative to Iran and sought another solution.
Filmmakers who wanted their films to be present in Berlin had to submit the film to the festival, and a selection board, including several Iranians, was responsible for selecting Iranian works.
But a condition was laid for the selection of Iranian films, and that the works should not be in any way governmental or sovereign, and if they have been licensed to make, it would be considered a negative privilege for them.
In this year ’ s Berlinale, Iranian cinema with three films: “Satan Does Not Exist ” (Mohammad Rasoulof),“ Namo ” (Nader Saeivar) with the drunken production of Mohajer and investment of Navid Mohammadzadeh and Pejman Bazghi and the film “Yalda ” by Masoud Bakhshi is present.
The first two films, which basically do not have a license to make and release, and the film "Yalda" is screened in the non-competitive section.
“Evil Does Not Exist ” by Mohammad Rasoul F“ Yilda ” by Masoud Bakhshi “Namo ” by Nader Saeivar, is an interesting and questionable point that how and why, despite such works that have not even been authorized by legal institutions, why should the Iranian cinema caravan be present in Berlin with more than 100 people?
Here are a few questions that are not bad for the country ’ s film directors to answer.
The first question is who will pay the cost of sending such a broad group in such a chaotic economic situation.
Do directors, cinematographers, and some critics and journalists go on this trip at personal expense or not?
The second question is, what is the function and output of this vehicle?
Do we sell films in the Berlin market that even if we have them, do we need them or not?

title: 'There is no devil '- Mohammad Rasoulof wins top prize at Berlin Film Festival
text:

The Golden Bear was awarded at the Berlinale Film Festival on Saturday to the film “The Devil Does Not Exist. ”
Rasoulof did not attend the festival to receive the prize because the Iranian authorities would not allow him to leave the country.
The film “The Devil Does Not Exist ”, which was secretly filmed to avoid censorship, recounts narratives about freedom under the pressure of coercion and deals with the death penalty in Iran.
The festival ’ s jury, led by Jeremy Irons, preferred the film over 17 competing films.
Sally Potter's "The Road Not Gone," "Berlin Alexander Platz" and "Siberia" were other nominees.
Germany ’ s DPA news agency reported that Rasoulof ’ s daughter, Baran, who plays the role in the film, received the Golden Bear on his behalf.
At the press conference on Saturday, organizers placed an empty chair named Mohammed Rasoulof.
In a video call on mobile phones at the press conference, Mr Rasoulof said: "The subject of this film is the responsibility of individuals.
I wanted to talk about people who disclaim responsibility and say that decisions are made by people at the top of the hierarchy.
But they can say no, and that's their strength. "
Getty Images Image caption Jury Chairman Jeremy Irons reports that every season of the film depicts a man selected to carry out the death penalty.
Some of them are obedient and some are disobedient.
But every decision they make has consequences, good and bad, mirrored for decades in their own lives and those of their loved ones.
Filmmaker Farzad Pak said that making the film secretly in remote rural areas and filming at night in a closed environment posed risks to actors and producers.
While accepting the award, Kaveh Farman reportedly noted how much the film had received in Berlin, adding: “This story reminds us that there is no wall in the world that can block the power of imagination, the power of thought, faith and love. ”
Last summer, Mr. Rasoulof was sentenced by the Revolutionary Court to one year ’ s imprisonment and two years ’ ban on leaving the country and forbidding participation in social and political activities on charges of “acting against the system and national security ”.
The second prize, Silver Bear, went to Eliza Hitman ’ s Never Rarely Sometimes Always.
The Silver Bear for Best Actress went to Paul Bier for her role in "The Underworld," and the Silver Bear for Best Actor went to Olive Germano for her role in "Hidden."

title: All About the Berlin Film Festival Political Prize
text:
Perhaps if cultural managers had taken seriously the remarks that had been raised all these years about the political orientation of cultural activities about Iran, it probably would not have ended with Mohammad Rasoulof, during his forbidden career, making a work outside the legal filmmaking system in the country, openly objecting to the rules, and then at the press conference of his film in relation to “the power of saying no ”. Let the Governor speak!
While Iranian cinema had four official representatives in this period of the Berlin Film Festival, Mohammad Rasoulof ’ s new film, “There is no Devil ”, which was produced and sent to the festival without due process of law, was given special attention by the organizers of the event!
What happened earlier in connection with the unofficial representatives of Iranian cinema and the Berlin Film Festival had shown that it would like to pay more attention to the unofficial representatives of Iranian cinema and even anti-Iranian works.
Rasoulof, who was not allowed to work in cinema or leave the country because of the verdict, was able to reach the 70th Golden Bear of the Berlin Film Festival on Saturday night, and in his absence sent his daughter Baran Rasoulof to the stage for the award, which has made his latest work without the necessary legal permissions for filmmaking inside the country!
* The political voice of the film festival!
But if you have any doubt about the Berlin Film Festival ’ s approach to supporting those Asian films, especially those produced outside the legal process of filmmaking in their country, just look at the performance of the festival in support of filmmakers such as Mohammad Rasoulof and Jafar Panahi.
Panahi was imprisoned for about three months after the 2009 presidential election for a film that he decided to make about its borders and propagate against the Islamic Republic, and after his release, in addition to being banned from leaving Iran, he was deprived for 20 years of activities including the right to film, screenwriting, leaving the country and interviewing domestic and foreign media.
However, after his conviction, he made three films, “This Is Not a Film, ”“ The Screen, ” and “Taxi, ” which have always attracted the attention of festivals such as the Berlin Film Festival, so much so that the Golden Bear of the festival was given to Panahi for the film“ Taxi. ”
The work got so high that Hujjatullah Ayoubi, the head of the film organization at the time, wrote in a complaining letter to the director of the Berlin Film Festival: “Like millions of people interested in cinema, I hear the terrible voice of politics at the Berlin Film Festival.
Like all of them, I wanted Berlin to be a reminder of art and culture, but you seem to prefer politics over art.
There is the sound of politics, and the bricks piled up at your festival will quickly build a new Berlin Wall around your festival. ”
What exactly does the House of Cinema congratulate you on?
A few days ago, in a report on this page about the strange and unreasonable support of the Directors ’ Association of the House of Cinema, we asked Mohammad Rasoulof for the release of this film in the House of Cinema at the same time as its release at the Berlin Film Festival.
A film that has been produced without obtaining the necessary permits to make a film in the country and the support of official guilds, has no meaning other than disregarding these legal structures.
But this is even more regrettable when we see that the House of Cinema yesterday sent a message to Mohammad Rasoulof congratulating him on winning the prize at this year ’ s Berlin festival!
Ironically, Mohammad Kalhor, a cinematic journalist, responded to the contradictory behavior of the House of Cinema by tweeting to Hossein Entezami, the head of the cinematic organization, saying: “The House of Cinema congratulated him while the Rasoulof F Award has not passed legal licenses.
Article 1 of the Statute of the House of Cinema states that it was established “within the framework of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran and under the supervision of the Ministry of Culture and Islamic Guidance. ”
“Mr. Speaker, is that not a clear contradiction? ”
A question that should definitely be answered in the coming days, because undoubtedly, the indifference and silence of the cinema organization on this issue will have no result other than the further expansion of the underground cinema and the weakening of the legal procedures of the country in the field of production of theatrical products.
Five years ago, Jafar Panahi, who had not been able to leave Iran due to a travel ban, took the Berlin Golden Bear for the film Taxi, and this year, Mohammad Rasoulof, who was banned from leaving Iran due to his judicial conviction, won the Golden Bear; interestingly, no film from the official stream of Iranian cinema has been able to gain a significant place at the festival, and in this situation, the House of Cinema as the country ’ s biggest guild. And the defense of the country ’ s legal process congratulates the outlaw!
In search of Rasoulof ’ s supervisory bodies, which made his film without obtaining the necessary permits, a few days ago, he issued a statement lamenting his absence in Berlin, saying that the fact that he was not allowed to travel shows “the authoritarian nature of the Iranian government ”!
But Rasoulof has taken this position in a situation where it is not clear how a person like him, who has special legal and professional conditions, could produce a work without its permission in public places of the country?
Basically, what is the role of the regulatory and law enforcement agencies in this area, and can anyone who wants to easily create a cinematic effect in the public places of the country without obtaining legal permits?
According to the Saudi Independent Persian media as one of the supporters of Rasoulof and his film, “The new Rasoulof film has 4 episodes.
In four fictional episodes of the film, which take place in completely different spaces, Rasoulof has shown that he can portray completely different situations: from the life of a middle class in Tehran who is familiar to the world with Asghar Farhadi ’ s films; to police chase scenes; and beautiful visual scenes in the forests of northern Iran … ” If, Jafar Panahi would one day make a cinematic work just by planting a camera in his car in secret. Now, it has reached a point that Rasoulof, who had the same conditions as him, put "police chase scenes" and "beautiful visual scenes in the forests of northern Iran" in his new film, and no regulatory agency has pursued the issue that he has been allowed to make this work by obtaining what license?!

The 70th edition of the Berlinale, which was co-directed by Carlo Chatrian (Henry) and Mariette Risenbeck (Executive), was lackluster, despite the participation of such influential directors as Sally Potter, Philippe Garrel, Abel Ferrara, Kelly Rickard.

title: Protest of the world 's most prestigious cinematic circles against the summons of Mohammad Rasoulof
text:
Mohammad Rasoulof, a renowned Iranian film director whose worldwide popularity is due to his films critical of the ruling order in Iran, was unable to attend the Berlinale Film Festival.
He has been sentenced to one year in prison and has been banned from leaving the country since 1996.
The film "The Devil Does Not Exist" was made in secret.
The film that won the Golden Bear won the top prize at the Berlinale Film Festival.
The film is about four people who are assigned to carry out the death penalty, each making their own choice.
In this film, Rasoul F unveils the freedom of the individual under the pressure of the ruler ’ s determinism and the responsibility of the individual to say no to power.
He was sent to prison just three days after receiving the award.
Follow Deutsche Welle on Instagram This action by the Islamic Republic caused a wave of protest in the world of art and cinema.
The Berlinale Film Festival on Monday backed Mohammed Rasoulof in a statement, protesting his summons to serve a one-year prison sentence.
In a statement, Berlinale ’ s director said: “This situation requires a reaction from the international community. ”
He described the Iranian government ’ s treatment of a director as “shocking ” because of his artwork and expressed hope that the Iranian authorities would reconsider their verdict.
But it wasn ’ t just the Berlinale festival ’ s management that objected to Rasoulof ’ s prison sentence.
The Cannes Film Festival, the German Film Academy, the European Film Academy and the Amsterdam International Documentary Film Festival have also expressed their support for Rasoulof.
These institutions and cinematic circles have expressed grave concern about the situation of Mohammad Rasoulof.
The Iranian government has leveled heavy charges against the critic: assembly and collusion against national security and propaganda against the regime.
The allegations that Rasoulof is not the only Iranian filmmaker or artist who has been sentenced to prison for it.
“We need directors like Rasoulof, ” Wim Wenders, the renowned German director and president of the European Film Academy, said in a statement,“ Our colleague, Mohammed Rasoulof, is an artist who has always provided us with facts that we know very little about. ”
Wenders stressed that world cinema “needs filmmakers like Rosso LF who are the voice of freedom and human rights and who defend human dignity. ”
In protest of the prison sentence for artists and cinematographers, Rasoulof himself, while the number of people with coronavirus in Iran is increasing every day, said: “Many art activists are in prison because they have criticized the government.
“With the spread of Covid-19 virus in Iranian prisons, the lives of prisoners are at risk. ”
He urged the international community to react quickly to the situation.
The coronavirus outbreak in Iran has already taken many victims.
Schools and universities are closed.
The Islamic Republic has given some 54,000 prisoners furlough over concerns about the spread of the disease in prisons.

text:
Evidence shows that climate change is occurring in many parts of the world in the form of severe decreases in atmospheric precipitation and in some other areas in the form of destructive and threatening floods.

title: Converting carbon dioxide into useful molecules using a hybrid reactor
text:
Recently, scientists at the University of California, Berkeley have developed a hybrid reactor that uses live bacteria to convert carbon dioxide into useful molecules.
If humans ever travel to Mars, one of the problems we ’ ll have to solve in advance is how to produce essential materials like fuel and medicine without taking them there ourselves.
One of the ways we can do this is to take the carbon dioxide from the Martian atmosphere and convert it into organic compounds.
Now, American researchers have done something similar in their recent study.
The function of the reactor developed by the researchers is similar to the natural process of photosynthesis, whereby plants use sunlight to convert carbon dioxide into sugars they can use for energy.
The system the researchers developed uses water and the bacterium Sporomusa ovata, which is surrounded by nanowires.
These silicon nanowires are one-hundredth the thickness of a human hair and act as the solar collector of the system.
These nanowires, by absorbing light, producing electrons and gluing them to the bacteria in between, create a chemical process that results in bacteria converting carbon dioxide and water into acetate and oxygen.
Acetate is one of the substances that can be obtained from acetic acid.
It can contain three substances: salts, esters, and anion, which can be found in a solution.
Acetate is also used in the production of polymers.
Peidong Yang, lead researcher on the study, said: “These silicon nanowires are like antennas.
They absorb the solar photon just like the solar panel does.
On Mars, about 96 percent of the atmosphere is made up of carbon dioxide.
On Mars, acetate molecules can act as building blocks to produce organic molecules to produce fuel, plastics or drugs.
Scientists are now working to improve the efficiency of the system and are investigating how genetic bacteria can be used to produce a wider range of organic compounds.
The findings of the study were published in the journal Joule.
End of message.

title: SpaceX is sending astronauts to space travel
text:
Following the success of the Crew Dragon space capsule, SpaceX ’ s dragon crew, which used the Falcon 9 rocket to deliver cargo to the International Space Station in March 2019, NASA officials have announced that the first group of astronauts will launch on May 27 this year.
Two NASA astronauts will arrive at the International Space Station using a space capsule that will be launched from orbit by a Falcon 9 rocket.
It will be the first launch since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011.
NASA plans to reduce the duration of astronauts ’ stay on the International Space Station by one week in order to send more astronauts into space.
In the first launch of the Dragon Crew capsule, two SpaceX astronauts spend two to three months on the space station conducting scientific research, before returning to Earth and landing in the Atlantic Ocean.
Today, astronauts are transported to the International Space Station using the Russian Space Agency's Soyuz capsule, known as Roscosmos, and the Russians only schedule two flights to transport astronauts throughout the year.
After six years of testing, development and design, Crew Dragon is finally ready to launch the first group of passengers into space.
In light of the COVID-19 pandemic, experts say astronauts must undergo a special quarantine period prior to launch to the space station, and the risk of transmitting the virus into space is high.
Due to the spread of the coronavirus, most NASA and SpaceX employees are working remotely these days, and experts hope to be able to launch rockets and space capsules in time.
The Dragon Crew Space Capsule has successfully completed a parachute test of a space capsule used during an emergency landing or the return of astronauts from the space station.
NASA astronauts arrived at the International Space Station after being quarantined, and two more parachute tests for the Dragon Crew space capsule are scheduled for late April.
Another ongoing test is examining the propulsion system in the event of a crash and failure of the Dragon Crew Space Capsule, which uses emergency engines to activate the capsule after launch and return astronauts safely back to Earth.
Several years ago, during testing of the capsule ’ s emergency engines, the capsule suddenly caught fire, which experts said was impossible to repair and reuse.
Researchers say nitrogen tetraoxide leaks into titanium tubes containing helium in the capsule's internal system caused the capsule to catch fire during emergency engine testing.
To address this problem, experts said they would consider pipes made of a metal other than titanium to reduce its ignition factor.
The Falcon 9 rocket also failed in its newest mission to launch satellites, the Starlink Space Internet project, although experts managed to deploy the satellites in a predetermined orbit in Earth orbit, but the Falcon rocket engine failed and could not be used for future missions after returning.
NASA astronauts, who will travel to the space station using the Dragon Crew capsule, are learning how to steer and control the capsule, because the technology used in SpaceX's equipment is different from NASA's.
To train astronauts, NASA also uses a flight simulator system to familiarize astronauts with the environment of the space capsule while traveling in space.
The launch will take place from Cape Canaveral, Florida, launch pad 39A, and astronauts will join the space station one to two days after launch.
In 2014, SpaceX and Boeing signed contracts with NASA to build a space capsule and send astronauts to the space station, but in the last test of Boeing ’ s Starliner capsule late last year, the launch of the capsule failed and failed to reach the speed needed to leave Earth ’ s orbit, forcing experts to bring the capsule back to Earth.
NASA officials said the SpaceX capsule was more successful than Boeing, and the Boeing capsule needed to carefully examine and fix the problem in order to obtain approval to send astronauts into space after various tests.
If a successful launch of astronauts to the International Space Station using the Dragon Crew Space Capsule, dubbed the Demo-2 mission, NASA will pay $3.1 billion to continue developing the capsule and sending several cargo launches to SpaceX.

title: Family of Ukrainian plane victims: No hope for investigation
text:
Some family members of the victims of the downing of the Ukrainian plane, in an interview with the Rokna website, have expressed disappointment in the investigation of the case and the negligence of the authorities in Iran.
In the report, published on Friday, May 2, Badii Ardestani, a 28-year-old woman who was killed in the downing of the plane, said: “We have no hope at all. ”
He said government officials said the shooter had been identified, "but would not be presented to us."
The brother of Mohammad Amin Biruti, a 29-year-old working in Canada who was killed in the downing of the plane, said the authorities "did not take any questions" and "there is no answer for us."
Earlier, two family members of the victims of the Ukrainian plane had been sharply critical of comments made by a Revolutionary Guards commander and the Iranian foreign minister.
Leila Latifi, the mother of Amir Hossein Saeedi Nia, who was killed in the downing of the plane, tweeted on May 8, referring to some news about Iran ’ s foreign minister ’ s consultation with Canadian officials, wrote: “Javad Zarif, how much did you pay for every moment my son ’ s beautiful smile? ”
The writer Hamed Ismailion, who lost his wife and daughter during the downing of the plane, tweeted on May 8, referring to the remarks of Amir Ali Hajizadeh, commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force, wrote: “Murderers in the name of the national hero appear on television in defense of the Supreme Leader and protestors of crime are in prison. ”
Families of the plane crash victims living outside Iran have formed a forum to appeal the case.
The association, known as the PS752 Family Association, has repeatedly criticized the lack of attention and misplaced comments by the Islamic Republic ’ s officials.
Meanwhile, Mohammad Javad Jamali Nobandgani, a member of parliament ’ s national security commission, told Rokna news agency that “the case is in a military court ” and“ there are a number of confidential issues in military matters. ”
He added that “the defendant will certainly appear in court ” and that“ the issue of Diya is certainly a matter of concern. ”
The official did not say when the trial will take place.
Earlier, Shukrullah Bahrami, the head of the Judiciary Organization of the Iranian Armed Forces, had said that one person was in detention because of the case, and several others had been summoned as defendants.
Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752 was shot down on the morning of January 9, 2018 by the Iranian Revolutionary Guards.
Iranian officials initially denied firing at the plane, citing a "technical failure" as the cause of the crash.
Three days later, the General Staff of the Armed Forces took responsibility for the incident, but there has been no public report on the case since.
The lack of information about the process of prosecuting the perpetrators of the case continues while on May 5, it was announced that the Revolutionary Court in Amol city had sentenced five of those who participated in a protest against the downing of the Ukrainian plane by the Revolutionary Guards to a total of 30 months in prison.
The charges have not been announced, but each of them has been sentenced to six months in prison.

title: Starship will be in orbit for the next six months.
text:
Elon Musk made the announcement on Saturday, September 28, during an event in which he briefly talked about SpaceX ’ s plans and the company ’ s history.
During the event, which took place at SpaceX ’ s testing facility near Boca Chika, Texas, Musk also said he expected the prototype to reach 65,000 feet in the next few months.
Musk added that Starship ’ s next flight after reaching this milestone will be to orbit.
The event also featured a demonstration of the Starship, which showed that the spacecraft would be 50 meters long and 9 meters wide, and could eventually carry a payload of 150 tons.
It was also shown that the starship will be launched by a large rocket called Super Heavy.
The Super Heavy rocket will have a diameter of 9 meters and a length of 68 meters.
According to Musk, the Super Heavy can accommodate up to 37 Raptors.
But he added that he was not sure that such progress would be made.
Musk noted that the number of engines varies depending on the mission and showed that the minimum number of booster engines could be around 24.
In most cases, the mask did not announce anything new.
He discussed previously announced design decisions, including a change in materials used to make the Starship from carbon fiber to steel, which he announced earlier this year.
He also showed clips of previous SpaceX achievements, including the first Falcon Heavy launch in 2018 and the successful test of the company ’ s Starhopper prototype in August.
Musk also repeated several times during last night ’ s event that his ultimate goal is to allow humans to finally live in another world.
But while he pushes his company to achieve this ambitious goal, it seems that one of SpaceX ’ s biggest clients, Elon Musk, is the human spaceflight project to near-Earth planets.
SpaceX is building a different spacecraft called the Crew Dragon for NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
The project has been repeatedly delayed, but the timeline is now under way again, and NASA is pushing ahead with an ambitious plan to land humans on the moon again by 2024.

title: More than 120 migrants rescued in the Channel by the British Coast Guard
text:
French naval and shipping officials said the British coast guard had rescued more than 120 migrants trying to cross the English Channel in seven small boats.
In recent months, the French and British coastguards have repeatedly intercepted boats attempting to transport Asian and African migrants across the English Channel to Britain.
The Reuters report echoed the comments of Clare Moseley, the founder of a charity in Calais, who said the plight of migrants in French refugee camps led them to make such a perilous journey.
The migration of these people speaks of the terrible conditions prevailing in some parts of the world.
They want to go to Britain because they want to be safe.
The English Channel is the part of the Atlantic Ocean that links it to the North Sea and is located in northern France and southern England.
The length of the Channel is about 560 km and its width varies from 240 km at its widest point to 34 km at the Dover Strait.

title: Starship is scheduled to launch into Earth orbit within six months.
text:
Last night, Elon Musk, president of SpaceX, at a conference at SpaceX ’ s facility in Boccaccia, Texas, revealed details of the Starship space rocket and when it will launch into orbit.
Elon Musk said during his conference that the Starship rocket could be launched into orbit within the next six months.
Elon Musk said: “I think we should do our best to become a special company, and we should do it now.
Musk believes that humans can and should become an “interplanetary ” species.
He believes his new spacecraft could help achieve that lofty goal.
He explained last night about the Starship rocket that could one day take humans to Mars.
He explained about Starship at the event, but said he would be tweeting more about the rocket in the coming months.
It has been 11 years since the Falcon 1 was launched into orbit.
Since then, the company has made significant progress.
The Mars mission has always been at the forefront of SpaceX ’ s goals.
Three years ago, Elon Musk expressed his desire to send humans to the Red Planet with a super, reusable rocket.
Now the interplanetary rocket he talked about has been launched.
So far, the Starhopper test vehicle, which is actually a prelude to the launch of the giant Starship rocket, has flown two low-altitude flights with a single Raptor engine.
The next goal is to launch a prototype of the Mk1 triple-engine from the ground.
They expect Mk1 to rise to an altitude of about 12 miles (20 km).
The second prototype, Mk2, is under construction at the SpaceX facility in Florida.
The company is building "Mk1" in Boca Chika and "Mk2" on the Florida coast.
The Mk1 and Mk2 will be equipped with at least three Raptor engines.
Testing these prototypes paves the way for operational Starship flights, which are scheduled to begin in early 2021.
Musk said construction of the Mk3 prototype will begin next month in Boca Chika, and if all goes well, we can expect it to be completed within three months.
Musk said: “This may sound a little crazy, but we ’ re going to launch Starship into orbit within the next six months.
If three prototypes are built quickly, it is likely that the Mk4 or Mk5 will be built as well.
Musk said the next test would take place in about a month or two, but he didn ’ t say anything else, just smiled and showed his hands how to land.
Musk also said that the missile ’ s steel heat shield plays a very important role in the launch and that he loves steel.
Musk announced that instead of using carbon fiber in the body, it would use stainless steel and a new technology in the heat shield, which would accelerate planning for the development of new systems.
The new design for the SpaceX rocket and spaceship hull and the use of a fully stainless steel hull have attracted attention, as this is the first time in the history of space that such a material has been used.
Musk says carbon fiber, a lightweight, durable material used in the most modern ships and rockets, is too expensive, costing us $135 per kilogram.
According to Musk, 35 percent of this material is wasted because it ’ s very difficult to cut and work with carbon fiber, so not a lot of it can be used, which brings the actual cost to us to about $200 per kilogram.
The $3 cost of stainless steel per kilogram is certainly a great incentive to use this material.
Musk says stainless steel is heavier than carbon fiber, but stainless steel is lighter than all the other metals that can be used and easier to work with.
When it is high in chromium-nickel, it also acts strongly in cold environments, while other metals become brittle in extreme cold.
The Super Heavy rocket will be used to launch the Starship into orbit.
Musk said the missile will be nearly twice as powerful as the Saturn V, the most powerful rocket ever built, and will have 37 Raptor engines.
The Saturn V, with a height of more than 110 meters, is the largest rocket ever built.
Saturn V was designed to take the Apollo spacecraft to the moon.
Musk also said he had proposed plans for Starship's orbital refilling, which would allow the transfer of fuel between spacecraft in orbit.
Musk said the process is simpler than connecting to the International Space Station.
This is another important part of the puzzle for creating a station on the Moon or Mars.
The interesting point is that the company ’ s goal is not just to travel to the moon and Mars, but also to travel to other planets in the solar system, perhaps Saturn.
The company is currently developing a Dragon crew capsule for NASA.
Musk said that we are focusing on the Dragon capsule as well as Starship, and that the first launch is likely to take place in 2020.
At the event last year, Elon Musk announced the name of the first Japanese billionaire to go to the moon, saying the first passenger on the starship was Yusaku Maezawa.
This man is a Japanese billionaire and the founder of a fashion and clothing company.
The traveler will not make the trip alone.
He will travel to the moon with six to eight artists, including architects, musicians, fashion designers and media designers.
SpaceX ’ s Starship spacecraft is designed to send humans to the moon and Mars.
In January of this year, when Elon Musk released a picture of the test version of Starship, it drew attention to the technology, and now the test version of the spacecraft has gone through a series of tests, bringing SpaceX one step closer to realizing the dream of space tourism and sending humans to the moon and Mars in 2024.

title: IPCC Special Report Makes Major Contribution to Climate Change
text:
In a report published on the official website of the International Meteorological Organization, the World Meteorological Organization said that carrying out scientific and comprehensive assessments of the relationship between the phenomenon of climate change and the Earth, carried out by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), plays a very important role in curbing greenhouse gas emissions to counter the effect of global warming and maintain food security.
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’ s Special Report on Land and Climate Change is the result of two years of research by more than 100 scientists around the world who use their expertise as writers and judges.
According to the Secretary-General of the World Meteorological Organization, the Special Report on Climate Change and Land makes a major contribution to addressing the interplay of phenomena such as climate change, desertification, land degradation, sustainable land management, food security and greenhouse gas fluctuations in the Earth ’ s ecosystem.
The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), which form the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), hold important positions in the field of international scientific expertise.
The authors of these two organizations, with their volunteer work in the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, have written many scientific articles on the climate situation, climate risks, the costs of inaction in this field and its possible solutions.
The report stresses that different land uses, including agriculture, forestry, etc., cause 23% of greenhouse gas emissions, which are caused by direct and indirect human intervention.
Notably, land in a natural, managed state absorbs almost a third of carbon dioxide from fossil and industrial fuels.
One of the major activities of the World Meteorological Organization is the overall monitoring of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
In this regard, the Global Atmospheric Monitoring Program contributes to health, agricultural productivity and food security by providing relevant data.
In this program, observations of concentrations of carbon dioxide and other heat-absorbing gases are published in the Annual Greenhouse Gases Bulletin, which, like other reports by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, assists UN decision-makers in negotiations on climate change.
The World Meteorological Organization is one of the pioneers of the Global Greenhouse Comprehensive Information System (IG3IS).
Knowledge and policies related to greenhouse gas emissions as well as the identification and determination of greenhouse gas uptake wells are the responsibility of the organization.
According to the Secretary General of the World Meteorological Organization, knowledge of the Earth system and the complex interactions between the atmosphere, ocean, land, cryosphere, biosphere and human activities are among the main tasks of the World Meteorological Organization.
Combining atmospheric, ocean, land and cryosphere forecasting models is important to improve accurate forecasts and provide extensive services in the areas of livelihoods, health, food and water supply.
The Special Report on Climate Change and Land was published after its adoption by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change on August 7.
The results of this report highlight the fact that the Earth has been greatly affected by human achievements and the issue of climate change has added to its problems, which requires optimal management of the planet.
Following the goals of the 2015 Paris Agreement, governments succeeded in strengthening the international response to climate change by stabilizing global average temperatures by 2 ° C above pre-industrial levels, and in their efforts to bring this to 1.5 ° C.
According to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, keeping global warming below 2 ° C – if it is impossible to achieve 1.5 ° C – will be achievable only by reducing greenhouse gas emissions from all sectors, including land and food.
Given the growing population and the negative effects of climate change on increasing vegetation cover, it is important to preserve its fertile arable land for food supply.
Earth has some limitations to tackle climate change, such as growing energy-producing crops and reforestation, and effective storage of carbon in tree and soil productivity will also take time.
Preventing the risk of food security, biodiversity and land degradation requires careful biological management.
For example, with the degradation of arable land and the occurrence of desertification, intense rainfall causes soil erosion and decreases the fertility rate and growing trend of plants, reducing the soil ’ s ability to absorb carbon.
This will exacerbate the phenomenon of climate change and reduce the security of food production, while climate change will in turn cause land degradation in many ways.
About 500 million people live in areas that experience desertification.
These areas are also vulnerable to climate change phenomena and acute events including droughts, heat waves and dust storms, which will increase due to the growing global population.
Helping countries prepare for the rise of these natural disasters and dealing with their effects is an important part of the World Meteorological Organization ’ s activities.
The World Meteorological Organization uses programs such as the Sand and Dust Storm Warning Advisory and Assessment System, the Comprehensive Drought Management Program and other climate services to tackle challenges such as agriculture, water and health issues.
Following a special report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change on a 1.5 (1.5) degree rise in global temperature, the Secretary-General of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said the organization will continue its efforts to help increase knowledge and build scientific chains as well as provide the solutions needed.
The World Meteorological Organization ’ s annual assessment on the issue of climate change, such as the announcement of the climate status index, is among the activities of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.
In June, the 18th World Meteorological Congress made important decisions on further support for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’ s assessments.
In cooperation with the World Meteorological Organization and the Intergovernmental Commission on Oceanography (IOC), as well as the International Council of Sciences, further coordination of the Board ’ s activities with global climate research programs.

title: The effects of climate change on biodiversity – with today ’ s science, extinction is a disaster
text:
Asghar Mobaraki, an environmental expert and scientific deputy of the SITES convention, said in an interview with Mehr News Agency: In the last two weeks, a lot of activities around the world have been raised on the issue of the climate plan, and at the recent UN meeting, before the General Assembly meeting, the organization had a meeting on the climate plan, and the United Nations presented a statement as a report and the media published.
Mubarak reminded: As far as I know, in our country, we have not been talked about and informed about this, while this is an issue that will continue to plague us day by day.
He explained that we look at nature from different perspectives.
From one perspective, the impacts of climate change can drastically exacerbate the protective status of many of our species and habitats.
Unfortunately, this has not received much attention and does not take into account the impact that climate change has on the conservation status of our environment.
In the discussion on the use and conservation of water resources, we raise the issues of agriculture and water use and water management, although no one cares about it.
If something was going to happen in Sistan and Baluchestan, no one would plant watermelon and this means that the concerns raised do not have much effect and may have some effect on controlling wells, for example, but in most places we do not see much effect.
He said: “What is happening in the area of the environment and water issues is limited to complaints and warnings at the level of speech and tribulation.
In practice, it is possible to say, for example, that a number of wells are closed in the area of Lake Urmia, but in contrast, we plant watermelon in places like Sistan and Baluchestan.
This use also requires a macro and general program where it has such a water condition.
He warned that the climate change situation is such that we may not have water and water resources in the future, and the talk is that we will face more rainfall shortages in the future, which in fact we have to solve now, and the remedy means that in most cases everyone is complaining about why the environment did not work, while we cannot create water and we have to think about a change of patterns, behavior and behavior. Be on top.
This environmental expert stated: We do not have any planning in the discussion of adaptation and planning and resilience.
Climate change is about resilience and adaptation, but we have no plans for these two.
Last year it rained and it may not come for another three or four years, but we have to prepare the mentality that there is a possibility that we will have a lack of rainfall in the future.
Therefore, a large program should be prepared in the form of adaptation and resilience programs, both in the field of agriculture, environment and industry, and events related to the conservation of natural resources.
He continued: One of the issues that is raised for adaptation and climate change is the conservation of natural resources, habitats and the environment.
The Paris Agreement, signed in 2016 by 197 countries that were parties to the United Nations Convention on Climate Change, originally wanted to be a nudge and a tool to try to work together internationally to tackle climate change.
Because the convention was already in place, and many countries were members but nothing was happening, so they said it would be a tool to stimulate the international community to work more together to tackle the impacts of climate change.
The environmental expert emphasized that the UN Convention on Climate Change was adopted in 1992 and since then, about five assessment reports have been submitted by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.
In all five of the most recent reports in 2019, all of these reports have led to the growing impact of climate change, and we see and are beginning to see these impacts, including the types of storms with higher intensity and the destruction of ecosystems.
Mubarak explained that climate change is in fact caused by greenhouse gases, and in 2016 a new report announced that more than 50 billion tons of greenhouse gases have been accumulated in the atmosphere, and the source of these are several important factors, namely fossil fuels, refineries, coal burning centers and projects, and industrial and transportation activities.
It is clear what our contribution to greenhouse gas emissions is like in a metropolis like Tehran or any other metropolis with this volume of traffic and cars.
Between 2030 and 2050, it is predicted that we will have 1.5 degrees of temperature rise, although it may reach two degrees, but at the moment the global effort is trying to keep the temperature rise to 1.5 degrees, and all the UN climate change plans are manoeuvring at 1.5 degrees, saying we can ’ t stop it and we should try to keep it to 1.5 degrees. We have this because the effects of 1.5 degrees are far more tolerable than the effects of 2 degrees, and the effects of 2 degrees are so great that we can ’ t afford it.
The environmental expert emphasized: “By 2017 we will have a recorded increase of one degree, and this is a degree increase by 2017 in a report that has been published on issues of biodiversity and environmental issues, such as increasing droughts in the Mediterranean region, increasing natural fires, and all of these have an impact on people ’ s lives and habitats. ”
Mubarak continued: The melting and fragmentation of glaciers is another issue that increases their potential to disappear.
We have the issue of rising ocean levels and the risk of flooding in countries that are in low-lying areas, such as the Maldives, or anywhere that has conditions like the Maldives, which means that the altitude above the ocean level is low and the risk of loss of these habitats, although small, is important in terms of biodiversity.
There is also the issue of time change in the reproduction of many important species of insects and birds, and we see effects that are registered globally in a particular region or in some regions.
He emphasized: "Ultimately, what is important for us from a natural perspective is the destruction of the environment or any activity that leads to the destruction of the environment or destroys our habitats, or in a broader sense changes our land, resulting in an intensification of the effects of climate change, and when we say land, we mean our land, ocean and marine habitats, and land in general terms."
The environmental expert warned that in the future, climate change will pose a major threat to us in the coming years.
We need to share the social and natural concept in the right way and to be aware of what ’ s going on.
Agricultural activities themselves make a significant contribution to greenhouse gas emissions.
What we cannot deny, and unfortunately we do not see this, is that we are dependent on land in terms of livelihood, whether in terms of biodiversity or environmental services and biodiversity, and all of them are dependent on land, in the general sense of the word land or land, and unfortunately human activities have affected more than 70% of the earth ’ s surface during this time.
Mobaraki added: "We must, in fact, realize that this change in the land and our destruction in general, whether through deforestation or manipulation in various forms, such as mining and the destruction of vegetation and any destruction that takes place, will help to intensify the effects of climate change."
It may not have much impact in one place or region, but when we bring these small impacts together on a global and national level, it can have a big impact.
The reality is that in some places we see the impact of increasing heatwaves or the amplitude of heat systems on our infrastructure, the impact of dust storms on our infrastructure, and the costs we have to pay for this.
I don't mean that this dust is necessarily caused by climate change, but it's not without effect, and the loss of infrastructure by the effects of climate change is something that we don't pay much attention to, and we don't take into account the costs that come with it.
The environmental expert said: "Ultimately, the rate of loss of our species will intensify dramatically because habitats are disappearing, the more habitats change, the more severe the effects of climate change, and the more severe the effects that different species take from this climate change in different forms."
Mubarak concluded that the IUCN Red List status reflects the current situation in which threatened species increase.
According to the IUCN Red List, 40% of amphibians, 25% of mammals, 14% of birds and 30% of sharks are threatened with extinction.
