title: Death: The Japanese ’ s Choice After the Disaster
text:
Sputnik – May 14, UN health experts released a relevant report saying that the situation is getting worse as no one knows the end of the coronavirus epidemic.
Dr Dora Kestel, head of the World Health Organization ’ s Office of Mental Health, explained: “Isolation, uncertainty about the future, economic hardship – all of these factors cause a lot of stress for people. ”
According to the study, signs of psychosis (stress with negative consequences for the body) have increased in 35 percent of those questioned in China, 60 percent in Iran and 45 percent in the United States.
In relation to this trend, UN experts called on governments to pay more attention to people ’ s mental health and create “emergency psychiatric services ” including remote services.
Sputnik asked Andrei Schmilovich, chair of the chair of psychiatry and medical psychology at the Russian Pyrogov Medical University, to interpret the situation.
The Russian doctor said: “We are facing serious mental disorders and we have a paranoid and panic reaction that occurred in an extraordinary situation.
This is what we call a Coronavirus or a Coronavirus psychosis.
There were even problems with people who were already perfectly healthy.
The proportion of men who call the "hotline" phone has grown significantly: there are now more men than women.
At least three out of every five calls are from men.
The main complaints are family or spouse fatigue, difficulty controlling one ’ s emotions, economic difficulties, fear of unemployment.
If measures are not taken, an outbreak of suicide among adults can be expected.
Even children and adolescents experience anxiety and self-image, for which protest reactions are more characteristic, such as dramatic conferences with friends or running away from home.
The doctors themselves, who are now experiencing tremendous stress, are turning to psychological services.
According to the Kyodo news agency, the number of concerned citizens in Japan has also increased.
So the 24-hour Inochi no Denwa service in Saitama saw a 20% increase in calls from the beginning of April.
Between 70 and 80 percent of these calls were related to COVID-19.
The age of most subscribers is from 40 to 50 years: they went to the service for fear of coronavirus and job loss during the economic downturn.
Students are worried about their future because of the cancellation of many lessons.
Parents who have to spend time at home with their children also seek advice.
Meanwhile, according to the Guardian, Japan ’ s suicide rate fell by 20% in April compared to last year.
The paper notes that this is the biggest decline in five years.
However, Ueda Michiko, associate professor at Waseda University in Tokyo, believes that unfortunately this is a temporary phenomenon: “As for the number of suicides in Japan since February of this year, in my opinion, this is a temporary decline.
It is known that the number of suicides decreases during war years and during natural disasters.
Immediately after the terrible earthquake struck eastern Japan, in March and April 2011, the number of suicides fell, but it increased sharply in May.
I think it ’ s a similar story now.
It keeps people away from suicidal thoughts.
But the state of emergency declared in the country severely affected the Japanese economy, many people lost their jobs or lost a lot of money.
So we can assume that once the situation calms down with coronavirus infection, the number of suicides will increase sharply.
In mid-April, my colleagues and I conducted a survey of ordinary citizens and found that the mental health of working-age people was worse than that of the elderly.
Sputnik: But why do Japanese people commit suicide right after the end of this or that emergency?
Is this related to Japanese conscientiousness, a sense of responsibility to help others in difficult times in this country?
Ueda Michiko: “I think in an emergency the importance of these events is such that they leave no room for other emotions and experiences.
But when things calm down, the person faces the problems of daily life.
It can wake up suicidal thoughts.
In fact, our studies have shown that during and immediately after natural disasters, the morale of mutual aid among Japanese increases significantly.
However, the current crisis is different in nature from natural disasters.
This directly affects each person ’ s life and not the area in which that person lives.
So, I think the reaction to it will be different.
It is said that in the context of the limitations caused by coronavirus, the greatest discomfort is the suffering of people whose lives are filled with intense work and numerous movements and contacts.
Those who are used to staying at home, or at least having relationships, are more likely to tolerate the current situation.
But, experts say, this worldview similarly affects the psychological state of most people.
Therefore, Tedros Adhanom, director of the World Health Organization, said: “It is abundantly clear that mental health goals should be one of the key elements in harnessing and managing the effects of the epidemic. ”
The points in this article are the author ’ s personal views and opinions and do not necessarily reflect the views of the Sputnik editorial board.

title: Inclusion of the West Bank and the Challenges Ahead of the Zionists / Three Consequences of Netanyahu ’ s Gambling
text:
According to the International Group of Young Journalists Club, according to a plan by US President Donald Trump under the title of Deal of the Century, 30 percent of the land of the West Bank and Ghor in Jordan will be annexed to the occupied territories.
One of the demands of supporters of compromise on the Palestinian issue is Israel ’ s withdrawal to the 1967 borders.
However, according to the deal of the century, not only has this not happened, but another 30 percent of the West Bank is supposed to join Israel.
On this basis, the West Bank will not have a border with the Jordan River and the Dead Sea.
The only link between the West Bank and the outside world is the two bridges that connect it to Jordan and pass through Israeli territory.
Also, Palestinian residents of the West Bank will not have access to Tel Aviv ’ s Ben Gurion Airport, and their only connection to the outside world is through two bridges that connect the West Bank to Jordan from the occupied territories.
The Amir Mohammed Bridge connects Nablus to Jordan and the King Hussein Bridge connects Jericho to Jordan.
In fact, the West Bank will be completely enclosed inside the occupied territories and its control will be in the hands of the Israeli army.
The only part of Palestine with a border outside of Israel is the current Gaza Strip, which borders the Mediterranean Sea for 12 kilometers and is unlikely to allow a port.
The Rafah crossing was previously controlled by Egypt.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced in recent weeks that he will soon annex 30 percent of the West Bank to the occupied territories.
This was agreed in the agreement between Netanyahu and Benny Gantz when the coalition cabinet was formed.
But what does it mean to join the West Bank and what challenges are facing the Zionists on this path?
The Israeli effort to dominate the West Bank, the Israeli settlement policy is based on several reasons and is constantly pursued; after the announcement of the Zionist regime in 1948, due to the territorial limitation of the regime, it has always suffered from a lack of strategic depth; therefore, in designing the security strategies of the Zionist regime, it has been trying to find a way to compensate for this weakness and thus overcome the feeling of insecurity.
In this regard, Israel chose “settlements ” as its strategy and tried to implement it.
Israel ’ s next goal of land grabbing and settlements is to prevent the formation of a Palestinian state in the future.
By building various settlements and establishing military bases in these areas, it confiscates much of the Palestinian land and destroys the geographical connectivity of the Palestinian territories.
These actions have resulted in large parts of the West Bank becoming fragmented units that lack any geographical contact with each other.
In order to form a Palestinian state, there is a need for a unified Palestinian state.
In general, the various cabinets of the Zionist regime have increased the number of settlers in the West Bank in line with this policy.
On the other hand, the Zionist regime has always tried to dominate the underground water resources of the West Bank, which has pursued this goal with the development of settlements.
Under international law, the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, is known as “occupied territory, ” and all Jewish settlement activities there are illegal.
An estimated 640,000 Israeli settlers now live in 196 different settlements that were built with the approval of the Israeli cabinet, and more than 200 settlements that were built without its approval across the West Bank.
News reports indicate that since the beginning of the responsibility of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in 2009, at least 20,000 housing units have been built for the Zionists in the West Bank.
With the coming of the Deal of the Century, the issue of West Bank annexation to Israel has also been raised much more seriously than before.
In fact, Trump is trying to recognize some kind of Israeli settlements in the West Bank as part of the deal of the century.
Stephen Walt, an American professor at Harvard University, believes that the purpose of the “Deal of the Century ” is to perpetuate the Zionist regime ’ s control over the West Bank.
In fact, when it comes to the annexation of the West Bank to Israel, it refers to the annexation of settlements built in the region.
Because according to international law, these settlements are occupied and must be destroyed, so this does not mean the annexation of the entire West Bank to Israel.
Israel ’ s attempt in the current situation is to annexe illegal settlements in the West Bank to Israeli territory, primarily to eliminate the possibility of forming a unified Palestinian state and, on the other hand, provide the ground for full security control over the West Bank.
Because the internal problems and challenges of Israel have scared the authorities of this regime.
The challenges facing Israel ’ s annexation of the West Bank to the occupied territories will undoubtedly cause the Zionist regime to face many challenges.
Several complaints will be raised about this.
1. The third intifada, one of the biggest fears of the Zionist regime, is the formation of the third intifada in the West Bank.
The constant threat of the Zionist regime has also been the possibility of arming the West Bank.
The Gaza Strip has carried out numerous operations against Israel over the past 13 years, and more recently, it has caused Israel to experience significant defeats by staging a return demonstration and sending incendiary balloons to the occupied territories.
However, due to the PA ’ s security cooperation with Israel and its hope for a two-state solution, the West Bank has not entered an armed phase against the Zionist regime.
But the deal of the century and Israel ’ s attempt to annex parts of the West Bank to the occupied territories have led the West Bank groups to move in this direction.
The PA ’ s opposition to the deal of the century and its rejection of the plan could eventually end security cooperation with Israel and put the people of the West Bank alongside the Gaza Strip in a single line against Israel.
This can lead to the formation of another intifada.
Haaretz, while stressing the halt to the West Bank annexation plan, emphasized that the potential damages of this plan will be very heavy and its implementation will face widespread anger that its signs have already been identified and the possibility of an intifada is likely to form.
The cancellation of the Palestinian Authority (PA) agreements under the leadership of Mahmoud Abbas over the past few decades has signed numerous agreements with Israel in line with security coordination.
The announcement of the deal of the century and Netanyahu ’ s attempt to annex the West Bank has led Palestinian groups in the West Bank to seek to cancel these agreements.
Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas has said that if Israel decides to annex part of the Palestinian territory to the occupied territories, we will withdraw from all agreements.
The Palestinian Authority, led by Mahmoud Abbas, had high hopes for negotiations with Israel in recent years.
He spent many years trying to reconcile with the United States and the Zionist regime, but eventually, with the Deal of the Century, he decided that all his efforts were useless.
Over the years, resistance groups in the Gaza Strip have rejected negotiations and stressed the option of resistance as the only solution to Israel.
After the repeated violations of the Zionist regime, especially after the election of Jerusalem as the capital and trying to recognize the occupation of the Golan Heights and trying to deceive the Palestinians in the framework of the deal of the century, the PA is increasingly disappointed with Israel ’ s agreement to implement the two-state plan, as in November last year, the PLO Central Council announced that it would suspend the recognition of Israel.
But at that time, the United States, some Arab countries and Israel were preoccupied with the Chinese context of the deal of the century and still did not take the threats of the PLO seriously.
The Zionist regime, by calculating that the PLO is in a weak position, still does not pay much attention to this issue or tries to show its indifference in official and unofficial positions.
But this time, Mahmoud Abbas seems serious about his decision and cancels at least some of these commitments, which will have important results.
The unity of Palestinian groups is one of those results.
After the Oslo agreement between the PA and the jihadist groups and the Hamas movement, differences arose that led to abuse by the Zionist regime.
Following the PA ’ s decision to cancel the agreements, the Hamas movement in a statement backed Abbas ’ s decision, stressing that the Palestinian people are moving toward practical and real actions in which decisions become actions.
The Palestinian National Council said: “The government ’ s decision to cancel the contracts is a new phase of resistance and resistance and calls on all Palestinians to unite in support of this decision. ”
Andrei Choprygin, a professor at the Russian School of Oriental Research, said Abbas ’ s move would lead to the full unity of the PLA and Hamas and could change the balance of power.
The weakening of the Zionist regime ’ s position is another important result in this regard.
The biggest concession Israel made after Oslo was the concession of recognition by the PLO.
Although the regime was able to sign the Hebron Agreement in 1997 following the Oslo Accords and redeploy its security forces in Hebron, it gradually broke all its promises to form two governments.
Arab countries that were still hoping for the implementation of the agreements by Israel have submitted several peace plans since 2002, the last of which was the deal of the century and the Manama Conference.
Now, with the consolidation of Palestinian groups against Israel and their seriousness, the Arab countries will have no excuse for normalizing relations with Israel and will have to make difficult choices; on the other hand, Israel will lose its previous political and security privileges because since Trump took office, many of the financial aid to the Palestinians has been cut and they have almost nothing to lose.
The international consensus on condemning this plan of West Bank annexation has been strongly condemned by international institutions.
The European Union, the Arab League, the United Nations and other major international countries consider the plan a violation of international law.
Israel Hume newspaper reported that the European Union ’ s Foreign Affairs Commission has begun negotiations over sanctions and punishing Israel if it implements its plan to annex the West Bank in order to declare sovereignty over it in line with the plan proposed by Donald Trump ’ s administration for the Middle East.
The United Nations has declared the plan illegal and condemned Israel ’ s unilateral efforts.
Jordan ’ s opposition is even more important.
Because the country made a peace treaty with Israel in the 1990s, Zionist experts have been worried about Jordan ’ s opposition to the West Bank annexation.
Rui Kayes, an Israeli Arab political analyst on Jordan ’ s reactions in the event of West Bank annexation, said that the threats may begin with a reduction in the level of relations between the country and Tel Aviv, saying, “The king of Jordan knows well that if parts of the West Bank are annexed to the occupied territories, Jordan may officially become the land of Palestinian replacement, and this is the biggest nightmare for Jordan, so the time has come. It will be faster in Israel. ”
Haaretz also emphasized the halt of the West Bank annexation plan, saying that the West Bank annexation will lead to a deep gap in relations with Jordan, in addition to destroying all opportunities for political negotiations with the Palestinians based on a two-state solution, and it should be emphasized that this is an existential threat to Israel.
Amos Gilad in his article in the Yedioth Aharanot newspaper wrote: The annexation of the West Bank is a blow to Israel, which causes severe damage to its security, because once one of Israel ’ s problems was providing security on the eastern border, but today Jordan has become an Israeli ally and is considered a strategic depth for its security, and the West Bank ’ s annexation damages these relations.
The result of the annexation of the West Bank to the occupied territories is one of the important plans that Netanyahu is seeking to implement.
He is trying to do this before the US presidential election.
But the main issue is that it violates international law and UN resolutions.
The Zionist regime will play a big gamble by implementing this plan, which may lead to the start of the third intifada in the West Bank.
It could also lead the PA to withdraw from all agreements signed with Israel, a major threat to Israel.
In any case, this plan may be implemented as well as the transfer of the capital from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, but global condemnation, along with the unity of Palestinian groups, will defeat it and have many consequences for Israel.
The end of the story is revealed by Joseph.

title: Countdown to the start of a new chapter in the history of space travel
text:

Robert Benken (left) and Douglas Harley, along with the US-made Crew Dragon, have been flying from a base in Kazakhstan since 2001.

Follow Deutsche Welle on Instagram The Falcon 9 launcher, also built by SpaceX with NASA support, is scheduled to fly the Crew Dragon capsule to the International Space Station at an altitude of about 400 km above Earth in a 19-hour mission.

title: The SpaceX spacecraft has finally gone into space.
text:

The crew of this mission are NASA astronauts.

title: NASA ’ s crewed launch may not happen today
text:

Because we are learning now.
"Bob and Douglas are our top priority, and we will do it when everything is safe and we can do it.
According to NASA, the number of visitors to the historic mission is limited due to conditions in the United States due to the coronavirus, and all tickets for the visit have been sold out.

If successful, it would be SpaceX ’ s first manned space flight and the first launch of astronauts from U.S. soil since the Space Shuttle mission, and would give the space agency autonomy from Russia for manned space launches.
NASA used the Soyuz space capsule to send astronauts to the International Space Station.

title: Will the nine-year-old American astronaut curse be broken?
text:

Robert Benken and Douglas Hurley aboard both NASA astronauts aboard Crew Dragon and SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket.

title: Fear of explosion prevented SpaceX space capsule launch
text:
In the final moments of the launch of the space capsule of the Dragon Crew to the International Space Station from the Kennedy Space Station in Florida due to the bad weather and the possibility of lightning hitting the rocket and the space capsule carrying it and causing an accident for astronauts, SpaceX and NASA experts decided to cancel the launch.
The upcoming launch of the Dragon Crew Space Capsule is scheduled to take place next Saturday afternoon.
SpaceX experts used liquid oxygen to shut down and cool the rocket after the decision to cancel the launch.
According to SpaceX experts, the canceled launch on Wednesday provided an "extraordinary and thorough exercise" to review all equipment, rescue personnel and inform the two crew members of the space capsule that they are ready to address possible defects and fix them.
The Dragon Crew capsule will be used to transport astronauts to the International Space Station, and in the coming years, the capsule will be used for long-term space travel, such as to the moon.
The presence of rain clouds in the space capsule launch area and unstable waves in the Atlantic Ocean did not provide favorable weather conditions for the launch of the space capsule and the space mission was canceled.
Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, no American astronaut has been to the International Space Station, and all launches have been from the Baikonur space station in Kazakhstan and the Russian Soyuz space rocket.
In 2014, NASA signed a deal with SpaceX and Boeing to use a new generation of space capsules to transport astronauts into space.
These days, the United States pays about $80 million to the Russian space agency for every seat on the Soyuz space capsule.
Two SpaceX trained astronauts, Robert L. Behnken and Douglas G. Hurley, both former NASA astronauts on space shuttle missions, have been selected for the first crewed mission of the Dragon Crew capsule.
In addition to transporting astronauts to the International Space Station, SpaceX plans to use the Space Crew Dragon capsule in the coming years to help boost the space tourism industry and send space enthusiasts on short space trips to Earth orbit.
To accurately connect the space capsule to the International Space Station, special calculations and sending the capsule at a specific time are needed to connect the capsule to the body, and in case of launch at an inappropriate time, the mission will fail.
The cancellation of the historic SpaceX and NASA mission, experts say bad weather could increase the risk of failed launch missions.
Very strong winds or the presence of electrically charged clouds that produce lightning can cause destruction of equipment, crew and payloads associated with the space rocket.
Even after the mission was canceled and the Falcon 9 rocket was shut down, the two SpaceX astronauts were forced to spend an hour inside the capsule to fully deplete the rocket ’ s fuel and avoid the risk of them leaving the capsule.
The SpaceX Dragon Crew capsule can carry up to seven people and will be able to take part in future missions after returning to Earth with modifications to some equipment.
In NASA's space projects, the Dragon Crew Capsule will be used to carry up to four people.

title: Historic and successful launch of SpaceX spacecraft
text:
Robert Benken and Douglas Harley set off for the International Space Station from the Florida Space Station with Crew Dragon and SpaceX Space Equipment Corporation's Falcon 9 rocket.
The US space agency, NASA, which broadcast the successful launch to the station, called their journey "historic."
The capsule will be docked next to the International Space Station after about 19 hours of flight.
The spacecraft ’ s initial launch schedule was canceled last Wednesday due to bad weather conditions a quarter before its launch.
NASA was concerned that the next launch schedule of the spacecraft, at 22: 00 a.m. on Sunday, may also be delayed due to poor weather conditions.
US President Donald Trump, who was in Florida to attend the launch ceremony on Wednesday, called Sunday's successful launch "heroic."
For the first time, NASA has used equipment from a private company to send astronauts.
The Falcon 9 rocket and Dragon Crew capsule are made by a company owned by American billionaire Elon Musk and CEO of Tesla.
So far, the company has had unmanned space missions.
Since the summer of 2011, when NASA sent its astronauts to the International Space Station on the space shuttle Atlantis for the last time, it has been decommissioned with the aim of reducing the cost of its space fleet and has been dependent on the Russian space agency ever since.
This dependency cost NASA a lot of money and was a source of unhappiness for the American people.
Russia received about $90 million per seat in its space business.
NASA ’ s plan to hand over transportation of its astronauts to the private sector has also been postponed due to technical problems, budget shortfalls and changes that came after Donald Trump took office.
NASA announced in 2014 that it had selected SpaceX and Boeing to work together on the Crew Dragon and CST 100 Starliner spacecraft.
The two companies each received several billion dollars from NASA, but the process of building a safe spacecraft that could carry humans into orbit took longer than anticipated, and NASA's dependence on the Russian Space Agency continued until Sunday morning's mission.

title: Dragon, the launch that has been launched to transform the space industry
text:
The successful launch of the Dragon capsule towards the International Space Station could be a major step in the space industry.
This success has been widely reflected in the media around the world.
Last night, NASA teamed up with SpaceX to launch a historic space launch, and nearly 10 years later, two of its astronauts, Douglas J.
Douglas G. Hurley and Robert L. Hurley.
Robert L. Behnken was sent from the United States to the International Space Station.
SpaceX's Dragon capsule was launched on the company's Falcon 9 rocket.
The mission was the first manned launch of the Dragon capsule, as the spacecraft had previously conducted unmanned missions and sent laboratory equipment to the International Space Station.
In a way, it can be said that Dragon has its own characteristics compared to previous spacecraft.
Astronauts such as Douglas J.
Douglas G. Hurley and Robert L. Hurley.
Robert L. Behnken also had some interesting comments about the spacecraft's features.
Robert L.
In a press release, Behneken said, “It may be every pilot ’ s dream to fly in a brand-new spacecraft. ”
I was lucky enough to get this opportunity.
The astronauts spent a lot of time preparing for last night ’ s flight, performing various simulations.
The two have worked with SpaceX since the early days of mission preparation.
As Douglas Harley said, “It was at least five or six years ago that we went to SpaceX and evaluated different control mechanisms.
But even on modern spacecraft like the Dragon, there are still plenty of control components that leave little space for astronauts.
The Dragon capsule is designed to be able to fly autonomously during the entire flight.
These automated operations include automatic docking of Dragon to the space station, separation from orbit, and the landing process.
But the Dragon also has manual control, and in case of any errors, the astronauts can take control of the spacecraft themselves.
The Dragon capsule has unique capabilities and has undergone numerous tests to achieve its new success.
One of the features of this capsule is its Launch Error System (LAS) or Emergency Escape System (LES).
The system is embedded on top of the giant rocket and is tasked with quickly removing the crew capsule from the rocket in case of danger or a possible explosion.
It has been used since the Mercury program to launch the Saturn V rocket for lunar exploration in the 1960s and 1970s, and is now used in Russian Soyuz rocket launches.
The system can be divided into two parts.
The first part is a lightweight protective shell that covers the capsule during the climb.
This coating protects the capsule from heat, wind and acoustic pressures.
The second part is the launch tower, which sits on top of the guard.
The tower is at the top of the rocket and has three launch error detection engines, as well as capsule separation and altitude control engines.
The engines are immediately activated during launch if the mission is deemed to be a failure, and the capsule separates the astronauts from the main rocket body.
Eventually, the parachute opens and the capsule lands safely on the ground.
This important feature indicates that SpaceX and the Dragon capsule have taken an important step toward their goal of safely sending astronauts to the International Space Station.
SpaceX had 13 successful tests of the capsule ’ s parachute to prove the performance of the Dragon capsule ’ s parachute system.
This parachute system can safely land the Dragon using only three of its parachutes.
The Dragon capsule can carry up to seven passengers on each flight.
The new SpaceX suit for the Demo-2 mission, the suit worn by the astronauts of the mission, is a new design in the space suit produced by SpaceX.
In the production of these new clothes, new technologies have been used.
For example, helmets are made with 3D printing technology and gloves are sensitive to the touch screen.
The main purpose of these suits is to protect astronauts from when they are not in the air capsule.
The suits also ensure that astronauts have enough oxygen and that their temperatures are regulated.
The communication link of breathable air is supplied through a central cable in the seat that is attached to the garment.
The spacesuit is called “Starman ” and it ’ s a piece.
But the point of these suits is that they are designed only for use inside the Dragon spacecraft and are not suitable for spacewalks.
A major step forward for the U.S. space industry, the successful launch of Dragon could revolutionize the aerospace industry.
This important mission has had a variety of reflections in reputable media around the world.
With the launch of the Dragon, the United States will eliminate its dependence on the Russians to send astronauts into space.
For the past few years, American astronauts have been aboard the Russian Soyuz spacecraft.
In addition, the Demo-2 mission marks the beginning of a new era in the commercial space industry, where private companies could sell tickets to ordinary travelers in the future to boost space tourism.
SpaceX plans to make orbital flights for space tourists in the not-too-distant future.
CNN reported that NASA and SpaceX had sent astronauts from the US within a decade.
The BBC News called the launch a date.
The Washington Post reports that the United States has opened a new chapter in space adventures.
Fox News reported the launch as historic.
On its website, The Guardian pointed to the presence of Donald Trump and Mike Pence at the Dragon launch site, writing: “This is a joint venture between NASA and a private company.

The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket was successfully launched on Saturday evening from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

title: Astronauts arrive at the International Space Station.
text:
Astronauts sent into space aboard the Crew Dragon capsule arrived at the International Space Station after 19 hours.
The astronauts, Douglas Harley and Bob Benken, were launched last night with the SpaceX capsule from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
After arriving at its destination, the Crew Dragon capsule was automatically attached to the International Space Station.
This is the first time a privately owned capsule has taken astronauts to the International Space Station.
In addition, for the first time in 10 years, astronauts were sent into space from the United States.
NASA has not yet announced how long Harley and Benken will stay on the International Space Station.
Their stay at the station is estimated to be one to four months.
During their stay in space, Harley and Benken will conduct experiments with three other crew members of the International Space Station, and will likely participate in spacewalks to install new batteries on the station.

The same series, which are not very popular in Turkey, are playing with the cultural identity of their neighbors.

Can the home theater network in Iran, according to Kaidan, create such an atmosphere, and does it even want to break social definitions in Iran and in countries that have much stronger conventional lines than us in many issues and gain economic and profit?
It ’ s a question we all know the answer to …
These non-Iranian Iranian series, just as people watched Persian One series with round eyes a decade and a half ago, have watched similar homegrown productions with rounded eyes since a year or two ago, and then the trend has continued until they get used to watching them and follow them.
Iranian series that are based on exactly the same Turkish series, with the same crises and shortcomings and the same useless attractions.
They don ’ t have stories because they don ’ t have good writers.
Today ’ s writers of home theater networks do not know how to tell stories, so they want to attract audiences by adding sexual elements and showing aristocratic life.
Their stories are not written to generate economic outings in other countries, nor to cure the pain of the people watching them.
This series has an internal address and an internal turnover.
It has internal damage and internal damage.

title: How does psychology help solve the COVID-19 crisis?
text:
Researchers have developed strategies for providing psychological interventions during the COVID-19 outbreak.
Studies have shown that due to the COVID-19 outbreak, some families may lose their source of income and students may become anxious about paying their tuition fees.
Therefore, in addition to the impact this epidemic has on the country ’ s economy, it creates problems related to physical and mental health at the national level.
In a review study, researchers examined how psychological interventions are presented in COVID-19.
The study states: “This article is based on narrative review articles from January 1 to April 1, 2020 by searching for keywords such as: new coronavirus 2019, medical and nursing staff, crisis intervention, new coronavirus outbreak, COVID-19, epidemic, crisis services, defense mechanisms, personality and crisis in prestigious sites of PubMed, ScienceDirect, Scopus, Google Scholar, ProQuest and also known. ” The most domestic databases, namely, ACECR, IranMedex, Migran and two Persian English languages, were conducted. ”
According to the authors, the research also searched some articles published online by China ’ s National Health Commission, the National Center for Disease Prevention and Control, and the World Health Organization.
Out of a total of 200 articles on psychological interventions in crisis, in general, and psychological interventions in the coronavirus, 35 articles eligible for these conditions were used for research.
"The findings of this study suggest that consistent provision of appropriate psychological services, even for those with mild or subliminal psychological problems, during pandemics is necessary to minimize the likelihood of exacerbation."
In another part of this study, the authors of this paper have categorized the levels of psychological interventions in the current crisis as follows: 1- Psychiatrists and psychologists can, with the correct diagnosis and file formation based on the severity of psychological problems for those who are in crisis and their separation in different groups to the authorities in order to provide financial assistance or any treatment support to the most vulnerable groups in which their performance may be completely impaired. Oh, they have.
People with sub-threshold or mild symptoms that make up the majority of the population can be greatly reduced by preparing brochures and activating telephone or internet lines as needed, as well as the training provided by public media.
In order to provide services to these clients who are in good mental health and only need guidance, counselors and psychologists who have received relevant training in this regard can be used.
3. For the treatment staff who are at the forefront of dealing with the disease, it is possible to provide psychotherapy services in the hospital and face to face, observing all health points and in the absence of the psychotherapist and the client.
For people with severe disorders, it is necessary to use professional psychotherapists who have specialized courses in the field of mental disorders.
Educational brochures and content produced to reduce anxiety and stress in the context of the coronavirus epidemic should be tailored to its audience.
6- It is necessary to establish specialized committees in our country, consisting of experts in the field of psychological crisis management, and the rest of the experts work under the supervision of this committee to prevent the divergence of votes and dissensions that not only do not result, but also greatly confuse the people.
Many of the psychological crises and anxiety created in epidemic situations are related to the financial and economic problems that many people face during such crises and are not fundamentally introspective.
Such people not only do not get help if they call a counselor and express their problems, but they may even feel more frustrated and frustrated.
It is suggested that if possible, a committee should be formed to address the problems of jobs at risk and set up telephone lines to provide services to these people.
This study was prepared by Mohsen Ahmadi Tahore Soltani, Associate Professor of Baqiyatallah University, Shokoufeh Taherabadi, Master of Clinical Psychology, Islamic Azad University, Hamedan Branch, AmirMohsen Rah Nejat, Arsia Taheri and Vahid Sanati University, Assistant Professors of Aja University of Medical Sciences and Haleh Shahed Haggam Ghadam.
End of message.

title: 'Game of Islamic Throne and Crown ': Why Artoghrol became controversial in Pakistan
text:
Getty Images Image caption The series has been dubbed the Islamic Game and Throne, a historical series of the Turkey-made Artoghrol uprising, aired on Pakistani state television since April and has gained a lot of fans.
The popularity of this series has been met with two completely opposite sides.
Some say the show is a threat to local culture and incitement to violence, while others praise it for honoring Muslim heroes.
But these discussions are not limited to analysts and figures, and Pakistani politicians also have a strong presence in the talks.
This is not the first time that a Turkish series has become popular in Pakistan.
But the difference is that Prime Minister Imran Khan is also promoting it for reasons that are thought to be personal and political.
A story about “Islamophobia ”?
One of the main reasons for the wave caused by the series in Pakistan is Imran Khan himself.
He not only praised the series and asked Pakistani television to show it, but also claimed that it would help Pakistan understand the importance of Islamic civilization.
As a result of these comments, the number of viewers of the series in Pakistan has increased to unprecedented levels.
Critics say Khan supported the series because it is consistent with his promotion of Islamic values and with his efforts to transform Pakistan into an ideal Islamic society.
He has said since becoming prime minister that he wants to "build a Pakistan that looks like the first Islamic society in history created by the Prophet Muhammad in Medina."
But it doesn ’ t seem to be a matter of personal interest.
An article in Pakistan ’ s English-language newspaper suggested that “perhaps the main reason should be sought in a closed-door meeting between him, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, and Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, held behind closed doors at the UN General Assembly. ”
In September 2019, the trio came up with the idea of launching a television aimed at countering what they said was rampant Islamophobia.
Photo copyright Samir Hussein Image caption Some think that promoting the series in Pakistan is a political decision Mr Erdogan praised the series for "capturing the heart of the nation" at an awards ceremony held in Turkey in November 2016.
The Diplomat website said in a note that Mr Khan "probably wants to take political advantage in Turkey, with which Pakistan is strengthening its ties".
But the Pakistani prime minister has also faced criticism at home for his clear support for the series.
Mushtaq Ahmad Khan, an anti-government senator, recently told parliament: “You [Mr Khan] can ’ t rebuild Medina ’ s government by broadcasting Artoghl. ”
The series is based on the life of Ertugrul, the 13th-century Muslim leader of Il Qai, whose son Osman is known as the founder of the Ottoman Empire.
Its main theme is the courage of the Muslim Turks in the battle against the Mongol invaders, the Christians, the Byzantine Empire and the Knights Templar in Anatolia.
Some Pakistani media say the program "glorifies the Islamic value apparatus and the Ottoman Empire."
The author of an article in the popular newspaper Mellat also believes that the series “rightly celebrates Muslim heroes, Islamic history and ethics. ”
Analysts believe that Muslims are mostly "shown negatively" in TV shows and movies, making the series a desirable change.
The English-language newspaper Global Village Space said in an article that “Muslims sought a positive and strong image in the global media.
And it seems that the Artoghrol uprising has satisfied the need to see a worshipful image of Muslims. ”
Some, like the Daily News columnist Amina Heydar Isani, feel that the series has played “a very important role in combating Islamophobia around the world. ”
But critics like Hodboy disagree with this view.
Referring to the show ’ s extreme violence and beheading, he says, “If the show ’ s goal was to paint a peaceful image of Islam and counter Islamophobia, it ’ s the opposite. ”
Others, such as cyberspace activist Jibran Nasir, who has become a politician, say the program is creating an “identity crisis ” among Pakistanis.
Photo copyright AAMIR QURESHI Image caption A family watching the Artoghl uprising in Islamabad also pointed to the popularity of the series in Pakistan.
The state-run Anadolu news agency quoted Pakistanis as saying the series "flies the flag of Islam" and "shows what a Muslim leader should look like."
Compared to the “soulless family stuff, ” some would argue that another reason for the foreign show ’ s popularity is the lack of high-quality Pakistani TV shows.
According to the Global Village Space newspaper, a number of Pakistani Twitter users claim that Artoghrol “has a different and entertaining content compared to the repetitive and soulless stories related to the family issues of Pakistani series. ”
The newspaper also writes that “it is clear that the main issue is the large number of TV channels and the lack of quality content. ”
Pakistani television productions have a large audience, but they do not address Islamic values very much.
Pakistani producers feel threatened by the Turkish series, and many, including Science and Technology Minister Fawad Chaudhary, express concern about the harm that foreign imports will do to the entertainment industry.
But Ms Isna hopes that the series Artoghrol Uprising will inspire better production in Pakistan.

title: The Role of Garden Cities from Environmental Perspective in Attracting Tourists
text:
According to the reporter of the Province Group of Young Journalists Club of Semnan, from the distant past in Iran, gardens have always been the place of people's living, and the combination of gardens with the city is called the Garden City.
The garden serves several important functions in the city, first in terms of livelihood and economy of the community, and also plays an important role in the food security of the community, and throughout history it has provided the economic benefits of the community.
The environmental impact of the garden in cities is another role of this urban space, which prevents the bad winds and causes cooling and increasing humidity, the water supply of the gardens increases the groundwater of the area and prevents soil erosion and floods, and provides an environment of animals such as storks, owls, dragonflies and birds and other grazers that are very useful for the cycle....
These gardens of cities have many tangible and intangible heritage. In the garden of cities, different generations worked together to create a suitable space for social interactions, and the tangible and intangible heritage is preserved, and cultural exchanges between different social classes and generations are also taking place, and in total, it contributes to the sustainable development of the region, and Semnan Garden City is an example of this ancient heritage that every day. We see the city garden.
Semnan has a historic water distribution system, and this same water distribution system has created gardens and an environmental hydrological structure such as a water mill, refrigerator, and water storage.
Garden City is a way to promote the culture of work and assistance in Semnan. The old neighborhoods of Semnan, which were once very beautiful gardens, are now part of these gardens have been converted into residential houses, and the hydraulic structures of the environment have been integrated with the urban environment, and many parts have retained their originality and exist as rural architecture.
Mohammad Amouzade, author and public culture researcher on the impact of the environmental diversity of Semnan Garden on the lifestyle and culture of Semnan people said: The existence of ponds, water reservoirs, diversity of trees and water structures and historical water pools has made people more familiar with the nature of the distant past and the need for people to explore the nature and visual aesthetics is met and the culture of respect for nature from childhood among Semnan people. The culture of work and helping culture in the city is far from the past.
It should be noted that now we are in the season of vegetables such as mint and leeks, and drying mint and aromatic vegetables is a kind of support culture in this garden city, which is carried out in cooperation with family members of this garden city, which causes the culture of work and cooperation from childhood among the people of this land, of course, due to the decrease in the area of the garden of the city compared to the past, but fortunately still remains.
The tower in the Semnan language is a place where water is divided into different farms and a smooth wood is the place to measure the water share of each farmer, and the tower after watering is the place of gathering insects and various animal species.
Mostafa Khoshnavis, a member of the Forest Research Board of the Research Institute of Forests and Rangelands of the country, said: Garden cities bring peace to the environment, soften the climate, control wind erosion and create diverse animal habitats.
He added: The characteristics of traditional garden cities are genetic diversity that makes the ecosystem sustainable against environmental stresses.
Environmental diversity plays an important role in air sustainability issues and reducing greenhouse gases and plant diversity, making the region safe from strong winds.
Semnan has a heritage of native trees and plants such as Angier, Sanjed and Castor and medicinal plants such as Penicerk or Narcissus that should expand this native cultivation.
The cultivation of Semnan gardens is based on extensive agriculture and in widespread agriculture, chemical fertilizers, pesticides and herbicides are not used, and this causes useful insects such as honey bees and ladybugs in this garden city.
By buying and using organic garden products, people encourage farmers to preserve organic plants and trees and preserve the habitat of animals and beneficial insects such as honey bees; on the other hand, agricultural subsidies also encourage organic cultivation and bee pollination is essential for the environment.
In Semnan, gardens have created a beautiful environment with great diversity, which has created a tangible and intangible heritage, and the province can be one of the destinations for low-speed tourism and environmental tourism despite the beautiful gardens.
With the introduction of an environmental garden city such as Semnan, with abundant native trees and plants, and old mills and glaciers that have low energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, an important step is taken in understanding the historical environmental culture of Iran.
End of message.

title: Hunting of Lake Urmia from space

He flew for the third time as crew commander of Crew Dragon Demo-2, the first space flight from the US since STS-135.
