title: NASA has agreed to reuse the Dragon capsule.
text:
As part of its plans to send a man to the moon, NASA announced that it would re-use SpaceX ’ s Dragon capsule.
NASA has announced that it will allow SpaceX to re-use its Dragon capsule and Falcon 9 rocket in the near future.
The Dragon capsule recently sent two American astronauts to the International Space Station from the United States.
The launch was from NASA ’ s Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida, which has been used for other missions, including Apollo.
The Demo-2 mission was a successful test flight.
In a statement, NASA said: “While this is not unexpected, it is an important step for NASA ’ s commercial manned programs that have led the United States to return to power and fly space from its soil. ”
According to NASA ’ s contract with SpaceX, the company has been allowed to reuse both its Falcon 9 and its Dragon.
The revised contract will allow SpaceX to carry out its second operational mission, known as PCM-2 or Crew-2.
The change is intended as part of a bilateral reform plan that formally extends the Demo-2 mission from two weeks to 119 days.
The Dragon capsule is said to be reused in 2021.
On SpaceX ’ s recent historic mission, Doug Harley and Bob Behenken were sent into orbit aboard the Dragon capsule.
About 19 hours later, the Crew Dragon capsule was automatically attached to the International Space Station to make the first successful journey to the orbital station from a US-based space station since the space shuttle's retirement in 2011.
End of message.

title: New details of Ukrainian plane crash from Tehran military prosecutor
text:
Gholamabbas Turki, the military prosecutor of Tehran province, on Monday, in a meeting with a group of families of the martyrs of the Ukrainian plane crash and a number of their lawyers held at the Judiciary Organization of the Armed Forces, said that the Judiciary Organization of the armed forces in this incident is sympathetic to the families of the martyrs, explaining the incident at today's meeting is not to normalize or justify it.
A passenger plane Boeing 737 of Ukrainian Airlines, which flew with number 752 on the morning of January 8, 2019 from Tehran to Kiev, the capital of the European country, was shot down by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) minutes after the flight from Imam Khomeini International Airport, and all 176 passengers and crew died.
More than half of the passengers killed in the crash were Iranian.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, in describing the actions taken after the incident, said that the presence of law enforcement and Red Crescent forces at the site of the accident, with the management of the Shahriar governor, was among the first steps after the plane crash, and the twelve groups of civil aviation accident investigation were immediately present at the scene and took the initial actions.
He said: “The day after the accident, on January 19, a delegation of 47 Ukrainians visited the site of the accident and made good cooperation with the delegation.
Turki said that on the same day of the incident, a case was formed in the Shahriar General Court, saying: 3 days later, on January 11, when the General Staff of the Armed Forces, after initial investigations, announced the cause of the accident as a result of human error, the case was sent to the Judiciary Organization of the Armed Forces and the Judiciary Board of the Military Court was formed on the same day.
Commenting on the three-day delay in announcing the incident and firing of the defense system, he said: "Among the reasons that the authorities have announced in this regard, is the necessity of a minimum investigation to clarify how the shooting and accident occurred, including the investigation of the relevant individuals, disembarking of tape recordings, matching radar graphs and investigating the possibilities and hypotheses that are under investigation."
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, meanwhile, said that the initial investigations were carried out in the shortest possible time, so that in similar incidents, the acceptance of firing during this period was unprecedented, but the final conclusion of the military court in this regard will be after the completion of the investigation.
Referring to the beginning of the investigation of the defendants as soon as the case was submitted to the Military Prosecutor ’ s Office, the judicial official said: “On the night of January 11, a number of individuals who were present in the firing system and its upstream sections were summoned as defendants, and a thorough investigation was carried out on the same night and one of the defendants was arrested. ”
He added that in the process of investigation, five other individuals were prosecuted as defendants who were arrested by legal decree, and three of the defendants were released after conducting appropriate investigations with bail, and now three are in detention.
Turki stressed, however, that during the investigation, if people are identified as accused, their charges will naturally be investigated.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, referring to judicial orders to obtain the incident report from the authorities, said: General Staff of the Armed Forces, the Ministry of Intelligence, the IRGC, air defense, civil aviation and even scientific and academic authorities sent their reports to the military court in accordance with the orders issued.
He said that the field investigations and local examinations were carried out without any obstacles from all the relevant centers separately and carefully, adding: "In numerous interrogation sessions, people as witnesses and informed in the air defense, the airport, the air control team, air defense representatives located in the flight control units, the person left from Flight 752 and the pilot of the sky plane were observed due to their observations during the accident, and in the case of the pilot of the sky, after reviewing documents." We noticed that it was published with distortions and displacement of words.
The judicial official also reviewed the conversations and videos and audio of the communication of the flight control unit with the aircraft and between the units themselves in the army and country sections, radar and defense systems, as well as the collection of videos of all the cameras overlooking the crash site and recorded people and persons, and the inquiries related to the radar graph of the air defense radar and other technical documents of the aircraft.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province said that part of the expert measures by the Civil Aviation Organization in accordance with the regulations governing the investigation of aviation accidents and the way to document these incidents, and according to the Chicago Convention, the country where the accident occurred has exclusive jurisdiction to investigate the accident.
He added that the Civil Aviation Organization has so far issued two announcements on the manner of the Ukrainian plane crash, and the third announcement of the organization is being prepared, and these reports will be uploaded on the website of the Civil Aviation Organization, with the aim of preventing future accidents, and all persons will have access to these reports.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, in explaining the issues raised about the cause of the accident, citing expert opinions, said: "The possibility of damaging collisions including laser beams and electromagnetism to the Ukrainian aircraft seems to be ruled out, and the initial theory of experts so far suggests that there is no explosion or other combustion at the moment of the accident."
Turki said that so far there is no reason for cyber and electronic hacking, external disruption in defense and missile systems and intrusion in systems or networks, adding: "We did not find any evidence for the possibility of sabotage and espionage on the plane, and traces of missile parts fired on the plane's fuselage are evident and the plane exploded due to the impact and its parts are scattered to a large radius of the impact, which is residential We collected airplane parts and saved the scene.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, emphasizing that the information and findings of the military court have been obtained in independent judicial investigations and their accuracy has been evaluated, said: "We used the reports of all the responsible departments and if we encounter other evidence during the investigation, it will be effective in completing or modifying the results of the investigations."
Turki went on to describe the causes of the tragic accident and pointed to the review of existing civil aviation procedures at the airport as well as the procedures of the defense network, said: "In the morning of the accident, given the possibility of a US air attack on Iran, the military department informs the civilian section of the country's space control that only flights are allowed to take off the runways that have already been identified by the defense network and their flight license issued by this network."
Accordingly, there is a change in take-off procedures at Tehran airports, and all flights must fly with permission and after identification by the defense network from the airport runway, and in all flights that have been carried out until and after the accident.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, in response to the ambiguities raised about the reason for not stopping flights on the night and day of the incident, said: according to the existing guidelines, if the air attack of the foreign enemy to the country is certain, the order to stop flights should be issued, which, according to the evidence and the hierarchy, the possibility of attack and threat only existed.
He added: Therefore, the authorities in accordance with the regulations have relied on taking control measures and the sky has not been completely closed on flights.
The official said the reason for the delay of flight 752 was that the reason for the delay, the extra load and the weight of the aircraft exceeded technical standards due to the addition of fuel to the flight custom, which was announced to the pilot before requesting a permit, and with his orders during this one hour part of the excess load of the aircraft is discharged, and the delay has nothing to do with the country or military.
Speaking about the compliance of the issuance of a flight license to the Ukrainian aircraft with the promulgation procedure of the country ’ s defense network, Turki said: “At 5: 52, the flight control unit will contact the country ’ s space control center and request the permission of the country ’ s control center one minute later, and finally, with the approval of the center at 6: 12 minutes, the pilot will receive the flight license from the control tower of Imam Khomeini airport. ”
At 6: 12 p.m., the plane at an altitude of 600 meters is targeted by an air defense missile and unfortunately it crashes.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, announcing that the military court has reached a series of errors in the investigation, said one of the most influential and major errors in the accident: The system that fired the missile after restarting due to the field conditions, does not determine the true north, and this mistake causes the target to be detected by the operator with a difference of about 105 degrees, and this error is the basis of a series of mistakes. Yes, and as a result, my dog is getting it wrong.
Turki added: "This human error in the arrangement of coordinates causes the air defense system operator to observe the aircraft as a target that is approaching Tehran from the northwest region, and its location and direction of movement is not related to the airstrip, on its radar, and the trajectory of the aircraft was different from the trajectory that the user observed."
He added: "The user of the defense system announces the identified target specifications to the relevant coordination center, but does not receive a response, and the recorded information shows that the message of the defense system has not been exchanged with the coordination center, and before exchanging the message and receiving the response, unfortunately the user fired, while this disconnect was only a few seconds."
Turki continued: The user asks the question and does not wait for the answer, and based on his own diagnosis, he fires, and the news release of the cruise missile in the system caused by the observations of the launched lights in the border areas by the scouts in the hours before the accident is also added to the cause.
Referring to the fact that the systems as downstream operating units did not have any connection to the control tower and only had to investigate and obtain instructions for identifying suspicious targets from the upstream center, he said: In the Ukrainian plane crash, no order was issued from the network to the downstream systems and at the time of the accident, the status of the defense systems was under the regulations of "limited fire", not fire in authority, so it should only by obtaining a network The shot took place.
Turki, pointing out that the ultimate detection of the target is hostile to the network, not the system, said: "The egregious error that happened here was that the system fired without getting permission from the network."
Referring to the fact that according to the experts and the results of the initial investigation of the judiciary, the defense system does not have a night vision camera and a friend from the enemy detection system, he said, "The operator of this system, when he identifies a target as a threatening target, should announce to his upstream centers, which is the same defense network, and take action after the command of the network."
Turki said that two missiles were fired by the defense system and the experts' investigation showed that one of these missiles had no effect on the aircraft and the other missile exploded near the aircraft, saying: 26 seconds was the distance of the first and second firing, but unfortunately in this time period, the user does not get permission for the second firing from the network.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, emphasizing that an error sometimes results in an irreparable disaster, said experts believe that if the user had taken the necessary precautions and used his experience, the accident would have been preventable.
He pointed out that the people who committed a series of errors are the ones who were arrested.
Turki said that in order to get the latest findings from the Ukrainian plane crash, 23 military experts in seven areas are cooperating with the military court in Tehran, adding that part of these groups expressed their opinions and still some of the reports remained.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province also said about the review of the black boxes: "The black boxes have been physically damaged by the accident and their review has its own technical complexity."
Referring to the fact that the black boxes were kept in a sealed place under the supervision of the military court and according to ICAO standards by the Civil Aviation Organization, he said that according to ICAO regulations, the country investigating the accident should review the black box with the presence of interested countries, and for review, all relevant persons including the accident investigation agency, relevant judicial authorities, representatives of other countries and ICAO representatives will be present.
Turki added: We invited the United States as the country of aircraft manufacturer, Ukraine in terms of aircraft ownership, and Canada, Sweden and Afghanistan in terms of their nationality, and the black box of this model of aircraft has no history so far, and domestic laboratories needed a transducer to be able to read the black box information, which the Americans opposed and did not provide us with the necessary equipment to review while reviewing the regulations with the presence of all interested parties. It will be.
After several meetings, at the end of last year, it was decided to send black boxes to a well-equipped lab outside the country and exactly coincided with the spread of the coronavirus around the world, and the foreign side announced that our laboratories will not accept the black box until the coronavirus subsides.
In a letter to ICAO, the Civil Aviation Authority said it was ready to send black boxes out of the country.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province said that Ukraine, as the owner of the plane, insisted that the black boxes of the plane be sent to the country for review, and said that the United States and Canada, as interested countries, expressed doubts about the ability and technical capabilities of Ukrainian laboratories to retrieve the black box information.
He added that now, after the relative reduction of COVID-19, French laboratories have announced their acceptance and readiness to receive the black boxes, which will be sent to the country with the diagnosis of the Civil Aviation Organization.
The judicial official said that so far, the families of the Supreme Court of Iran ’ s 80 martyrs have raised their complaints, adding: “In cooperation with the Human Rights Headquarters of the Judiciary, the Judiciary ’ s Center for Legal Advisors and Lawyers and the Bar Association, measures have been taken to determine a lawyer for the families of the martyrs. ”
Turki said that the administrative process of filing the case for 28 families in the martyr foundation has been fully completed, saying that the martyr foundation, whose representative is present at the meeting, announced that it is ready to expedite the administrative process of filing the case by referring other families so that the remaining families can follow up the administrative measures by receiving a letter of introduction from the military court or through their lawyers.
The military prosecutor of Tehran province on compensation for the accident said: "We had meetings with the Supreme National Security Council and the Presidential Legal Assistance, and we followed up the issue of compensation, and against the decisions of the competent authorities, the payment of damages and reparations will be based on international rates and will be paid equally if the legal documents are completed, preferably sooner than the time of the aviation accident court."
According to the Judicial Cooperation Agreement adopted by our representative in Ukraine, we asked them to send us aircraft insurance documents and some necessary legal documents, and the International Deputy of the Judiciary follows this issue constantly from the government.
Referring to the fact that Ukraine has not yet fully responded on behalf of the judicial authority and has not submitted the necessary documents and documents, Turki said, "In this regard, we have received several judicial regents from Ukraine, which, while emphasizing our country's exclusive competence in dealing with the dimensions of the accident against international and domestic regulations, have given the necessary responses to the Ukrainian judicial authorities for legal cooperation in three stages."
The military prosecutor of Tehran province, pointing out that despite the technical and legal complexities of the case, the speed of the investigation and the accuracy and reliability are emphasized by the head of the judiciary, the attorney general of the country and the head of the judicial organization of the armed forces, said: "We try to maintain judicial independence by constructive interaction with all the responsible authorities, the judicial investigation and full enforcement of the rights of survivors of the accident seriously and follow and complete and complete and follow the principles of the court with the final verdict of the Tehran military court." is.
At the meeting, a number of families and their lawyers discussed their demands, views and contents, and representatives of the Judiciary Human Rights Headquarters, the Judiciary ’ s Center for Legal Advisors and Lawyers Affairs and the Shahid Revolutionary Foundation attended the meeting.

title: William Faulkner, the writer who made the reader think
text:
= = Early life = = William Faulkner was born on September 25, 1897, in Mississippi.
After his birth, the family moved to Oxford, the University of Mississippi, in 1902.
At the age of seven, he showed an interest in the history of his homeland and the American South, as well as in literature and writing.
His mother also played an important role in the development of his talents.
In his youth, he developed a passion for poetry and became fascinated by the poetry of John Dahl.
According to William Faulkner, apart from John Dell's poetry, many of his references and thoughts in writing have come from the great works of writers and poets such as Fitzgerald and John Keats, as well as books such as the Bible and the tragedies of ancient Greek history.
He wanted to work in the military, but his low weight and short stature prevented him from enlisting in the U.S. Army, enrolling as a cadet at the Royal Flying Corps in Toronto, Canada, and on December 2, 1918 he was named an honorary second lieutenant.
He attended the University of Mississippi, dropped out of the university in 1924, and in 1925 he and his friend sailed to Italy on a cargo ship, where he set off on foot for Germany and France.
Although Faulkner's intellectual and artistic foundations were formed in his childhood and adolescence, he began his life's journey to greatness and fame in fiction at the age of 25.
He first published a poem called "Portrait" in the famous "Double Dealer" magazine, which gradually became known for his poetry, and he also helped to mature his thinking by writing poetry.
It was during this period that local readers began to admire his poetry, but William Faulkner decided that if he wanted to put his poetry on the market for more sales and financial success, he would never achieve his lofty goal.
So he tried to shift his focus to short and long stories, which were more about familiar issues and problems of his time, and he tried to present the events of the history of the American South in an educational way in the form of a story.
Although his first works were published in 1919, most of them in the 1920s and 1930s, he remained relatively unknown until he received the Nobel Prize in 1949.
He later won the Pulitzer Prize in 1957 for his anecdote and his last novel The Plunderers.
What is striking in this author ’ s works is his first severe pessimism.
Another characteristic of his writing is the description and painting of landscapes of killing and mutilation, and so on.
This writer presents the reader with the scattered pieces of a problem that can only be interpreted and solved after conversations that have been interrupted and started again.
Another characteristic of this author is his particular way of paying attention to time, which usually confuses and misleads the reader.
Almost never does a writer tell a story regularly and gradually from beginning to end, but often begins at the end.
From the early 1920s until the outbreak of World War II, when he moved to California, Faulkner published 13 novels and numerous short stories.
The collection became the basis of his fame and eventually received the Nobel Prize at the age of 52.
Most of his books have been translated into Persian by translators such as Saleh Hosseini and Najaf Daryabandari in Iran.
Considered the greatest American novelist between the two world wars, he is usually the main character of his stories, a veteran returning from the war and facing various problems.
With the support of Anderson, he published his first novel, Soldier ’ s Pay, during the beginning of the American Depression.
Almost the whole story was written around Faulkner's biography.
Based on his military service, he criticizes the social status and life of the people.
He published his second work, Mosquitoes, in 1927, which brought him to public attention.
Faulkner also wrote Anger and Noise in 1929.
It was only after this book was published that he became more famous, and the New Library Institute ranked him the sixth book on the list of the 100 best British novels of the 20th century.
Then he added a new twist and a new twist to the plot.
Faulkner teaches that novels, narratives, dialogues, and characters can have functions and characteristics beyond their usual definitions.
In this novel he applies these new features and introduces it to the reader.
At the same time, “anger and fuss ” is the culmination of what is now known as“ Faulkner ’ s style ” in literature.
Then, after a while, it is revealed in the Holy Quran, as well as in the Sunnah, the Sunnah, and the Sunnah.
But he later admitted that he had never been satisfied with the use of such a style as writing anger and uproar.
In the same year, he wrote another book called Sartori.
In this book, he drew on the wars of secession in the American South or Mississippi.
In the book, he believed that generations of honorable men had become extinct because of these killings, and that conspirators and hypocrites had instead taken control of society.
Three years later, he published his most violent work, The Temple, and was very successful in selling it.
His work does not sell much in the United States today, but he is highly respected among the French intellectual class.
William Faulkner ’ s other novels include The Numbers of Thirteen, The Green Branch, The Forest Palm, Hamlet, The Intruder of the Court, the collection of short stories, The White Flower, A Legend, The Great Forest, and Uncle Willie.
His first collection of short stories included many of his most acclaimed stories, such as A Rose for Emily, The Indian Goes, The Sun of That Age and A Rainless September.
The Village Detective is Faulkner's fourth collection of short stories, translated by Ahmad Okhovat.
Faulkner is known for his experimental style and his careful attention to the way he expresses and writes.
Unlike Ernest Hemingway ’ s minimalist style, Faulkner frequently used the flow of the mind in his writings, often writing deeply emotional, subtle, complex, and sometimes Gothic stories with a variety of characters, including freed slaves, or descendants of slaves, poor whites, working-class southerners or gentry.
He died of a heart attack in Oxford, Mississippi, on July 6, 1962, three weeks after falling off his horse.

title: Maintenance of alangdareh and lunch costs 1.5 billion tomans annually
text:
According to the Mehr reporter, Yahya Sotoudeh Nia, at a news conference on Thursday with the media of Gorgan, said: Green space is divided into two categories of urban and forest parks, and in Gorgan, there are 53 urban parks with 340 thousand and 266 square meters.
He added: Since 2012, maintenance of Alangdareh Promenade Park with an area of 185 hectares has been handed over to Gorgan Municipality in the form of a joint memorandum of understanding with the preservation of the state ownership.
Sotoudeh Nia said that the protection of Nahar Khouran Park with an area of 630 hectares has been assigned to the municipality, and the book of Sayyad Shirazi Park with an area of 70 hectares and Hezarpich Park with an area of 200 hectares has been prepared and is in the process of transfer.
He said that the annual maintenance cost of the alangdareh and lunch is over one and a half billion tomans, while its revenue in the month may not reach 50 million tomans.
Sotoudeh Nia said: "For us, the maintenance of these forests is not material and income, and we are all citizens.
The head of the Sima, Landscape and Urban Green Space Organization of Gorgan Municipality added that the per capita green space of Gorgan is 7.43 square meters, and given that Gorgan is not an industrial city, this number is acceptable, but this figure should be increased.
He continued: The per capita park in Gorgan is less than one square meter, while the standard is two square meters, and due to the lack of land, the construction of pocket parks was on the agenda.
Sotoudeh Nia stated: “The placement of these parks has been done and so far nine pocket parks have been created, and our motto is to create 40 pocket parks if we find suitable land by the end of the year. ”
Head of the Sima, Landscape and Urban Green Space Organization of Gorgan Municipality stated: In the year 97, the budget of the organization was 13 billion and 348 million tomans, which in the year 98 increased to 18 billion and 800 million tomans.
He announced the beautification share of this figure of one and a half billion tomans and with the credit line of the municipality of five billion tomans.

title: The rise of cosmetic surgeries during the Coronavirus era
text:
Getty Images Image caption Some clinics around the world say the number of cosmetic surgeries has increased, and a number of beauty clinics around the world are reporting an increase in surgeries during the coronavirus era.
This is probably because people can hide their face behind a mask or work from home after the procedure.
Despite the virus causing businesses to close almost all over the world, a number of plastic surgery clinics have remained active, taking more stringent measures such as COVID-19 tests and frequent cleaning.
Cosmetic procedures have increased in clinics in the United States, Japan, South Korea and Australia during the Corona period, and patients have been referred for surgeries such as lip augmentation, Botox, facelift and nose surgery.
Eran Hernandez, who had both her lips plucked and her excess facial fat removed during the Corona era in Los Angeles, said: “I decided to do these things during the quarantine because I had the opportunity to do what I wanted to do during my convalescence. ”
“Lip fillers aren ’ t something that all men tend to do, so some people may approach this differently.
So I preferred to stay at home and fully recover so that when I leave the house, people don ’ t know what I ’ ve done. ”
She said the last time she had done beauty work before the quarantine, she had to go out for work with her lips “severely swollen and bruised. ”
Rhode J. Rohrich, a cosmetic surgeon in Texas, said he saw more patients than usual during the coronavirus.
“If we wanted to, we could probably work six days a week.
It's so amazing. "
According to the surgeon, people usually need to consider recovery time during surgery, but now that many people work from home, there is no need to take time off.
“They can actually heal at home, and they can also wear masks when they ’ re out of the house after a rhinoplasty or facelift.
People want to resume their normal lives and part of that is to look good. ”
Cosmetic surgery during the Coronavirus era has not only increased in the United States.
South Korea, known for its large number of cosmetic surgeries, was one of the first countries to witness the coronavirus outbreak in the country.
Instead of staying at home across the country, the country adopted a program of social distancing and encouraging people to work from home.
However, the number of people who usually came to South Korea for cosmetic procedures declined during this period, and beauty clinics decided to give local people a discount.
A 54-year-old high school teacher who had undergone eyelid surgery in February told Junangang Daily that “every plastic surgery clinic I visited was full of referrals. ”
A spokesman for BK Hospital in Seoul told the BBC that at the beginning of the epidemic people were scared, but locals began to visit beauty clinics.
The spokesman said: "With Coronavirus, patients gradually felt safe and comfortable for cosmetic procedures.
The number of patients is constantly increasing. ”
“This number is estimated to increase by half compared to the same quarter last year. ”
The spokesperson said the enquiry of foreign patients for cosmetic procedures has also increased.
“The number of questions online has increased considerably as there is an opportunity for online consultation and they are prepared to come here for these actions as soon as travel restrictions are lifted. ”
The EPA Image caption People were told to stay home in Japan during the coronavirus outbreak, but Prime Minister Shinzo Abe declared a state of emergency that lasted until May 31.
People were asked to stay at home.
Despite this, beauty clinics saw an increase in patients.
The wave prompted the Aesthetic Medicine Association of Japan to warn that cosmetic treatments “are not necessary for many people. ”
He called on people to refrain from surgery to "prevent further spread of the virus."
Michel Tajiri, coordinator at the Baylis Clinic in Fukuoka, said: “Because the outpatient plastic surgery clinic is so well equipped to perform these operations within a day, we are definitely seeing an influx of patients willing to undergo treatment in this era. ”
“The main reasons are that they don ’ t go to work and also everyone wears masks and so any action can be easily hidden. ”
For Mr. Hernandez, surgery during the coronavirus outbreak was the perfect time.
“It certainly gave me more opportunities to recover.
I was able to take medications that I probably wouldn ’ t be able to take if I were driving, and I could use ice compresses on my lips and face more often. ”

title: The effect of herbicides on carp
text:
The results of one study showed that the randup herbicide interferes with the growth and reproduction of carp.
It should be used in agricultural lands, and it should be considered as standard.
Roundup is the brand name of a systemic, non-selective, glyphosite-based herbicide that is used after the weed has grown.
Montenegro launched the product in the 1970s, and other companies have since sold glyphosate based herbicides under other names.
In 2018, Bayer purchased the product from Montenegro.
Roundup is widely used to control perennial and perennial weeds in gardens and arable and non-arable land.
Inattentive and excessive use of this herbicide, improper handling and disposal of contaminated wastewater has led to the introduction of this herbicide into water sources and into natural waterways.
This herbicide may have harmful effects on aquatic life and cause long-term biological effects.
There is conflicting information about Randall ’ s safety.
The herbicide is considered safe for humans, but there is limited evidence to suggest that the risk of cancer in humans may be increased due to the use of large amounts of glyphosate in agricultural occupations.
In 2015, the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC), part of the World Health Organization, said glyphosate "may be carcinogenic" to humans.
In 2018, a person with non-Hodgkin lymphoma received $289 million in damages from the Montenegro Corporation.
That ’ s because a San Francisco jury found that Montenegro failed to warn consumers about the dangers of the herbicide.
The damage was reduced to $78 million during the review.
Common carp is one of the freshwater fish that is economically valuable and widely grown in Iran.
In the northern provinces of Iran, carp farms are located in or near agricultural areas and are often fed by water that may have passed through agricultural fields.
Therefore, the environment in which common carp is raised can be constantly contaminated with foreign chemicals from agricultural activities.
Contamination of water by pesticides and herbicides may hinder proper productivity.
In fact, reduced water quality associated with poor management and stressful conditions is the leading cause of mortality and reduced productivity in many carp farms.
Chemical compounds such as pesticides and their widespread use on agricultural land and pollution of water systems may cause damage to a variety of ecosystem organisms, including fish.
For this reason, researchers from Islamic Azad University of Lahijan Branch and Islamic Azad University of Izeh Branch studied the effects of randup herbicide on male carp.
Elham Madani and Akram Tehranifard and their colleagues in this study examined the weight, gonadosomatic index (ratio of testicular weight to body weight), histopathological changes of gills and testicles of common carp fish.
32 common productive carp fish were randomly placed into 4 groups each with 8 fish.
One group had no exposure to herbicide, and 3 groups took roundup pesticide exposure in concentrations (5, 10 and 15 mg / L) in 5-day and 10-day cycles.
The concentrations used for roundup venom were 25, 50 and 75 percent of the LC50 reported by roundup venom for carp (20 mg / ml), respectively.
LC50 is a lethal dose by which about half of laboratory animals die.
The researchers said: "Based on the findings, exposure to a dose of 20 mg / L of randup resulted in significant weight loss on day 10 and a gonadosomatic index on days 5 and 10.
In fish encountered with roundup (20 mg / L) necrosis and disorganization of the structure of the cascade blades, sticking of the cascade blades together, separation of the base membrane and rupture of the cascade epithelium and ejection of blood cells were observed.
In testicular fish exposed to high dose glyphosate, increased number of spermatogonia due to decreased spermatogenesis, destruction of spermatocytes, decreased spermatozoa, decreased diameter of sperm tubes, loss of interstitial ducts and destruction of sertoli cells were observed.
Sublethal concentrations of roundup have toxic effects on gill structure and reproductive performance of male carp. ”
Based on the results, the researchers recommend: "There are steps to be taken to reduce the use of this herbicide on agricultural farms and control its use."
The results of this study were published in the spring of 1999 in the latest issue of the scientific research journal "Experimental Animal Biology" affiliated to Payame Noor University.
End of message.

title: The Dragon will bring 12 American astronauts back to Earth.
text:
SpaceX's crewed Dragon capsule will return astronauts to Earth on August 2.
Last month marked a historic day for American space missions, with two of the country's astronauts making their way into space from the United States for the first time since 2011.
On this mission, Douglas Harley and Bob Behenken accompanied the first manned flight of the Falcon 9 rocket on May 30, and about 19 hours later, the Crew Dragon capsule was automatically attached to the International Space Station to make the first successful journey from a US-based space station since the space shuttle's retirement in 2011.
The mission, called Demo-2, was the first manned launch of the Dragon capsule, as the spacecraft had previously conducted unmanned missions and sent laboratory equipment to the International Space Station.
The two astronauts will return to Earth two months after their trip to the space station.
NASA plans to land the Dragon capsule in the Atlantic Ocean on August 2.
The two astronauts will leave the space station on August 1, around 8 p.m. "Eastern Time" (4: 30 a.m. Tehran time).
After the successful landing of these astronauts, the Dragon capsule will make more space travel.
Later this year, astronauts from NASA and the Japanese Space Agency will fly to the International Space Station.
End of message.

title: Raising Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari agriculture for the passage of traditional irrigation
text:
Agriculture with the consumption of 70% of freshwater resources is the largest water consumer in the world, the water crisis for agriculture will lead to a food supply crisis, so it is necessary to pay more attention to the efficiency and efficiency of water in agriculture.
Increasing population, climate change, depletion of water resources and drought have led to various management and policies in recent decades to store and increase the efficiency of water consumption in agriculture as the largest consumer of water around the world.
Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, as a province that once produced 10 percent of the country ’ s water, today, but with the droughts that have gripped it, it has not had a good day in terms of water resources, and its agriculture has not been without this issue.
The unpleasant water resources of the province Director of Water and Soil Agriculture Jihad Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari announced the inappropriate status of the province's water resources in the agricultural sector, stating: 65 percent dependence on groundwater resources and their excessive use has caused a lot of damage to water resources.
Gholamreza Zakeri stated: 50 percent of the province ’ s aqueducts are dry and 30 percent face a reduction of 40 to 60 percent, while springs are also not in better condition and there is a decrease in watering.
He pointed to the organization ’ s strategies to combat water scarcity in the agricultural sector and said: “Increasing soil organic matter is one of the strategies we are pursuing, so that 30 to 40 percent of plant residues are left in the ground to store and store more water in the soil. ”
Water and Soil Manager of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Jihad, adding livestock manure, not burning plant residues in fields, preventing livestock grazing in fields after harvest, returning plant residues to soil and protective agriculture without tillage or reduced tillage (preventing excessive plowing). Greenhouse and dense cultivation and the use of dehydrating cultivars are also of particular interest to this organization.
There are a lot of ways to use water in the gardens.
According to the statistics of the Ministry of Agriculture, 2million and 400,000 hectares of agricultural lands of the country have been equipped with new irrigation systems, of which more than one million and 100,000 hectares have been provided by the government.
This shows the government ’ s interest in water and its optimal consumption in the agricultural sector.
In addition to increasing irrigation efficiency and reducing losses, modern irrigation methods also play a role in preventing soil erosion, preventing excessive growth of weeds, simultaneous application of water and fertilizers, facilitating agricultural operations and increasing the quantity and quality of the product.
Since agriculture has roots in the heart of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, the province has moved to make the best use of the water that is used to produce the crop.
For this reason, it has seized the opportunity and opportunities to change traditional irrigation methods and has recorded significant successes in its agricultural record.
Rostam Ghaffari, one of the farmers of Gaucher village in Farsan city, has been for four years, along with several other farmers, have integrated their 22 hectare lands with a rainwater irrigation system.
He said: “When I saw a man who had been in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in prison, I was in
Ghaffari said that 85 percent of the cost of implementing its rainwater irrigation system was in the form of government grants, adding: "Previously, although water shortage problems were not in the current form, we were harvesting much less than today when we were in drought."
The farmer noted that the high price of land sales, in addition to the higher yield, is one of the other advantages of the pressurized irrigation system, and continued: This system has reduced the labor of farmers so much that it no longer needs to be in the field for several hours in a row.
He added: “Without a doubt, if I had known that a pressurized irrigation system had such benefits, I would have changed my irrigation method much sooner. ”
Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, the flagship of the development of new irrigation systems, the head of the Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Organization, referring to the province's top ranking in the development of new irrigation systems, said: The implementation of new irrigation systems plays an important role in saving and increasing water efficiency, because with increasing productivity, more product can be produced with less water.
Zabiullah Gharib described the pace of development of new irrigation systems in the province as 2.5 times the national average and added: Now 56 percent of the province ’ s water lands are equipped with new irrigation systems, while the figure in the country is about 20 percent.
Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Organization head said: In the discussion of the use of modern irrigation systems, there are also changes taking place, for example, the irrigation system is replacing rainwater irrigation, because water losses in the rainwater irrigation system due to spraying and therefore evaporation of water are high.
Emphasizing that all the lands of the province should be equipped with new irrigation systems, Gharib said: "Smart agriculture will be implemented when our lands are equipped with new irrigation systems, in these conditions, the feeding, the duration of irrigation and all the activities that should be done in a farm will be under control."
Equipping 25 thousand hectares of irrigated lands of the province with new irrigation systems in the government of Tadbir and Omid Water and Soil Director of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agricultural Jihad in an interview with IRNA said that the implementation of new irrigation systems has started in the 1970s in the province, noting that so far, of a total of 118 thousand hectares of the talented water lands of the province, 65 thousand hectares have been equipped with new irrigation systems.
Gholamreza Zakeri, referring to the very good performance of the government of prudence and hope in this regard, stated: 39% of this amount, i.e. 25,000 hectares, has been equipped with new irrigation systems since 2013.
He continued: This year, 2,200 hectares of new irrigation systems are being implemented and 1,800 hectares are also being prepared for the implementation of these systems.
Director of Water and Soil of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Jihad pointed to the importance of using new irrigation systems in the current situation and stated: The implementation of each hectare of a new irrigation system will save 4,400 cubic meters of water.
Zakeri pointed to government grants in the implementation of new irrigation systems and noted that the amount of these facilities has been different annually, this year for each hectare of drip irrigation system, type and combined (irrigation and type) 175 million rials, each rainy hectare 105 million rials and for each hectare of low-pressure irrigation system 70 million rials.
Referring to the implementation of more than 2,500 hectares of type system in the province, he emphasized: This year, the share of self-help of farmers is approximately 40 to 55 million Rials per hectare.
The potential for a 30% increase in crop after the implementation of new irrigation systems The director of water and soil of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari agriculture mentioned the potential for increase in crop after the implementation of new irrigation systems 30 to 33%: Of course, this does not mean that the implementation of these systems will increase the crop by itself, but the timeliness of fertilization, the use of suitable seeds and the fight against pests and diseases provides the potential to increase crop by the implementation of these systems.
Zakeri noted that the highest level of implementation of pressurized irrigation systems in the province is specific to the cities of Shahrekord and Borujen.
He said that the reason for the lower level in other cities is the lack of applicants for implementing new irrigation systems, and said: Because part of the cost is self-help in implementing these systems, the farmer should certainly be an applicant, although some other problems such as social issues and national land disputes and exceptions have also played a role in this regard.
Water and Soil Manager of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Jihad said that there is no water land development plan in the province, adding that the only irrigation method is the amount of water that exists in the province for optimal water consumption from the sink to the new irrigation systems.
To improve irrigation performance, it is essential not only to promote the implementation and use of new irrigation methods, but also at the same time to consider the performance of the irrigation system and to improve the skills of farmers to control and manage the irrigation system during operation.
According to experts, one of the issues that attention to it plays a role in the optimal performance of irrigation systems is attention to the uniformity of water use in farms, an issue that the lack of management skills of farmers can contribute to and reduce crop yield and waste of water resources.
Director of Water and Soil of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari Agriculture Jihad said: In order to ensure the proper exploitation of these systems by farmers and operators, a contract has been signed with one of the technical and engineering companies to monitor the exploitation and monitoring of the projects that have already been implemented.
Zakeri emphasized that the company, while reviewing the projects, fixes their potential problems and educates the beneficiaries.
He noted that before, contractors taught farmers how to operate and plan new irrigation systems, but since contractors were usually less present on projects after implementation, the work of reviewing, continuous training and informing the beneficiaries was assigned to a company.
The high cost of pipes and equipment needed to implement irrigation systems is a problem that farmers applying for the implementation of these systems are facing today, an issue that, according to the Director of Water and Soil Agriculture Jihad of the province, can reduce the desire to implement these systems due to the increase in the share of self-help of farmers.
According to IRNA, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari has 66,000 beneficiaries in the agricultural sector and one million and 500,000 tons of agricultural products are harvested annually.

title: Increasing the incidence of flooding in the country due to climate change
text:
On Sunday, Morteza Eftekhari, in an interview with the economic reporter of IRNA, added: "Climate change is a phenomenon that has been proven to occur among researchers of this issue."
He continued: “The trend of climatic component changes over the past few decades has well proven that the world ’ s climate, including Iran, is changing.
Eftekhari said: "Given that changes in climatic variables, especially precipitation and temperature, will have a direct effect on different aspects of water resources, therefore, for the future of the country, estimates of the extent of these changes and their impact on water resources should be made."
The head of the Water Research Institute of the Ministry of Energy continued: The results of future scenarios on temperature and precipitation variables indicate that a significant increase in temperature will be one of the most likely future changes in different areas of the country, and this will increase the water demand in different sectors, especially in the agricultural sector.
He added that changes in the future rainfall regime of the country are also among other things that have been determined based on future climate scenarios.
Eftekhari said that the increase in the intensity of rainfall and the change of precipitation from snow to rain may increase the risk of flooding in the country in the coming period.
The head of the Water Research Institute of the Ministry of Energy continued: "Also, changing the pattern of precipitation (snow to rain) may reduce the water supply resources in the hot seasons in the country, and as a result, change the time pattern of the water supply of the country's permanent rivers."
Not long ago, the Deputy Minister of Energy, Water and Water, warned about climate change on his Instagram page.

title: Crew Dragon will bring American astronauts back to Earth
text:
Jim Bridenstine tweeted that the Crew Dragon spacecraft will leave the International Space Station on Aug. 1 to bring Douglas Harley and Bob Behenken back to Earth.
NASA plans to land the Crew Dragon capsule in the Atlantic Ocean on August 2.
Landing and retrieving the capsule will mark the end of NASA and SpaceX ’ s Demo-2 mission, the first time SpaceX has flown two astronauts to the International Space Station.
Douglas Harley and Bob Behenken left the United States on May 30 aboard the Crew Dragon capsule for the historic test flight to the International Space Station.
The Demo-2 mission was the first manned launch into Earth orbit from US soil since the retirement of NASA's shuttle program in 2011.
The mission, also SpaceX ’ s first manned launch, marks a new era of American space exploration.
According to NASA, the mission will provide important data on the performance of the Falcon 9 rocket, Crew Dragon spacecraft and ground systems, as well as intra-orbital, landing and landing operations.
The test flight will also provide valuable data to confirm SpaceX ’ s crewed transportation system for regular flights transporting astronauts to and from the International Space Station.

title: Reactions to transfer black box of Ukrainian plane shot down in Iran to France
text:
Ukraine, Canada, Afghanistan, Britain and Sweden welcomed the transfer of the Ukrainian plane ’ s black box to France.
Ukraine, Canada, Afghanistan, Britain and Sweden welcome the transfer of the black box of the Ukrainian plane shot down near Tehran to France and demand that Iran carry out a full and independent technical investigation into the crash.
Earlier, the black boxes of the Ukrainian plane fired near Tehran were taken to the French Civil Aviation Disaster Investigation Office for study.
In a statement issued by the International Support Group for Victims of the Ukrainian Plane Crash on the website of the Ukrainian Foreign Ministry, he said: “We welcome the transfer of the black boxes of flight PS752 to the French Civil Aviation Safety Research and Analysis Office.
We ’ ve been waiting for this step for a long time, but only one step in the process of completing technical research.
“We reiterate our call on Iran to conduct a full, transparent and independent investigation, a technical investigation in accordance with international standards. ”
As noted, the international team will continue to work hard to ensure transparency, accountability and justice, including reparations to the families of the victims of the disaster.
Ukraine International Airlines flight 737-800 crashed shortly after takeoff from Tehran airport early in the morning of January 8.
176 people were killed: citizens of Iran, Ukraine, Canada, Britain, Germany, Sweden and Afghanistan.
On January 11, the Joint Chiefs of Staff of Iran ’ s armed forces announced that the Ukrainian Boeing had been accidentally shot down, blaming a human factor: the plane flew near Iranian military facilities and was mistaken for an “enemy target ” — a cruise missile.
At the same time, Iran noted that they were expecting an attack from the United States and that its air defense systems were in full combat readiness.

title: How to read Hemingway?
text:
Ernest Hemingway, a Nobel laureate and one of the most important of the 20th century, was born on July 21, 1899 in Illinois and wrote seven novels, six collections of short stories and two nonfiction books during his lifetime.
On the occasion of the birth of this author, which coincided with the thirteenth of July, we have suggestions for better reading of the works of this author.
Hemingway ’ s work is fluid, simple, and clear, but for many readers of literature, it may be difficult to begin reading Hemingway ’ s books.
Why read Hemingway?
Ernest Hemingway is an influential writer in the history of literature and fiction, his works have repeatedly won the most prestigious international literary awards such as Nobel and Pulitzer, this author employed a different kind of narrative description and caused many writers after him to borrow his own literary style.
Hemingway has named his literary style the Iceberg Theory, in this way of writing, fictional events are narrated like an iceberg floating in water, only one-eighth of which is visible, and the author includes only the information that is essential in the process and omits the rest of the information.
This technique created a tremendous change in storytelling, especially the writing of short stories, and it was a development that freed the stories from conventional chatter.
Hemingway ’ s works are included in the list of books of the century, books to read before death, and the best fiction books in history, highlighting the importance of this author.
What do we need to know?
One of the topics that helps to better understand Ernest Hemingway ’ s work is getting to know his personal life.
Much of what we read in his books is what he has turned from his personal life into a story.
At the age of 19, he volunteered for the First World War but was not allowed to fight because of poor eyesight, but Hemingway insisted on serving as an ambulance driver for the Red Cross.
He was wounded several times during the Chang, but his most significant injury is when he was wounded by mortar shell fragments and spent a long time in the hospital, a novel about this part of Hemingway ’ s life and the war.
Even the character of Catherine Barkley in this book is based on the nurse Hemingway fell in love with.
Hemingway also participated in World War II as a war correspondent, and several short stories are the result of this era.
The sun continues to blow, the Great River or along the river to the trees, each of which is somehow tied to the World War, and their heroes are survivors of the war and have many memories of these days.
But Hemingway ’ s most important masterpiece is a relic of his childhood, Hemingway ’ s father had a great interest in fishing, and this hobby was passed on to Ernest, a point that can be clearly seen in the famous and widely read story of The Old Man and the Sea.
But before the Old Man and the Sea, Hemingway had written about having and not having a fishing boat captain.
Another important point to know before reading Hemingway ’ s works is his political approach, he has written a lot in opposition to fascism and against dictatorship, both as a journalist and as a writer, sometimes even changing from a journalist to a social-political activist, who is this point in The Bell for, or who is this death knell?
It is a story of an American soldier in the Spanish Civil War fighting alongside groups against General Franco, which Hemingway did.
Perhaps the other thing that matters is that during the World War, Hemingway led a French group against the Nazis that was tried after the war for armed acts but was never proven guilty.
The political and social history of the world in the years of Hemingway's life, his personal life, as well as the knowledge of his contemporaries, such as Scott Fitzgerald, with whom he has written, are points that contribute to the understanding of his works.
Getting to know Hemingway ’ s contemporary writers helps to better understand the difference between him and his contemporaries.
Is it a classic?
To read Hemingway ’ s work, we must note that he is not a classic writer in his different style, he did not deal with the long margins and descriptions of classical literature, and his long novels are not immune.
He was interested in shorthand and engaging the audience with fiction, which is a feature of modern literature.
In general, Hemingway ’ s works are innovative and even among modern works have their own creativity, but the value of this author ’ s work has always been compared to classical works, and even classical enthusiasts have not been able to be indifferent to it.
In these works we have a happy and well-spoken writer, a writer who was in middle age with young people and was even close friends with a group of hippies.
Hemingway is a realistic writer, but he has always tried to maintain his sense of humor.
Where do we start?
To read Hemingway ’ s works, the first and most important suggestion is The Old Man and the Sea.
The book, translated by Najaf Daryabandari, was published in 222 pages by Kharazmi Publications.
The next book, Farewell to Arms, is again translated by Najaf Daryabendari, published by Amir Kabir Publications in 343 pages.
These two books are always on the list of works to be read or masterpieces of the 20th century.
If you are interested in short stories, you can also read Men Without Women, a collection of stories that have been published in various magazines by the author.
This book has been translated by Asadollah Amraei for publication of Horizon in 222 pages.
Even if you are interested in writing, Hemingway can be a good teacher and read his series of talks and learn very precise points.
The book The Last Interview and Other Conversations of Ernest Hemingway with a translation by Houshang Jirani has been published in 88 pages by Cheshmeh Publishing.
The final chapter of many critics considered Ernest Hemingway to be the greatest writer of the 20th century.
His stories are an exploration of real human life, suffering and the meaning of life.
The portrayal of human inner feelings is the most important characteristic of this author, which makes his works a read for every reader.
Who was Ernest Hemingway?
Ernest Hemingway was born on July 21, 1899 in Oak Park, Illinois.
His father, Clarence, was a doctor and his mother, Grace, was a piano and singing teacher.
Ernest spent the summers with his family in northern Michigan, where he discovered his passion for fishing.
After finishing high school, he worked for a while in Kansas City as a reporter for the Star Chronicle in 1917.
During World War I, he volunteered to serve in the army, but poor eyesight prevented him from doing so, instead serving as an ambulance driver for the Red Cross near the Italian front.
On July 8, 1918, he was injured and spent months in the hospital.
In 1925, his first collection of short stories, in our time, was published, which spoke well of his particular style.
His memoirs from that period were published after his death in 1964 as The Variable Eid.
Ernest Hemingway was an adventurer for most of his life.
From being wounded in Italy by 200 pieces of Austrian shrapnel during World War I, to taking part in the frontlines of the Spanish Civil War or touring the African wilderness, to fishing and hunting wildlife and living in Cuba.
He finally said goodbye to life with his hunting rifle.

title: A new phase of development of the world ’ s largest nuclear fusion project has begun.
text:
According to the BBC, the world ’ s largest nuclear fusion project has entered its fifth phase.
The project, which is being developed at a cost of 20 billion euros in southern France, will be able to produce the extremely hot plasma needed for fusion.
According to experts, nuclear fusion is a clean source of electricity that helps solve the challenge of climate change.
The project, called Iter, is being developed in cooperation with China, the European Union, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia and the United States, all of which have contributed some of the cost.
Right now, nuclear energy needs to be broken down.
In this process, heavy chemical elements are decomposed to produce lighter elements.
But nuclear fusion is the result of combining two light materials and making a heavier sample.
Such a process produces a large amount of nuclear energy with low radioactivity.
Iter traps hot plasma inside a structure called tokamac to control fusion reactions.
In fact, the goal of the project is to demonstrate the feasibility of nuclear fusion on a commercial scale.
The facility will begin operations after the completion of the project in 2025.

title: Nuclear fusion reactor assembly begins in France
text:
The assembly of parts for the massive Iter reactor began on Tuesday, July 28, in southern France.
The construction of the reactor is an expensive mega-project, and while the prospects for its success are unclear, there is much hope attached to it.
In this reactor there will be tests for nuclear fusion.
The success of these experiments could mark the beginning of a new chapter in clean, environmentally friendly energy production.
Some even believe that the reactor ’ s technology, if successful, could solve the energy shortage problem at once.
French President Emmanuel Macron, who attended the virtual commencement of the ITER reactor assembly, called its construction a promise of peace and progress.
He stressed that nuclear fusion makes it possible to achieve “environmentally friendly, carbon-free, safe and virtually waste-free energy. ”
South Korean President Moon Jae-in also called Iter "the greatest scientific project in the history of mankind."
Bernard Bigot, director of the ITER, called the start of the assembly of the reactor a historic moment, while emphasizing that the hardest part of the work had not yet begun.
He said assembling the reactor would be like assembling a large three-dimensional puzzle that would have to be mounted very carefully.
Assembly of the reactor, 60 kilometers northeast of the French port of Marseille, is underway at a slower pace, with the coronavirus epidemic spreading.
In addition to the European Union, the United States, Russia, China, India, Japan and South Korea are also involved in the project, which is estimated to cost more than €20 billion.
The basis of the project, which is called “Star on Earth, ” is to provide a nuclear fusion process similar to what happens in stars.
In this reactor, hydrogen atoms are supposed to merge and produce energy.
This is the exact opposite of what happens when nuclear energy is produced.
In nuclear power plants, atomic nuclei are divided.
In nuclear fusion, the atoms deuterium and tritium (two heavy isotopes of hydrogen) combine under the right conditions to produce a heavier atom called helium.
The process also produces a neutron particle and a large amount of heat, which is used to heat water and turn it into steam.
The steam generated rotates the turbine blades and eventually generates electricity.
But before that, hydrogen must be heated to 150 degrees Celsius.
Director Iter hopes the first phase of work will begin in 2025.
Ten years later, the reactor will be loaded with deuterium tritium, and efforts to produce energy from nuclear fusion will begin.
There is no clear plan yet to convert this energy into electricity in the ITER reactor.
Join the Persian Deutsche Welle channel on Telegram, if the test results are positive, the reactor could start producing electricity in 2060.
Supporters of the project hope that nuclear fusion will become a major source of energy – without emissions harmful to the environment or the risk of explosions at nuclear power plants.
The only raw material needed for the project is hydrogen, which is almost everywhere.
Follow Deutsche Welle on Instagram What are the opponents saying?
Critics of the project call it too expensive.
Silvia Koting-I, a Greens nuclear expert in the Bundestag, said the project is a “multi-billion dollar grave and has no happy ending. ”
The Green Party politician says the commercial application of the technology will begin at the best possible end of the century and has criticized German and EU support for the project.
Critics of the project say fighting climate change requires urgent action and that greenhouse gas emissions should be significantly reduced now.
They want to invest more in renewable energy, which is much more efficient, cheaper, and will be more advanced in 50 years.

title: Mars is the new arena of competition between China and the United States!
text:
As you read this, eight human robotic ambassadors are at work on the Red Planet; we have six rovers orbiting Mars, a lander and an unmanned rover exploring the mysterious world.
But the quest for exploration on the Red Planet has become so fascinating that space agencies from different countries take advantage of the opportunity to put Mars at the closest orbital distance to Earth, and send three more ambassadors to the Red Planet.
The first was the United Arab Emirates' HOPE, which was supposed to launch 24 shots from Japan's Tanigashima Space Center aboard the H2A 202 rocket, but was delayed by a week on the morning of the 30th of Tir due to adverse weather conditions.
Three days later, on August 22, 2019, the launch of this year ’ s second passenger on Mars and China ’ s first Mars mission with the Tian Wan-1 launch began.
The Mars 2020 mission with NASA's Perseverance rover will be the last Martian passenger to launch this year.
If there are no technical or atmospheric problems, the mission is scheduled to be launched to Mars around 15: 17 on Thursday.
If the UAE mission is to be viewed as being cooked up by the United States and Japan, there is little room for doubt about the Chinese identity of the Tian Wen-1 mission.
Now, Chinese-made products not only compete with American products on the ground, but this time the soil of the Red Planet is supposed to be a new competition between the two powers of the Earth's east and west in their extraterrestrial exploration.
On the eve of realizing the dream of conquering Mars, the Chinese space agency's Mars exploration project began in November 2011 with the cooperation of the Russian space agency.
In this joint project, the Russian Fobos-Grunt spacecraft, designed to reach Phobos, one of the Martian moons, carried with it the first Chinese Martian orbiter, Yinghuo-1.
The launch was successful and the spacecraft was placed in its predetermined parking orbit, but the propulsion engines that had to be turned on to get the spacecraft to Mars failed and the massive mission failed.
About two months later, the spacecraft ’ s fragments entered Earth ’ s atmosphere and crashed into the Pacific Ocean.
After this bitter experience, China began its own independent Martian project.
Tianwen-1 is the first Chinese interplanetary mission to Mars, taking its name from a long poem by Qu Yuan, the greatest ancient Chinese poet of the 3rd century BCE, asking questions about the cosmos.
The launch of Tian Won-1 at a glance The robotic spacecraft consists of three parts: Orbiter, Lander and Mars Rover. It was launched from Hainan Island in southern China on Wednesday, August 20, 2019, on the Long March-5 launcher from the Won-Chang satellite launch center, and about 36 minutes after launch it successfully entered orbit to Mars.
Tian Wan-1 will reach its first destination in Mars orbit at more than 17,000 km / h in March this year.
It will then spend two to three months orbiting Mars until it stabilizes its position for a lander landing.
This period will allow engineers to study the atmospheric conditions of Mars before attempting to land, which is one of the most dangerous parts of the mission.
Then, around May, the lander and Mars rover separate from the orbiter and enter the atmosphere of Mars to land on the Utopia Plain.
A vast plain of volcanic rocks and a large river basin where NASA's Viking II Mars lander landed three decades ago.
Landing on Mars, slowing down and landing on the surface are some of the most difficult and complex technical steps ahead of the mission.
For a smooth landing, the lander separates from the spacecraft, and the parachute, brake missile, and airbag slow it down as it enters the planet and stops it on the surface.
If this stage is successful, a steep surface from the lander will be opened to allow the rover to exit the lander and start scrolling on Mars.
Apparently, the lander has no scientific activity and only serves as the Mars rover ’ s rescue system.
If successful, China would be the second country after the United States to make a soft landing on Mars.
The six-wheeled rover with its solar panels will probe the surface of Mars for 90 Martian days (the Martian day is 40 minutes longer than Earth's), searching for biological molecules and conducting chemical analyses of its soil.
During this time, the orbiter will continue to circle Mars and be the bridge between the rover and Earth.
The goals of the mission are to find evidence of life on Mars in the past and present, map the Red Planet, determine the composition of the Martian soil and the distribution of icy water, study the Martian atmosphere, especially the ionosphere, and detect the magnetic and gravitational fields of Mars.
In general, on the Chinese orbiter, seven scientific instruments including medium resolution camera, high resolution camera, subsurface radar, magnetic sensor, mineral spectrometer, neutral particle and ion analyzer and energetic particle analyzer on Mars rover, six scientific instruments including the rover's subsurface radar, magnetic field detector, weather monitor, surface composition detector, mapping and orientation camera and multi-spectrum imaging camera. It has become.
The rover ’ s magnetic field detector will provide valuable information about Mars ’ past magnetic field and Earth Penetration Radar (GPR) to help detect geological formations beneath the planet ’ s surface.
This ambitious mission highlights the significant progress of China ’ s space program.
There may still be mistakes, but so far it has gone well.
It is interesting to know that the Chinese Space Agency was established in the spring of 1993 and in less than 30 years, it has been able to send orbiters, landers and rovers to the Red Planet.
Chinese officials did not comment on the Tian Won-1 details, such as the costs and preparations for the launch.
Mars missions have a high risk of success, and perhaps that ’ s why it ’ s so silent.
The new chapter of NASA ’ s exploration of the Red Planet has been consistently consistent with NASA ’ s exploration of Mars.
In the 1940s, Mariner probes produced the first images of Mars.
Viking 1 and 2 were the first man-made landers to land on the surface of the planet and search for life on Mars.
These activities culminated with the successful launch and landing of the Curiosity rover in 2012, giving color to black and white images of Mars.
It also showed that the planet had a variety of habitable environments, giving us hope for evidence of life.
The Endurance rover, or Perseus, is the next passenger who will most likely travel to Mars today from Cape Canaveral, Florida, aboard the Atlas 5 launcher to land at Jezero Crater on Tuesday, if all goes according to plan.
The 45km crater of Jazro is a crater that 3.5 billion years ago there was a river valley whose water entered the basin of the crater and created a lake about one-tenth the size of Lake Urmia.
Interestingly, the delta is also formed from the alluvium of that river.
The delta deposits could have preserved signs of possible life that existed in the lake.
But Endurance alone can ’ t detect the evidence, so one of the rover ’ s main goals is to collect and store samples with potential astrobiological signatures in small cans so that in about a decade another spacecraft can go there and bring them back to Earth.
This is because, in order to confirm the existence of biological signatures, the samples must reach the ground.
The exact details of the mission are not yet known, but it will likely come from a partnership between NASA and the European Space Agency, which will reach Mars by 1407 / 2028 and return the samples to our planet by 1410 / 2031.
The rover also has a two-kilogram helicopter called Ingenuity, which will detach after landing and operate for the first 90 days of the mission.
It will be the first flight of a robot in a world other than Earth to photograph the surface of Mars and the rover that brought it to Mars.
If it works well, it could become a regular part of NASA ’ s upcoming Mars missions.
Take a look at NASA ’ s Mars Endurance rover ’ s science instruments, equipped with seven science instruments and a total of 23 cameras and two microphones to hear the sound of a landing on the surface of Mars.
Its apparent similarity to Curiosity and the use of the same landing system makes it Curiosity's twin rover.
Both use sky crane technology to land.
On the previous mission, Curiosity was cut off from the sky crane with the help of ropes and slowly landed on the surface.
Although similar in appearance to Curiosity, Persephone uses newer versions, such as a more accurate landing system, and its wheels are very different, with sturdy wheels to cope with the rough surface of Mars.
The rover's power supply is provided by the Multi-Purpose Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (MMRTG).
The total weight of this generator is 45 kg, of which 4.8 kg is made up of plutonium dioxide.
The heat generated by the decay of this radioactive element is converted into electricity and the electrical power generated is equivalent to 110 watts.
It also keeps the rover warm during the cold Martian nights.
Unlike solar panels, MMRTG has provided significant flexibility in the rover ’ s instruments ’ performance even at night and during dust storms during the Martian winter.
Curiosity ’ s instruments sought to study the habitability of Mars, while Perseus came up with a set of different instruments to hunt for evidence of life.
The robotic arm of the Mars Endurance Rover is 1.2 meters long and has five joints.
A small turret called the Pixels (PIXL) is mounted at the end, which measures the distribution of elements in a square as small as a postage stamp of Martian rocks.
With the help of a tool called Watson, it can take visual images at the same time, and with the help of a tool called Sherlock (SHERLOC), it can achieve the distribution of organic matter.
Taken together, there is convincing evidence of the possibility of a simple life.
Such evidence is evaluated with the Raman spectrometer of the Sherlock instrument in the ultraviolet region.
Therefore, the composition of the stone is determined without the need for evaporation of the stone with a laser beam.
This was the most destructive technique used in Curiosity.
Endurance has a few other tricks up its sleeve: MEDA will monitor the Martian climate, and MOXIE will generate oxygen from the carbon dioxide in the Martian air, a vital tool for future human missions.
The RIMFAX instrument will be the first surface-penetrating radar to detect the presence of water and ice up to 10 meters deep.
In addition, a variety of cameras will capture the surface of Mars with unprecedented visual clarity and detail as it lands.
After landing, the Mars Endurance rover will spend the first two years of its mission at the crater to study and collect life samples.
It will then drive out of the crater to reach the neighboring Midway region with abundant carbonate rocks.
Some of the rocks here are as big as a house and may be parts of Mars ’ mantle that were ejected during the impact that formed the crater.
Studying them will further deepen our knowledge of the Martian subsurface.
