title: Dragons on their way home.
text:
The Crew Dragon spacecraft, carrying two American astronauts, has now separated from the International Space Station and is preparing to land in the Atlantic Ocean.
SpaceX ’ s first manned and historic mission is coming to an end, and NASA is livestreaming the return and landing of the capsule with its two astronauts aboard.
NASA television is broadcasting the return of astronauts Bob Behkenn and Doug Harley, two crew members of the Crew Dragon capsule, to Earth.
The live broadcast of the event began at 01: 30 a.m. and the "Dragon" began at 04: 04 a.m.
The transatlantic landing of the Dragon will likely take place today (August 2) at 11: 12, if weather permits.
Once the return is complete, it will mark the success of the first manned private space capsule.
The mission was an important historical moment in the shift from public space flight to private space flights, and the next important step may be space flights aimed at carrying citizens and launching space tourism.
It should be noted that Behkenken and Harley were not just going to the International Space Station for show.
They both conducted numerous scientific experiments, such as Earth observation studies and research on water droplets under microgravity conditions.
End of message.

title: NASA astronauts are on their way to Earth.
text:
The return of Robert Bencken and Douglas Harley marks the end of SpaceX's first crewed mission to the International Space Station and the first in which American astronauts traveled to the orbiting station from the United States nine years after the retirement of NASA's space shuttles.
According to the report, Harley and Bhimnekon separated from the International Space Station at about 7: 35 p.m. on Saturday, Eastern Time Zone time, and the two astronauts will return to Earth on Sunday if they proceed as planned.
Crew Dragon is expected to land on the coast of Florida at 2: 42 p.m.
The main landing site was on the surface of the Atlantic Ocean near Kennedy Space Center, but due to the synchronization of the landing with Tropical Storm Isaias, Crew Dragon's landing site was located along Florida's east coast.
Getting back to Earth from home has always been a more difficult experience, but Behneken and Harley are ready for it.
Both are former NASA astronauts who flew space shuttle missions.
SpaceX founder Elon Musk told a press conference following the launch of the Dragon spacecraft that he was not yet eager to "declare victory," stressing that a return could be more dangerous than a climb.
Behkenken and Harley arrived at the International Space Station on May 30 on a Falcon 9 rocket built by SpaceX.
The mission, called Demo-2, is a historic launch for SpaceX, which, nine years after the retirement of NASA's space shuttle, managed to transport astronauts from the US to the station for the first time.

title: NASA astronauts return to Earth with Dragon capsule
text:
According to news sources, the crew of the Dragon capsule landed with a parachute at 2: 48 p.m. local time on Sunday, August 2, near Pensacola, Florida.
The capsule was then transferred to a ship and the astronauts left.
This is the first time since the Apollo mission 45 years ago that a NASA crew has landed on the surface with a capsule.
After the retirement of NASA ’ s shuttle fleet that was able to land, American astronauts went into space and back on Russian rockets and capsules.
It was American astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Benken who returned safely from the International Space Station after completing their mission.
They left Earth for the space station more than two months ago, on May 30, aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 capsule from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
In nearly 10 years, it was the first manned U.S. spacecraft to reach the International Space Station.
Before the landing, there were concerns about bad weather and adverse conditions caused by the passing of Hurricane Isayas, but on Sunday after the landing, NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine tweeted that the weather was “extraordinary. ”
The Dragon spacecraft's journey is the beginning of private companies being used by the U.S. space agency (NASA) to launch astronauts into space.
With the landing of a capsule carrying two NASA astronauts in Florida, the first manned mission into space is completed by a private company.
While the Dragon capsule is a fully autonomous vehicle with the ability to navigate to the International Space Station, the crew must be prepared for all scenarios, including understanding how they operate under their command.
DARGON has no flight controls and all commands must be entered through a touchable screen.
SpaceX, which owns the Dragon spacecraft and the Falcon 9 rocket, was founded by Tesla CEO Elon Musk.
The company has previously used its rockets to send equipment to the International Space Station.
SpaceX will build six return spacecraft for NASA under a $2.6 billion contract.

title: Dragoon landed on the ground with two men.

title: What foods are going to disappear soon?
text:
Under normal circumstances, it ’ s easy to fully consume our favorite meals and snacks, but many of today ’ s typical meals may not be available for years to come.
Climate change, disease, and other factors pose a threat to global production and can even destroy your favorite food.
Almonds appear to be increasing in demand for almonds and almond milk, but there are questions about the sustainability of their production.
The United States is economically one of the hubs of the almond industry, but the production of almonds and milk is simply not feasible.
It is even predicted that soon almonds will reach their lowest production levels and even the almonds will disappear.
Many of us can ’ t function without a drink in the morning, and the world ’ s economies rely on coffee production.
But because of climate change, our favorite hot beverage is facing an uncertain future.
According to a report from the Australian Climate Institute, if action is not taken to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, climate change could reduce the global region suitable for coffee production by up to 50% by 2050.
The report also suggests that wild coffee could be extinct by 2080.
Chickpeas can be severely affected by climate change.
India is the world ’ s largest producer of chickpeas, and harvests in the country have been hit hard by rising temperatures leading to droughts.
In fact, pea production has been reported to have decreased by between 40% and 50% worldwide.
Peaches and other similar fruits have also disappeared under the influence of climate change.
The main problem is unpredictable temperature fluctuations, which in turn can lead to crop declines.
Severe cold attacks have caused damage to crop yields in the northeastern states of the United States in 2016.
An orange makes for a refreshing snack, but these fragrant citrus fruits are at risk around the world.
The disease of the so-called green citrus plant, or huanglongbing, has caused a shortage of oranges in parts of the world.
Reduced orange production has also been observed in Bhutan, Brazil, China and elsewhere.
Chocolate may be hard to imagine a world without chocolate, but according to a study by the International Center for Tropical Agriculture, this popular snack is likely to be heavily influenced by our changing climate.
Farms in Ghana and Côte d ’ Ivoire, the world ’ s two largest cocoa producers, were recently analysed and it can be concluded from this review that if temperatures rise by 3.9 degrees Fahrenheit (2.3 degrees Celsius) by 2050, the land is not suitable for cocoa production.
Rice is another essential crop that can be affected by the effects of climate change.
Reports from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations warn of the impact of sea level rise on rice production in major river deltas, while dry weather conditions have also affected yield.
If rice production is seriously affected, we will see a significant decrease in rice production and even the extinction of the traditional form of rice production.
Bananas are a favorite fruit of many people around the world and a staple food for many people around the world.
But bananas seem to be in danger of extinction.
The cause is related to a disease caused by the fungus Fusarium.
This fungus leads to “Panama disease, ” which actually causes the banana to turn black and the banana to fall from the inside out.
The outbreak in Latin America prompted Colombia, a country whose economy relies heavily on banana production, to declare a national emergency in 2019.

title: Crew Dragon's first operational mission date has been set.
text:
After assessing data from the Crew Dragon test flight, which took place earlier this month with two people, NASA announced that the first operational flight of SpaceX's Crew Dragon spacecraft with four astronauts will take place on October 23 from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The crew of the next Crew Dragon mission was supposed to go into space at the end of September, but NASA said that due to the busy schedule of the International Space Station, the launch would be postponed to October 23.
On this mission, astronaut Mike Hopkins, pilot Viktor Glover, Shannon Walker and Sochi Noguchi, mission specialists from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) will fly aboard the Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station.
Crew Dragon will be launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from Launch Pad 39A at Kennedy Space Center.
Assuming the Crew Dragon launch on October 23, the crew of four will fly into space around 17: 47 p.m.
However, due to changes in the orbit of the International Space Station due to aerodynamic forces and possible re-manoeuvres, launch times can vary slightly.
With the launch on October 23, Hopkins and his colleagues will dock on the International Space Station on October 24 and begin a six-month research mission on the orbiting station.
The Crew Dragon mission, due to take place in October, will be the first manned flight from SpaceX's regular return flight series to the International Space Station.
The mission, called Cro-1, follows the first crewed flight of Crew Dragon during a demonstration mission to the International Space Station.
Bob Behkenken and Douglas Harley flew to the International Space Station on May 30 on a Falcon 9 rocket built by SpaceX.
The mission, called Demo-2, is a historic launch for SpaceX, which, nine years after the retirement of NASA's space shuttle, managed to transport astronauts from the US to the station for the first time.
Harley and Behkenken returned to Earth on the second Sunday of August.

title: 35 Countries to Replace Clean Resources with Fossil Fuels / Construction of “Khorshdaq ” in Iran
text:
Due to the lack of energy on the planet, researchers from 35 countries around the world, inspired by the sun, have implemented an international project called "ITER" and hope to build the world's largest hydrogen fusion reactor to replace fossil fuels with clean energy sources, and this research was also carried out in Iran, which began with 20 percent localization of the tokamak device, and today we have achieved its full cycle.
According to estimates, energy demand in the 21st century will exceed the amount of energy resources, so that by 2030, the amount of energy needed by humans will be 60% higher than the current level.
On the other hand, if per capita energy consumption in developing countries equates to average energy consumption in rich countries, developing energy demand will increase to eight times its current level by 2050, so that by 2100 global energy demand will increase by at least two times its current energy consumption, so access to a sustainable and environmentally friendly energy source is essential.
The environmental challenges posed by fossil fuel use are other issues, as in recent years, three-quarters of the excess carbon dioxide (CO2) from burning fossil fuels such as coal and oil, and one-fourth from deforestation in the tropics.
According to global estimates, the primary sources of energy known on Earth will only be sufficient for 500 years, so the easiest solution is to look up at the sky and take inspiration from nature and build “sunsets ” (tokamaks) on Earth.
The interaction that occurs in the sun is fusion, and the human-made machine is called tokamak.
According to Dr. Reza Amrollahi, the head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Amir Kabir University of Technology and the creator of the Tokamak project, the sun sends us 30,000 times the energy of all types of energy on the planet at any moment, and this energy is not only clean and environmentally friendly, but it also promotes plant growth and development.
Referring to the construction of the tokamak device at the university, Amrollahi continued: In the sun, light nuclei fuse together and form heavier nuclei, thus releasing a lot of energy, in which case nuclear fusion takes place.
He described nuclear fusion as a clean, safe, sustainable and environmentally friendly energy source and noted that in nuclear fusion, light nuclei such as hydrogen, deuterium and tritium are fused together and heavier nuclei and some energy are produced.
Tokamak is a type of device that encapsulates plasma.
The system contains deuterium-tritium plasma, which is held by two series of magnetic fields and forms a tornado-like shape.
The use of tokamaks is to achieve the generation of electricity through the fusion method.
Since 30 years ago, researchers in the country have been seriously studying nuclear fusion plasma encapsulation, the first nuclear fusion device, the Alvand, was built in collaboration with Italy, with less than 20% of its technical knowledge indigenous.
The second Tokamak machine, called "Damavand", was purchased from Russia, and the third nuclear fusion device, which was operated at the Free University, was purchased from China.
In order to achieve the technical knowledge of this device, our researchers at Amir Kabir University of Technology have localized it. This device has been implemented as "Alborz" tokamak in cooperation with the modernization and development organization.
The project, which is about to be completed, involved about 40 small and large companies in the manufacture of parts of the machine, one of which is the largest transformer factory in the country (Iran Transfo Zanjan) and the smallest of which is a few knowledge-based companies of measuring devices.
ITER ’ s massive international project to build the sun on a reactor assembly ground was launched in southern France almost 15 years ago with the aim of controlling hydrogen fusion and is expected to continue until the end of 2024.
The project is inspired by the nuclear fusion reactions that take place in the sun and stars, which will be one of humanity ’ s most significant successes from a scientific and technological perspective, as the exploitation of huge amounts of energy produced will forever change the course of technological progress.
The project has been in operation since 2006 with the participation of more than 35 countries including EU member states, including the United Kingdom, Switzerland, China, India, Japan, Korea, Russia and the United States, and about 40 km from Aix-en-Provence, with the aim of recreating the unlimited energy produced by the sun and stars through hydrogen fusion in hopes of finding alternatives to fossil fuels.
In recent months, several pieces of the experimental reactor called Tokamak, some the size of a four-story building and weighing several hundred tons, have been delivered to the site from India, China, Japan and Korea.
In the grandeur of the project, it is enough that its electromagnetic solenoid is capable of attracting a giant aircraft.
This giant reactor is 10 times larger than similar ones.
The first generation of this type of reactor was built in the Soviet Union in the 1950s.
The giant reactor simulates and reproduces the hydrogen melting reaction that occurs naturally in the heart of the sun.
This fusion makes it possible to reach temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius with a mixture of two hydrogen isotopes that are converted into plasma.
In the nuclear fusion method, deuterium and tritium (two heavy isotopes of hydrogen) combine to produce a heavier atom called helium, which produces a neutron particle and a large amount of heat, and in the bombardment inside the tokamak reactor, the neutrons produced by this fusion generate heat, which is driven by a circuit of water under pressure in the form of steam, moving the turbine in a chain of electricity....
ITER can produce its first plasma in late 2025, and the reactor will reach full power by 2035.
Hydrogen fusion is a safe and clean source of energy, freeing us from fossil fuels, with the advantage that unlike a nuclear reactor, it does not produce radioactive waste.
The construction site of ITER, one of the largest sites in Europe, covers nearly 42 hectares and has employed 2,300 personnel with a projected budget of €20 billion since its inception in 2010, and 10 million pieces from thousands of factories worldwide are shipped to Saint-Paul-lez-Durance.
ITER researchers believe it will be a fully formed jewel of technology and is predicted to be the most complex and expensive device ever built with the world ’ s largest magnets and human-powered computers.
The project was born in 1985, when Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev first met in Geneva.
They expressed their support for the broadest international cooperation to obtain [fusion] energy.
ITER is therefore considered a “diplomatic technology ” because the idea was also a way out of the Cold War.
The scientific community then succeeded in bringing this innovative technology to market as an essential way for fusion energy.
The ITER project will test several technologies for the production of fuel (tritium) and, according to physicists, ITER will also make it possible to study the behavior and stability of a giant plasma.
Most countries will benefit from this project, especially France.
With more than half of the contracts awarded in Europe – currently 3.7 billion euros ($4.1 billion) out of a total of 6.4 billion euros (7.2 billion) – the French industry is the big winner, ITER helps companies develop technology and apply applied projects in other sectors such as medical technology.
ITER is no longer the only research project on fusion.
Two thousand private startups are developing similar or competitive technologies, so we can hope that any hybrid technology that is rapidly exploited will meet some of humanity ’ s needs and reduce the threats posed by irreversible climate change.
The ITER project also aims to "bring the sun to Earth" and show that we can master nuclear fusion reactions to produce energy, just like stars do.
If we overcome technological barriers, and if ITER succeeds, the new energy window on Earth may open with this new, safe, clean energy that can replace non-sustainable sources.
The impact of the ITER International Project on the field of fusion is diverse and profound.
To achieve a reactor scale plasma that produces 500 megawatts of power, ITER needs to develop and advance a variety of technologies.
The participation of 35 countries in ITER leads to the achievement of significant benefits including technology, technical knowledge and experience.
End of message.

title: The path to Mars has been modified.
text:
NASA says it has recently modified the Mars Perseverance rover's path to the Red Planet by turning on the rover's deep space engines for the first time, and four more such maneuvers are planned before landing in February 2021.
NASA's new Mars 2020 mission has turned on its deep space propulsion engines for the first time to correct its path to Mars.
The centerpiece of NASA ’ s $2.7 billion mission is the Mars Endurance rover, which corrected its trajectory toward the Red Planet with a trajectory correction exercise on Friday, 15 days after launch.
Mission team members said the maneuver successfully used the spacecraft's eight propulsion engines.
The mission requires five trajectory correction maneuvers to prepare the rover for a landing at the Martian crater called Jezero on February 18, 2021.
NASA has announced that the remaining four exercises will take place on September 28, December 20, February 10 and February 16.
There is also an opportunity for February 17 and a possible final course correction for February 18, just nine hours before the "Endurance" landing.
The Mars Endurance rover launched on July 30 with the goal of landing at the 45-kilometer Jezero crater and looking for signs of ancient life there, which once hosted a lake and river delta.
The rover will also collect and store samples of Martian soil to be brought back to Earth in the future, which is scheduled for early 2031.
Of course, the mission will also test new exploration technologies.
For example, a small helicopter called "Ingenuity", tied to the belly of "Endurance", is traveling to the Red Planet and will make the first flight in the world beyond Earth.
In addition, one of the “endurance ” tools, called MOXIE, produces oxygen from the carbon dioxide of Mars ’ atmosphere.
NASA officials say an improved version of MOXIE could one day help humans live on Mars.
NASA plans to land the first humans on Mars in the next decade.
End of message.

title: Abbas: Palestine stands united against conspiracies / UAE stabbed us in the back
text:

title: Health tourism: a concept beyond treatment
text:
ISNA / Khorasan Razavi Treatment is one of the motivations through which people travel to different places and travel to improve their physical and mental condition.
Health tourism is not limited to medical services and includes naturopathic services as well.
Director of the Research Department of Tourism Management and Planning at the Institute of Tourism, ACECR, in an interview with ISNA, regarding the introduction of "health tourism" as one of the types of tourism, said: "Health tourism" in recent years has created advantages including job creation and poverty reduction and has promoted the economic situation of countries.
Masoumeh Tavangar stated: The World Tourism Organization (WTO) has provided a definition of health tourism, according to this definition, services that improve and increase health and morale of people, and in a place outside of their residence for more than 24 hours, is considered health tourism.
He added that the use of the health properties of mineral waters, healthy weather in one place and the use of medical services of a country are among the services that have been mentioned in health tourism, so health tourism has a concept beyond medical tourism.
Nature therapy is one of the types of health tourism, this faculty member of the Institute of Tourism, ACECR said: Those who work in the field of health tourism believe that the provision of services in this area should be in the level of the first world countries and in contrast, prices and costs should be in the level of developing countries and the third world to encourage people to travel to use these services.
Tavangar pointed out: According to the history of health tourism, topics such as nature therapy, such as the use of hot springs, began from the past and from Greece and Rome, and with the development of this type of tourism in European and American countries, health tourism has also become more prevalent, but recently in this type of tourism, medical issues have become more prevalent than nature therapy.
He continued: In the past, only in Western countries, advanced medical services, superior doctors and up-to-date medical equipment were used; but recently, in developing countries such as Singapore, Thailand, India and Turkey, health tourism has become popular and tourists choose these countries to use their medical services.
Director of the Research Department of Tourism Management and Planning at the Institute of Tourism, ACECR stated: Usually, countries create their competitive advantage in certain fields and try to attract tourists in a specific field, for example, some countries specialize in cancer treatment, organ donation and treatment of neurological diseases, but some other countries promote their services in the field of plastic and cosmetic surgery.
Iran has low statistics in the field of health tourism, Tavangar explained: Today Mashhad is more active in the field of beauty, heart and eye surgery and has received more patients in these areas, but in general, Iran has not opened its position in the field of health tourism among neighboring countries and has a low rate of tourism in the field of health tourism, while Iran has skilled manpower and costs are very affordable for health tourists.
He added that medical issues in Iran have come from the past when Avicenna expresses his medical opinions and writes books, and it can be related to health tourism, but officially, this type of tourism was recognized by the Ministry of Health in 2003, and in 2004, this issue was raised in the Cultural Heritage Organization and the description of the duties in this organization for the management of health tourism, and since then it was introduced as an independent industry. And he is known.
We can plan for new forms of health tourism in Khorasan Razavi. This faculty member of the Institute of Tourism, ACECR stated: Since health tourism is effective in the economic development of countries, it has been considered in the country 's laws and policies, and in our country, for this type of tourism, the Health Tourism Policy Council and the International Health Services Committee have been formed in the Ministry of Health and Medical Education.
Tavangar said that improving infrastructures such as international relations of the country, transportation, excellent medical services, the appropriate cost of treatment, health facilities and facilities, the feeling of security, the provision of treatment visas, the presence of skilled professionals and the provision of medical services to foreign tourists in various languages and several languages of the world can help expand this type of tourism.
He continued: Mashhad is one of the most important economic hubs of the country, and along with medical issues, it can also work in health fields due to its diverse nature, and now it is possible to plan for new forms of health tourism in Khorasan Razavi province, as well as to increase health villages in the province, which is currently low in number.
What Threatens Health Tourism?
Director of the Research Department of Tourism Management and Planning at the Institute of Tourism, ACECR said: In general, development is a category that, if its aspects are not measured, will be harmful.
For example, in the field of health tourism, the rights of indigenous people should be considered and they should be provided with medical and health services at an affordable cost, otherwise the development of health tourism is a threat, on the other hand, tourists who travel to a country to receive health services should have clear rules to protect them against possible medical errors that protect their rights.
Tavangar said: One of the challenges that the industry now faces is the mismanagement of those who help to attract health tourists, in fact, they can be referred to as informal marketers.
At present, there is not yet a coherent structure for the management of these people, and for better management of health tourism, a full and comprehensive statistics must be obtained from the University of Medical Sciences in order to plan carefully through the policy making organizations in this area to improve it.
End of message.

Earlier in his speech on the occasion of the 51st anniversary of the burning of the Al-Aqsa Mosque, Haniya condemned the agreement between the UAE and the Zionist regime and called for a comprehensive plan to confront the actions of the regime, saying that this agreement is no less than burning the mosque.

title: India and Thailand are Iran ’ s rivals in attracting Omani tourists
text:
Abdolreza Khodadadi, active in the field of health tourism in the country and having a medical coordination company in Oman, told Mehr reporter about the welcome of Omani from Iran to use health services: Everywhere we hear that cheap, Iran has become a tourist destination, or the availability of daily flights and visa removal can attract tourists, but these cases are effective in increasing the arrival of Omani tourists to Iran.
Cancellation of Iran visa was a good thing for Omanis, this is a golden opportunity for tourism of the country, which if we benefit from it, we can see its positive effects grow.
But if we don ’ t take advantage of this opportunity, the competitors will surely take the market away from us.
Previously, the cost of surgeries worth Oman ’ s money may have been very high, but now, with the devaluation of Iran ’ s currency, this cost has been reduced.
Previously, the flights of the two countries were not direct and used transit, but again, this did not prevent them from coming to Iran.
Despite removing visas and conducting more than a dozen direct flights between Iran and Oman, Iran still lags behind the arrival of Omani tourists compared to countries such as Thailand and India, which have been able to attract Omani tourists, we have not even achieved 50% of this desirable market.
In fact, Iran is not yet the number one destination for Omanis.
Iran 's travel agencies do not have a special program for tourists, Khodadadi said that officials and institutions related to the issue of health tourism should be a powerful arm for the cooperation of health tourism activists and guides of the country and not a barrier for them. These institutions should plan and follow their instructions and regulations to increase the incoming statistics of health and medical tourists.
Unfortunately, most of these regulations and guidelines are meant to undermine and derail the Arabic-speaking tour guides, who have each managed to directly attract more than tens of thousands of medical tourists to our country for more than two decades at their own expense and with their own initiatives.
The need to support and support them as a lasting legacy of health tourism seems essential.
Instead, while maintaining the input statistics, institutions related to health tourism in the country with new methods and providing new medical services, special and luxury medical tours, try to provide maximum absorption methods, but unfortunately, we are witnessing regulations and tastes in dealing with this group, and in fact, the root of therapeutic tourism is struck.
He added: Exhibitions are currently being held in Oman with the theme of health tourism.
A country like Malaysia is building pavilions and introducing parts of them to private collections and hospitals to introduce Iran should be the same, that is, the introduction of Iran should be targeted.
The tourism expert on Iran ’ s advertising in the field of health tourism also said that the people of Oman are usually very hard to trust unless someone has used Iran ’ s health services and they ask him.
Some of them do not seek traditional services at all; Iranian companies should be able to introduce them to modern services or gain their trust in other ways.
Still, Iranian agencies serve Omani tourists in the traditional way, while some of them want special or VIP services, they can easily plan for these people, or they can increase the number of people who want a special treatment package and attract them.
These people need a VIP car in the hotel ’ s treatment package along with medical services.
Iran ’ s competitors, India and Thailand, also said about Iran ’ s rivals in attracting Oman ’ s health tourists, “Now Omani patients go to India and Thailand because they receive a lot of ancillary services from these two countries, while receiving desirable services from these countries has been transferred to them chest to chest. Omani people prefer chest to chest advertising. ”
The tourism expert in Oman said: “We have three different dimensions in tourism, which are often confused with medical tourism, which means services such as sludge therapy, water therapy and so on.
Medical tourism such as hair transplantation, eye surgery and...
The health tourist does not come for relaxation, relaxation, mental and physical renewal and specifically to stay in a 5-star hotel, but an ultra-luxurious eco-tourism unit and local drinks and foods and herbal tea can satisfy the applicants for such services.
It ’ s important to remember that health tourism is needed in today ’ s world.
There are tourism companies with subparagraph (b) and (a) that should be focused on, but some have only obtained an IPD license, while the health tourist, if he goes to a country, wants to take advantage of its pristine nature and spend his recovery period or be in peace, but we do not plan for these types of health tourists.
If the book of Revelation is about to be revealed, then it is about how many people will be able to follow it, and how many people will be able to follow it.
How is it that these offices work in the field of tourism but go to medical services alone?
Shouldn ’ t they also be providing medical care?
He said that 80 percent of the people who call the tourism offices in Oman are willing to cooperate, but do not have a special program for health tourism, adding that every year more than 40,000 Omani tourists, whether from medical or pilgrimage places or visiting relatives and relatives, travel to our country, only about half of them go for medical and medical services.
In fact, instead of increasing these statistics, the offices and officials plan for the existing statistics, which will lead to the collapse of the tourism growth graph in the country.
We have not been able to provide new services to attract new people.
Khodadadi stated: Unfortunately, one of the inappropriate and far from the ethics of tourism in the field of health and tourism is the presence of representatives of tourism agencies licensed by medical sciences, right next to the entrance gate of Shiraz airport, so that guests after checking their passports and before receiving equipment, deal with the employees of these agencies, and the first sentence they say to them upon entering the country is: "Be careful outside of the fraudsters and the fraudsters and translator and translator. The guide is a thief, and if you want health care, call us because we have a license. ”
This has been mentioned many times by our guests, namely Omani nationals, and unfortunately, the negative impact and future decline of the number of medical tourists will follow.
Unfortunately, despite the warnings of Iranian friends and agencies based in Oman, there has not yet been a deal with these airport based tourism companies, so we want to address this issue.
Exactly this issue hits the root of the medical tourism statistics, because instead of attracting new tourists from the countries of origin, they are seeking to attract tourists who have entered the country with previous communication and coordination, and are among the guests who have traveled to our country with confidence in Arabic-speaking tourism guides and Iranian tourist agencies based in Oman.
Referring to the experience of other countries, the tourism expert said: "In the past five decades, when the industrial smokestacks had risen, people in neighboring countries and the Persian Gulf were suffering from respiratory problems. Some tourism companies in Lebanon, by identifying the good weather, designed tourist settlements and chartered flights increased their stay in the settlements. Many of them, when they returned, many of their lung and respiratory problems were solved." We don ’ t have such areas in Iran, we just couldn ’ t plan for it.
He also explained about the purpose of Omani tourists' medical travel: Omanis usually come to Iran to do things such as eye surgery, beauty and hair transplantation, women and infertility, treatment of bone, back and spine diseases, internal diseases and general surgery. They also visit Shiraz and Mashhad, Tehran and Isfahan.
I have not yet seen a travel package that meets the required standards of all the tourism programs in the country.
All tourism companies in our country focus only on medical tourism, not health tourism.
Khodadadi, who has a medical coordination company in Oman to send patients to Iran for treatment, continued: “There are maybe ten other Iranian companies in Oman that are doing the same. ”
But Omani travelers are not comfortable with companies and the usual way, this is due to the bitter experience they have had with other countries, so they use the experience of their compatriots in using the services of companies, that is, if their compatriots have a good service from a company, they only work with the same and the advertising of other companies does not affect it.
A number of Omani tourists come to Iran for pilgrimage, in which case they go to Mashhad or to travel to northern cities.
Ardabil and the city of Sarein have been added to their destinations in recent years, but the infrastructure of the city has not yet been introduced.
The city, with its therapeutic water springs, can be a therapeutic tourism destination.
Especially for people with knee and joint problems.
Ramsar ’ s therapeutic sludge can also be included in the list of targets.
Of course, Omani have families in provinces such as Hormozgan and Sistan and Baluchestan and travel there, so they can also define tourism infrastructure for them to refer to medical tourism.
Oman Air and Sea Trips Khodadadi also said about the establishment of sea lines between the two countries: Now, it is not possible to go to Oman for a while, but because passenger ships were not filled, companies lost money, for example, a ship had to take 240 passengers, its fuel cost was high and it was not economical.
Also, if the weather is bad, the ship does not move, so no tourist company would be responsible for cancelling the passengers ’ travel.
For the Khobab route of Bandar Abbas and Qeshm, lines were also launched, but it could not work permanently.
He also said about Iranian trips to Oman: Iranians get an airport visa to enter Oman and have to pay 5 Omani rials for it and one rial for service and services.
This fee is for a 10-day visa, but the person who wants to stay for one month will have to pay 21 Omani riyals.
Also, getting a hotel voucher is one of the requirements because unfortunately in the past years some Iranians did not have a specific place to stay in Oman, which is why now they want a hotel voucher at the airport.

title: “Cool Roofs ” is a solution to cool and improve Tehran ’ s air
text:
The results of a simulation showed that the use of cool roofs in Tehran is better than green roofs due to better performance, lower costs and no need for special infrastructure.
According to the report of Tehran ’ s air quality in 2017, “due to the overpopulation of the city and its geography, as well as the undue increase of vehicles, air quality in the metropolis reaches undesirable conditions on many days.
The most common cause of this in recent years has been the emission of motor vehicle pollution, and in recent years, the phenomenon of dust and particulate matter entering from other places has also increased the severity of the air pollution problem. ”
Temperatures in some cities or urban areas are significantly higher than those in the suburbs.
Heating buildings, air pollution and the use of inappropriate materials such as asphalt that absorb sunlight, etc.
They are among the factors that cause the warming of cities and the creation of the “urban heat island ” phenomenon.
Green roofs and cool roofs are ways to reduce this urban heat island.
Green roof is any type of prefabricated structure with vegetation that can increase the per capita green space of cities due to the limitations of the development of surface green space in densely populated cities.
Green roof has the role of thermal insulation in buildings and saves energy.
A cool roof is also a type of surface with a high reflectance factor that is often white in color.
In the modern type, these roofs are built with a certain slope and using a coating of artificial materials with high reflectivity coefficient.
This type of roof can reduce cooling energy consumption by 10-40%.
Hossein Malakooti, Somayeh Arghavani and Valiollah Sheykhi, researchers in the Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences at the Faculty of Marine Science and Technology of Hormozgan University, in a study using numerical simulation, investigated the possible effects of using green roof and cool roof in the period from 26 June to 10, 95 (early summer) in Tehran.
The results of the study show that green roofs reduce the temperature during the day, but increase the temperature at night.
This type of roof also affects the speed and direction of the wind and the natural ventilation of the city, and the emission (heat energy radiation) from its surface is high.
These reasons have led to the fact that a cool roof is better than a green roof in a significant reduction in air temperature and a large circadian reduction in heat flux.
By reducing the incoming radiation, cool roofs reduce the heat stored on urban surfaces, which play a positive role in reducing the heat island.
By performing a simulation of green roof and cool roof and examining their effect on the concentration of surface pollutants, it was found that their concentration was not visible at the average boarding time and in some selected meteorological stations, it was also decreasing, and in general, these proposed strategies did not have an adverse effect on the air quality of the metropolis of Tehran.
Since the cost of building and maintaining a green roof is more than a cool roof and also a cool roof has a better performance, the development of a cool roof in Tehran is suggested.
But the researchers emphasize that in order to verify the accuracy of the simulation results, field studies are necessary.
Referring to the effect of reducing temperature and wind speed on increasing the concentration of pollutants and intensifying urban heat island in some hours of the day, the researchers emphasize: "Programs to reduce emissions of primary pollutants and man-made heat, such as improving fuel quality and updating urban transport systems, should continue to be the priority of improving air quality and adjusting the heat island in the metropolis of Tehran."
The results of this study were published this summer (2020) as a scientific research paper entitled "A Case Study of Summer Performance of Green Roof and Cool Roof Development Strategies on Air Quality in Tehran Metropolis" in the Journal of Iranian Geophysics.
End of message.

title: More than 50 refugees rescued in the English Channel in two days
text:
Once again, a group of refugees trying to cross the English Channel were rescued by French border guards.
The migrants were identified in a small inflatable boat about 1.5 kilometers off the coast of the city of Calais and rescued by border guards.
It appears that the smugglers were trying to get them to the Scott cargo ship, which the police tracked down.
They were taken to a detention center in the port of Calais.
On Wednesday, more than 50 asylum seekers were identified by the Coast Guard in the English Channel near the Calais Strait.
According to the Calais government, more than 100 migrants attempted to cross the English Channel on Wednesday due to the calm sea and clear skies, including 22 children.
According to Euronews, these refugees are often transported in large numbers by gangs and smugglers in perilous conditions on small boats at sea, thinking of criminals as their saviors but not knowing that they will never reach their dream destination, and most of these travelers, even if they survive dangerous voyages, will still have to live in precarious conditions in camps and camps.
End of message.

title: Erdogan and the Dream of Restoration of the Ottoman Empire
text:
AP Image caption Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says his party's victory extends beyond his country's borders, intoxicated by marking a turning point in his country's history, winning a party for the third time in a row in elections for the first time in 54 years, calling this victory not only a victory for the Turkish people, but also a victory for those who were once within the borders of the Ottoman Empire.
Before the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) won the election, Mr. Erdogan appeared with his wife, Amina, at the headquarters of his party in central Ankara and addressed a crowd of supporters celebrating: “Today, he has won from Istanbul to Bosnia, from Izmir to Beirut, from Ankara to Damascus, from Diyarbakir to Ramallah, Nablus, Jenin, the West Bank, and Gaza. Today, it has won from Turkey to the Middle East, the Caucasus, the Balkans and Europe. ”
The geographical map that Erdoğan drew in his speech covers the territories that were once ruled by the Ottoman Turks.
The era of invasions and conquests had passed before Recep Tayyip Erdogan was born and is now a time of establishing spheres of influence and expanding authority through economic and cultural means, relying on political intelligence and seizing opportunities.
The Freedom Fleet and the Valley of the Wolves were history supporters of Erdogan and his Islamist supporters, which put their rise to power on the eve of the US invasion of Iraq and the opening of a new chapter in the history of the Middle East, Erdogan ’ s government made the best use of that historic opportunity and by refusing to join the US military, opened its place in the hearts of the Arabs.
Since then, the Turks have begun to conquer the Arab heartlands one by one, and they reached the peak of popularity last year by sending the Freedom Flotilla to Gaza, which also flooded the Arab markets with Turkish goods, brought huge and lucrative civil, industrial and service contracts, and infatuated Arab families, from Yemen to Morocco, with Turkish serials such as No Light and Love and Valley of the Wolves.
With the arrival of wealthy Arab tourists and expendable money to Turkey, Turkish passenger flights to Arab airports have increased so much that while the major European airlines are on the verge of bankruptcy, Turkish Airlines has become one of the highest paid and most efficient airlines in the world.
A country plagued by hyperinflation and high unemployment, now one of the 16 largest economies in the world, and a country known for the successive collapse of fragile governments and political coalitions, has seen a stable government that has been in power for more than eight years and needs less than two more years to set the record for the longest political stability since the arrival of democracy in Turkey.
The situation has reached such a point that now everyone is waiting for Mr. Erdogan to get rid of his electoral engagements as soon as possible and think of a solution for Libya, and in foreign policy, the Arab leaders, who constantly complain about the interference of “non-Arab governments ” in their countries, openly invite Turkey to mediate their problems, as if the Arabs have completely forgotten that their fathers were fighting for freedom from under the yoke until 100 years ago. The Turks were being killed, as if no one was looking at the statues and monuments of the" martyrs "of the war with the Turks, who have been standing on the streets and squares for decades.
Turkish Islam and the Arab Spring have little doubt that without the direct support of the United States, Turkey could have won even a small portion of these political and economic concessions.
America, which is at war with fundamentalist Islam, sees the peace plan in the hands of the Turks.
The Bush and Obama administrations, for all their differences, agree on Turkey ’ s role model for Muslims.
The uprisings in Tunisia and Egypt provided a new opportunity for Turkey, Erdogan ’ s government from the very beginning expressed sympathy with the movement in these countries, and in the case of Egypt, those who were concerned that the Tahrir Square movement would be confiscated in favor of the Islamists, would find peace in the name of Turkish Islam, and even the Muslim Brotherhood itself emphasized that it was following the example of Turkey ’ s Justice and Development Party.
The spillover of Arab uprisings in Libya and Syria made it difficult for Turkey.
Turkey, which had capital in both countries, took a stand against military intervention in Libya.
Syria was so close to Turkey that the media still refers to Bashar al-Assad as one of Erdogan ’ s personal friends.
In the case of Libya, the prolongation of the NATO operation and the persistence of Muammar Gaddafi on the one hand and the historical pessimism of the Arab masses on the other hand, helped Turkey, and now not only has the credibility that Turkey had built for itself among the Arabs, but it has come to a point where everyone is waiting for Mr. Erdogan to get out of the election as soon as possible and think of a solution for Libya.
In Syria, Turkey, on the other hand, warned the West against a repeat of the Libyan scenario, insisting that Bashar al-Assad could still fix the crisis with reforms.
On the other hand, Erdogan hosted the first meeting of the opposition to Bashar al-Assad and opened the border so that Syrian refugees could come and talk about the “crimes ” being committed against them.
Although the Syrian media and pro-Syrian press in Lebanon have taken a critical tone from Turkey, Erdogan ’ s government has continued to play in such a way that it can still be said that whether Bashar al-Assad is staying or leaving, Turkey ’ s position in Syria will be preserved and its business in the Levant market will thrive.
During the summer and harvest, the AKP will begin the third period of Turkish rule, as the Arab Spring reaches the summer and the process of developing new Arab systems begins.
The fact that Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says his party ’ s victory extends beyond his country ’ s borders can be interpreted as saying that he is now going to win the bid for the construction of new political structures in Arab countries by the architects of Turkey ’ s Justice and Development Party (AKP).
The Arab uprisings, along with the slogans of freedom and change, have shown a fertile ground for the rise of Islamism.
The most efficient means of gathering people for demonstrations is Friday prayers; in the example of Egypt, where the uprising has been victorious, the Islamic currents, from the fundamentalist Salafists to the moderate Muslim Brotherhood, have shown more ability to organize and influence among the people than any other organization.
This is where the Turkish model enters the scene, a model that the West is pleased with, and the Arabs, from Islamist politicians to the public who think of the Hereafter, see it as the secret to success of their Turkish Muslim brothers.
This is the promise of the resurrection, the resurrection of the dead.
That the former subjects of the Ottoman Empire, which he mentioned in his victory speech, would have taken over the Topkapı and Dolmabahçe palaces in Istanbul a hundred years ago, from now on line with the Chan Kaya Palace in Ankara.
Outside Turkey, all grounds are open for interpretation of the dream, but inside Turkey, the nudges are threatening the bubble.
The lesson of the fate of the tattered Adnan of Islam Erdoğan, as much as it does on the outside, has left many people emboldened.
Mr Erdogan ’ s main promise in his victory speech was constitutional reform, reforms that went against Atatürk ’ s legacy and towards the Islam of the Ottoman caliphate that Atatürk dismantled.
Although AKP has won fewer seats in parliament than both previous terms, the number of voters has doubled since it was born nine years ago, and Mr Erdogan, relying on more than 21 million votes cast in his favor on Sunday, sees his victory as inevitable in any referendum to amend the constitution.
Of course, he is not the first person in Turkey to win his party three times in a row, and he sees such popularity as his support; in the history of democracy in Turkey, along with Adnan Menderes, who led the country for ten years, Mr. Erdogan is still at the second rung.
Photo copyright BBC World Service Image caption Mr Erdogan is going to stay in Turkey's history for a few periods in power, although he was not an Islamist, Adnan Menderes took Islam out of the veil that Atatürk had completely obliterated, restored the call to prayer in mosques, impoverished Turkey 60 years ago to a rate of economic growth that is still unprecedented, enabling active foreign policy, He entered NATO, but eventually paid the price for falling back on the gallows with the heirs of Ataturk.
But here, too, history is on Erdogan ’ s side, the period of the coup has passed, and if there were those who had the slightest possibility of plotting a coup by them, they were arrested and imprisoned, especially since, unlike thirty years ago, nobody in the West is happy with the coup in Turkey, and the army does not intend to turn the successful and popular Turkey of the West and East into Pakistan of Pervez Musharraf.
Erdogan ’ s opponents are singing that the changes he wants to make by amending the constitution will blow the Turkish dream of Europeanization, at a time when the wind is blowing from the right in Europe and the wave of Islamophobia is increasing day by day.
But the results of this year ’ s election and last year ’ s referendum show that this opposition is only heard by a part of the urban middle class, who find themselves increasingly isolated in Turkey, and the new middle class formed by the Justice and Development Party (AKP) in Turkey, stigmatizing them as reactionary and belonging to their past.
The tradition of looking to the west has settled in the heart of the Turks even since the Ottoman era, but if the generation of the Muthuls of Atatürk ’ s legacy looked longingly to the west, the generation that had been cultivated under Erdogan ’ s leadership would like to look fondly at the West instead of need: you get used to our kebab doner, not us to your steak.
But more than anything, Erdogan ’ s dream can be turned into a nightmare.
Another record that Erdoğan set was naming ethnic minorities in his victory speech: “Today my Turkish brother, my Kurdish brother, Zaza, Arab, Luz, Georgian, Gypsy, all my brothers won. ”
Getty Image caption Erdoğan's dream can be turned into a nightmare more than anything else when he promised to amend the constitution, saying the new constitution would be based on brotherhood, solidarity, participation, unity and equality Turkish, Kurdish, Zaza, Arab, Circus, Luz, Georgian, Gypsy, Tatar, Turkmen, Alawi and Sunnis.
Perhaps the minorities on his list were chosen carefully, he mentioned the Gypsies twice but did not even mention the Armenians and Assyrians.
Small and disadvantaged minorities such as Circus, Laz, Georgians, Tatar and Turkmen are not Turkey ’ s problem, the main challenge lies in the promise of equality to the Kurds.
Sunday ’ s election has brought Kurdish representatives into the ranks of lawmakers who have fought and imprisoned for years for the rights of their people and even some of them are still in prison, an unprecedented victory for the Kurds of Turkey, as was the victory of the AKP.
For Kurdish politicians, the promise of equality to set up a Kurdish television network and perhaps to allow a number of Kurdish-language publications and to teach the language in classes outside the schools is not limited; their demands are like a double-edged sword; giving in to these demands will turn the Turkish ethnicists, who are also abundant in the AKP, against Mr. Erdogan and refusing them, risks rebellion and unrest in the country.
While the goods of rebellion and uprising are being bought in the Middle East market, the Kurds do not need to take up arms, they need to walk in the streets, and then the Erdogan government will turn another part of the country against itself if it wants to retreat, and it may lose control of the affairs, if it wants to resort to the usual method of repression, the dream of Europeanization will be destroyed and the Ottoman Empire will be destroyed.

title: Corona has reduced her beauty.
text:
According to an IRNA report on Monday from the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons, Babak Nikomaram, referring to the beginning of cosmetic procedures last week with the observance of health protocols in the country, said: "Performing cosmetic surgery for people with underlying diseases and heart problems is a high risk."
He said that before plastic and cosmetic surgery, the health status of the individual is fully monitored, and people who do not have a specific underlying disease and cardiovascular problems will be operated on a controlled basis if they need to.
The vice president of the Association of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons, pointing out that candidates for cosmetic surgery in the country are between 18 and 65 years old, continued: Permission to perform plastic and cosmetic surgeries was issued last week by the Ministry of Health, although this is done in compliance with specific health protocols.
Nikomaram added: "The most beautiful operations are performed in countries such as the United States, Brazil and South America, and among the countries of the region, Iran has the highest rate of plastic and cosmetic surgeries after Turkey, and Iran has 330 plastic surgeons, which in the Middle East region has the highest number of surgeons in this field."
He emphasized that people should refer to qualified and trained physicians for performing cosmetic surgeries, because otherwise, cosmetic surgery can have irreversible complications for them. Of course, it goes without saying that any type of surgery has a complication, but doctors are trying to minimize the amount of it.

title: The Arab League did not condemn the normalization of relations between the United Arab Emirates and Israel.
text:
The Arab League ’ s foreign ministers did not agree to a resolution proposed by the Palestinian delegation to condemn the normalization of relations between the United Arab Emirates and Israel.
According to Reuters, Palestinian Foreign Minister Riyad al-Maliki in a video meeting of Arab League foreign ministers called on them to condemn the agreement between the UAE and Israel to normalize relations.
But a draft resolution proposed by the Palestinian delegation at a three-hour meeting of Arab League foreign ministers was opposed by some Arab countries.
Al-Jazeera news network says that in return, some Arab countries have called for support for the normalization of relations between the United Arab Emirates and Israel.
According to the report, the PA had “reduced ” its harsh tone against the Emirati-Israeli agreement in the draft resolution to gain some Arab support.
But the Palestinian movement was not successful.
A Palestinian delegation official told Al Jazeera that the Arab League rejected a proposed resolution condemning the normalization of relations between the United Arab Emirates and Israel.
Hesam Zaki, assistant secretary general of the Arab League, told reporters the discussion was serious.
But comprehensive negotiations on the resolution proposed by the Palestinian delegation did not lead to an agreement.
In the video conference, Maliki thanked other Arab countries for refusing to normalize relations with Israel, saying that US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and Jared Kushner, Donald Trump ’ s son-in-law and senior adviser, had intimidated and threatened the agreement to normalize relations between the UAE and Israel.
The official signing ceremony for the normalization of relations between the UAE and Israel will be held next Tuesday, September 15, hosted by President Donald Trump at the White House.
Meanwhile, Palestinian ambassador to the Arab League, Mahand al-Akluk, said the Palestinian delegation and Arab countries agreed that the final statement underscored their commitment to the 2002 Arab-Israeli peace initiative to create two independent states.
Al-Akluk added that at the end of the three-hour discussion of the Arab League foreign ministers, it was agreed not to explicitly condemn the normalization of relations between the UAE and Israel.
The Palestinian ambassador to the Arab League also said, but in return, some countries wanted to legitimize the normalization of relations between the UAE and Israel, which was not agreed to.
Mahand al-Akluk has also stated that the resolution proposed by the Palestinian Authority did not vote.
Last week, Palestinian Authority leader Mahmoud Abbas called on Arab and Gulf leaders to refrain from joining the normalization process with Israel.
Mahmoud Abbas said the agreement between the United Arab Emirates and Israel was the "latest poisoned dagger" that has been inflicted on Palestinians and the body of the "Arab and Islamic Ummah."
Ali Khamenei, the leader of the Islamic Republic, also called the UAE ’ s move to normalize relations with Israel a “betrayal ” of the Muslim world, the Arab world and the Palestinian issue.
The normalization of relations between Israel and the United Arab Emirates is the first in more than 20 years of diplomatic relations between an Arab country and Israel, mainly because of concerns on both sides about Iranian threats in the region.
Sources: Reuters, Al Jazeera and the Jerusalem Post

title: Iran ’ s Foreign Ministry: We have not received Canada ’ s complaint about the Ukrainian plane, and we will not
text:
A spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry said the Iranian government has not received any complaints from the Canadian government about the downing of the Ukrainian plane and will not receive them in the future.
Saeed Khatibzadeh said Friday that “the Canadian court has no jurisdiction ” in the case and that“ judicial proceedings will be conducted inside Iran. ”
According to a spokesman for Iran ’ s Foreign Ministry, “any person, whether natural or legal, ” if they have a complaint, can“ refer ” to the competent court, which has been established in Iran and is in the process of dealing with the case.
The remarks come as the Canadian newspaper "National Post" reported on September 9 that the Canadian federal government had recently informed lawyers that it had submitted two mass legal cases to the Iranian Foreign Ministry.
According to the report, the lawsuit was filed in a Toronto court against the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Revolutionary Guards, the armed forces, Ali Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic, and other officials of the regime and the IRGC.
Flight 752 with Ukrainian aircraft on the morning of January 8 last year was shot down by the Revolutionary Guards ’ defense around Imam Khomeini airport and 176 passengers died.
The families described the downing of the plane as a "terrorist act" and copies of the petition were sent to Iranian embassies in Australia and the United Kingdom.
On the other hand, a spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry has announced the “judicial investigation ” of the case inside the country, while about eight months after the incident, no information has yet been released about the judicial investigation of the case in Iran.
In addition, some family members of the victims of the downing of the Ukrainian plane have already spoken of the hopelessness in dealing with the case and the negligence of the authorities in Iran.
In a report published on the Rokna website on May 2, Badii Ardestani, a 28-year-old woman who was killed in the downing of the plane, said: “We have no hope at all. ”
The brother of Mohammad Amin Biruti, a 29-year-old working in Canada who was killed in the downing of the plane, said the authorities "did not take any notice" and "there is no answer for us."
Families of the plane crash victims living outside Iran have formed a forum to appeal the case.
The association, known as the PS752 Family Association, has repeatedly criticized the lack of attention and inappropriate comments made by the Islamic Republic authorities.
Hamed Esmaeillion, a spokesman for the Family Association of Victims of Flight 752, on September 24, in an interview with Radio Farda, emphasized that some families of victims have faced harassment and disrespect from judicial authorities in their visits to the military court to pursue the case.
The families of the victims also went to the Ukrainian embassy in Tehran on September 24 and, in a meeting with Sergei Bordi Liak, the Ukrainian ambassador to Iran, expressed their concern about the process of the case.

title: UAE and Bahrain move ‘ peace ’ in exchange for ‘ support ’
text:

Erekat added that Jared Kushner, a regular adviser to the US president, is seeking to create an Arab-Israeli NATO in the region.

title: Opening of two neighborhood parks with an area of 9500 square meters in Tabriz
text:
According to the reporter of the Young Journalists Club of Tabriz, Davoud Talebnejad, the mayor of the 3rd district of Tabriz, announced the opening of two parks in the Shahid Tajlaei and Omid neighborhood with an area of 9,500 square meters in the Holy Defense week.
He said: The parks of Shahid Tajallaei neighborhood on the southeast side of Shahid Tajallaei Square and Omid neighborhood park on the north side of the defense boulevard between Taleghani Town and Fatemieh Square will be opened at the Holy Defense Week and will be exploited by the citizens.
He enumerated the purpose of constructing neighborhood parks of Shahid Tajlaei and Hope to meet the needs of the citizens of these neighborhoods with the smallest distance and the least time, adding: At the level of the district, by constructing neighborhood parks, we are trying to increase the access of citizens to green spaces and citizens do not have to travel more distance from their residential homes to use the parks.
The mayor of District 3 of Tabriz stated: The land use of these two parks was residential and the municipality could easily make these two pieces profitable by building them according to the use, but in order to provide the green space and meet the needs of the citizens of these two areas, the municipality has renounced its income and allocated these two points to the park to provide an opportunity for the spiritual and mental peace and comfort of the citizens.
Talebnejad announced the cost of property spent on these two neighborhood parks as 355 billion rials and said: 20 billion rials has been spent on their implementation.
He added: In these parks, 400 elm trees and 3,000 yucca and rose shrubs and a variety of 950 meters long barberry, shemshad and new leaves have been planted and 4,650 square meters of grass has been planted.
End of message.

title: What Happens in “Beauty ” Offices?
text:
A relatively old man and a young woman leave the operating room.
The man has had his eyelids drooped, he has had Botox and gel injections, and he tells of a satisfying operation for several men who are sitting in the waiting room to take their turn.
The office is busy.
There is a large waiting room, but almost all the seats are full.
Beauty applicants have tried to observe social distance but appear to have been unsuccessful.
All of them are waiting for their turn, but they are still waiting for their turn.
Two young secretaries are struggling; one is a doctor ’ s assistant in the operating room, and the other is sitting at the front door, filing patient records, paying visits, and giving masks and gloves to those who enter without complying with the hygiene protocol.
Sometimes he or she walks into the operating room to ask the doctor when the operation is over and to guide the next patient to the examination room in a few minutes.
After half an hour, a relatively old man and a young woman leave the operating room.
The doctor will give advice after the surgery.
A few men who are waiting for their turn start a conversation with someone who has just had an operation: Does it hurt?
I also want to blink my eyes.
- It doesn't hurt much.
I only had pain when he injected numbness behind my eyelids.
After the man and his young companion leave, a young girl and boy enter the office.
They put on masks, file cases, make their own, and sit on a couch.
The doctor ’ s office is large enough to be fitted with a special, stylish design.
In front of each room are signs: laser room, surgery room, examination room, hair transplant room.
In another part of the office, photos of the doctor and celebrities who are his clients are installed.
The next beauty applicant enters the surgery room.
The operation time is longer than before and the sound of waiting in the hall is heard.
The receptionist goes to the doctor with every protest to check when the operation is over.
After an hour, the doctor comes out of the operating room and enters the examination room.
The receptionist enters his room with an olive bowl behind him and after a few minutes guides the next beauty applicant.
The second secretary, the one who makes up the patient file, has been working for four months.
Insert patient information into an iPhone.
She ’ s 23 years old and doesn ’ t mind having her eyebrows “lifted, ” but her family is against any cosmetic procedure.
The stress of getting a coronavirus is also disturbing to the secretary, and she complains of men bending over the counter: “Some clients don ’ t really pay attention.
Even though I give them masks after they come in, they don ’ t mind.
The same man who came out of the operating room a few minutes ago and had an eyelid lift, kept coming back and laying himself on the table to ask a question.
In the end, I had to warn him.
Most patients can ’ t wait their turn.
Especially when the doctor is half an hour late, naturally everyone is delayed, but patients complain, complain, and want to leave early.
They don ’ t know that beauty is not a pill to take.
For that to happen, they need to practice their patience.
Most of our clients are women, and because the doctor is a skin specialist, many people come to laser for their body and skin.
Men also come for hair transplants and laser beards.
Thank God we never had a problem.
A few years ago, a woman was allergic to Botox and didn ’ t know it.
A few days later he came back and put it on his head.
In the end, we had to complain about it.
“It ’ s normal because you can ’ t really tell if someone is allergic to Botox. ”
We are not finished talking that the strength of one of the male clients is exhausted and without the permission of the secretary opens the door of the examination room and goes inside.
The clerk raises an eyebrow and says, "Here's the sample.
He doesn't care if there's another patient in the room.
In doing so, it destroys the right of the patient who is inside and the patient who is ahead of him. ”
I get a list of beautiful tariffs from the secretary to take a look at the prices.
He said: “We ’ ve had a price change.
Ask me about the new prices. ”
The new price of a package of Botox is one million tomans and 30 cc of it is 600 thousand tomans.
I ask about a sign in the corner of the office wall that says, “Zero percent price increase, ” and it says,“ Price change is normal. ”
Tariffs are written in four sheets of A4 and include various services, including the cost of gel discharge two million and 500 thousand tomans, eye lift (cat ’ s eye) two million and 500 thousand tomans, digging any 500 thousand tomans.
One of the beauty applicants who lives in Germany and has come to Iran to do beauty services sees the price tariffs on my hand and talks: “The tariff on beauty services in Iran is very cheap.
Do you know how much you have to pay for any of this in Germany?
These services do not include insurance and should be free of charge.
Germany has its own rules.
I went to a clinic in Germany for beauty services.
The doctor told me that injections of gel and Botox are for people over the age of 40, and because Botox paralyzes muscles, no more than three steps are allowed.
I come to Iran for this kind of work.
Last year I came to Iran and had a breast implant.
When I returned to Germany, I was infected.
I went to a hospital in Germany and they said you had to be hospitalized.
“I went to China, thank God, my problem was solved. ”
After four hours of waiting, it ’ s finally my turn.
I enter the examination room.
The doctor takes his tablet and enters my national code.
He checked my profile again.
He looks at my face and says, “You should have started injecting Botox earlier.
Now the chin is deeper and does not completely disappear even with the injection of gel. ”
He takes a picture of my face with his tablet.
I would also like to discuss with the doctor the beauty applicant who is sitting in the waiting room and coming from Germany, “Is there an age limit for this in Iran? ”
He replied, “We usually have applicants from 23 years of age and above, but we do not have a repeat injection limit.
It ’ s done all over the world. ”
After the examination, the doctor suggests injections, both Botox and gel, then directs me to the receptionist.
The clerk looks at his phone and calls me the doctor ’ s prescription.
He said: “The cost of botox and gel injections is about three million tomans for me.
I thanked him and left the office.
I try to contact one of the beauty doctors in Germany and ask about the rules of the procedure.
The head of the plastic surgery department of a hospital in Germany, which is called “Fakhr Arz ” in German, and happens to be an Iranian, says about the cosmetic procedures in the country ’ s hospitals:“ There are beauty applicants in every age category, but most applicants in the age range of 50 to 55 salons.
For example, there is a lot of liposuction in Germany.
Cost is free.
In other words, insurance does not cover these costs unless the operation is prescribed by a psychologist or psychiatrist.
For example, the operation of patients whose beauty is damaged by the complications of another disease, such as cancer, and who need cosmetic surgery, is done by the doctor ’ s order and with health insurance.
In general, the cost of cosmetic procedures in Germany is very expensive and applicants go to Prague in Czech Republic or Turkey, for example, because the costs are much lower there.
Even in some hospitals in Turkey, all the beauty services are packaged.
Most cosmetic procedures in Germany include facial fat injections and liposuction.
There's very little demand for a nose job.
Usually, gel injections and Botox are performed by doctors who work in clinics around the city.
This service is not provided in the hospital.
The cost of Botox injections in Germany starts at 300 euros, and the gel for the lips costs about 900 euros.
There is no age limit for injections.
This can be done for anyone who wants to apply, but usually young people in Germany do not want to do this.
The age of 18 is very limited and cannot be done.
Unless someone is seriously injured or burned.
For older people, not all procedures are performed because medical regulations have a high risk of surgery and may jeopardize the health of the individual. ”
End of message.

title: Protest against Arab-Israeli Relations: Palestinian Authority Resigns from Arab League Presidency
text:
On Tuesday, the Palestinian foreign minister condemned the establishment of relations between the Arab states and Israel as a “shameful ” move to step down from the chairmanship of the Arab League meetings.
For the Palestinians, the agreement signed last week between the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain and Israel was a betrayal of the Palestinian cause and a severe blow to their struggle for an independent Palestinian state in the occupied territories.
Two weeks ago, the Arab League rejected a request by the Palestinian Authority to condemn the agreements.
According to the Arab League ’ s timetable, the meetings of foreign ministers were to be chaired by the Palestinian delegation over the next six months.
But Riyad al-Maliki, the Palestinian foreign minister, resigned from the position at a news conference in Ramallah on Tuesday.
"Palestine has decided to relinquish its right to chair the Arab League's foreign ministry council at the current summit.
"To preside over a council that witnesses the Arab rush to normalize relations with Israel has no honor or respect."
Maliki then read a part of his letter to Arab League Secretary General Ahmed Aboulgheit, which sharply criticized the UAE and Bahrain ’ s decision to normalize relations with Israel.
The letter said: “The UAE deal with Israel has created a deep crisis in the Arab League and the Kingdom of Bahrain is following the same path of collapse. ”
At the same time, following steps aimed at reducing friction between Palestinian factions, representatives of Fatah, led by Mahmoud Abbas, are scheduled to meet with the delegation of Hamas in Turkey on Tuesday.
Hamas took control of the Gaza Strip in 2007 in a brief armed conflict with Fatah.
Disputes over power sharing in the Felsini region have delayed the implementation of agreements on cooperation and unity between the two factions.

title: How do cities threaten the value of the environment?
text:
ISNA / Gilan, a researcher, considered the result of the imbalance and incompatibility between humans and nature to disrupt the ecosystem relations, adding: With the expansion of cities, the manifestations and values of the natural environment are subject to further destruction and erosion and urbanites are deprived of natural attractions.
Rapid urban development in the contemporary decades of various social, economic, cultural, political and...
