The environmental structures of the city require a planning approach at all levels of the city in order to achieve sustainable development.
The emergence of sustainable development as the main slogan of the third millennium is also due to the effects of cities on the biosphere and various dimensions of human life.
The characteristics of today ’ s urban communities have caused instability of humans and the environment of the urban area and the natural environment and the built environment.
The problem facing urban planners today is how to apply sustainable urban policies and plans and map the effects of this sustainability in cities; therefore, achieving such conditions requires direction to the goals and executive plans and reform the status of structures and related management in the administration of cities.
Emad Mottaki, PhD student in Geography and Urban Planning, in an interview with ISNA, considered environmental problems as one of the most fundamental issues of today ’ s cities and their conflict with the natural environment and said: Urban development inevitably comes with the dominance of buildings, industries, transportation and economic activities on natural spaces, and this dominance over time has changed as the city ’ s dominance over nature and causes widespread urban pollution.
He considered the result of the imbalance and incompatibility between humans and nature to disrupt the relations of the ecosystem and added: With the expansion of cities, the manifestations and values of the natural environment are subject to further destruction and erosion, and urbanites are deprived of natural attractions and psychological and social problems are presented.
Stating that the concentration of population in cities and marginal areas of the city and the disparity between the growth of services and urban infrastructure, especially in developing countries, has turned urban areas into unsanitary and polluted places, the city today is faced with problems of sewage disposal and waste and water supply, air pollution, noise pollution, traffic and so on.
They are on the front.
This PhD student in Geography and Urban Planning considered the origin of urban irregularities, destruction and pollution in adopting incorrect policies, adopting poor plans and implementing wrong urban projects and activities, and said: Urban development activities and growth need a proper strategy and in line with environmental conditions.
Considering that the city of Rasht has a good potential in terms of urban environmental structures and has desirable natural space, he emphasized: Unfortunately, in recent years, due to the increasing acceleration of urban development and the increase in population, urban development projects are being implemented at a rapid pace and lack of proper planning in this area and lack of attention to urban environmental mechanisms has caused irreparable damage to the city body.
He continued: In fact, what causes urban environmental imbalance in the city of Rasht provides or threatens it; in general, it is in the form of environmental turbulence, destruction and environmental pollution that today is considered as environmental problems. Therefore, due to the importance of the environment in urban development, its consequences in the sustainable structure of the city have been widely considered by urban planners.
The top researcher said that the use of the urban complex model and the compact city can be effective in restoring the environmental structure and emphasizing on the urban environment with a sustainable development approach, said: Environmental emphasis and attention to natural potentials such as existing natural green spaces by implementing appropriate spatial policies such as environmental design create diverse and multi-functional spaces that are effective in expanding public and public spaces and respond to the needs of citizens. It brings security and comfort to the residents.
He described sustainable development as one of the most important and common discussions at the international level, adding that sustainable development meets the needs of the current generation without compromising the ability of the next generation to meet their needs.
In Iran, as in other countries of the world, sustainable development with an emphasis on environmental protection has been taken into consideration and gradually in the field of policy making, planning and implementation of various activities and other components of sustainable development has been considered as a comprehensive and multidimensional concept.
Stating that sustainable development requires an environmental planning approach, he noted that sustainable urban development is a dynamic and uninterrupted process in response to changing economic, environmental and social pressures.
This PhD student in Geography and Urban Planning considered the urban environmental structure in fact the manifestation of the urban environment and said: Comprehensive attention to the urban environment can be effective in better living and creating sustainability.
Bio-urban structures can be river, natural and artificial green space, animal and plant cover of urban area and...
He pointed out.
In fact, vegetation consists of growing and changing elements, and therefore, at different times, they have a variety of effects on the space and enrich the space, and animal cover actually creates a meaningful coexistence in the urban space.
Sustainable urban development with a focus on changing the density and use of urban land, including meeting the basic needs of people in the field of housing, transportation, leisure and...
He said that the city should be livable and economically viable and socially equal.
The environmental expert, stating that the development of urban guardrails from the perspective of transportation requires the establishment of smart urban development principles, noted: Sustainable transportation is to put the urban body in proportion to walking, cycling and public transportation, and the quality of transportation services to the extent that it encourages social interactions and welcomes public transportation.
The most important features of transportation in a sustainable city include the emphasis on walking and cycling, the combination and mixing of uses, and the emphasis on social functions as a unifying factor for buildings and public spaces.
He said physical development and excessive destruction of agricultural lands and gardens, increase of environmental waste, lack of neighborhood councils and lack of sustainable participation of citizens in decisions related to development, horizontal expansion of the city and social anomalies, negative impact on public health due to high dependence on cars in urban travel, lack of a comprehensive urban furniture plan, excessive development of workshop industries and damage to the environmental structure are among the threats of urban environment without environmental approach....
Content also emphasized on the implementation of space policies and urban planning, stating: the existence of regulations for control and planning of land use and thinking of environmental protection, the existence of suitable platforms for electronic activities, the existence of potential and natural beauties such as vegetation, the implementation of plans and programs to improve the status of the access network and the existence of appropriate scientific knowledge to enhance the safety, attractiveness and comfort of citizens are necessary for sustainable urban development.
This top researcher, creating attractive and refreshing ecotourism and recreational spaces, expansion of public transport, especially the development and promotion of technology and equipment for urban services with minimum emissions, providing sustainable urban development model with an environmental approach and with strategic participation of urban management, promoting the quality of the urban environment through organizing and development of green spaces and parks, reducing dependence on private vehicles by replacing public transport, especially gas buses, developing the necessary policies for public participation. As the main factor in preserving the urban environment, paying attention to the development, implementation and completion of wastewater treatment and surface water collection facilities, preventing the physical growth of the city and organizing the construction and providing a program of urban furniture in order to pay attention to environmental issues are other urban environmental patterns based on environmental sustainability.
End of message.

During this two-day visit, he will meet and consult with a number of high-ranking Iranian officials, including his Iranian counterpart, and exploring ways to expand relations between the two countries, pursuing the implementation of previous agreements, and reviewing regional and international developments are among the main topics of this high-ranking Iraqi Foreign Ministry official ’ s consultations on a trip to Iran.
This was also the focus of ISNA ’ s political correspondent.
We continue to cooperate with Iran in the field of weapons, the Venezuelan president ’ s emphasis on continuing to cooperate with Iran in the field of weapons was also among the most popular today.
President Nicolas Maduro, noting that Venezuela plans to produce indigenous weapons, said that a special military and scientific council for this purpose would be formed in Venezuela and that cooperation with countries, including Iran, would continue in the military field.
End of message.

title: Crew Dragon ’ s first operational flight will take place next month
text:
NASA has scheduled the first manned operational flight of the Crew Dragon capsule, SpaceX Crew-1, which will take four astronauts to the International Space Station for the first time on October 31.
NASA and SpaceX have set a new launch date for the Crew Dragon capsule for its first manned operational flight, October 31, on Halloween night.
The mission, dubbed SpaceX Crew-1, will follow the successful test flight of Demo-2, which took astronauts Bob Binkon and Doug Harley to the International Space Station (ISS).
Bechenken and Harley returned to Earth in August 2020 after two months on the International Space Station.
The flight was the first crewed Crew Dragon flight to take an astronaut from the United States to the International Space Station after July 8, 2011.
SpaceX and NASA had originally planned to launch on Oct. 23, but decided to postpone it for a few days to give Earth and space station teams more time to prepare for the launch of the Soyuz capsule on Oct. 14 and its departure from the space station on Oct. 21.
NASA said in a statement that the new launch date will reduce the potential risks of launching and connecting the Dragon capsule after the launch and Soyuz connection.
This extra time is needed to ensure that all open work, whether on Earth or inside the space station, is closed before Dragon arrives.
This increased distance also provides a good opportunity to conduct additional tests to isolate the space station ’ s air leaks if necessary.
SpaceX continues to advance preparations for the Crew Dragon spacecraft and the Falcon 9 rocket, giving teams more time to do pre-launch work.
The mission will take three NASA astronauts, Michael Hopkins, Victor Glover, and Shannon Walker, as well as JAXA astronaut Soichi Noguchi, to the International Space Station, where they will stay for six months.
SpaceX delivered the Crew Dragon spacecraft, which will be used for the flight, to Cape Canaveral, Florida, in August.
The capsule will be launched on Halloween night around 2: 40 a.m. Eastern Time Zone time aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
End of message.

title: Japanese and American astronauts ready to fly SpaceX spacecraft
text:
Japanese astronaut Sochi Noguchi, along with her American astronaut colleagues, said at the press conference that she was ready for the flight, SpaceX's second manned mission.
The mission will be the first of a series of regular and rotating flights to the International Space Station system, which will be operated by SpaceX's new crewed transport system following approval by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
With its first successful astronaut mission in May, SpaceX became the first private company to successfully transport astronauts into orbit from the United States since the retirement of NASA's Space Shuttle fleet in 2011.
Two astronauts were sent to the International Space Station, where they returned safely to Earth in August.
NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine announced that SpaceX ’ s next mission, called Crew-1, would be another “significant milestone ” in the development of the ability of the United States to send astronauts into space by American rockets from its soil.
He also stressed the importance of having an international crew, for example Noguchi, the importance of sending more astronauts to the International Space Station and increasing the capacity to conduct scientific research at the orbiting laboratory.
Crew-1 astronauts are scheduled to travel to the International Space Station on Oct. 31 at 2: 40 a.m. local time aboard the Crew-Dragon capsule aboard SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The astronauts will remain in the orbiting lab for about six months.

title: Britain at a crossroads: exploring the possibility of sending refugees to two remote islands in the Atlantic Ocean
text:
Home Secretary Priti Patel has reportedly considered a proposal to send asylum seekers to two remote islands in the Atlantic Ocean, some 6,500 kilometres away.
CNN reported on Saturday that Ms Patel ’ s advisers had recently presented a plan to transport refugees to two remote areas off the coast of Africa, including Ascension, a British overseas island.
The island is located in the South Atlantic Ocean and is about 8,000 km away from the UK.
It was said earlier that Ms Patel had ruled out the plan as impossible.
However, the British newspaper The Times reported on Thursday that British authorities were investigating whether it would be possible to transport refugees by boat to areas off the coast of the country.
This summer, Britain ’ s immigration minister said the government was working faster with France to toughen immigration measures to stop migrants crossing the Channel illegally.
In recent months, a group of hard-line critics have accused the UK government of taking an increasingly “chaotic ” approach to illegal immigrants entering the country.
Whether Ms Patel approves the bill or not, it alone reflects the hardening of hard-line positions and the intensification of immigration restrictions under Ms Patel ’ s administration.
In August, he tweeted that the number of small boats carrying irregular migrants crossing the Channel was “appalling ” and“ unacceptably high. ”
On Thursday alone, 235 irregular migrants in 17 small boats entered British waters.

title: Home show, competitor or second branch of Turkish networks?
text:

The increase in the activity of satellite networks and the distribution of Turkish works in Iranian satellite networks coincided with the increase of activities in Iran ’ s home theater network; at that time, some cultural analysts considered the home theater network as a reasonable response to satellite networks and an opportunity to overcome their works, a network that had less audits on its works and could attract the audience of Turkish TV series.
But that ’ s where the mistake started.
Many of the programmers and artists who were born and raised by the IRIB moved from television to the home theater network in order to gain more profit and freedom.

On the other hand, less monitoring of the home screen network caused the creators active in this network, instead of presenting a new form and production of a cultural product, to resort to repetitive and sexual formulas of Turkish series and, with a glance from the rival, produced works that even in some cases, had lower quality and content than their Turkish rivals, and even caused some Iranian families to protest against some of these works.
Works that were only economical and did not spare any effort to sell more, from unnecessarily stretching the story, music-based video clips and creating triangular and square love nodes to the inclusion of erotic sequences.
Content works that, as a cultural commodity, had a countercultural function and only filled the pockets of its creators.
This is something that even the creators of these works are aware of.
From Manouchehr Hadi, the director of the love and romance series, who himself has confessed to modeling the Turkish series, to the writer of the series Dell, who says that the reason for the increase in the series' episodes is more money.
Now, some time after increasing the activity of VOD and attracting the audience through free subscription services and attractive plans to sell the works of the home theater network at a lower price than physical broadcasters and strengthening their position among the families as a multimedia and video broadcaster, in their latest action, they have dubbed and broadcast exclusive Turkish series.
The home theater network and VOD, which were supposed to rival Turkish satellite and TV channels, have now become their second branch.
Their cultural and content performance shows that the lack of proper supervision of the production of cultural works and the transfer of the field to individuals who are concerned only with financial interests, not cultural ones, provides the way for cultural influence and the destruction of the cultural foundations of the country and Iranian families.
Now that we are living in the era of the soft cultural war, the abandonment and lack of supervision in the field of cultural production can cause irreparable damage to our country; therefore, it is recommended that we not leave the field of culture to the enemy, by increasing the controls on the production of cultural works in the home theater network, and by producing great cultural works, such as Mokhtarnameh, the lost innocence, Hazrat Yusuf, English Kiev, Imam Ali, zero degree Hats off and...

title: Former Saudi intelligence chief calls Palestinian leaders defeated
text:
The former head of the Saudi spy services, Bandar bin Sultan, in an interview with the Saudi TV channel Al-Arabiya, described “failure ” as the most appropriate word to describe the seventy years of behavior of the Palestinian leaders, during which Palestinian leaders, despite the financial and political support of Saudi Arabia and other Arab countries in the region, burned all peace opportunities with Israel one after the other, and even in recent years with enemies. Saudi Arabia, the governments of Iran and Turkey, colluded.
Commercial propaganda in Bandar bin Sultan ’ s sequel has called the Palestinian cause a just cause that has failed because of the incompetence of its leaders, while Israel ’ s unjust goals have succeeded because of the use of competent leaders.
Bandar bin Sultan has been the Saudi ambassador to the United States for 30 years, and after returning to Riyadh, he has been leading Saudi intelligence services and the head of the National Security Council for many years.
In the first part of a lengthy conversation with the Al-Arabiya television network, he has strongly blamed Palestinian leaders for their 70-year actions for repeatedly burning opportunities for peace with Israel and ignoring Riyadh ’ s recommendations.
Bandar bin Sultan has said that Saudi Arabia has always proved its goodwill and readiness to help the Palestinians.
"Every time the Palestinian leaders asked for our advice and assistance, we gave them both without the slightest expectation.
But they always accepted our help, and ignored our advice, and each time they turned to us again and again, and we did not hesitate to help them, regardless of their faults. ”
Bandar bin Sultan later said that in aiding the Palestinian leaders, Saudi Arabia went further and supported their unjustified actions because it did not want to take a position against the Palestinians under any circumstances.
The statements of the former head of Saudi intelligence services reflect the public mood in Saudi Arabia and other Gulf Arab states toward Palestinian leaders.
In 2017, the crown prince defended the right of Israelis and Palestinians to form their own governments.
Bandar bin Sultan went on to say that the 1948 UN plan for the creation of two independent Israeli and Palestinian states and then the Camp David peace plan in 1979 could each lead to the creation of a Palestinian state, but Palestinian leaders continued to oppose and divide the Arab world, while at the same time Israel expanded its influence.
Yasser Arafat lacked political courage and therefore refused to accept the Camp David agreement, although he later admitted that the Camp David agreement was far better than the Oslo agreement he signed with Israel in 1995.
The former head of the Saudi intelligence services then pointed to the internal conflicts of Palestinian groups, including the conflict between Hamas and the Fatah organization led by Mahmoud Abbas since 2007, saying that relations between Palestinian leaders and the Arab states of the Persian Gulf have been cooling for years.
The United Arab Emirates has been cutting off aid to the Palestinian Authority since 2014, while the Riyadh government has been cracking down on Hamas members on Saudi soil.
Mahmoud Abbas himself accused the UAE of treason after signing a peace deal with Israel, saying it had "stabbed the Palestinians in the back".
Bandar bin Sultan called the use of such language unacceptable by the Palestinians towards the pro-Palestinian Arab states and said: “I think our support has created a sense of indifference among the Palestinian leaders and has led them to conclude that they are not paying any price for their mistakes towards Saudi Arabia and other Arab states in the Persian Gulf. ”
Ben-Sultan also accused Palestinian leaders of aligning with the Turkish and Iranian governments against Arab states in the region.

title: Britain has completed its nuclear fusion research facility.
text:
Britain has announced the completion of a fusion technology research facility under the Atomic Energy Agency.
Harworth Group has announced that the UK Atomic Energy Agency ’ s new nuclear fusion technology research facility in the city of Ratterham has been completed.
The 2,500 square meter facility will develop and test technologies for fusion of materials and elements when it opens this year.
The UK Atomic Energy Agency has said the $28 million facility will help UK companies win contracts under the International Experimental Thermonuclear Reactor Project, an international nuclear project under construction in southern France.
The International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor, known as the ITER, is the largest design of a nuclear fusion reactor ever designed and based on magnetic confinement.
To start the fusion process, it is necessary to raise the fusion fuel, which is composed of deuterium and tritium, to a high temperature.
It's close to 100 million degrees Celsius.
One of the proposed methods is to enclose the plasma with the application of magnetic field.
The ITER Plan was first proposed in 1985 in talks between the Soviet Union and the United States.
Over the following years, a number of other countries joined the project, and today seven members – China, the European Union, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia and the United States – are involved in the project.
The main installation of the project is also located in France.
End of message.

title: Inactivity of officials and the migration of health tourists to Turkey and the UAE / Acceptance of medical tourism during the Corona era is possible?
text:
According to the reporter of the field of health and treatment, the medical science group of the Young Journalists Club, in all over the world, tourism has a good benefit for countries and causes a lot of value, which in this regard, health tourism is of particular importance.
Currently, Iran is one of the leading countries in the field of medicine, and foreign patients from different countries, especially the Persian Gulf and neighboring countries, come to Iran for treatment, which makes a significant currency for the treatment process to enter the country.
Reza Jamili, a health tourism expert, said in an interview with the reporter of the Young Journalists Club: "It is possible to advance a part of the economy with the capacities of this industry; an industry that is one of the few sectors of the economy that contributes to a fair distribution of wealth and the possibility of creating employment, including for special and marginal groups, is unlimited, and many young people and families were hoping to get rid of the oil economy. Do not give and take.
The health tourism expert continued: But the set of conditions that occurred in the past 8 months following the coronavirus epidemic in the country has crippled the tourism sector in a special way.
In the meantime, medical tourism has been one of the well-known and efficient brands of the country ’ s economy in the past few years, which has suffered more than any other area of the industry.
He added that Iran ’ s medical tourism, based on the rich history and history of Iranian medicine and diverse medical infrastructure and, most importantly, competitive prices of various treatments, had been able to become one of the first choices for medical travel in the Middle East and even Europe and among the Shiite population of the region.
The formation of more than 300 active health tourism companies in recent years, most of which were launched with the efforts of startup youth familiar with new business methods and digital marketing, promises to flourish a part of the country ’ s healthcare industry, which, while providing value and employment, contributes to brand development and cultural-human diplomacy of the country in the Middle East region.
He added: “Corona has been crushing health tourism in Iran for more than 8 months, and most of the companies in the industry, including health startups formed in this market, are collapsing, but the remarkable point is that despite the efforts of 24 hours in the past two months by activists in this field, some negative advertising against our country in foreign media and biased highlighting the statistics of Corona in Iran, many requests for medical travel. ” Iran has been given requests, which are often for the use of health services that not only does not occupy the capacity of the country ’ s medical centers to provide services to domestic patients, but also activates unused capacities on the ground, and providing services to these health tourists can revive the damaged economy of medical centers and the business of tourism companies.
He said: Currently, centers such as private hospitals and limited surgical centers offer optional and low-risk treatments to foreign patients, and by attracting tourists, a significant amount of the lost income of medical staff and health investors will be compensated due to corona conditions and less economic power.
He said that at present, the lack of attention of the Foreign Ministry to the requests of health tourism companies on the one hand and the inaction of policy makers on the other hand has led to confusion of health tourism activists and loss of foreign exchange earnings over the past two or three months; revenues that the Iranian authorities have been diverted into the pockets of Turkish and Emirati medical centers and companies.
Activists in this field believe that, as Iran ’ s rival countries in the region, including Turkey, with more than 320,000 patients with coronavirus, have been able to have principled propaganda and revive part of their health economy by attracting foreign patients for treatments such as beauty, general surgeries, ophthalmology, orthopedics.
Jamili said it is necessary for government officials, including the Foreign Ministry, to allow medical travelers to travel to the country as soon as possible by leaving the current uncertainty.
It should be warned that procrastination in this regard will only lead to the loss and death of the good name of the country ’ s medical tourism, and the efforts that have been made in the past few years and with the efforts of the sympathetic youth of the industry, will be eliminated.
More at the end of the message.

title: Is it time for the Arab League to die?
text:
The Arab League, which was formed in 1945 with six founding members of Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan, and whose main purpose was to unite Arab countries, is now in an identity crisis more than ever and its prospects are not clear.
In today ’ s world, regionalism and regional cooperation are on the agenda of many governments, especially developing countries, especially because regionalism and the formation of regional blocs can be an effective way to gradually open up the national economies of these countries and integrate them into the global economy and trade.
Regional organizations with the participation of countries present in a region and with various goals such as scientific, political, military, economic and...
To promote the situation in each of these areas, and in some cases, such as the European Union and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
(b) Significant improvements have been made (1).
The Arab League is a regional organization whose member states share linguistic, religious and geographical commonalities, an organization whose founders hoped to achieve the necessary cohesion in the difficult circumstances of the time and in the future.
At the beginning of the statute of the Arab League, it is stated that the Arab League was formed to stabilize the intertwined relations between Arab countries, based on respect for the independence and sovereignty of states, and works in the public interest of Arab countries, improving their status, and securing their future, aspirations and aspirations.
The Arab countries emphasized on the first page of the statute that one of the main goals of the League is to act on the public opinion of the Arab people in all countries and promised never to take action that would lead to change of governments (2).
After 75 years of the establishment of this regional organization, it can be said that not only its goals have not been achieved, but in some cases, it has been a factor in getting away from it.
The issue of Palestine, the Syrian crisis, the Yemeni war and the civil war in Libya and the Arab revolutions have clearly shown the weakness of the Arab League in theoretical and practical terms.
On Tuesday, the Libyan National Accord government said it would not take the presidency of the Arab League Council.
Tripoli ’ s representative to the union told the secretariat he would prefer to head the council under better conditions.
The Presidency is transferred alphabetically every year, and if a country refuses to accept it, the next country can become a candidate.
The stamp of the Kingdom of Egypt coincided with the establishment of the Arab League in 1945, Libya became the sixth country to refuse to accept the presidency of the Council of the Arab League in the past two weeks.
It was the first time that the Palestinian government refused to accept the presidency of the Arab League ’ s council in protest of the behavior of the Arab League secretariat in exchange for the compromise of the UAE and Bahrain with the Israeli regime.
After Palestine, Qatar refused to accept the post.
Then came the Comer Islands, which also withdrew from the country.
Later, Kuwait and Lebanon said they would prefer to take the presidency of the Arab League council in a better position.
The PA has never been as angry at the actions and behavior of the Arab League as it is today, and the relationship between the two sides has never been so tense.
Ramallah feels that the union has clearly sacrificed the Palestinian issue to the interests and influence of the UAE.
Ramallah also witnessed that Saudi Arabia, which considers itself the great Arab states, did not take any action in response to the UAE / Bahrain compromise and in support of Palestine.
After the announcement of a compromise agreement between Abu Dhabi and Tel Aviv, Ramallah requested an extraordinary meeting of the Arab League secretariat, but Ahmad Aboul-Gheit said there was no need for an extraordinary meeting and a regular meeting would be enough to discuss the issue.
After holding a periodic meeting, the Arab League also refused to condemn the UAE ’ s move to compromise with the Palestinian occupiers.
Arab League officials told the Palestinians that they did not want the Palestinian issue to be a factor in the duplicity and division among Arab states, even though it had actually happened.
The Palestinian anger at the Arab League was doubled a while ago when Ahmad Abou al-Gheit praised the compromise agreement, claiming that it prevented the occupation of the West Bank, and Saeb Erekat, the secretary-general of the Palestine Liberation Organization ’ s executive committee, said he should resign and does not have the authority to do so.
Palestinians pray over the symbolic coffin of the Arab League, the six countries ’ withdrawal from accepting the rotating presidency of the Arab League Council has also been met with reactions and ridicule from Arab cyberspace users.
Users have written that the Arab League is no longer effective and should be buried.
The famous Egyptian presenter Maatz Matar wrote that the Arab League is dead and should be buried quickly, or that Arab countries should put Israel at its head.
The Twitter account of "Al-Rada al-Arabi", also alluding to the loyalty of the Arab League's secretary-general to the UAE, wrote: "This is the end of an organization that has led itself to a post where a person, such as Ahmad Abolghit, with Abu Dhabi nationality, has reached its general secretary."
Another Arab said, “May Allah forgive the Arab League. ”
“For years, the dead and the dead body that remains will not move except at the behest of the Western countries and Israel whenever their interests demand it. ”
Last month, a campaign was launched on social media that called for the conversion of the Arab League building into a wedding hall.
The type of relationship between the Arab League and the Arab people from the perspective of the users of cyberspace, with the behavior of the Arab League in exchange for the compromise of the UAE and Bahrain with the Zionist regime, the issue of Palestine as one of the identifier factors to this union, which has been emphasized in all meetings over the past 75 years, has now become the source of difference.
The Arab League has never been able to resolve the differences between Arab countries.
On the contrary, crises have been drawn into the union itself and have led to dualism.
In the Syrian issue, there is this dichotomy, with some countries including Jordan, Egypt, Tunisia, Algeria and Iraq talking about the need for the Syrian government to return to the Arab League.
But this crisis is a matter of prestige for countries such as Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
Even the UAE and Bahrain have reopened their embassies in Damascus, but the Arab League is too independent to raise the issue of Syria ’ s return at one of its meetings.
The Syrian government, which is one of the founders of the Arab League, has repeatedly said that it sees no need to return to the Arab League and that the League is dead.
The Yemeni war and the apparent aggression of the Saudi government against the Arab country are also issues that the Arab League is unable to solve.
Because he doesn ’ t really have permission to get into this.
In the past five years, the United States has not seen a position or initiative from the Houthis except for the condemnation of the Yemeni Ansarullah.
The Libyan war and the recruitment of Arab countries in the meantime also exposed the inefficiency of the Arab League more than before.
If the Arab League had a role in supporting the position of Egypt, the United Arab Emirates and the Saudi government, and although the Libyan National Accord government is still the seat of the union, the weight of the Caliph Jaftar is heavier, thanks to the aforementioned countries.
But the crisis that may be said to have dealt the main blow to the Arab League was the crisis of the blockade of Qatar and the tension between the Saudi, Egyptian, Emirati and Bahraini governments and Doha in 2017.
This crisis has clearly shown its impact on the frontiers of the Arab world.
From Tunisia and Libya to Syria and the Persian Gulf, we see the rivalry between these two currents.
The Arab League is also under the influence of the Saudi movement and will never be able to act as a mediator.
The position of the Arab League and the Arab states on this crisis has been very precarious and has not even reached a semipartite unity.
Meanwhile, some countries, including Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, have shown a neutral stance with a desire for Qatar.
Iraq and Jordan have more explicit positions.
Iraq has repeatedly said it opposes the blockade of Qatar, and Jordan has been angered by the Saudi and Emirati governments over its drive to Qatar.
The visit of the Emir of Qatar to Jordan in March last year and the meeting with Abdullah II was very important in this regard.
Other countries have also tried to maintain their neutrality and invite the parties to the crisis to talk.
All of this has made the Arab League an institution that, after 75 years, Arab users say, should be buried and relegated to history.
Rather than being an influential factor in the Arab world, it is itself affected by the crises between Arab countries.
The oblivion of the mission on the question of Palestine on the neck of this union was the final blow inflicted on the half-dead body of the Arab League.
Source: The End of the Message

title: Crew Dragon's first operational flight has been delayed.
text:
The crewed Cro-1 mission, which was scheduled to launch on SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket late this month, has been postponed until November.
The Cro-1 mission, which will send four astronauts to the International Space Station, was supposed to take place at the end of October, as if the mission had been postponed.
According to NASA officials, the launch will not take place sooner than early to mid-November.
NASA has scheduled the first manned operational flight of the Crew Dragon capsule, SpaceX Crew-1, which will take four astronauts to the International Space Station for the first time on October 31.
NASA and SpaceX have set a new launch date for the Crew Dragon capsule for its first manned operational flight, October 31, on Halloween night.
The mission will follow the successful test flight of Demo-2, which took two astronauts, Bob Behnken and Doug Harley, to the International Space Station (ISS).
Bechenken and Harley returned to Earth in August 2020 after two months on the International Space Station.
The flight was the first crewed Crew Dragon flight to take an astronaut from the United States to the International Space Station after July 8, 2011.
SpaceX and NASA had originally planned to launch on Oct. 23, but decided to postpone it for a few days to give Earth and space station teams more time to prepare for the launch of the Soyuz capsule on Oct. 14 and its departure from the space station on Oct. 21.
As of now, October 31 is not a launch date and we will have to wait until November to see the manned launch.
NASA officials said the delay was due to the completion of hardware tests and data analysis by SpaceX.
NASA astronauts Michael Hopkins, Victor Glover, Shannon Walker, and Japanese astronaut Soichi Noguchi will be sent to the International Space Station for a six-month stay.
The planned launch of the Cro-1 has been postponed several times.
The first test launch date was August 30, then late September, then October 23, then October 31, and now early or mid-November.
End of message.

title: Suicide rates rise among Japanese women and students during Coronavirus era
text:
Studies show that suicide rates among women and school-age children in Japan rose during August, giving a glimpse of the impact of the coronavirus crisis on people ’ s mental health.
According to ISNA, this data from Japan points to the psychological damage caused by the coronavirus epidemic around the world.
The latest government figures show that the total number of suicides in Japan in August of this year was 1,854, up 15.4 percent from the same period last year.
Female suicides increased by 40% in August.
Although this figure is about half the rate of male suicides, the increase in female suicides is far greater than the 6% increase in male suicides.
According to Bloomberg, the number of school-age suicides has more than doubled over the same period of their lives.
Sociologists have repeatedly warned against the impact of the epidemic on mental health, as restrictions on social interaction have isolated people, and the global economic crisis has led to the loss of thousands of jobs and further consequences.
A global study by Kerr International found that 27 percent of women reported an increase in mental health problems, compared with just 10 percent of men.
In Japan, women are burdened by the economic crisis as their main fields of employment, including travel and retail jobs, have been hit hard during the quarantine period.
Data from Japan ’ s Ministry of Internal Affairs shows that the percentage of employed women has fallen twice as much as men.
At the end of July 26.
Nine million people are working in Japan, down 3.2 percent from a year ago, and a decline of more than two-thirds of women is reported in the fall.
Employment is not the only cause of harm to women ’ s mental and emotional health.
For example, domestic violence hotlines encountered more calls as family members were forced to stay together in quarantine.
South Korea, which has the highest suicide rate in the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), also saw a similar increase in female suicide rates during the first months of the epidemic.
The epidemic has brought about many changes in children ’ s social development and, at the same time, has been responsible for hidden parental stress, which doctors say may lead to parental neglect.
Mayumi Hangai, a physician at the National Center for Child Health and Development who studies children ’ s stress during an epidemic, told Bloomberg that parents who are stressed may not see the signs of their children ’ s stress and may not have enough empathy and compassion for their problems.
When schools reopened in June, children faced increased pressure to make up for lost jobs.
Japan is one of the few countries to provide timely information on suicide as it is a major social issue in the island nation, and many other countries, such as the UK, China or the US, do not report official suicide figures until years later.
The UK, for example, published its 2019 suicide statistics last month.
End of message.

title: The Zionist regime ’ s parliament has approved a compromise agreement with the emirates
text:
The Israeli parliament on Thursday in a special session approved a compromise agreement between Tel Aviv and Abu Dhabi.
According to the Al-Mayadeen Network website, after the Zionist regime and the UAE signed a normalization agreement at the White House on the 15th of last month, and after the approval of the agreement by the cabinet of the regime, it was time to stamp the Knesset ’ s approval of the agreement.

The Arab Joint List, which includes four Arab parties, said earlier that it supports a comprehensive peace and an end to the occupation and votes against the agreement signed between Israel and the UAE.
Our political stance is contrary to the centuries-old deal proposed by the US government.

title: Downing of Ukrainian Plane; Complaint of Khamenei and IRGC
text:
A Washington-based legal office said in a statement that it had filed a complaint on behalf of a number of relatives of the victims of Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752 who were American citizens against the Islamic Republic government led by Ali Khamenei and the Revolutionary Guards under the command of Hossein Salami.
According to the statement issued on Friday, October 16, survivors ’ complaints have been filed in the federal court in Washington, D.C., and the plaintiffs hope that “this case will be an effective step toward litigation and accountability for the perpetrators and perpetrators of this crime. ”
The Ukrainian passenger plane was shot down on the morning of January 8, 2019, shortly after takeoff from Tehran airport, due to two IRGC air defense missiles, and all 176 people on board died.
Airplanes as a defensive shield?
The downing of the Ukrainian plane came hours after IRGC forces fired a number of missiles at two bases of U.S. forces and allies in Iraq in retaliation for the killing of Qasem Soleimani, the then commander of the Quds Force, in a drone strike by U.S. forces.
Amir Ali Hajizadeh, commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force, claimed responsibility for the catastrophic error by a three-day delay in a television interview, saying that the IRGC air defense officer had “mistakenly identified a cruise missile ” and fired at the Ukrainian passenger plane.
One of the most significant charges leveled against Iran is allowing passenger planes to fly, despite warnings of retaliation from the United States.
The Islamic Republic is accused of using passenger planes as human shields to prevent a possible U.S. attack.
In a statement, Harrischi ’ s Washington law office said relatives of a number of victims had complained of “failing to protect the safety of passengers in combat conditions, as well as hiding key evidence, destroying debris at the site of the accident, and illuminating the hidden aspects of the incident. ”
A fragment of a Ukrainian passenger plane shot down by two IRGC missiles said in the statement: “Unfortunately, the families of the victims not only do not have the slightest confidence in the proper investigation of the incident by the perpetrators, but they also have no confidence in the Iranian judiciary to bring justice. ”
The complaint is one of the international efforts of the victims of the downing of the Ukrainian plane, which has been pursued by the judiciary of foreign countries.
A $1.1 billion lawsuit was filed in a Canadian court in February last year, just one month after the incident, a legal team in Canada filed a lawsuit on behalf of survivors of the victims, demanding $1.5 billion ($1.1 billion) in compensation.
The team is headed by renowned Canadian lawyer Mark Arnold, who has previously been able to obtain a court order to convict the Islamic Republic and seize two of its buildings in another case.
The Canadian government formally informed Iranian officials last month that two collective complaints have already been filed in the country ’ s courts over the downing of the Ukrainian plane.
The Civil Aviation Organization ’ s Accident and Accident Investigation Office said in a report published on February 30 that 146 of the passengers on the Ukrainian plane had Iranian passports and five had Canadian passports, and most of the other victims were Ukrainian citizens.
Meanwhile, the 52 passengers on the plane were dual Iranian-Canadian citizens, some of them of Iranian descent, and citizens of countries such as Britain and Sweden.
Iran ’ s focus on negotiating with Ukraine appears to be the Islamic Republic, which does not recognize dual citizenship, trying to push for reparations talks by focusing on talks with Ukrainian officials.
ISNA news agency reported on Saturday that the first round of talks between the Iranian and Ukrainian delegations was held on August 9th and 10th under the supervision of Mohsen Baharvand, Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs and his Ukrainian counterpart, and the second round is scheduled to be held on October 18-30 in Tehran.
Follow DW on Instagram Baharvand says three technical meetings will be held during the round of talks, one of which is “on legal issues about the amount of compensation for individuals and aircraft. ”
Meanwhile, talks have been held between Iranian and Ukrainian officials in Ukraine.
Iran ’ s ambassador to Kiev, Manouchehr Moradi, told Ukraine ’ s official news agency after the talks: “The payment of compensation, like the rest of the incident, has a legal and international framework.
In the negotiations and interviews that followed, we announced that we are prepared to pay compensation in accordance with international rules and Iran ’ s obligations under the conventions in which it is a party.
"This means that we will not accept any formula for compensation, and that is an important point."
The Islamic Republic appears to be trying to discredit a possible court order in Canada and the United States, but the experience of years has shown that these efforts often fail.
At the same time, many survivors of the victims of the Ukrainian plane have repeatedly stressed that the justice and accountability of the perpetrators of the incident is more important to them than receiving compensation.

title: Take a look at the livable city approach
text:
According to Mehr News Agency, Hamed wrote a post specializing in urban planning and environment: Currently, humanity is facing an unprecedented challenge in the environmental field.
There is widespread agreement that the Earth ’ s ecosystem can no longer sustain current levels of economic and consumer activity and growth, and is no longer sustainable.
It is because the pressure and the burden on nature have doubled.
In 1950, the world ’ s population was 2.5 billion, while in 2012 it reached 7 billion, and by the middle of the 21st century it could reach 10 billion.
Following the increase in the global population, we have witnessed an unprecedented increase in the population of urbanization with its harmful consequences for the biosphere, and the continuation of this kind of urbanization growth, especially with its form and function in the underdeveloped countries, including Iran, is a crisis and a warning against the instability of urbanization.
The increase in population, along with the increasing proportion of urbanization, has had adverse consequences for such cities.
In the meantime, other problems such as pollution, traffic, psychological problems, etc. reduce the quality of life and consequently livability in cities.
In recent decades, in parallel with the paradigms of sustainable development and sustainable urban development, the idea of improving the quality of life, which makes cities livable, has found its place in the urban planning literature.
Livability, as one of the fundamental issues in urban sustainability, refers to the urban system in which attention is paid to the socio-cultural, economic, physical and psychological health of all its inhabitants.
This quality embraces desirable urban spaces that preserve and reflect cultural richness.
Equality, justice, security, participation, recreation and empowerment are the keys that reinforce this concept.
In explanation and recognition, it should be said that the three concepts of sustainable development, quality of life and livability are the key components of this book as a new strategy on urban planning, each of which is necessary and necessary to achieve the goal of desirable urban development, although in practice they have many differences.
But in many sources, due to the proximity of the principles of sustainability and livability, these two words have been used in the same way.
Sustainability is defined repeatedly as meeting the needs of the present without compromising the needs of future generations.
This concept includes the positive effects of decision making on three factors: justice (people and society), ecology (ecology) and economics, the purpose of sustainability, as well as the satisfaction of the basic socio-economic needs of the present and future, and the responsible use of natural resources and the environment upon which the preservation and improvement of the welfare of society depends.
In practice, the elements of viability and sustainability are completely interrelated.
Both livability and sustainability address issues of social justice, human health and promote friendship with nature and healthy economic activity.
The fundamental difference between viability and sustainability lies in their time and scope.
Sustainability is longer-term, with a focus on larger environmental goals such as reducing climate impacts, increasing energy efficiency and reducing the use of natural resources.
While livability often involves short-term focused planning and community-level strategy implementation.
Viability consists of a set of different topics guided by a set of related principles.
These principles include fairness, participation and accessibility, which are considered to be the main components of viability.
It should be noted that measuring quality of life and livability provides common information so that they are trying to measure the three economic, social and environmental concepts, but there is also an important difference between the two concepts.
While quality of life measures ultimately focus on the characteristics of the well-being of people living in a particular geographic location, sustainability measures focus on the characteristics of regions and the services they can provide to residents.
In fact, the measurement of quality of life is influenced by demographic characteristics that are beyond the control of planners, while the measurement of livability is more practical and includes factors that planners can influence in that field.
The growing importance of livability comes from increasing awareness of unstable patterns of urban living and consumption that are neither healthy nor sustainable and, in the long run, reduce the ability of environmental resources to support the planet ’ s population.
Viability has been praised and accepted by both residents and planners working to create sustainable, functional and enjoyable living spaces.
In general, habitable settlements create a greater sense of community and ownership, and the rate of migration from them is low.
Considering that today ’ s human and civil society has faced issues such as environmental pollution, vulnerability of urban environment, poverty and injustice, individualism, disintegration of social relations, imbalance, loss of urban identity, loss of natural and cultural wealth, reduced public participation in the decision-making process.
The existence of these features and instability leads us to more and more recognition of the dimensions and principles of livability in order to reduce environmental, economic and social problems.

Urban livability as a discourse shapes planning and development activities and has become a key urban issue around the world.
The origin of the concept of urbanization goes back to ancient Greece.
Today it forms the basis of urban reconstruction studies and land use policies.
Viability is a quality that is not only unique to environmental characteristics but also related to behavior-based practices and the interaction between environmental and personal characteristics.
A liveable city is a link between the past and the future, a city that fights against any waste of natural resources, and we must leave these resources healthy for mankind.
The livable city is a sustainable city, a city that meets the needs of current residents without diminishing the ability for future generations, and has an ideal relationship between the urban environment and the social life that makes it sustainable.
The livability of urban spaces is nothing but the everyday living space of citizens, which is perceived every day, consciously or unconsciously along the way, from home to work, and the social and physical dimensions of the city have a dynamic relationship with each other.
Urban space consists of two social and physical spaces.

Urban spaces are places that belong to the public and are not exclusive to the physical and physical aspects, and in fact they are meaningful by human presence and activity.

title: Four refugees, including two children, drowned in the English Channel.
text:
Four asylum-seekers, including two children, drowned in the English Channel (Reuters) Photo source: A rescue operation has been going on for hours by French boats since French authorities announced the deaths of two children and a man and woman who were trying to cross the English Channel to reach Britain.
A boat carrying refugees has sunk across the English Channel between France and Britain.
The prosecutor of the French city of Dunkirk has opened an investigation into the cause of the sinking of the ship.
These people are said to be Iranian.
A massive rescue operation has been under way for hours, which crashed near the northern French city of Dunkirk.
According to French authorities, two children aged 5 and 8 and a man and woman died.
The other 14 were taken to hospitals in the port of Calais and the French city of Dunkirk.
The English Channel, between France and Britain, is one of the world ’ s busiest waterways, and it can be dangerous to cross by small vessels, especially in winter when the sea is stormy.
Another disaster came after the British Meteorological Office warned of bad weather and strong winds in the Channel region.
Natalie Alpeik, MP for the Dover region in the British Parliament, said: “It ’ s terrible that there ’ s been another disaster on the canal.
Human traffickers have no respect for human life: "A sailboat accidentally encountered a ship and alerted French authorities of the incident.
Four French ships, a Belgian helicopter and a French fishing vessel were involved in the rescue.
Since the beginning of the year, more than 7,400 asylum seekers have arrived in Britain by sea in small boats.
While there are still two months left until the end of 2020, that number is 1,825 more than in 2019.
The survivors were taken by helicopter to hospitals in the port of Calais and the northern French city of Dunkirk on Thursday, August 6, and a total of 235 migrants, including several pregnant women, crossed the English Channel from Europe to the southern coast of Britain.
This is the highest recorded number of illegal immigrants arriving in the region in a single day.
About ten days ago, Home Secretary Priti Patel announced the “most significant revision ” of the country ’ s asylum system in a decade.

The English Channel should not be turned into a children ’ s cemetery.

An Iranian arrested in connection with the death of the family of Irannejad in France Image source, Family archive Image source, from the right of Armin and Anita Irannejad and their mother Shiva Mohammad Panahi and Artin in the arms of his father, Rasool Irannejad Sebastian Pew, prosecutor of the Dunkirk region in France said that an Iranian man has been arrested on suspicion of connection to the death of four Iranian refugees in the Channel.
Rasul Irannejad and his wife, Shiva Mohammad Panahi, and their two children, Anita, 9, and Armin, 6, died when they were sailing from France to Britain as a result of the sinking of the boat carrying refugees.
The family ’ s 15-month-old son, Artin, and two other passengers on the boat have disappeared, and it ’ s likely they too have died.
The boat had sailed from the coast of Dunkirk to Britain and was supposed to land 22 people on the British coast by crossing the English Channel.
The detainee was born in 1983 in Iran and was in charge of a semi-rubber boat carrying 22 refugees from the Grand-St refugee camp near Dunkirk.
When the boat crossed the English Channel, the weather was bad and the sea was turbulent.
Prosecutor Dunkirk said the detainee had been identified and detained based on the statements of the survivors.
He is currently “in the investigation phase. ”
The indictment charged him with seven counts of manslaughter for failing to take safety precautions, as well as endangering the lives of other passengers who were rescued.
The prosecutor ’ s group has also systematically and systematically demanded punishment for “aiding the illegal entry and stay of foreigners. ”
The prosecutor said he admitted he was a boat driver but said he was "not involved" and was an immigrant, but was described by other passengers as someone close to traffickers.
The prosecutor said he was the only survivor of the boat who spoke Farsi and that his comments contradicted other passengers, all Kurdish and Iraqi.
As other countries have become more strict in accepting refugees in recent years, many Iranians, Afghans and other countries involved in the conflict in the Middle East are trying to reach other countries through illegal and sometimes risky ways, which in some cases have led to disastrous results.

Most of these migrants are men, and about 20 to 30 percent are family members. ”

Also, according to the representative of the three border markets, two of them are closed.
Pointing out that people need jobs, Mr. Hosseinpuor emphasized that the situation has become such that people like Mr. Rasoul Irannejad, who lost his life and his family, sell whatever they have and with the help of Turkish smugglers go to Turkey and from there to Europe.

Under the impact of the coronavirus epidemic, safe routes to enter and declare asylum in the country have been closed, but small boats and the English Channel are still open.
So far this year, at the end of the 10th month of 2020, 7,400 people have made their way to the UK via the English Channel, four times the number of people who entered the UK illegally last year.
At least seven people have drowned in these waters this year, including four members of Mr. Irannejad ’ s family, as well as their missing baby.
The cost of crossing the Channel for refugees is between 5,000 and 6,000 euros per person.
Getting out of Iran, especially if you live in border areas, doesn ’ t cost much.
The main cost is to pass through Turkey and get to one of the Western European countries.
In the case of the Irannejad family, crossing the Turkish waters to Italy and arriving from Italy to France amounted to almost 8,000 euros per person.

Some of them clash with the central governments of their country and flee because of political charges, some flee because of threats of murder and assault from the chaos and conflict of armed groups and civil war, and some seek a place where they can feed themselves and their families more safely.
The fear of conflict with the police due to participation in ordinary crimes, fraud, return checks, interference in smuggling and theft, and the like sometimes causes people to cross the borders of countries illegally and apply for asylum.

title: Who is responsible for the deaths of migrants?
text:
Again, a tragic incident and again, a number of Iranian migrants lost their lives in the English Channel between France and England, so that some of their attention will be drawn to these innocent people who burn themselves in the water and fire just to seek a better life.
Immigration is not a new debate in human history, and from the beginning of humanity humans and even animals have migrated to find a better place to live.
Some birds even migrate seasonally from one place to another in order to survive, and many people wish they could fly wherever they want.
While some may seek asylum in other countries for political or security reasons, the vast majority of migrants seek to find another place to live due to economic conditions, and some may seek to emigrate for social, cultural or intellectual reasons.
Of course, according to international statistics, more than 95% of migrants these days are economic and social refugees who, due to the conditions in their countries, are trying to move to another country that they think has better economic or social conditions.
If the wars and conditions created by superpowers are not for other countries, such as sanctions and even economic war, the majority of people would prefer to remain in their own countries, and the number of people seeking to leave their homeland and emigrate would be much less than what we see today.
For more than 20 years, the United States has occupied Afghanistan and Iraq and made empty promises to act for democracy, human rights and economic progress of the people of these countries, but we see that the situation in these countries is getting worse and naturally the number of people seeking to emigrate from these countries is increasing.
In Syria, Libya, Yemen and many other countries, the wars waged by Americans and Europeans have led many people to seek to leave their homes and try to migrate to a place they think might be better off.
Today, Iran is facing the most severe inhumane economic sanctions in human history, and the Iranian people are forced to endure all kinds of pressure to resist US bullying.
Given that the Iranians even sat at the negotiating table and signed the JCPOA, the Americans and Europeans did not fulfill their obligations towards Iran.
And given that the Iranians see what the Americans and Europeans have done to other countries and nations in the region and what they promised these nations was a lie.
The Iranians can no longer trust the promises of the United States and Europe, which is why today they are stuck in a very complicated situation.
Currently, there is no horizontal hole to solve this issue and, well, many are not able to tolerate all these pressures and are willing to go to sea in order to find another place to live.
This is why we see that the oppressed family is forced to risk crossing the English Channel and lose their life.
Although Europeans themselves are the claimants of human rights and human rights, we observe that in their behaviors, they do not do anything to protect human rights or human rights, and they are only limited to slogans.
The fact that they have bowed down to the cruel US sanctions against the Iranian nation means that they are partners in the US crime against Iran.
The fact that they remain silent about the massacre of the Yemeni people means that they are complicit in the crime.
The very fact that they are silent about what is happening in other parts of the world around them, or even that they are involved in things like Libya or Africa or Syria, means they have to take responsibility for what is happening.
If there is a new war in the Middle East, the flow of migrants to Europe will surely multiply and the European authorities will increase in this regard.
Today, it can be said that the blood of every innocent person who loses their lives anywhere in the world is the responsibility of politicians who decide to launch wars or so-called sanctions against nations.

title: The tragedy of the death of Iranian family in the English Channel
text:
A family of five who wanted to emigrate to the United Kingdom and left their home in the village of Glynah, in the city of Sardasht, West Azerbaijan, drowned in the waters between France and Britain as they crossed the English Channel.
The 15-month-old child of the family has not yet been found.
According to Euronews, the incident occurred on Tuesday, November 27, while the family members, Rasoul Irannejad, 35, his wife Shiva Mohammad Panahi, 9 years old Anita Irannejad, 6 years old Armin Irannejad and 15 months old Artin, were on a boat with several other refugees crossing the Channel to Britain. The boat capsized and Rasoul Irannejad drowned and his wife and two young children were killed. John died, but the fate of their 15-month-old baby is still unknown.
Another 15 people on board, believed to be Iranian, were taken to hospital, and two others are believed to be missing at sea.
The boat was reportedly carrying 17 people but smugglers had 27 people on board, while the British Meteorological Office had previously warned of bad weather and high winds in the Channel region.
The boat, about 2 km off the coast of France, was accidentally spotted by a passing sailboat at 9: 30 am local time and was immediately informed by French authorities that the search and rescue operations involved four French vessels, a Belgian helicopter and a French fishing boat, but when the rescue teams arrived, the boat had sunk.
Rasul Iran was a construction worker and his wife was a housewife, but they moved from Sardasht to Turkey and from Turkey to Italy.
They were quarantined in Italy for 20 days, then headed for France, and spent 20 days in the jungles of northern France, where they made several train trips to England, but each time the police brought them back to the camp, until the last night they sent a text message to their family that they were going to board a boat, a boat that was not reaching its destination.
A friend of the family, who was with them in the camp in northern France, wrote, “This family spent 80 million tomans and smuggled them, they put all their money into it. ”
The prosecutor of the French city of Dunkirk has opened an investigation into the cause of the sinking, saying the creation of a new system that would allow asylum seekers to enter the UK from outside its borders could put an end to dangerous sea crossings and prevent such catastrophes.
The English Channel, between France and Britain, is one of the world ’ s busiest waterways, and it can be dangerous to cross with small vessels, especially in winter when the sea is stormy.

text:

title: Dahlan Architect of Arab Settlement Agreements with the Zionist Regime
text:
"The engineering of the Arab-Israeli peace agreement was with an exiled enemy, Mahmoud Abbas."
According to the report, Foreign Policy is written by Jonathan H.
Mohammed Dahlan became a stain in 2011 when Palestinian police raided his Ramallah home and led the former Fatah security chief, who appeared as a rival to Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, to the Jordan River to Abu Dhabi.
Dahlan, still in exile in the United Arab Emirates, has finally found a chance for sweet revenge.
In his new role as a confidant of Gulf leaders and a regional strategic mastermind, he is helping forge Arab peace agreements with Israel.
Over the past nine years, Dahlan has developed an unusual close relationship with Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Crown Prince of the United Arab Emirates, who sheltered Dahlan after he fled.
Born in a refugee camp in Gaza, he has acted innumerable as an international representative of his wealthy patron, helping his master conclude business and political deals, from North Africa to Eastern Europe.
According to Dahlan, when the sun goes down, he and the crown prince get on a fast car, go on night patrols on Abu Dhabi ’ s desert highways, and sing their favorite songs together.
Their apparent friendship has turned the Dahlan into an influential — and invisible — hand in achieving the “Ibrahim Agreement, ” a US-brokered normalization agreement that Israel concluded with the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain last month.
He is the architect behind the UAE ’ s stance that, while expressing passionate support for the Palestinian government, is pressuring 84-year-old Mahmoud Abbas with embarrassing situations, such as when Abbas had to cancel two COVID-19 medical airliners because the UAE transported them through Tel Aviv ’ s Ben Gurion airport.
The refusal to accept aid in August and Mahmoud Abbas ’ s furious condemnation of the peace agreement, described as a “knife in the back, ” have united two longstanding allies in the region along with Saudi Arabia, the Gulf ’ s largest and richest country.
Bishara Behbe, a Palestinian professor and critic of Mahmoud Abbas who co-wrote analytical columns with Jason Greenblatt, Donald Trump ’ s former special envoy to the Middle East, told me: “Bin Zayed does nothing about the Palestinians without consulting the Dahlan.
It is a life saver. ”
After a tumultuous career in Palestinian politics and a potential successor to former Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat, Dahlan has learned to play the long game of progress.
Born in Gaza ’ s Khan Yunis refugee camp, he became one of the youngest leaders of the 1987 Palestinian Intifada against Israel.
He learned Hebrew during several periods in Israeli jails.
Finally expelled from Palestine, he earned Arafat ’ s confidence as a key assistant when the Palestine Liberation Organization was based in Tunisia.
After their return in 1933, at the time of the Oslo Peace Accords, Dahlan took over the leadership of the secular Fatah Party in Gaza and led security operations there; and became the executor of Arafat's orders against the opposition to the Hamas movement.
But while Dahlan rose from the ranks of the Palestinian Authority after the death of Yasser Arafat in 2004, he regularly clashed with Mahmoud Abbas, seeing him as a vague rival who needed to be kept under control.
In 2007, Dahlan was blamed for failing to quell violent movements in which Hamas took control of Gaza.
He and Abbas have been accusing each other of corruption for years, stoking their mutual hatred.
Finally, a Palestinian court found Dahlan guilty in 2014 of “slandering ” Abbas and sentenced him to two years in prison.
A year later, he was sentenced to another three years in prison for embezzlement.
The 59-year-old Dahlan is sometimes powerless, but the defeated is not permanent.
When Israel labeled Dahlan a terrorist, he continued to be a key player in the negotiations over the Oslo peace agreements.
It seems that the US governments became interested in him one after the other, and this process began in the White House of Bill Clinton and has reached the presidency of George W. Bush and now Trump.
Although he was previously unknown, he is now among a group of candidates who are constantly appearing in political polls to replace Abbas.
I saw Dahlan the night before July 28, 2011, when police raided his home in Ramallah.
While he never interviewed Western journalists, I was invited as a Bloomberg News correspondent to meet with him alongside a Palestinian journalist.
Dahlan said that since it was not the right time, he had to cancel the scheduled official interview, but he was happy that the conversation would not be recorded.
Dahlan did not hesitate to criticize Mahmoud Abbas for a moment and expressed hope that he would one day oust him through elections.
He also promised that he would be given a chance to speak in the future.
Now, however, Dahlan is in the shadows and, with commercial connections, has expanded his nest in Abu Dhabi and has a hand on fire in Abbas ’ s replacement drama.
The next morning, when I woke up, I heard a report on the radio that Dahlan had disappeared after searching for dozens of Palestinian commandos in his home.
They arrested 10 of his bodyguards and seized large quantities of weapons and ammunition from the basement.
Dahlan was immune from arrest as a member of the Palestinian Legislative Council, but was reported the next day that he had left the West Bank and entered Jordan.
It took us another four years to conduct the conversation, this time for a Bloomberg interview at the location of his big new home in Abu Dhabi.
He looked neat, wearing a Black Boss T-shirt and blue jeans, and went on to offer dates and chocolate plates while we talked in the living room on the marble floor.
This distinctive villa among the high-rise skyscrapers of Abu Dhabi is known as an international hall for its movement of Palestinian and Israeli politicians.
By then, Dahlan had become increasingly obsessed with commercial interests, describing himself as an “opener ” to customers because of the extensive international connections he made while traveling the world with Yasser Arafat.
In addition to bin Zayed, Dahlan was also close to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, with whom he had previously consulted on how to deal with radical extremist movements, as well as the leaders of Serbia and Montenegro.
Dahlan and his family took up Serbian citizenship after wealthy Emiratis rescued Air Serbia in 2013 and invested in a $3 billion property development project off the coast of Belgrade.
This time he spoke openly but mysteriously, carrying on the same vagueness of speech for which his mentor, Arafat, was famous.
Instead of announcing his participation in the competition for the Palestinian Authority ’ s presidency, Dahlan said he was seeking re-election to parliament and would add what he called a “value-added ” component to the leadership team after Abbas left the stage.
Beyond that, he expressed appreciation for the life he was able to rebuild in Abu Dhabi and expressed an interest in his nighttime drive with the crown prince.
Behind the UAE ’ s deal with Israel is a 20-year history of trade and personal and technological ties.
Of course, when you interact with the dodgers who refused to give interviews this time, it ’ s hard to just stick to the appearance.
He is the focus of a series of conspiracy theories that accuse him of poisoning Arafat.
He has also been accused of helping Israel ’ s Mossad service kill a Hamas operative in Dubai, and a series of self-denying rumors that he was on a flight from the United Arab Emirates to the Palestinians that Abbas rejected.
Although he appears to be influential in advising the UAE on how to manage Palestinian leaders, his political star now appears dim.
According to Dmitry Diliani, a spokesman, his faction within the Fatah party known as the Democratic Reform Movement, issued a statement rejecting Ibrahim ’ s agreements.
Any normalization of relations with Israel should take place within the framework of the 2002 Arab Peace Initiative, first introduced by Saudi Arabia, which requires Israel to surrender all occupied territories before resolving the conflict, he said.
This may have something to do with the fact that many of Dahlan ’ s partners in the West Bank were arrested by Abbas ’ s forces last month following the UAE agreement, and his faction now needs to position itself within the Palestinian consensus in opposition to Israel.
Photos of him and bin Zayed were burned and trampled during street protests against the agreement to normalize relations between the UAE and Israel.
Dahlan is now living in the shadows, shifting his interests in Abu Dhabi with commercial ties, starting to involve himself in the succession of Abbas and advising his Emirati friends about dealing with the Palestinians.
Much depends on whether Trump will be president for another term or whether Democratic nominee Joe Biden will come to the White House with a more multilateral approach.
The question for Dahlan and the region is whether he can move past the revenge game of old rivals and play a constructive role in bringing the Mughal Palestinians into a rapidly changing Middle East. ”
End of message.

title: Member of Parliament: Government to pay for the transfer of the bodies of the Irannejad family to Iran
text:
Kamal Hosseinpuor, the representative of Sardasht in the Islamic Consultative Assembly, announced the transfer of the bodies of members of the Iranian family to Iran with the financial assistance of the government.
In the past few days, during the capsizing of a boat carrying 22 asylum-seekers on the Channel en route from France to Britain, five members of a family called Irannejad, including 9-year-old Nita Irannejad, 6-year-old Armin Irannejad and 15-month-old Artin Irannejad, died.

French authorities have announced the discovery of the bodies of four members of the family, but the 15-month-old Artin Irannejad has not yet been found.
