title: Heavenly surprises. How to minimize losses in an unpredictable climate – Agroinvestor
text:
The problem of weather forecasts is largely due to the vast expanses of our Motherland - weather stations can be located hundreds of kilometers from the fields of farmers, which negatively affects the accuracy of forecasts.
At the same time, the local weather on the field according to the indications of the state weather station remote for 100-150 km may differ significantly from both the predicted and the actual one.
To obtain objective factual data, farms often establish their own private weather stations.
“It can rain all the neighbors, but at the same time bypass your fields.
Its weather station allows you to accurately understand how much moisture a particular field received, ” explains their popularity, the development director of ExactFarming (information technology in agriculture) Yegor Zaikin.
By connecting your own weather station to online forecasting services, it becomes possible to update the short-term forecast for the installation site of such a station and maintain your own local log of weather observations, which means that you can obtain accurate values of such important agronomic parameters as accumulated precipitation and the sum of active temperatures.
Specialized agricultural weather stations, in addition to meteorological parameters, as a rule, allow measuring specific environmental parameters that are not involved in weather forecasting - soil temperature and moisture content, leaf moisture.
Many stations are able to create around themselves entire measuring networks of sensors that allow you to see what is happening on each field individually.
All this is transmitted in real time to any device of the agrarian – modern stations are equipped with SIM cards and can transmit information on-line.
In the middle of the last century, humanity began to make active attempts to influence the climate.
Many countries, in particular the United States and the USSR, conducted research aimed at the formation of clouds and fog, as well as the challenge of artificial precipitation.
Soon, the military became interested in research conducted for peaceful purposes.
The first recorded use of climate weapons in the 20th century can be considered Operation Popeye, which the United States conducted in Vietnam during the war.
In the rainy season (March to November) from 1967 to 1972, silver iodide was dispersed from aircraft in the rain clouds, which provoked precipitation three times higher than normal.
As a result of this operation, the Ho Chi Minh Trail was blurred, along which South Vietnamese guerrillas received weapons and equipment.
However, at a huge cost, and about 5.7 thousand tons of silver iodide was consumed, the effect was quite short-lived and ineffective.
At the initiative of the USSR in 1977, the UN adopted a convention banning the use of any climate weapons, which the United States joined.
Today, studies of the impact on climatic conditions are conducted by several countries of the world, including the United States and Russia.
The most famous objects are the American HAARP, located in Alaska, and the Russian Sura, located near Nizhny Novgorod.
According to some experts, both of these objects are climatic weapons that can change the weather on a global scale.
HAARP (High Frequency Radio Wave Ionospheric Scattering Program) is an American research project to study the interaction of the ionosphere with powerful electromagnetic radiation.
The project was launched in the spring of 1997 in Alaska, located on an area of 13 hectares, the estimated radiation power is from 3.6 to 4.8 MW.
According to the US government, HAARP was completely stopped at the end of 2014.
The facility "Sura", located 150 km from Nizhny Novgorod, has a more modest size and is now not in the best condition.
According to experts, at best, the consequences of the use of climate weapons can affect the aggressor itself, its allies, as well as neighboring neutral states.
At the same time, it is problematic to calculate in advance what the result will be.
In the worst case, the rash use of such technologies can lead to a catastrophe of a global scale.
Numerous meteorological stations, sensors of humidity and soil temperature, which have recently appeared in farmers, can help to survive the heat or floods in farms, says the head of the Center of competence of agrotechnologies GC Softline Grigory Portyankin.
All this technology connected to the Internet and exchanging information is called the Internet of Things (IoT).
“New technologies make it possible to achieve such a level of agriculture, at which the agrarian has the opportunity to apply all the necessary arsenal of equipment and technologies in the current situation at the optimal time for them, ” the specialist explains.
For example, agricultural applications that exist now can give advice on how to fertilize, what technology to choose, and at what time and at what distance to sow the selected crop.
And although they will not be able to give an accurate weather forecast, “smart ” technologies will help to avoid mistakes in agricultural technology and suggest how to minimize the risks from changing the weather.
In addition, agricultural equipment connected to the Internet and satellites, much more accurately introduces fertilizers and sows seeds, which increases the stress resistance of plants.
Imagination painted bananas and mangoes in the south and wheat in the north.
However, the reality turned out to be more prosaic: agriculture, although advanced to the north, but slightly, and in the rest of the country it became impossible to predict the weather.
In addition, droughts and floods have become more frequent, as a result of which a good harvest has become more difficult to obtain.
Nevertheless, as the magazine “Agrotechnics and Technologies ” found out, it is still possible to cope with such weather.
This year, employees of the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) were banned from using the term “global warming ”.
Instead, it is recommended to use more neutral phrases like “weather change ”.
This is due to the US withdrawal from the Kyoto Protocol, an international treaty to prevent global warming.
Indeed, the very fact of climate warming raises doubts among many meteorologists - not only American, but also Russian.
“It is too early to talk about climate change, since we have been professionally observing the weather for only about a hundred years.
But we can say for sure that the duration of cyclones and anticyclones has increased - it can rain for a long time, and then a long dry period will come, "says Egor Berezovsky, head of the Field Experimental Station at the Timiryazev Regional Agricultural Academy.
In fact, there is no escaping the fact: the weather is becoming less predictable, and farmers have to deal with both drought and unprecedented rainfall during one season.
Contrary to popular belief, global warming has not led to the fact that in the north began to grow apple trees and grapes (although experts note a slight shift in agriculture towards the northern latitudes), its consequences are in the unpredictability of the weather and in the constant losses of farms.
But this does not mean that you need to silently suffer losses.
In recent years, agriculture has learned to deal with the effects of climate change and minimize losses from changing weather.
Although most often the influence of human activity on the weather is characterized as "climate warming", in reality there is not warming, but a sharp change in weather.
So, the average air temperature since 1980 has risen by only 1 ° C, and by 2100, according to forecasts, will rise by another 3 ° C.
It would seem that it is not so much.
But in practice, even such a slight warming leads to sharp changes in weather.
“There have never been such frequent severe droughts during the growing season.
At the same time, in the arid zone, they became even stronger, and Europe was in the zone of severe arid phenomena, ” said Nikolai Sukhoi, chairman of the Union of Water Workers and Land Reclamators.
As a result, the amount of rainfall increased.
The rains have become stronger - in a few days the monthly norm falls immediately.
Accordingly, this has resulted in a problem for many old meliorative structures.
“We see an increase in the load on existing facilities.
Many of them require restructuring, ” warns Nikolai Sukhoi.
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change report does not bode well for warming.
Based on the data of this document, with an increase in the average temperature by 1 − 3 ° C, the yield of some crops in the middle zone may slightly increase, but in general, farmers are waiting for losses.
In hot countries, any increase in temperature will immediately lead to a drop in crop productivity, which will exacerbate the risk of hunger in poor regions.
There is no need to go far for examples of losses from the heat: in 2012, a drought in our country led to a rise in the price of some products by 20%.
In particular, increased the price of buckwheat, which began to sweep off the shelves.
It is not possible to predict sharp changes in the mood of nature in Russia.
Moreover, it is well known that the remote forecast is less accurate.
This opinion is shared by Roshydromet and foreign meteorological organizations that warn about this on their websites.
“Accurate forecasts were always given for a maximum of three days.
With longer term weather forecasts, accuracy drops significantly.
In addition, in principle, we can not predict precipitation, ” says Yegor Berezovsky.
However, the farmers themselves do not hope to get an accurate forecast.
For such a service, rarely anyone pays, and usually farms rely on publicly available free forecasts on sites or look at the weather in applications that are connected to agricultural machinery.
For farmers, the quirks of the weather mean additional costs and crop losses.
Especially bad is that the change of weather began to occur during the agricultural year, when the plants go through the stage of vegetation or ripening.
After all, even mild heat or rain causes stress in plants, which leads to a decrease in yield.
“The climate has become generally more sharply continental: in vegetation periods, prolonged heat is immediately replaced by a flood.
This stress weakens the plants.
The changes affected the course of day and night temperatures, the difference of which already reaches 10 − 15 ° C. Because of this, dew falls on the plants at 4 − 5 o ’ clock in the morning, in which spores of pathogens appear, further leading to epiphytotics, ” explains Elena Sokolova, director of technical expertise at Syngenta.
The heat, of course, has a negative effect on animals.
Everyone knows the so-called season of big milk, which falls on the summer.
At this time, the weather is warm and cows (when walking) are on pastures.
However, heat is good in moderation, because animals do not tolerate heat well.
“With an increase in the temperature of the external environment, they have reduced activity, appetite and sexual desire.
As a result, the cow consumes less feed, her milk yield decreases and the quality of milk (the content of fat and protein decreases).
For animals, this is heat stress, and stress is always accompanied by a decrease in productivity, ” says Alexei Voronin, head of the analytical department of the National Union of Milk Producers (Soyuzmoloko).
By the way, heat negatively affects forage plants, which become less valuable for animals.
In hot weather, the feed loses its juiciness, the expert states.
And yet, over the years of unpredictable weather, agriculture has developed a number of measures that allow you not to depend on the weather forecast, but to work “in fact ”, as in the good old days, when farmers could know exactly whether it would rain today, just looking at the sky.
The most important rule in conditions of unpredictability is not to apply all fertilizers at once.
“It is better to add half of the recommended dose before sowing, and then add it, depending on the situation.
For example, if there was a lot of precipitation, to fertilize less, and if there is little – more, ” advises Yegor Berezovsky.
Further, if the climate in the region is usually arid, it makes sense by leaving stubble to protect the soil from direct sun exposure and thereby prevent moisture loss.
As in the case of fertilizers, there is nothing new and difficult in this - you just need to use a long-known mulch.
“In an arid climate, mulching and direct crops give a good result.
First, mulch creates an additional layer on the soil and thereby obscures it.
Secondly, over time, the mulch rots, forming another layer of soil, earthworms settle in it, which process plant residues and create additional channels, thanks to which moisture is better absorbed into the soil, ” says the head of the export department for Russia Amazone Dr.
Victor Buxman.
This method in the framework of the SASCHA project was tested in the Tyumen region, where it showed a good result.
By the way, as Buxman notes, climate scientists have revealed that in the Tyumen region there is a noticeable shift of agriculture to the north - there were more farms, and began to grow previously not peculiar to the region of culture.
According to Elena Sokolova, plants can be prepared in advance for stress.
For example, this can be achieved by doing architectonics, that is, first of all, to create the optimal ratio of the root and vegetative system, as well as the best ratio of the length of the stem and leaves (this is especially true for cereals).
The correct formation of the root system, the specialist continues, is when both the surface (at a depth of 4 − 5 cm) root system is developed, which helps to survive strong prolonged rains, and the deep (30 − 40 cm or more), which gives the plant the opportunity to survive drought.
“To do this, you can use retardants, ” says Sokolova. – Even in precision agriculture, there are machines that allow you to apply nitrogen fertilizers in rows deep into the soil.
Nitrogen fertilizers in this case stimulate the formation of the root system at depth. ”
In addition, she advises the use of varieties of dwarf or semi-dwarf type.
The fact is that the so-called sucking force (the ability of cells to absorb moisture) in the upper leaves is stronger than in the lower ones, so dwarf plants are less whimsical.
If they are not, you can use retardants that reduce the stretching of cells, thus preventing the growth of plants in height.
There are also special drugs of physiological action that can, for example, accelerate the opening and closing of the stomata, which helps to resist sudden changes in weather (from rain to drought).
Finally, Elena Sokolova recommends a cautious approach to the use of tank mixtures (a cocktail of plant protection products, fertilizers and growth stimulants, which are introduced at a time, thereby reducing costs).
“After them, the plants are often weakened and are not able to effectively resist various stresses.
In addition, herbicides can adversely affect subsequent plants in crop rotation, ” warns the specialist “Syngenty ”.
As for animal husbandry, there, due to the fact that animals are adapted to a certain climate, it will be necessary to apply non-standard approaches.
For example, in the farm "Farm of Growth" (Moscow region) found an unusual solution - built rare for Russia barns made of natural timber.
“Cows are always cool in them because the tree breathes.
In addition, we have loose housing, that is, cows move freely around the room, and do not stand in a stall, as usual.
Thus, animals are comfortable in barns even on hot summer days, ” explains farm specialist Alexandra Pogodina.
But in hot countries on farms it is advisable to install industrial air conditioners.
Of course, this will greatly increase the cost of producing raw milk.
However, it makes sense to do this, otherwise cows may stop giving milk altogether.

title: Simplification of the visa regime for medical tourists can increase their flow to Ukraine by 10%
text:
Simplification of the visa regime for medical tourists can increase their flow to Ukraine by 10% Simplification of the visa regime, in particular, reducing the time for embassies to consider issues of opening visas for medical tourists, can increase their flow to Ukraine by 10%.
This opinion was expressed by the President of the Ukrainian Association of Medical Tourism Violetta Yanyshevskaya.
“The number of medical tourists in Ukraine can grow by 10% if we simplify the visa procedure.
If we create favorable conditions for other factors, the flow may increase significantly, "she said during a press conference at Interfax-Ukraine on Monday.
According to her, the number of medical tourists entering Ukraine in 2016 amounted to about 55 thousand patients, including citizens of Israel, Italy, Spain, Iraq, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Georgia, Azerbaijan.
Most often, foreign patients come to Ukraine to receive rehabilitation, dental services, plastic surgery, cell therapy, cardiac surgery, treatment of ophthalmic diseases.

title: Chinese women stuck at the airport, unable to pass passport control after plastic surgery
text:
They went to South Korea to improve their appearance.
Three Chinese women were stranded at a South Korean airport, unable to pass passport control, due to just made plastic surgery.
It was simply impossible to establish the correspondence of their swollen and bandaged faces to the photos available in the documents, reports Ren TV with reference to the Daily Mail.
It is reported that the three girls went to South Korea during the autumn Golden Week, a Chinese holiday celebrated for a whole week.
South Korea is known for its achievements in the field of beauty, so foreigners often fly there in order to improve their appearance.
Chinese girls had plastic surgery and, without waiting for their faces to take on a human form, went home.
There was an emergency situation at the airport with them.
The picture of oriental beauties, whose faces are bandaged, went viral and collected tens of thousands of likes.
In the photo, Chinese women sit waiting for the decision of the immigration service.
Not yet known.
They were able to fly back to China.

title: Foreigners go to Russia to change their appearance
text:
The President of the Russian Association of Medical Tourism Konstantin Onishchenko announced an increase in the flow of foreigners who came to Russia for medical purposes.
In the first half of 2017, the number of foreign patients exceeded 20 thousand people, and this is a third more than last year.
At the same time, 20% of medical tourists have had plastic surgery in our country.
Most popular were facelift, rhinoplasty and mammoplasty.
About the causes of the phenomenon and prospects for the development of the industry Dni.Ru talked with plastic surgeons.
According to the candidate of medical sciences, plastic surgeon, member of the society The New York Academy of Science Andrey Kovyntsev, 80% of arriving foreign medical tourists are Russian-speaking people – those who do not have a language barrier.
They come thanks to "word of mouth", on the recommendation of people who were satisfied.
“I have not heard of anyone offering organized medical“ tours ” to foreign citizens, providing interpreters, accompanying and supervising such patients.
But this is not a problem in a world where every smartphone has the Internet.
Foreign patients come to us first of all not through advertising posters, but by recommendation.
Based on my own experience, I can say that we first contact via the Internet for a preliminary consultation.
During the first conversation, we discuss desires, options, amount, opportunities, important details.
The patient can also send me photos and ask any questions that concern him, ” Kovyntsev says.
Modern methods of plastic surgery reduce the time of rehabilitation, and yet after surgery, a doctor ’ s supervision is necessary.
“Our doctors and medical staff are trying to help as much as possible and prevent possible complications.
It happens, we correct the mistakes of foreign colleagues, ” says the plastic, maxillofacial surgeon, cosmetologist of the BIOS clinic Lyubov Akrum.
According to her, in the West, the level of plastic surgery is determined by the price.
"Experienced surgeons and exorbitant prices are waiting for the customer of the level of celebrity.
Affordable, budget surgery offers questionable quality.
Therefore, taking into account the exchange rate of the dollar to the ruble and the skill of Russian plastic surgeons in large centers, our country becomes a profitable option, "the expert believes.
Akrum is sure that medical tourists can become even more.
“I think in order to expand the flow of foreigners to Russia, it is worth investing more educational and financial resources in this industry.
At the same time, the medical community should approach the Western mentality in terms of the quality of service and the approach to the patient itself.
After all, we are going to a new level.
Stereotypes are crumbling, and the fact that in Russia there are not only bears, but also medicine, becomes known and obvious to an increasing number of foreigners, which can not but rejoice.
I think this is a good sign for our country.
And if now our state had the opportunity to provide our clinics in accordance with international standards, perhaps we could become competitive.
After all, golden heads and hands in Russia have always been in abundance, ” the surgeon noted.
“Despite the decent level of our specialists and clinics, patients still come to us, rather by accident. – thinks associate professor of the Department of Plastic Surgery of the Faculty of Advanced Training of Medical Workers of RUDN University, head of the Department of Plastic Surgery of the BIOS Clinic Andrei Voroshkevich. – No one is engaged in special advertising of Russian clinics abroad.
In addition, the level of development of our medical institutions is very uneven. ”
The expert believes that for 20 years, Russian surgeons have come to the world level of standards in aesthetic medicine, and a number of clinics and surgeons are not inferior to the world.
Saving on plastic is a real story.
Therefore, the number of foreigners coming from abroad to operate in Russia has increased, and these are mainly our former citizens, who are many abroad.
Patients come to visit relatives for two to three months and do large combined operations.
In this case, the determining factor is the price.
In Russia, they make expensive modern operations for a modest amount, compared with foreign clinics.
It is most advantageous to do large operations, advanced facial plastics using endoscopic technologies.
Abroad it is expensive.
For example, the cost of facelift with SMAS (facelift) in the United States starts from an average of $5,000, we - from $2,000, "Voroshkevich calculated.
Cost savings definitely affect the increase in the flow of patients.
The second important factor is the accumulated experience, practice, good professional level.
According to the observations of surgeons, mainly patients come from Europe: Italy, Spain, France.
In the border areas of foreigners doing plastic, a little more.
Colleagues from Kaliningrad, for example, take many patients from Poland.
As for preferences, young women, as a rule, come for liposuction, prosthetics, correction of the shape of the nose.
After 40 years go for eyelid plastic surgery, endoscopic lifting.
After 50 years come to do facelift and body lift.
Experts expect that medical tourism will continue to develop.
President of the Russian Association of Medical Tourism Konstantin Onishchenko believes that the growth of the market will be about 20% annually.

title: The construction of the ITER fusion reactor has overcome half the way to its completion » DailyTechInfo
text:
Thermonuclear fusion reactions are an ideal solution to the ever-increasing energy needs of mankind, they can ensure the production of unlimited amounts of energy without harmful emissions into the environment and without the formation of highly toxic radioactive waste.
Unfortunately, scientists have not yet managed to create a fully functioning fusion reactor, despite a lot of efforts being made in this direction.
One such effort is the international ITER project, a huge experimental tokamak reactor currently under construction in southern France.
The first experiments at this reactor should be carried out in 2025, and recently representatives of contractors reported that the construction of the reactor is completed by 50 percent, and this is quite consistent with the completion date planned for 2021.
The project is funded by seven participants, mainly the European Union, with relatively small investments from the US, India, China, Russia, Japan and South Korea.
Construction began in 2013, but a series of delays led to a shift in the timing of the completion of construction.
At the same time, the price tag of the project, which has already been spent 22 billion US dollars.During the first experiments, which, as mentioned above, will begin in 2025, the ITER reactor will produce hydrogen fusion reactions, i.e., in fact, copy the processes occurring in the depths of the Sun and in the epicenters of thermonuclear explosions.
The nuclei of deuterium and tritium will combine and merge into one helium nucleus.
At the same time, a large amount of energy will be released, which will be absorbed by the walls of the reactor chamber, which will lead to their heating to a high temperature.
The ITER reactor will not produce electrical energy, it will be used only for research and development of technologies for initiating and maintaining fusion reactions.
This method of generating electricity has long been used in thermal and nuclear power plants, but thermonuclear power plants will differ in that as a result of their operation there will be no harmful by-products and they will be safer than conventional nuclear power plants.

title: Abbas says East Jerusalem can only be the capital of Palestine
text:
TASS, January 14.
Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas spoke on Sunday in Ramallah at an emergency meeting of the Central Council of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO).
In a speech broadcast by Palestine Al Yawm, he said that "East Jerusalem can only be the capital of the state of Palestine."
"This is our city and our land, we will not leave it," Abbas said.
According to him, “the Palestinians are now experiencing a crucial moment in their history, on which their future depends. ”
"We will not submit to the dictates of anyone and will not repeat the mistakes of the past," Abbas said.
He called Washington ’ s threats to the Palestinian people “shameful ” and also sharply criticized the intentions of the administration of US President Donald Trump to stop financial assistance to the autonomous administration.
"It is no longer acceptable for us that the United States remains the mediator between us and Israel," Abbas said, adding that "we will again go to the United Nations so that the Palestinian state becomes a full member of the international community, let the Americans use the veto every time."
Abbas made it clear that the PLO is also under pressure from Arab capitals.
"We do not interfere in the internal affairs of the Arab states, but we will not allow the Arabs to interfere in our affairs," he said.
The Palestinian leader stressed that the implementation of the peace agreements signed in Oslo in 1993 had been “stopped by Israel. ”
According to him, “the agreements reached in Oslo no longer exist. ”
Abbas accused the United States and Israel of disrupting the peace process.
However, he stressed that the administration in Ramallah "will no longer allow Palestine to remain under the occupation regime free of charge."
Abbas noted that "it is no longer acceptable for the Palestinians that the United States remain intermediaries [in contacts with Israel] and impose its will on them."
“We support the peaceful popular resistance that began in Palestinian cities in response to US President Donald Trump ’ s decision to recognize Jerusalem as the capital of Israel, ” he said.
Abbas warned that "the Palestinians will break off relations with any state that moves its embassy to Jerusalem."
He also noted that the Palestinians “remain committed to negotiations for a peaceful settlement under the auspices of the UN and do not call for war. ”
The meeting in Ramallah was opened by Selim Zaanoun, President of the Palestinian National Council (PNC).
He stressed that the participants of the meeting are faced with the task of adopting “a comprehensive plan to counter the US decision to recognize Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and the measures taken in the Holy City by the Israeli occupation authorities. ”
The PLO is recognized by the international community as the sole legitimate representative of the Palestinian
The PLO Central Council is its extended governing body, which is convened between sessions of the NSP.
This meeting will be held under the slogan "Jerusalem, the eternal capital of Palestine".
It is attended by 90 of the 114 members of the Council, as well as 160 observers from public organizations.
The Islamic movement Hamas and the radical group "Islamic Jihad" (banned in Russia) refused to participate in the meeting.
The Islamists offered Abbas to hold a forum in Beirut to “avoid Israeli influence. ”

title: Berlinale 2018: What Men Do
text:
The new Gus Van Sant film shown in the competition "(Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot) is a film adaptation of the autobiography of the same name by caricaturist John Callahan (redheaded for the role of Joaquin Phoenix), also a man of outstanding destiny.
At the age of 21, being in a state of drinking, he was in a car accident, after which he experienced paralysis of the lower extremities.
From that moment on, Callahan decided to fight alcohol addiction with the help of a twelve-step program (under the wise guidance of a pleasant beard performed by Jonah Hill), and put all his frustration with the surrounding reality in the channel of caustic caricatures on taboo topics.
Over time, he will come to try on with himself - he will overcome the difficult relationship with his mother, and then he will go to apologize to everyone to whom he did some dirty. The colorful fate of the sarcastic artist Callahan in the hands of Gus Van Sant suddenly turns into a cherished and standard biopic in the spirit of the "Stephen Hawking Universe".
The only difference is that neither the figure of the famous theoretical physicist nor the style of the director of the film about him meant anything else.
Van Sant, and so picked up recently, won a world name uncomfortable questions and desperate plots from the life of the marginalized, and drawings Callahan, coming to life here in animated inserts, generally do not fit with such a loud reconciliation and Zen.
The situation is not saved by the impressive ensemble headed by Joaquin Phoenix, who plays a cartoonist that in his twenties, that in his forties without any makeup, only with changing hairstyles.
There is a tiny role in Udo Kira, and angelically bright Rooney Mara in the role of a flight attendant, and enveloping the velvet voice of Hill.
Each, indeed, his own: over the years, many cinnics lose gallons of poison, but from the variants of the approached complacency version of another American independent - Todd Solondza with his "Dachshund" - looks more charming and whole.The hero of another competitive film "(The Prayer) is also trying to embark on the path of correction.
22-year-old drug addict Tom (amazingly organic and talented young actor, for whom this work is the first big role in the movie) is treated for heroin addiction in a religious community located in the French mountains.
Former drug addicts are united not only by the desire to overcome the craving for drugs, but also by common works and prayers, songs and performances about Jesus.
Tom at first does not quite share the benevolent mood of others and even tries to leave the community - and at this moment he gets acquainted with the pretty Sybil (), but gradually he is imbued with general optimism and faith in prayer, which can overcome not only addiction to heroin, but also heal quite real wounds.
From this confrontation Kahn, however, as in most of his other paintings, the most famous of which, probably, is the story of a real maniac "", does not make a tragic, bright opposition, does not add any spectacular scenes and plot twists (although the story of a religious community in our time could acquire frightening details).
“Prayer ” is a perfectly smooth, measured, qualitatively filmed story of growing up and making complex decisions in the simplest ways.In the center of the Iranian film“ ” (Knook) is also a person of the creative profession.
The capricious and eccentric director Hassan (), even proud of his forbidden status in Iran, has no way of finding a place in the world of new reality, where the most popular is his competitor, with a clever look reflecting on the camera that “love will save the world ”.
The ban on shooting does not allow the birth of new masterpieces, the glory of Hassan is gradually fading.
Meanwhile, a strange maniac with a pig head appears in Tehran, killing and brutally cutting off the heads of filmmakers, but he never comes to Hassan, which, of course, causes a new round of creative torments.
In an attempt to increase the popularity of Hassan himself goes in search of a criminal in the hope of directing at least his own death.The author of “The Pig ” Mani Hagigi is an ironic and self-critical director.
In his films, he likes to combine the semblance of a detective story and the socio-political realities of modern Iran, in the cultural space and especially at film festivals known precisely for its banned directors.
In Berlin, for example, for many years in a row, there were actions in defense of Jafar Panahi, who is forbidden to make films in his homeland, however, two of his works already made after this ban, "Closed Curtain" and "Taxi" were presented at the Berlin International Film Festival, "Taxi" was marked with the "Golden Bear".
Hagigi ’ s previous film “The Dragon Comes ”, by the way, was also shown in Berlin two years ago, but he did not receive any awards.
So the current “Pig ” looks quite relevant here, even despite a fair share of sarcasm, which in the current competition is still little appreciated by anyone. The man of the“ romantic ” category was the hero of the Mexican film “: veterinary student Juan (Gael Garcia Bernal) decides, together with his friend Wilson (), to rob the National Archaeological Museum in Mexico, which is about to close for reconstruction.
Friends manage to steal a pair of sports bags with valuable artifacts of the Maya, Mixtecs and Zapotecs, but selling them, of course, is not easy.
Further journeys of Juan and Wilson include a comical crossing of the border, a meeting with a collector of old things (the great Simon Russell Beale), who knows how to determine their authenticity, licking, desperate drunk dances on the beach in Acapulco and a conditionally tragic ending in the spirit of the films of the 70s. A professional, not two veterinary students.
Such a replacement is needed by the Museum for a poetic and touching story about the pursuit of a better life.
No matter how cozy and family life may seem Juan, he is a figure of eternal dissatisfaction.
The youngest son, whom they did not want, is called a midget and a short one, reminded that it is time to finish university and join his father in the family business of treating animals.
Finally, at the Christmas party, with which he escapes with Wilson on business, he is entrusted with the role of Santa Claus, in which the grandfather, who died this year, previously dressed up.
Juan is a patriot of national culture, interested in the Aztecs, fascinated by the funerary mask of King Pacal, which he steals with special solemnity.
The true reason that provoked him to such a reckless adventure in the film, fortunately, is not called, but it is easy to choose your own.
In one Ruizpalacio mounts the preparation for the robbery in the spirit of “Big Kush ”, in the other he voices a set of stop frames with dialogues in real time, creating the effect of a video report from the crime scene.
But the best scene of the film is a hilarious fight in the spirit of a soap opera with a bright light spot, as in the photo with a flash: Juan gets involved in defending the honor of the dancer Scheherazade, whose films he watched to the holes.
This scene perfectly illustrates the content of the picture: two young people, who did not have time to lose their childhood ideals and ambitions, start a crime, as in the movie, but experience a tough clash with reality (Wilson, in addition, dies a long sick father).
The sad irony of the Museum is that this twisted plot is just as doomed to oblivion as the entire cultures on which modern Mexico stands.
The story turns into an outlandish exhibit (the camera does not accidentally dig into automatic telephones and other signs of the time), whose motives, details and details are eroded over time.
No matter how much Wilson tries to perpetuate this modest tragedy of the spirit, he only delays the inevitable: the transformation of the object into an artifact, and then into a fake surrounded by legends.

title: Video of testing the world ’ s largest aircraft
text:
MOSCOW, 27 feb — RIA Novosti.
In the Network appeared a video of tests of the prototype aircraft Stratolaunch, during which he made several runs on the runway.
The video was published on Twitter by one of the project ’ s leaders, Paul Allen.
Testing took place on February 24 and 25.
To check the operation of engines and on-board systems, the device performed several trips.
On the runway, Stratolaunch reached a speed of 46 miles per hour (74 kilometers per hour).
Captured new video of @ Stratolaunch plane as it reached a top taxi speed of 40 knots (46 mph) with all flight surfaces in place on Sunday.
The team verified control responses, building on the first taxi tests conducted in December.
pic.twitter.com / OcH1ZkxZRA — Paul Allen (@ PaulGAllen) February 26, 2018 Stratolaunch is planned to be used as an aerial launch platform to launch launch launch vehicles to deliver cargo to low Earth orbit.
The wingspan of the aircraft is 117 meters, the weight is 230 tons.
According to preliminary calculations, the device will be able to lift up to 250 tons of cargo into the air.
The first test flight is expected to take place in 2019.

title: Video of testing the world ’ s largest aircraft
text:
TODAY 00: 12 2018-02-28T00: 16: 19 + 03: 00 Stratolaunch drove on the runway at a speed of 74 km per hour [video] Resize text: A A Video shot during the testing of the prototype of the world ’ s largest Stratolaunch aircraft appeared on the Internet.

title: UN: Poor farmers need protection from extreme climate events
text:
Natural disasters such as drought and floods caused $96 billion in damage to crops and livestock in developing countries between 2005 and 2015.
Half of this amount came from Asian countries, according to a study by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO).
Experts said that there is a need for greater protection of low-income farmers.
According to the Thomson Reuters Foundation.
“Asia in terms of natural disasters is the most affected region simply because it has been hit by a lot of tropical storms and heavy monsoon rains, ” explained one of the study ’ s authors, FAO risk adviser Stefan Baas.
In addition to rainfall, Asian agriculture has also been hit by earthquakes, tsunamis and extreme temperatures.
According to the study, drought alone caused $29 billion in damage to the agricultural sector in all developing countries.
In Africa, the loss of agriculture from natural disasters amounted to $26 billion over the past decade, and in Latin America and the Caribbean - $22 billion.
Drought has become the most costly natural disaster for crop and livestock production in these two regions.
Due to crop pests and animal diseases, African farmers suffered $6 billion in damage.
According to FAO Director-General José Graziano da Silva, climate change could exacerbate the effects of natural disasters Efforts to reduce such hazards and better manage them must become part of modern agriculture to achieve sustainable development.
According to FAO estimates, around 2.5 billion people worldwide depend on agriculture.
Measures to limit risks include the use of drought-resistant or flood-resistant seeds, early warning systems for extreme weather conditions, and farmers' access to insurance and financing.
The study, which excludes industrialized countries, Ba ’ ath promised, will be updated every two years and used as a tool to monitor global commitments to combat poverty and climate change.
The material was provided by the project "+ 1".

title: Inside the Istanbul daughter-in-law. Turkish TV series threaten Uzbekistan
text:
Inside the Istanbul daughter-in-law.
Turkish TV shows threaten Uzbekistan 00: 11 21.03.2018 Not everyone knows that Turkish TV shows in Uzbekistan are banned with enviable regularity.
In this process, we can conditionally distinguish three stages: the ban of the 2000s, the ban of 2012 and, finally, the current period, which began in February this year.
Curiously, there are prohibitions, and no one knows the reasons for them.
In any case, no one gave any clear official explanations on this matter.
However, some TV viewers still know something about something.
It seems that one of the reasons for the bans is the periodic deterioration of relations between Uzbekistan and Turkey.
Another reason is the discontent expressed about the series by the national clergy.
Bet on the rating Digital broadcasting made the series available to the widest segments of the population of Uzbekistan – first of all, of course, for women.
Among all the series, the first place here is confidently held by the Turkish.
In popularity in Uzbekistan, they have long overtaken both Korean and even local Uzbek.
It is not surprising that many TV channels in Uzbekistan are betting on the “Turkish horse ”, hoping to raise ratings and expand the audience.
It is considered that Turkish TV shows, despite their "foreignness", in the sense of depicting life, culture and mentality are very close to a simple resident of Uzbekistan.
Fergana talked with representatives of the reference group, and, more simply, with fans of Turkish TV series.
Housewives, pensioners, state employees and other viewers, hooked on Turkish soap, admit that they worry about the fate of screen characters sometimes more than for the fate of their real friends.
It is not surprising that they are amazed and upset by the bans on Turkish films, from time to time descended by someone unknown from the very top.
“When my favorite TV series“ The Magnificent Century ” was removed from the TV network together with the Russian TV channel “Domashny ” in 2013, I began a real depression, ” recalls the lover of Turkish soap operas, the dispatcher of Nargiz from the village of Kibray, Tashkent region.
- I then with great difficulty reached the television, and they told me that the series was removed for technical reasons - it is clear that they were lying.
After that, I heard that the case had to do with politics. ”
According to Nargiza, she and other viewers received the same blow after learning about the termination of the broadcast of the scandalous series "Black Love" (on the private TV channel ZO "RTV).
Now she finds solace in watching other Turkish series, which are broadcast on the state channel Toshkent.
Former literature teacher Shoira Saidovna from Tashkent believes that if you really want, you can find fault even with the classics.
“The clergy have spoken out against Black Love, accusing the series of spreading debauchery, ” she says.
- Then why not demand to ban "Anna Karenina" or "Quiet Don"?!
After all, following their logic, there are also many things in these books that "do not correspond to the Uzbek mentality."
Spectator debauchery is not afraid At the moment, almost half of the 13 state TV channels broadcast Turkish TV series.
In addition, they are shown on four of the six private TV channels.
Of the state channels, Turkish TV shows show the most on "Tashkent", "Cinema", "Uzbekiston" and "Yeshlar" ("Youth").
Among private channels in this category are Milliy (National) and Sevimli (Beloved).
Here are some of the most popular Turkish TV series in the country, which are on the TV channel "Sevimli" almost daily: "Ickarida" ("Inside"), "Istanbullik kelin" ("Istanbul daughter-in-law"), "Onamning yarasi" ("My mother's wound"), "Ezo"...
A shot from the series "Istanbul daughter-in-law" Some series continue for months, they are watched by whole families.
An employee of the TV and radio company, who asked to be called Muyassar, believes that the current celebration of Turkish TV series is due to the “resuscitation ” of relations between Uzbekistan and Turkey.
The impetus for improving relations was the visit of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan to Uzbekistan in November 2016 and the return visit of Shavkat Mirziyoyev to Istanbul in October 2017.
It was after this that the private Uzbek television station ZO "RTV began broadcasting the Turkish soap opera" Kara sevda "(" Black Love ").
Before that, in the time of Islam Karimov, Turkish television production, as well as all Turkish, had a strict taboo.
Not surprisingly, when Black Love was banned last month, it sparked a flurry of outraged comments on social media.
It is believed that the series fell into disgrace due to a series of critical articles on the Islamic website Azon.uz and negative statements of the scandalously famous Tashkent imam Rahmatullo Saifuddinov.
According to the mullah and the authors of other critical publications, such films are alien to the Uzbek mentality, since they contradict the dogmas of true Islam and corrupt young people.
However, the audience is not afraid to be depraved and demand the resumption of the show.
Here are some of their comments on ZO ’ RTV ’ s Facebook page.
“If you think this film is ‘ vicious ’, why don ’ t you remove another Turkish TV series from the air – ‘ Inside ’, which will be worse than ‘ Black Love ’? ”
"ZO" RTV, you are losing your audience - many people do not want to watch you already! "
"Return the series, let those who are not satisfied with the content of the film, watch movies to their liking, they are teeming with other channels!"
(The style of the words is preserved.)
"Fergana".)
Some believe that the removal of the series from the air is not accidental: the Uzbek clergy thus trying on the role of a religious censor.
However, to understand the hostility to this series is difficult.
Marriage of convenience, adultery, premarital sex, unwanted pregnancy, murder out of jealousy and blackmail - all these stories are found in any melodrama, especially stretched over hundreds of episodes.
So why are Turkish TV shows a threat to the Uzbek nation?
The fight with TV series on television seems all the more strange that any of the movies you like today can safely watch online on the same YouTube, not to mention the numerous torrents.
So the ban on television will not save anyone from anything, but it can show the prohibitions in a very disadvantageous light.
In 2017, the Turkish TV series Black Love became the first Turkish melodrama to win an international Emmy Award in the Best Telenovela category.
It is clear that the audience was waiting for him with special interest.
However, the show of "Black Love" on the Uzbek TV channel ZO "RTV on February 16 was suspended.
This was preceded by an article written in a threatening tone and published two days earlier on the Islamic website Azon.uz.
The article was directed against Uzbek artists who duplicated the series.
The author of the article Ziyavuddin Rahim threatened the actors with the punishment of the Almighty, because, in his opinion, their activities fall under the concept of "haram", that is, it can be considered sinful, vicious and cursed.
Rahim called the Uzbek artists involved in the dubbing of the series, "the most ardent traitors of the nation, troublemakers, duplicitous and hypocrites," and urged to fight against them, threatening that otherwise there will come, no less, the end of the world.
Footage from the TV series "Black Love" Following the clergy against the series, the media monitoring center at the Press and Information Agency of Uzbekistan spoke.
The conclusion of the center refers to the contradiction of the series to the national mentality and traditions, as well as to the family values of Uzbeks.
However, here the scythe unexpectedly found on the stone.
The website Azon.uz, which posted Ziyavuddin Rahim ’ s controversial opinion, in turn, was criticized by Uzbek officials.
According to Ozodlik, Bobomurod Rustamov, an employee of the Committee on Religious Affairs under the Government of Uzbekistan, said that the author of the publication "violated the boundaries of what is allowed."
For this reason, Rahim ’ s article was sent for examination.
Moreover, Jamshid Nabiyev, head of the licensing department of the Uzbek Press and Information Agency (UzAPI), believes that the publication contains extremist appeals, so appropriate measures will be taken against the Islamic site.
It is not yet clear whether there has been any punishment for those who posted the aggressive publication, but it seems that it has been removed - an error message appears when you try to open the page.
According to the employee of the NGTRK Muyassar, for many years of work on television, employees have already become accustomed to various kinds of force majeure and bans.
Repressive measures in periods of "thaw" successfully coexist here with positive undertakings.
"Remember, in the early 2000s, religious radicals intensified and terrorist acts occurred in different parts of Uzbekistan," Muyassar said. - Then, too, mass bans began, including on Turkish film production.
Even CDs with Turkish films on religious themes were banned.
Few people understood then that all this was the result of the complication of our relations with Turkey.
Do you seriously think that after watching the film, people will rush to buzz on the streets or wander around in brothels?
No, bans can't solve the problem.
For that matter, the main causes of any discontent and problems in society should be sought in mass unemployment, lack of money for living.
Migration, infidelity, divorce, "love triangles" and unheard of crimes (murder of children by mothers or, conversely, parents by children) - all this came from life in the series, and not vice versa.
And there are a lot of such series – why did you stick to “Black Love ”?
I think that both the good and the bad come from family, upbringing, values instilled in the human environment.
And movies and books, at best, only teach the difference between good and bad.
That ’ s what our clergy should think about. ”
On the private TV channel "Milliy", where the Turkish historical melodrama "Empire of Qesem" is now successfully being performed, they hold a slightly different point of view.
Poster series "Empire of Kesem" "This is called to make a fly of an elephant, - says the employee, who wished to remain unnamed. - The real ban affected only the melodrama" Black Love "on ZO" RTV.
It will take some time, and everything will return to normal again.
At one time, in 2012-2013, the series "Magnificent Century" also suffered - it was closed together with the Russian TV channel "Domashny".
This happened after a wave of arrests and expulsion of Turkish businessmen from the country.
One of the big bosses saw then in the characters of the films the spirit of rebellion.
We, it happens, also call unknown persons from the street, demand removal from the air of this or that picture, scolded for the "unbridled" of the plots.
People are different.
Previously, while working on the state channel, we were forced to cut out even kissing scenes from films.
We translated our own films, omitting "indecent" or overly emotional language.
Then there was a whole department of censorship, now it is gone.
Today, all issues related to ethics on state channels are decided by the Art Council.
Private channels make their own decisions.
By the way, the same "Black Love", it seems, even in Turkey itself at some point was banned - there are many scenes in it that clearly do not fit with the Muslim mentality.
I was still wondering: how this series can be watched together in the same room, where not only the daughter-in-law with her husband, but also the father-in-law or mother-in-law...
Perhaps the imams were outraged by this fact, and not something else. "
Either way, history repeats itself.
A few years ago, Turkish melodramas were banned in Uzbekistan for "unacceptable" content.
Then they were rehabilitated - and here is a new round of bans.
Local imams are again trying to resist their introduction - and in this struggle, it seems, any methods are used.
Poorly affect the gene pool In recent years, the topic of confrontation between spiritual, religious and secular norms has become increasingly relevant in Uzbekistan.
This is especially clear if we take into account the aggressive attitude of the local clergy, concerned with the struggle for the morality of society.
Sometimes it gets funny.
Thus, the imam-khatib of the cathedral mosque "Mirza Yusuf" of the Yunusabad district of Tashkent Rahmatullo Saifuddinov said that Turkish series adversely affect the gene pool of the nation.
This was said on March 2 during the Friday sermon.
According to the minister of the cult, from women who think during sexual intercourse not about their husband, but about beautiful actors from Turkish TV series, gay children are born.
Despite the obvious absurdity of this statement, it caused fierce controversy, dividing the Internet audience into two opposing camps.
To be fair, most commentators made the imam laugh.
Saifuddinov has already made quite strange statements - including about men involved in gynecology and obstetrics.
His calls to “stop it, ” that is, to actually deprive doctors of the right to a profession, immediately dispersed on social networks, causing a storm of indignation among users.
However, later he refused his statements that a male gynecologist is a shame, but from the song, as they say, the words can not be thrown out.
As for "Black Love", here, as already mentioned, opinions diverged.
Opponents of the series, in particular, wrote on the page of the channel ZO "RTV on Facebook the following:" husband and wife, although married 5 years, sleep in different rooms ";" married woman continues to date her beloved ";" married man meets other women ";"... wants to kill his mother ";" he is a cheater, and wants to blame everything on his wife ";" naked women "One woman doesn ’ t have a scarf on her head. ”
Finally, a sacramental question was asked: “What spiritual food do you intend to draw from this series? ”
Ozodlik commented: “The ban on a Turkish television series that angered Muslim leaders in Uzbekistan is seen as part of President Shavkat Mirziyoyev ’ s broader effort to adopt a new approach to Islam – at least with regard to moderate Muslims. ”
If this is the case, as Ozodlik believes, it is obvious that this is an unprecedented turn in relations between the state and the Muslim clergy.
The fact is that “Black Love ” is broadcast in more than 70 countries around the world, including such countries as Afghanistan, Iran and Pakistan.
And only in Uzbekistan, in fact, much more secular, the clergy saw in the series almost a call for debauchery.
How should such processes be interpreted?
Perhaps these are the fruits of the rising "Islamic democracy", which finally felt its strength after the end of the brutal control of spiritual life in society by the punitive Karimov structures.
It is also possible that the removal of Black Love from the air is a step by the Uzbek government towards the official clergy in order to calm and direct its activity in the right direction.
The reforms initiated by current President Shavkat Mirziyoyev are unprecedented for Uzbekistan.
Especially impressive is his actions against the once powerful National Security Service (NSS).
It is considered that the positive changes for the Muslims of the republic are counted from January 31 - from the very day when Mirziyoyev managed to dismiss the permanent head of the National Security Service Rustam Inoyatov.
For the sake of justice, it must be said that the strengthening of the influence of the clergy in public life takes place not only in Uzbekistan.
Fergana has already told that with the approval of the government, erotic scenes will be cut out of all domestic and foreign films shown in Tajikistan in the near future.
A month earlier, a ban on the demonstration of such scenes was introduced in Kyrgyzstan.
Relevant amendments were also made to the Kyrgyz law "On State Support for Cinematography".
The fact that Uzbek Muslim leaders are becoming more active can be seen even in their social media posts.
Increasingly, they talk about the need to ban certain works of film art, criticize the scenic outfits of artists that do not meet the norms of Islamic morality, demand the introduction of hijabs, and also allow minors to attend sermons in mosques.
Thus, the imam of the Tashkent mosque, Shermurod Togay, is indignant at a certain film on the Uzbekiston TV channel (obviously, we are talking about a domestic historical picture), in which they undeservedly laugh at "respected ashons".
"In Russian films, despite the fact that their kings (finished) drunkards, engaged in adultery, they are always exalted..." - indignant priest.
Togai criticizes the filmmakers, saying they distorted the story by portraying Uzbek women performing a "belly dance" in royal palaces.
And this is in the “post-temur ” times, when our women could not think about removing the veil from their heads – and then suddenly they dance half-naked!
He is no less outraged by the fact that Uzbek men are depicted with hair hanging below the ear.
Whatever it was, one thing is obvious: individual representatives of the clergy are increasingly trying not only to influence people ’ s lives, but also to build the whole society in accordance with their ideas about good and evil.
The question is how far they will go in these attempts and to what extent the state is ready to meet them 20.03.2018 Source - fergananews.com Permanent address of the article - http: / / www.centrasia.ru / newsA.php? st = 1521580260 News of Kazakhstan

title: Presented the world 's largest liner
text:
Worldwide, new flagships and innovative aircraft are produced annually.
What is the most popular among the characteristics of aircraft?
Of course, this is the maximum range and kilometers of non-stop flights.
But the dimensions also deserve attention!
The title of the world ’ s largest liner gets Stratolaunch.
Stratolaunch broke into a new phase of development in the world of air transport - it descended to the runway at a speed of 46 miles per hour.
It may seem that the numbers are not so large, but given the large dimensions of the liner, it becomes clear that the figure is impressive - you just have to look at the giant body of the aircraft with double fuselages sliding on concrete.
Stratolaunch did not immediately acquire these chic indicators for him - first tests and subsequent modifications were carried out.
In December 2017, a low-speed test recorded a speed of just 28 miles per hour.
Obviously, it was necessary to improve the aircraft, especially the opportunities were.
Actually, they were used - now the speed reaches 46 miles, as already mentioned.
Still, the tests of the liner are not finished - in 2019 Stratolaunch expects another test flight.
Before that, the massive liner and its 6 turbofan engines have already been tested. Where?
The Mojave air and space ports in California were provided.
Microsoft co-founder, Paul Allen, plans to send the world ’ s largest liner beyond passenger and commercial operation — he would like to bring Stratolaunch closer to space.
Why not?
The use of an aircraft can significantly reduce the cost of access to low Earth orbit - a team of enthusiasts also suggests that the reliability of the aircraft will not yield to professional equipment.
The development of Stratolaunch was engaged in the Californian company Scaled Composites, specializing in conceptual liners.
What is it remarkable for?
The company was awarded the Ansari X Prize – it allowed to design the first private spacecraft.
Launched in 2004 with the participation of SpaceShipOne, it is designed for reusable manned operation.
Getting closer to the stratosphere What exactly would Paul Allen want to achieve?
His concept reveals the use of this large-sized aircraft as a platform to lift rockets into the stratosphere.
Predominantly this would be carried out before launching rockets directly into space.
Here, the massiveness of Stratolaunch plays into the hand - its dimensions allow you to carry a load of up to 550,000 pounds.
Six huge turbofan engines Pratt & Whitney are included in the equipment of the liner.
As for the wingspan, here the figure reaches 385 feet.
The development of Stratolaunch is not over yet - not all tests have been carried out, now work is underway on a series of tests for low and medium speeds.
The date when it will be possible to commercially use the liner, has not yet been specified.
Nevertheless, there are already those who want to - the co-founder of Microsoft has high hopes for the implementation of new products.
Perhaps, Stratolaunch will be used not only in space – its launch as a civil aviation vessel is not excluded.
Plus in its dimensions is again obvious - such dimensions will allow you to accommodate a large number of passengers on board, but this may be too costly in terms of resources.
The idea of air launch rockets is not new — it flashed in the world of aviation before.
However, together with Stratolaunch, there is an opportunity to find a new approach to the existing “old ” idea.
The Pegasus XL rocket, which was created by aerospace contractor Orbital ATK, is now launched from a modified Lockheed TriStar jet liner.
Confirmation that the projects are not unique can be found from NASA, the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA is the Department of Defense ’ s Advanced Research Projects Office) and Richard Branson ’ s Virgin Group.
They are also developing similar concepts.
The project “Buran ”, a native of the Soviet Union, also provided for the sending of air missiles with the help of an aircraft, namely from its rear part.
A subsequent return to Earth was also contemplated.
Despite the fact that developments similar to Stratolaunch existed before and exist now, no one can equal this air giant.
On the Stratolaunch there is a separate space between the fuselages - there can be suspended missiles from the central part of the wing.
The company engages in business relationships with other businesses.
For example, already started cooperation with Orbital ATK, which will help to launch not only Pegasus XL, but also other models.
The project may seem unnecessarily ambitious, but these ambitions are justified.
Experts in the field of space technology are confident that the project has a successful future — in part thanks to funding from Allen.
In that case, if the subsequent development and improvements of Stratolaunch are successful, and the tests end with favorable indicators, the company will be able to provide crew services and transportation of light cargo to Earth orbit at affordable prices - much lower than current ones.
The option with certain difficulties and failures is also considered - then it will be a bright fragment in space history, captured as the creation of the world's largest liner.
It is worth noting that the Stratolaunch project and its implementation is really a dream for Russian aviation and the country as a whole.
Previously, many similar concepts were put forward, but they remained only ideas that did not go beyond discussions and minimal technical feats.
Stratolaunch is a serious and, above all, a bold project that Russian state corporations could not decide on for at least ten years, or even more.
Many people know Paul Allen as an important face of Microsoft — for a time it really was.
The developer played an important role in the history of the company, which he founded in 1975.
Bill Gates helped him.
Having worked not so short term at Microsoft, he left the company in 1983, but his share remained.
This is only part of Allen's success, but it definitely led to the absolute financial dependence of the businessman - the co-founder became a billionaire.
The future of Stratolaunch is cloudless or gloomy...
If the plane is not launched as planned, it could become another "Spruce Goose" (flying boat made of wood, built in 1947 and used only once; in the foreign version - "spruce goose", in the Russian-language - "white elephant".
This is a property that is extremely expensive for its owner, but it is not possible to get rid of it).
The key moment in the fate of Stratolaunch will be the first flight in 2019.
This will help to understand whether the liner should count on a commercial future.
It will also determine whether the aircraft will be in active service or go to the museum to "Spruce Goose".
This racing flying boat belonged to Howard Hughes, who tried to keep it in working order, spending a million dollars annually until his death.
After the death of the owner, the ship was transferred to the Long Beach Museum, in California.
Now it is in the Aviation Museum of McMinnville (Oregon).
It is worth noting that the famous Spruce Goose never entered commercial circulation - only once Hughes H-4 Hercules was able to make the first and last flight on November 2, 1947.
However, the developers of Stratolaunch hope for a cloudless fate of the liner - they believe that the enthusiasm of Paul Allen, combined with positive forecasts and expert reviews will give a good result.
Now a whole team of experienced and highly qualified specialists is working on the aircraft, who are doing everything to ensure that the efforts involved in the success of Stratolaunch are not in vain.
Perhaps right now, Paul Allen and his team are taking an important and innovative step towards space exploration.

title: Israel and Sudan agree to normalize relations
text:
Israel and Sudan agreed to normalize relations with the mediation of the United States.
The two countries "agreed to the abolition of martial law between the two peoples," according to a joint communiqué issued by the three countries in Washington on Friday.
In the near future, the “ring of peace ” will be more and more, and“ much, much more ” states recognize Israel, US President Donald Trump said during telephone conversations with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and representatives of the transitional government of Sudan.
We can talk about at least five states, one of them may be Saudi Arabia, said trump.
In addition, on the same day, the US president informed Congress that Sudan should be removed from the list of states sponsoring terrorism, which currently includes Iran, Syria and North Korea.
Removing Sudan from the list could be used as a means of pressuring negotiations to normalize relations with Israel.
In Sudan, in April 2019, as a result of mass protests, authoritarian President Omar al-Bashir was overthrown, after which a transitional government was installed in the country for a three-year period.
Then new elections must be held.
The agreement on normalization of relations between Israel and Sudan contradicts the joint position of the League of Arab States (LAS), according to which the condition for such normalization should be a solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, said on the same day in the administration of the head of the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah Mahmoud Abbas.
Representatives of the radical Islamist movement Hamas in the Gaza Strip also sharply criticized the agreement, calling it a "political sin".
Earlier, on October 19, Israel officially established diplomatic relations with Bahrain.
A month earlier, the United Arab Emirates made this decision.
Until then, diplomatic relations with Israel from Arab countries were supported only by Egypt and Jordan.
According to the human rights organization “Betselem ”, in 1967-2013 in the West Bank and East Jerusalem were established 125 official Israeli settlements and outposts and about a hundred illegal.
According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), the Israeli authorities have occupied 35 per cent of the territory of East Jerusalem for settlement construction.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Is there a chance for reconciliation?
In the area of Har Homa, located between Jerusalem and Bethlehem, a new Jewish settlement is being built.
Palestinian representatives believe that Israeli settlement policies erode the chances of a two-State solution to the protracted conflict and impede a peaceful settlement.
The international community has also criticized the construction of settlements.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Israel confiscates private land On lands privately owned by Palestinians, the construction of settlements was prohibited.
The new law legalized settlements built in the Palestinian territories “out of ignorance or at the initiative of the state. ”
Land owners are provided with compensation or the provision of an alternative plot.
The Palestinian Authority does not allow the sale of land to Israel under the threat of the death penalty.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Demolition of Amona The new law does not apply to those Jewish settlements that are to be demolished by a court order.
However, it was with the help of this law that the supporters of the settlements hoped to prevent the forced eviction of the residents of Amona, a settlement in the West Bank, whose residents have been in conflict with the Israeli authorities since 2005.
Forty families were forcibly evicted, and then demolition began.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Barricades and riots The Israeli Supreme Court ordered the demolition of Amun in late 2014.
The deadline for demolition has been postponed several times.
Until recently, members of right-wing groups and settlers opposed the evacuation of residents and the destruction of the settlement.
Many of the opponents of the demolition of Amona specially came here from other places.
In turn, the Palestinians vehemently protested against the continuation of the settlement.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Settler conflict with Palestinians The settlers from Amona believe that the West Bank, occupied by Israel during the Six-Day War in 1967, is the land promised to the Jewish people by God, as evidenced by the Torah.
Today, about 600,000 Israelis live in settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem.
Clashes between Jewish settlers and Palestinians have occurred over and over again.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories New shelter in Ofra In total, some 4,000 apartments for Jewish settlers were illegally built on land owned by Palestinians.
This is a total of 16 settlements and outposts.
They must either be forcibly demolished or legalized according to the adopted law.
Many of the Amona settlers who lost their homes found new shelter in the nearby settlement of Ofra.
Israeli settlements in the Palestinian territories Forced demolition in Ofra No and in Ofra itself, existing since 1975, not all buildings have been erected legally.
Therefore, nine houses built on private Palestinian land should be demolished here by March 5, 2017.
The family of Ben Shushan was also among those who had to leave their homes.
