title: Why Russia tolerates the antics of the DPRK
text:
The Russian team of the seiner "Xianghailin-8" has been held by North Korea for more than a week, but it became known only the day before.
The Russian Embassy in the DPRK worked on the release of the sailors, trying not to make noise, but the scandalous story still leaked to the media.
Why are we forced to tolerate such behavior from a country living including on our humanitarian aid?
The Russian seiner "Xianghailin-8" with a crew of 17 people and a crab catch on board was heading to the Russian port of Zarubino, from where the cargo was supposed to be transported to the South Korean city of Sokcho, but on the night of 16 to 17 July was detained by the border guards of the DPRK.
The detention was knowingly illegal, as it occurred at a distance of 53 nautical miles from the coast of North Korea.
According to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, territorial waters are 12 miles offshore.
The DPRK believes that the convention is not directed to it, and tries to control the zone 50 miles from the shore, which it does not always succeed.
Seiner, again, was detained when he was at a distance of 53 miles.
Currently, the ship is held in the port city of Wonsan, most of the Russian sailors are prisoners of their cabins.
An exception was made only for the captain, his assistant and two South Korean sailors - they were placed in a hotel.
According to Victor Sedler, the director of the Northeast Fishing Company, which owns the seiner, the main problem is the temperature in the cabins, which rises to 35 degrees.
Russian sailors are not allowed to go on deck, are interrogated and searched daily, there was a risk that they will run out of food and water.
Representatives of the Russian Embassy met with the sailors even before the news of their detention spread to the media.
According to the press release of the diplomatic mission, the detainees are healthy.
At the same time, “all necessary measures are being taken to resolve the situation as soon as possible. ”
There is reason to believe that optimism in this case is not unfounded, that soon the sailors will be released, and the seiner will be sent to the Russian port.
In favor of this, says at least the comment of an employee of the Embassy of the DPRK in Moscow, as if by the way mentioned the “good relations ” between Moscow and Pyongyang.
“Before that, our ships were repeatedly detained in the DPRK, and quite often.
And in general, the consequences were never serious.
It took some time, disassembled and released, - said the President of the Far Eastern Association of Sea Captains Peter Osichansky to the newspaper VIEW. - Perhaps there will be a fine for sailors and the shipowner, nothing more.
Most likely, the sailors accidentally got into these waters.
If no crime is established, a maximum of two weeks and the ship with the sailors will be released. ”
Despite all this, the question hangs in the air - why does Russia tolerate such antics from the DPRK at all?
On this topic, let ’ s start with the fact that the antics from the DPRK by and large are forced to endure everything.
And arbitrariness on the part of North Korean border guards is not the biggest problem.
The issues with North Korea ’ s missile and nuclear programs are much more serious, but the “Juche regime ” can be considered a clear example of a truly independent foreign policy, when“ what I want is what I do. ”
Actually, the Juche ideology implies exactly this - identity and self-reliance based on the army (which in the DPRK as a percentage of the population as a whole is the largest on the planet).
In the end, we are dealing with a closed, unpredictable and extremely wayward country that has repeatedly proved that it is able to survive by blackmailing literally the whole world.
When the West accuses Russia and China of acting as “lawyers ” for North Korea, this is not true.
Both Beijing and Moscow regularly subscribe to international sanctions imposed on Pyongyang: as official members of the “nuclear club ” and North Korea ’ s neighbors, by definition, we cannot be satisfied with the violation of the nuclear non-proliferation regime and missile tests near our borders, especially given the fact that the controllability of Korean missile crafts is questionable.
In view of this, even the relations between Pyongyang and Beijing in recent years, experts regard as “cool ”, although the PRC is perceived in the DPRK as the only true ally.
Beijing and Moscow understand better than all other powers who they are dealing with, and see as their main task the removal of tension in the region.
Really hard pressure on Pyongyang can dangerously aggravate the situation, and a full-fledged war (in the future, we recall, a nuclear one) would be a disaster at all.
In such a situation, our only trump card remains those very “good relations ” with the“ Juche regime ”, which are often called “special ”.
With the Russians and the Chinese, the North Koreans are at least ready to keep in touch, talk and negotiate.
It may sound ridiculous, but it ’ s true: the very ability to call Pyongyang to resolve any issues is a luxury few have.
And we appreciate this opportunity, because without it the situation will become much more dangerous.
As such problems are trying to solve in the United States, it is known that the damage to all other parties there will not be counted.
In the end, the Russians and the Chinese periodically have to put aside their own pride and proceed from the fact that the main thing is a positive resolution of important issues for us and the prevention of open conflicts, and not the approach that dictates the ambitions of a great power.
It is possible, of course, to demand the release of the “Xianghailin-8 ” within three hours, threatening Pyongyang with“ decisive measures ” and armed forces, but the development of such a scenario is unpredictable from the point of view of the fate of our sailors and frankly harmful from the point of view of preserving the very possibility of dialogue with the DPRK.
That ’ s why we “tolerate. ”
Even though the situation looks humiliating to us.
Russia, by the way, does not just have “good relations ” with the DPRK – we are the main supplier of humanitarian aid to this country.
Despite this, our sailors are kept in cabins, and two South Koreans are accommodated in a hotel, although formally two Koreas are at war.
It is worth recognizing that our country has never been able to derive any other benefit from the “special relationship ” with the Kim dynasty, and dialogue with the most closed society on the planet was a“ ceiling ” for us.
But the very appearance of the DPRK on the map is a comprehensive merit of our country.
Lee Seung Man and Kim Il Sung (photo: Public Domain) As you know, the two parts of the once united Korea are two zones of occupation, Soviet and American, that is, the DPRK and the Republic of Korea are a kind of analogue of the GDR and Germany in Asia.
The only difference is that at the time of the occupation of the USSR from the north and the USA from the south at the end of World War II, Korea was a Japanese colony, which was supposed to be granted independence as a single power after the victory.
The governments of Kim Il Sung in the North and Lee Seung Man in the South wanted to unite the country under their leadership and were going to fight for it.
Formally, the northerners began, but Kim Il Sung received a personal “good ” from Joseph Stalin not immediately and only after he convinced Moscow that the United States would not intervene in the conflict, and it would end very quickly due to the superiority of the North over the South in terms of weapons (which, of course, was also the merit of Moscow).
The US, as you know, did intervene, and the bloody war, in which Pyongyang twice changed hands, and Seoul four times, ended almost at the same place where it began.
The DPRK lost a little more territory than it acquired, however, and did not acquire anything, in the ancient capital of Korea, Kaesong.
The USSR did not buy anything at all.
The rational format of participation in the Korean conflict, chosen by Stalin (pilots, anti-aircraft guns, military advisers, but not the troops themselves), minimized our physical losses - the same Americans left more than 37 thousand soldiers in Korea.
Even economic losses can not be said - we armed the Chinese army, which thoroughly fit into the Korean war, not for free.
But this is what ultimately determined our geopolitical damage.
Beijing is openly offended by the fact that Moscow uses Chinese soldiers as “cannon fodder ” and refuses gratuitous military supplies.
This resentment was followed by a serious cooling of relations between the two countries and a military conflict on the island of Damansky.
On the contrary, the United States managed to improve relations with Germany and Japan precisely against the background of the Korean War, which became a pretext for the Western world to rally and militarize against the “red threat ”.
It could have ended, and it could have been much worse for everyone.
For example, the commander of the UN troops, General Douglas MacArthur (officially against the DPRK fought not the United States, but the UN coalition) advocated a nuclear strike on the territory of China.
Thus, no one has ever been able to extract any real bonuses from the DPRK.
Communist China is no exception: had it not been for the Korean War, it might have taken control of Taiwan.
For both Moscow and Beijing, North Korea has always been a source of problems and losses, a symbol of unrealized opportunities.
This situation is as stable as the Juche regime itself.
And all we have to do is make sure it doesn't get any worse.

title: Tomorrow SpaceX will test the emergency rescue system of the Crew Dragon spacecraft in flight. This is the last major test before the first operational flight with astronauts on board
text:
Tomorrow, January 18, SpaceX intends to make the final major test of Crew Dragon ahead of the long-awaited Demo-2 mission with the first operational flight of a crewed spacecraft to the ISS.
We are talking about those additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the shooting of the capsule during the flight.
Of course, the launch will be broadcast online, and those who want to watch the broadcast will find it below in this note.
The carrier rocket itself with the ship is already installed at the site of the SLC-40 complex at Cape Canaveral and is waiting for the countdown; a suitable launch window for the launch of the rocket opens on January 18 at 15: 00 Kyiv time.
SpaceX will have four hours to conduct the launch; assess the weather conditions as favorable and state that the probability of a successful launch is 90%.

The first with sixteen Draco engines is designed for orbital maneuvers and orientation of the ship in space, and the second with eight SuperDraco engines is responsible for shooting and controlled landing of the rescue capsule in case of an emergency.
The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.

title: Seafarers helped with water
text:
The crew on the ship detained in the DPRK runs out of food and fuel On the tenth day from the moment of detention by the border guards of the DPRK seiner "Xianhailin-8" Russia managed to ensure that 17 sailors of the ship, 15 of whom are citizens of Russia, and two - South Korea, delivered water on board.
This was announced by the deputy director of the company - the owner of the vessel Sergey Sedler.
As he specified, “Xianghailin-8 ” runs out of products and fuel.
The Russian Foreign Ministry said that it is doing everything possible to “resolve the situation ”.
The representative of the diplomatic mission of the DPRK in Moscow noted that the ship was flying the South Korean flag and the captain has already recognized the fact of violation of territorial waters.
The Russian ship “Xianghailin-8 ” brought water, said the Deputy Director of the North-Eastern fishing company Sergey Sedler.
“We brought water to the ship today.
The delivery was organized by the Koreans at the request of our embassy, ” he said.
He said the ship was running out of food and fuel.
“Now all efforts have been directed to speed up the inspection so that the ship will return home as soon as possible, because everything ends with them, ” he added.
Following the results of yesterday ’ s visit to the ship by employees of the Russian Consulate in the DPRK, the Russian Foreign Ministry issued a statement, according to which it has already “put before the North Korean side the issue of ensuring proper conditions for the detained sailors. ”
A Kommersant source in the Russian Foreign Ministry confirmed that work on the release of the sailors is already underway, and assured that there is no doubt about the positive outcome of the case.
According to the Russian Foreign Ministry, the crew is “in satisfactory condition ”.
The representative of the Embassy of the DPRK yesterday said that the ship was flying the South Korean flag, and that the captain recognized the violation of territorial waters, reports TASS.
He said that now in respect of the seafarers check.
“Given the good relations between Russia and the DPRK, we expect that after the inspection, the sailors and the ship will be sent to the Russian Federation, ” the embassy added.
According to the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, territorial waters end 12 nautical miles from shore, while the ship was detained about 50 miles away.
The All-Russian Association of Fishery Producers sent an appeal to the Russian Foreign Ministry with its interpretation of the actions of the North Korean side.
According to the association, the incident is related to the tightening of control over the activities of Korean ships: in 2018, the Russian border service “stopped the illegal activities of 68 fishing vessels of the DPRK off the coast of Primorsky Krai. ”
The chairman of the Far Eastern regional organization of the Russian Seafarers ’ Union said that the organization is ready to do everything possible to release the ship ’ s crew, even to contact North Korean trade unions if the relatives of the detainees so request.
Recall, on Tuesday it became known about the detention of the North Korean authorities of a fishing vessel with 17 sailors — 15 Russians and two South Korean citizens.

Seiner was escorted to the North Korean port of Wonsan.
The crew is charged with violating the rules of entry and stay in the country.
The Ministry of Unification of the Republic of Korea tried to find out the details of the incident and the situation of the fishermen through the inter-Korean liaison office in Kaesong, but received no response.
On July 19, Seoul sent a similar request through the Red Cross, but this attempt did not end.

Referring to the information of the Russian Consulate in the DPRK, Rosrybolovstvo reported that “on the ship the means of technical control and satellite telephone communication were disabled, mobile phones from the crew members were seized ”, and the captain and his assistant are in the hotel separately from the rest and do not have contact with them.
The deputy director of the company also indicated that the Xianhailin-8 was heading to the Sea of Japan for crab fishing.
One of Kommersant ’ s sources in the Russian Foreign Ministry suggested a possible plot of the incident: the crew was transporting contraband goods.
Seiner could try to escape from the Russian border guards and thus be in the security zone of the DPRK.
According to Sergei Sedler, the ship at the time of detention was without cargo.
"Kommersant" could not quickly get a comment from the Far Eastern Customs Administration.

title: A court in the United States halved the compensation for cancer patients from the herbicide Roundup
text:
A court in the United States halved compensation for cancer patients from the herbicide Roundup He ordered Bayer to pay the plaintiffs $86.7 million instead of the previous $2 billion Moscow.
July 26.
INTERFAX.RU - In the United States, the court of appeal reduced the amount of compensation that the owner of the brand of herbicides Roundup, the German concern Bayer AG must pay to the spouses of Pilliod, who used this herbicide and who because of this began cancer.
According to The Wall Street Journal, now the amount is $86.7 million instead of the previous $2 billion.
Judge Winifred Smith of the California Supreme Court for Alameda County found the previous amount “excessive and unconstitutional. ”
The claimants have not yet formally agreed to accept this compensation.
A Bayer spokesman called the second instance ’ s decision a “step in the right direction, ” but vowed to appeal it again.
The company believes that the courts have not proved the connection of the damage suffered by the plaintiffs with the use of the herbicide, and that the substance in the basis of Roundup - glyphosate - is not a carcinogen and can be used without fear.
The couple of Elva and Albert Pilliod filed a lawsuit against the American manufacturer Roundup, the company Monsanto.
According to them, due to the use of this tool, both developed non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and the manufacturer did not inform about the danger of the herbicide to health.
Since the lawsuit was filed, Bayer has bought Monsanto for $63 billion and became a defendant.
Last week, a federal judge in San Francisco reduced from $80 million to $25.3 million the compensation that Bayer sued another resident of California on the same grounds.
In total, more than 13,400 similar lawsuits against Bayer have been filed in the US courts, Reuters reminds.
There is no consensus on the effects of glyphosate on the body.
The International Agency for Research on Cancer considers this substance "probably carcinogenic", while the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) of the United States claims that glyphosate is safe when used cautiously.
A number of EU regulators also reported that there are no risks of developing cancer as a result of the use of this herbicide.

title: Found in the wall of the gallery picture Klimt recognized as the original
text:
ROME, 17 Jan – RIA Novosti, Alexander Logunov.
Experts confirmed the authenticity of the found picture of the Austrian artist Gustav Klimt “Portrait of a woman ”, which was stolen in 1997 from a gallery in the Italian Piacenza, told RIA Novosti the head of the staff of the police department of the city Filippo Sordi.
The "Portrait of a Woman", believed to have been stolen from the Ricci Oddy Gallery since 1997, was discovered in mid-December by gardeners who were cleaning the walls from ivy.
The picture lay in a niche behind a partition in a black bag, which was hidden by thick vegetation.
Doubts art critics in the authenticity of the find was caused by the fact that the picture remained in excellent condition, being, presumably, abandoned by robbers 22 years ago.
“The research lasted a month from the discovery, experts appointed by the prosecutor ’ s office confirmed the authenticity of the painting, ” Sordi said.
According to him, now there are new examinations of the canvas for the left fingerprints and other evidence that can shed light on the mystery of the abduction of the portrait.
According to one of the most common versions, the kidnappers left the picture in a secluded place immediately after the crime, but were unable to return for it because of the uproar.
"As long as the painting is kept in a guarded safe by the Italian Central Bank, it remains at the disposal of the judiciary," Sordi said.
Despite the fact that the authenticity of the work has been established, investigators do not yet give an answer to another question of this detective story: whether the picture could all this time be in the chamber or was secretly planted there shortly before the discovery.
As told RIA Novosti, the president of the gallery of contemporary art Massimo Ferrari, on the day of discovery of the picture, the museum staff managed to get acquainted with the state of the picture.
“It ’ s too well preserved, especially when it comes to small scratches and a back with traces of wax.
If it was a fake, it would have to be made by a skilled craftsman, ” said the head of the gallery.
According to him, the traces that could be seen on the surface of the painting were quite comparable with other paintings of the museum.
In the conversation, Ferrari, however, does not hide the disappointment that the timing of the return of the portrait of Klimt to Piacenza remains unknown.
A small gallery has already planned for this year a series of events with the participation of the acquired canvas.
"Portrait of a Woman" was included in the list of the most wanted works of world art.
A small picture in green colors hit the front pages of newspapers a year before it disappeared.
In 1996, an 18-year-old student, flipping through a catalog of Klimat ’ s works in the gallery, drew attention to another female portrait that no one had seen since 1912.
As shown by x-rays conducted at the local hospital and subsequent studies, Klimt rewrote an earlier picture, which presumably depicted his deceased muse Maria Munch.
A new version of the painting, painted between 1916-1918, was soon acquired by the Italian collector Ricci Oddi.
However, to appear before the public with a newly acquired history of the picture was not destined.
In February 1997, shortly before the opening of the exhibition dedicated to Klimt, the painting was stolen.
In the conditions of the beginning of repair and turmoil around the organization of the show, the disappearance of the canvas was noticed a few days later.
The main version of the theft was built around the frame found on the roof, which gave reason to believe that the picture was pulled up with a fishing rod, but it is possible that the thieves entered the gallery from the front entrance - it is still unclear whether the outdated alarm system worked.
In 2016, new details emerged in the form of DNA samples found on the frame, but nothing has been reported since.

title: High meat consumption in the West contributes to global warming – UN experts
text:
UN experts believe that the high consumption of meat and dairy products in the West contributes to global warming, and the transition to a plant-based diet could help in the fight against climate change.
This is stated in a large report of the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), reports “European truth ” with reference to the BBC.
Experts did not explicitly encourage people to become vegans or vegetarians.
But they noted that more people can be fed using less land if people eat less meat.
“We don ’ t tell people to stop eating meat.
In some places, people have no other choice.
But it is obvious that in the West we eat too much of it, ” said Professor Pete Smith, an environmental scientist at the University of Aberdeen in the UK.
The report, which was discussed in Switzerland, calls for decisive action to prevent soil damage and desertification that contribute to climate change.
Climate change can have dangerous consequences for food production.
Rising temperatures, increased rainfall and more extreme weather events will affect crops and livestock.
Food production also contributes to global warming.
Agriculture, together with forestry, accounts for about a quarter of greenhouse gas emissions.
Cattle farming contributes to global warming due to methane gas produced by animals, as well as deforestation, for example, to expand pastures.

title: Humanity will face the threat of mass starvation – UN experts
text:

103 specialists from 52 countries worked on the report for more than two years.
Experts described a pessimistic scenario.
If the average global temperature rises by more than 2 degrees Celsius, vast fertile lands are likely to turn into deserts, infrastructure in permafrost areas will be destroyed, and droughts and cataclysms will hit the cultivation and production of food.
It is noted that soil and forests are the ideal “allies ” of humanity in the fight against climate change.
They serve as sinks of carbon dioxide and prevent an increase in CO2 emissions into the atmosphere.
However, mismanagement of resources has changed the situation to the exact opposite, and these territories are now becoming the main drivers of climate change.
Scientists say that agriculture is the “fault ” for the disappearance of 70% of the world ’ s forests.
It is often overlooked that grasslands and savannahs are also key drivers of climate stability.
The tendency to turn these territories into cultivated areas for cereals leads to a large-scale increase in carbon dioxide emissions into the atmosphere.
The report describes how the current economic model amplifies climate change - and at the same time is a victim of these changes.
Experts predict a decrease in the yield of grain crops - and a corresponding increase in food prices.
According to estimates, by 2050, cereal prices could increase by 29%.
If emissions of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere continue to grow at the current rate, in the next 60 years in the United States alone, the production of grain and soybeans will decrease by 80%.
In addition, the increased content of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere negatively affects the quality of products, reducing their nutritional value.
Already, 821 million people on the planet suffer from hunger, and 1.5 billion do not receive the necessary trace elements from food.
Experts believe that the situation can still be corrected.
To do this, it is necessary to optimize agriculture and the food industry on a global scale, as well as to rehabilitate more than 2 billion hectares of degraded soils.
As UNIAN reported earlier, scientists said that there are 12 years left to stop global warming and save the planet from its consequences in human civilization.
But now the deadlines have been reduced.
There is a growing consensus that in fact the next 18 months will be critical to efforts to prevent the onset of a global climate crisis.

title: The Hill: If you want to save the world, start with yourself, give up meat
text:
We need to ensure not only a rapid transition from fossil fuels to clean energy, but a rapid transition from the current industrial model of agriculture to regenerative agriculture that grows mainly plants.
Our diet needs to change as well.
Maxim Isaev,, 09: 50 — REGNUM It is expected that by 2050 the population of our planet will reach 10 billion people, which will lead to a projected 70 percent increase in demand for animal products.
The United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) recently held a meeting in Geneva, Switzerland, to discuss the future impact of agriculture on climate.
IPCC experts have published their official report, which talks about the dangers the world could face if changes in the process of food production are not made.
What is the point of the case?
We should eat less meat, writes Eric Adams in an article for The Hill.
Frans Snyders.
The butcher shop.
It is not the first time that experts from the IPCC have pointed out that animal husbandry plays a leading role in climate change.
In 2014, the IPCC stated that reducing the consumption of livestock products is one of the most effective strategies to mitigate the harmful effects of agriculture on the climate.
High demand for beef, chicken, eggs, pork and other animal products, as well as the agricultural industry model itself, contribute significantly to climate change, deforestation, air and water pollution, and biodiversity loss.
Currently, we use one-third of the land surface, one-third of all grain produced, and up to 16% of the earth ’ s fresh water reserves for raising livestock.
The horrors of climate change are already making themselves felt both in the United States and abroad.
New York City is still recovering from Superstorm Sandy (2012).
Last month, due to heat waves in Western and Central Europe, the Greenland ice sheet released billions of tons of water, raising sea levels by half a millimeter.
Bangladesh is facing millions of climate refugees.
There is no doubt that the US Congress should act as soon as possible.
Against the backdrop of ongoing discussions on a new green course and a new attempt to revise the Baby Food Act, which sets standards for baby food programs such as the national school lunch program, Washington has the opportunity to deal a serious blow to US emissions while improving the health of our nation.
For example, New York adopted the “Green New Deal ”, which involves the transition to diets saturated with a large amount of plant food.
Washington should also pay attention to this approach in the fight against climate change.
We have committed to phase out processed meat and halve red meat consumption by 2030.
The EAT-Lancet report states that countries like the US should reduce meat consumption by 50% by 2050, so we must ensure that not only New York, but the rest of the country joins forces to tackle climate change.
Instead of a system of agriculture that encourages the intensive use of pesticides and concentrated animal feeding practices (CAFO), we should move to a policy of expanding the production of fruits, vegetables and plant-based sources of protein, such as beans and lentils.
Restoring shrubs and grass cover on 25 million acres of land in the western United States that are currently used for animal husbandry would offset up to 23% of all carbon emissions in the United States.
We need to ensure not only a rapid transition from fossil fuels to clean energy, but a rapid transition from the current industrial model of agriculture to regenerative agriculture that grows mainly plants.
Our diet needs to change as well.
Some may say that changing diet on a huge scale is impractical or even impossible.
But I know what I ’ m saying because we ’ ve already tried this approach in the largest city in the United States (New York) and in the largest school system.
Slogans of vegans Daria Dry © IA REGNUM Read also: Bloomberg: To whom does the EU owe the growing popularity among its citizens?
Just ask what the hundreds of people who want to join the New York City medical program prescribing plant-based diets to prevent or combat common chronic health problems, including heart disease and type II diabetes, think about the issue.
You can also find out the opinion of students of public schools in New York, who every Monday enjoy a lenten meal.
Initially, the pilot project was launched in 15 Brooklyn schools, and then spread throughout the city.
Sea levels continue to rise.
With each generation, our children are getting weaker.
Our fellow citizens are forced to move because of climate disasters.
That ’ s why New York City has decided to prioritize policies that encourage the transition to healthy, climate-friendly diets as part of the Green New Deal.
Congress should do the same.

title: Bayer offered to pay $8 billion to settle claims over herbicide Round
text:
Bayer offered to pay $8 billion for the settlement of claims over the herbicide Round On this information, the company ’ s quotes went up sharply Photo: Reuters Moscow.
9 August.
German concern Bayer offered to pay up to $8 billion to settle numerous lawsuits in the United States, the applicants of which believe that the company's product - the herbicide Roundup - can cause cancer, Bloomberg reports, citing sources close to the negotiations.
On this news, the growth of Bayer quotations on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on Friday reached 11%, Reuters reports.
In the United States, the company filed about 18.4 thousand claims, follows from its reporting.
Previously, some applicants who have used Roundup and who have developed cancer, have already achieved multimillion-dollar compensation in court.
The herbicide is produced by Monsanto, but Bayer bought it for $63 billion and is now responsible for lawsuits.
Since the completion of the transaction with Monsanto, Bayer ’ s quotations have been declining for 14 months, the company has lost about a third of its capitalization.
Because of this, the shareholders of the company expressed a vote of no confidence in its management.
According to Bloomberg interlocutors, negotiations on pre-trial settlement of claims and payment of compensation can last several months.
The company is ready to pay from $6 billion to $8 billion, but the plaintiffs' lawyers are demanding more than $10 billion for the refusal of claims.

title: Humanity must give up meat for survival – UN report
text:
In the areas turning into deserts, there are 500 million people.
Over the next 25 years, land degradation could reduce global food production by at least 12%, leading to higher global food prices and disruptions in the supply chain.
Humanity must change its approach to agriculture and abandon meat in order to survive.
This is stated in a new report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC).
107 scientists from more than 50 countries participated in the preparation of the report, with more than half of them from developing countries, which are the most affected by climate change, according to the UN News Center.
See also "Clean" products.
Experts emphasize that land degradation and climate change are interconnected phenomena.
The rational use of land resources will help to reduce the greenhouse gas emissions that cause global warming.
Slowing global warming, in turn, will save the Earth ’ s soil cover from erosion, and humanity from hunger.
According to the report, the growth of agricultural production, including excessive reliance on bioenergy, should not lead to the depletion of land resources and increase in greenhouse gas emissions into the atmosphere.
Of course, soil is needed to feed the world ’ s population, including providing biomass for renewable energy sources, but every year, as the land degrades, the land becomes less fertile.
In addition, the ability of the soil to absorb carbon is significantly reduced.
This accelerates climate change, and rapid global warming leads to further degradation of land resources.
The authors of the report emphasize that humans have a negative impact on 70% of the land cover, not counting glaciers.
To date, already a third of the Earth ’ s soil cover has been affected by erosion, sealing and salinization, leaching of organic substances, acidification, pollution, soil compaction and other negative processes.
In the next 25 years, land degradation could reduce global food production by at least 12%, leading to higher global food prices and disruptions in the supply chain.
“Good land management will help slow and in some cases reverse such adverse processes, ” said one of the authors of the report, Kyoto Tanabe.
In the territories turning into deserts, 500 million people live, and the inhabitants of Asia, the Sahel, the Middle East and the Arab Peninsula suffer the most, experts say.
Globally, 820 million people are undernourished.
But there is a way out: sustainable land use will also contribute to addressing climate change.
Agriculture, forestry and other land uses account for 23% of all greenhouse gas emissions.
At the same time, natural processes on earth absorb almost a third of carbon dioxide emissions, which are the result of fossil fuel use and industrial activities, ” said co-chair of one of the working groups involved in the preparation of the report, Jim Squiya.
According to experts, an important role in the fight against climate change can be played by reducing food losses and switching to a balanced diet that includes products of plant origin, such as grains, legumes, fruits and vegetables, as well as animal products that produce small emissions of greenhouse gases.
The authors of the report suggest switching to plant foods and giving up meat.
This will reduce the emissions of methane that cattle produce.
In 2015, the states adopted the Paris Agreement, in which they promised to keep global warming within 2 degrees Celsius, and if possible at 1.5 degrees Celsius compared with the pre-industrial era.
The new report will be discussed during the upcoming climate and environmental negotiations in New Delhi (India) in September and in Santiago (Chile) in December. * * * The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change was founded in 1988 by the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).

title: Live broadcast of tests of the emergency rescue system of the spacecraft SpaceX Crew Dragon in flight [Beginning — at 16: 00]
text:
In a few hours, the live broadcast of a rather important SpaceX launch will begin.
Of course, we are talking about In-Flight Abort Test for Crew Dragon – the last major test before the long-awaited first operational flight of a SpaceX spacecraft with astronauts on board.
The launch was supposed to take place yesterday, but was postponed to today due to bad weather (strong and steady winds and ocean waves in the splashdown zone).
A suitable six-hour start window opens at 15: 00 Kyiv time.
You can watch the online broadcast directly in this news, or on NASA and SpaceX channels on YouTube (for whom it is more convenient).
As part of the launch, SpaceX will conduct an experiment with a simulated launch vehicle crash to conduct additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the capsule firing during flight.
These tests are not a mandatory part of NASA's Crew Dragon certification program, but SpaceX intends to conduct them on its own initiative to demonstrate the reliability of the SAS.
Initially, the SpX-DM1 capsule was planned to be used for these tests, but it was known to have been destroyed by an explosion during static tests of the emergency rescue system on April 21, 2019.
SpaceX will take for tests the capsule, which was originally intended for the first manned flight with astronauts.
Soon after launch, the rocket will be deliberately destroyed (how, it is not yet clear), and the capsule after an emergency shooting will move away to a safe distance, then release parachutes, and then splash into the ocean.
The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.
The improvement should prevent the very possibility of a repeat of the scenario that led to the crash in April.
Also not so long ago, in preparation for the Demo-2 mission, SpaceX successfully tested new parachutes for Crew Dragon.
By the way, the other day, NASA astronauts held a dress rehearsal of the ground part of the upcoming Demo-2 mission, in which the first operational flight of Crew Dragon with a crew to the ISS will take place.
Astronauts Robert Benken and Douglas Hurley, who will go on a 15-day expedition to the ISS, as part of the Demo-2 mission, put on new SpaceX spacesuits and walked them along the bridge to the ship.
The mission itself is due to take place in the first half of this year.

title: The severity of the law did not prevent the tragedy in the children ’ s camp “Holdomi ”
text:
Global food prices will soar in the coming decades, and the availability of food for tens of millions of people will be much lower.
And all this because of climate change on the planet.
The corresponding forecast is contained in the report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC).
These trends are directly relevant to Russia, but not in such a threatening sense.
“Governments have set the IPCC a difficult task – for the first time in history to comprehensively consider the entire land-climate system.
We have done so thanks to the many contributions of experts and Governments around the world.
This is the first time in the history of the preparation of IPCC reports that the majority of authors, namely 53%, come from developing countries, ” said IPCC Chairman Hveson Lee.
Here are just a few of the report ’ s highlights of how climate change impacts agriculture and food production.
Since 1961, per capita consumption of vegetable fats and meat worldwide has more than doubled, and the amount of food calories consumed has increased by about a third.
This means, among other things, that gross food production has grown substantially in recent decades: per capita food stocks have increased by more than 30% since 1961.
Resources to meet the food needs of the world is enough, there is enough food for everyone, said in 2012 during a meeting between Pope Benedict XVI and the Director General of the UN Food Organization, José Graziano da Silva.
However, the distribution of food in parts of the world is still extremely uneven.
According to the IPCC, 821 million people worldwide are still undernourished, 151 million children under the age of five are stunted, and 613 million women between the ages of 15 and 49 are deficient in iron.
At the same time, about 2 billion adults are overweight or obese, and 25-30% of the world ’ s food production is attributed to loss or waste – sure signs of overconsumption of the notorious “golden billion ”.
The increase in global food production has been accompanied by a gigantic increase in the burden on the ecosystem.
For example, according to the IPCC, since 1961, the use of nitrogen fertilizers has increased by about 800%, and water resources for irrigation – by more than 100%, so that today about 75% of the clean water on Earth is spent for this purpose.
Agriculture, forestry and other land uses account for 23 per cent of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions.
Erosion of soils used for agriculture is much faster than the process of soil formation.
Between 1961 and 2013, the drylands increased by more than 1% annually.
In 2015, an estimated 500 million people lived in areas affected by desertification in the 1980s and 2000s, most severely in South and Southeast Asia, the Sahara region and the Middle East.
Climate change, the IPCC experts conclude, affects all four fundamental principles of food security: food availability (yield and production), affordability (prices and ability to obtain food), consumption (nutrition and cooking) and stability (disruptions in availability).
“Food security will increasingly depend on future climate change as a result of lower yields, particularly in the tropics, higher prices, lower nutrient quality and supply chain disruptions.
We will see different impacts in different countries, but more radical impacts will be seen in low-income countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, ” said Priyadarshi Shukla, Co-Chair of IPCC Working Group III, following the session in Geneva.
The conclusions reached by the IPCC experts require the closest attention, says Ilya Bereznyuk, an expert in the field of agriculture and food, managing partner of Agro and Food Communications.
According to him, for many global corporations in the field of agriculture and food industry, the issues raised in the report are already in the top three strategic development problems: “Planning their development for 10-20-30 years ahead, these companies prescribe climate change issues in their documents and models, paying great attention to topics such as access to clean water, food, etc. Russian companies rarely look so far.
But I would trust the opinion of those scientists who predict serious changes in a few decades. ”
Today, a number of Western intellectuals are generally inclined to believe that climate change poses a fundamental challenge to the model that has been the main engine of the world economy of the last few centuries – a model focused on constant growth and, more broadly, on modernization.
If all the countries that signed the Paris Climate Convention “moved decisively towards the implementation of the modernization projects planned by each of them, they would find the lack of a planet compatible with these projects.
They would need several planets, but they have only one, ” writes French philosopher and sociologist Bruno Latour in his new book Where to Land?, recently published in Russian translation by the publishing house of the European University in St. Petersburg.
We all feel that the earth is falling from under our feet, and this deepens our confusion – this formulation fits well into the pages of the IPCC report that speak of rapid soil degradation.
Access to quality food increasingly determines the social status of a person, says HSE Associate Professor Pavel Rodkin.
In his opinion, given the deterioration of the environmental situation and climate change, a significant part of the world in the future will not be able to produce food not only for export, but also to meet the needs of its own population, in connection with which food production will be increasingly concentrated in technologically advanced zones of the world economy.
However, it is likely to be no longer the products to which we are accustomed, but the food of the future, in many ways reminiscent of George Orwell ’ s dystopia “1984 ”.
Conditional "food 2.0", Rodkin believes, will arise within the framework of a qualitative change in the composition of food - we are talking primarily about the introduction of synthetic, inorganic food for mass consumption.
And at the next stage, there will be a “food 3.0 ”, which can be given any necessary shape, size, weight, color and other characteristics.
Natural products and materials of organic origin will become the subject of a new luxury.
“Man has always sought to optimize the preparation and consumption of food, the appearance of which is responsive to the nature of work and way of life.
It is no coincidence and deservedly one of the icons of mass consumption of the twentieth century was a burger, embodying all the necessary qualities of caloric content, speed of preparation, assembly and quick snack on the go.
Synthetic food, on the other hand, will remove the constraints that still exist when the form and basic characteristics of food are determined by its natural characteristics.
If today the unusual and non-standard shape of the product, for example, the square watermelons grown by Japanese farmers from Shikoku Island, is a purely marketing move, then the new way of producing food allows you to set a new shape that is subject to the functional requirements of storage, transportation, preparation and consumption.
The creation of new forms of food will be engaged in designers – just as in the twentieth century they designed new household appliances.
Functionality and rationality of food design can include solving problems of its rapid absorption, digestion and assimilation in a designated unit of time in order, for example, to optimize working time.
Food 3.0 will not be associated with abundance and diversity, but with the unification of consumption and all life, ” the expert predicts.
However, while the mass transition to synthetic food looks like a very distant future, its main consumers are not starving Africans.
“Artificial meat can gain popularity among a small proportion of residents of large cities, but in general, it will change little, – believes Ilya Bereznyuk. – Shares of companies that produce artificial meat or produce pure protein from locusts can grow, but so far no more than exotic start-ups, which in the next 15-20 years are unlikely to occupy a serious market share.
A very important type of consumption: artificial meat may interest people in glamorous New York or Los Angeles, but not in Texas, where the tradition of growing real meat goes back decades.
The same is true in Russia, Latin America and many other countries.
Despite the fashion for the rejection of animal food, it is unlikely that this will lead to any fundamental changes, and not only because of purely economic moments. ”
The potential of “traditional ” food production is indeed far from exhausted, and climate change is not only making negative adjustments to this process.
As noted in the IPCC report, the increase in average annual temperatures increases the yield of some crops (corn, cotton, wheat, sugar beet) in high latitudes, which include Russia.
This fact recalls the significant export ambitions of the Russian agro-industrial complex.
“At one time, when the ex-Minister of agriculture Alexander Tkachev said that Russia will feed the whole world, many took this statement skeptically.
But if the current trends of climate change continue, Russia will indeed play a more serious role in the global food market, primarily due to its territory.
Despite the fact that 70% of the country ’ s area belongs to the zone of agricultural risks, the territory of grain growing is very large – from the southern regions to Siberia, ” says Bereznyuk.
According to him, the situation with soils in Russia is much better now, including due to not the highest level of use of agrochemistry.
In China, which Russian farmers have long considered as the most desirable export market, the specific indicator of the use of agrochemicals is several times higher, and this has a negative impact on the quality of soils - many lands have become unusable due to the high intensity of exploitation.
The recommendations of the IPCC experts for more efficient use of land resources include a long list of items: the use of sustainable land-use technologies, reducing excessive consumption and waste of food, stopping the clearing and burning of forests, preventing their excessive deforestation, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, etc.
However, there is another crucial factor that will also have a powerful impact on the global food market in the coming years: the continued growth of the world ’ s population.
According to the UN forecast, by 2050 it will grow by 2.5 billion people to 9.1 billion inhabitants, and this growth will occur exclusively at the expense of the poorest countries.
Simple economic logic suggests that with more eaters and fewer opportunities for food production, the cost of food will rise steadily.
To see how this pattern works over long periods of time, it is enough to refer to the statistics of the Food Organization of the United Nations (FAO), which annually calculates price indices for basic food products.
According to these data, the last period of relatively low food prices was in the early 2000s, but they have increased dramatically since then.
Whereas in 2003 the FAO nominal food value index was 97.7 and the real (inflation-adjusted) index was 98.3, at the moment these figures are 169.5 and 137.9 respectively.
The social consequences of food price hikes were recently shown by the Arab Spring of 2011 (when the FAO Integral Index reached 229.9).
All this makes it extremely serious to take the forecasts of experts on climate change.

title: Scientists: global warming threatens biblical misfortunes
text:
In July last year, the capital of Yemen, Sana'a, was attacked by clouds of locusts on July 27, a cloud of grasshoppers covered Las Vegas, being in the center of news releases that flew around the world.
They came from the desert, attracted by the lights of the big city.
At the same time, a cloud of insects invaded Yemen, a country ravaged by civil war and suffering from food shortages.
The second invasion attracted less media attention, though with far more disturbing consequences: it was a locust whose famed gluttony has the potential to wreak havoc on crops in more than 60 countries, mostly in Africa, the Middle East and Central Asia.
These two episodes, at first glance quite different, are, according to some researchers, links in the same chain and threaten to become frequent: scientists warn that global warming entails changes in insect behavior that become more dangerous and less predictable.
Scientists already have evidence that the increase in temperature in the atmosphere leads to changes in the metabolism of insects.
In 2018, a group of American researchers published an article in the journal Science, which states that the warmer the area, the more active the reproductive function of insects, and the better their appetite.
So, desert locusts absorb per day the amount of food equal to its own weight.
Researchers believe that with a rise in temperature of just one degree Celsius, the damage caused by insects to crops of wheat, rice and corn can increase by 10-25 percent.
The greatest damage in this case threatens areas with a temperate climate, where the bulk of agricultural products are grown.
"Everywhere except in the tropics, the increase in temperature leads to an increase in the insect population.
Thus, there are more individuals who eat more, ” writes Curtis Deutsch, one of the authors of the study.
Image caption Rising temperatures are causing insects to eat more and breed more intensively, noting that locusts are not the only pest capable of destroying crops, but remain the only species regularly monitored nationally and internationally.
All because of its bad fame and destructive potential.
The last forty years, the growth of the locust population has been contained, but several serious incidents have occurred, such as the invasion of hordes of insects in 2004 in Africa, as a result of which the damage to agriculture in the form of crop losses reached $2.5 billion.
Although it is estimated that the share of locusts in the total damage from insects is relatively small - only 0.2% - nevertheless, the effect that local populations can have on the region can be devastating.
"Climate change at the northern and southern borders of the desert locust habitat - it is becoming drier - can significantly expand this area, which will have important and negative consequences," Michael Le Coq, one of the world's leading locust specialists, told the BBC.
“The stakes in this game on crops, pastures, food supplies and, ultimately, social security for the poor in such regions can be colossal, ” warns Le Coq.
Locust infestations are one of the oldest disasters known to man; references to it are contained in the Bible and the Koran Ancient enemies As one of the most destructive disasters, desert locusts, according to the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), have the potential to destroy up to 10% of the world ’ s food reserves.
Even a small flock of locusts eats enough food per day to feed 35,000 people.
Their favorite delicacy is the main crops: rice, corn, wheat.
These creatures are one of the oldest enemies of mankind: they are mentioned in the Bible and the Koran.
Thus, in the Bible, the locust invasion was one of the ten famous "executions of the Egyptians" - punishments to which the Egyptians were subjected for the oppression of the children of Israel.
Ancient historian Pliny the Elder tells about 800 thousand people in the territory of modern Libya, Algeria and Tunisia, who died of hunger, the cause of which was the invasion of locusts.
More recently, in 1958, in Ethiopia, locusts covered an area of 1,000 square kilometers and destroyed 167,000 tons of wheat — enough to feed a million people for a year.
The owner of the illustration Getty Images Image caption Locust with its fierce appetite is able to destroy the entire crop in the field at the root More temperate regions are at greater risk: the metabolism of insects accelerates when around warms, but slows down when it gets too hot, as can be seen in the tropics.
It is the general warming in Argentina that experts believe is the cause of the 2016 locust hex - the largest in 60 years.
Further, above, faster than FAO, which regularly monitors desert locust activity, also reports that global warming contributes to the establishment of favorable conditions for the population of locusts, whose adults in such conditions are able to overcome up to 150 km per day.
According to the agency, this means that in the future locusts will move much faster.
The copyright holder of the illustration Getty Images Image caption Locusts got into the lenses of cameras during broadcasts from the World Cup in 2014. Not only that, the increase in ambient temperature allows insects to rise higher and overcome natural obstacles in the form of mountains, thereby opening up new ways of migration, especially in the presence of tailwinds.
"Overall, we expect locust infestations to become more frequent and widespread in the future with global warming," said Erian Sees, director of the Global Locust Initiative at the University of Arizona.
The regions that are most threatened are those that are primarily focused on farming.
At the same time, not only food crop producers are at risk: in Pakistan, due to the invasion of locusts, the safety of the cotton crop, a crop that in one form or another accounts for almost half of the national exports, was threatened.

title: Greening will affect dozens of capital parks
text:

title: SpaceX has successfully tested the crew rescue system Crew Dragon (video)
text:

The next step of the company may be a full-fledged launch into space of a ship with a crew on board.

title: British Coast Guard rescues refugees trying to cross the English Channel
text:
British border guards and the coast guard rescued about 50 refugees who were trying to get into the country from France, sailing across the English Channel in rubber boats.
On Friday, August 23, reports Sky News.
According to eyewitnesses, illegal immigrants were removed from boats off the south-eastern coast of the UK near the coastal cities of Hastings, Deal, Dover and Paradise.
The British Coast Guard has confirmed that there have been a number of refugee incidents off the coast of Kent and Sussex counties.
It is noted that in the first seven months of 2019, more than 1.2 thousand illegal immigrants tried to get to the UK by boat, overcoming the English Channel.
The migration crisis in the EU began in 2015.
According to various estimates, between 1 and 1.8 million refugees arrived in Europe that year.
In 2018, about 103 thousand people reached the European continent by sea.

title: The body of a migrant who sailed from France to Britain was found in Belgium
text:
The body of an Iraqi migrant who tried to cross the English Channel from France to Britain was found off the coast of Belgium.
This is reported by “European truth ” with reference to The Guardian.
The body of a 48-year-old man was found in an improvised life jacket made of empty plastic bottles and carrying a small bag with an identity card, the Bruges prosecutor ’ s office said on Monday.
“This is the first time we have found the body of a migrant, ” said Karl Decaluwe, the governor of West Flanders.
Officials believe the man drowned while trying to swim from a beach in northern France to Britain.
The current is believed to have brought his body into Belgian waters.
The man allegedly decided on such an act after he could not get asylum in Germany.
Six EU countries agreed to accept 356 migrants after two weeks of confrontation Eight days before the body was found, a Belgian sailor spotted a man in a belt of empty plastic bottles begging for help in the waters off Dunkirk.
The sailor informed the French maritime authorities of the incident, saying he tried to save the man, but it was washed away by the current.
About 1,450 migrants have been rescued by British or French coast guards since January, double the number of people who tried to cross the canal throughout 2018, according to official French figures released on Monday.

title: Scientists have listed the advantages of global warming for the economy and agriculture
text:
As an example, scientists talked about climate change in West Virginia.
There, according to a scientist from the local university Jason Hubbart, the growing season is getting longer every year.
Recall that this is the time during which the soil is suitable for growing vegetation.
In the future, the climate in what is now West Virginia is likely to be more favorable for agricultural production.
We have to plan for it now, ” said Hubbart, professor of hydrology and water quality.
Thus, scientists suggest that global warming, although it can bring destruction, in the form of melting glaciers or drought in already arid areas, but they want to remind that climate change can also lead to prosperity in those regions where now the average annual temperature is not high enough for a comfortable life.

title: NSTU NETI engineers developed a “tilter ” for assembly and control of equipment
text:
Employees of the Department of Engineering Graphics of NSTU NETI developed for the international project ITER "tilter" for the assembly and control of equipment, the press service of the university reported.
It is a production mechanism that produces rotation and translational movement of various objects from one post inside the reactor to another.
The tilter also acts as a frame in which equipment and drives are placed that allow for 90 degrees rotation.
The university said that the peculiarity of this “tilter ” is that it will be able to rotate objects up to 50 tons with great accuracy.
This is necessary in order to assemble the port plug.
These are structures weighing about 45 tons, which should protect the equipment from the neutron flux and reduce the radiation background in the areas where specialists will work. — NETI has been in the project for many years, employees are developing part of the port plug.
Now in France there is an employee of NSTU NETI Kirill Pishchevsky, who performs work for INP, - says Alexander Burdakov, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, Advisor to the Directorate, Head of the Laboratory of the Institute of Nuclear Physics SB RAS, Head of the Department of Electrophysical Installations and Accelerators of NSTU NETI.
ITER is an international experimental fusion reactor under construction in France.
China, the European Union, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia and the United States are participating in the work on ITER.
The task of the project is to demonstrate the scientific and technological feasibility of using thermonuclear energy on an industrial scale, as well as to work out the necessary technological processes for this.
The launch of the reactor and the production of the first plasma on it is planned for 2025.
Photo: press service of NSTU NETI

title: The thieves said that they themselves returned the picture of Klimt, found in the wall
text:
MOSCOW, 22 Jan – RIA Novosti.
Two men admitted that 22 years ago they stole and then returned the painting by Gustav Klimt “Rub a Woman ” and not all the time kept it in a niche in the wall of the Ricci Oddi gallery in Piacenza, Italy, where it was found by gardeners.
The two men admitted that 22 years ago they stole and then returned a painting by Gustav Klimt “Rub a Woman ” and not all the time kept it in a niche in the wall of the Ricci Oddi gallery in Piacenza, Italy, where it was found by gardeners, reports The Guardian.
The two men said in a letter to Ermanno Marian, an employee of the newspaper Libertà, that they stole the work of the Austrian artist worth 60 million euros in February 1997, and then returned it, making a “gift to the city ”.
The journalist received a letter from them after the discovery of the “Portrait of a Woman ” in December last year.
It turned out that one of the thieves three years ago said Mariani that he stole the painting, and demanded to organize a meeting with the investigators.
Lawyer Gibo Guglieri told the publication that the thieves allegedly returned the job four years ago.
“It is not yet known exactly how she got into the niche, and where she went immediately after the theft.
The thieves had confessed to what they had done before, but no one believed them.

title: Changing faster than in the world: the weather forecaster made an alarming statement about the climate in Ukraine
text:
Head of the Department of Applied Meteorology and Climatology of the Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Institute Vera Balabukh gave an alarming forecast for Ukraine due to climate change.
About it reports "Apostrophe" with reference to "Gazeta.ua".
“We expect an abnormally warm February.
In Kiev until the third decade of January did not come meteorological winter (when the average daily temperature is below 0 degrees five days in a row - "Apostrophe").
It was three winter days.
In December, seven, but not in a row, ” says Balabukh.
According to her, since the mid-1970s, the average global temperature has passed through zero degrees.
“In Ukraine, climate parameters have been changing since the 1990s.
Change is twice as fast as global change.
Changes the duration of the seasons, the number of summer, frosty and hot days, "tropical nights" (when the air temperature does not fall below 20 degrees during the day - "Apostrophe"), humidification, wind conditions, the number of extreme events.
The frost that we had earlier is associated with the Siberian anticyclone.
He's not here right now.
In autumn and winter, high pressure areas associated with the Azores anticyclone prevail.
Brings warm and dry air.
If it comes from the Atlantic, it is also warm and humid.
It is associated with fog, ” she said.
Last year was unusually warm for Ukraine.
Throughout 2019, there were unusually high temperatures.
February and December were among the warmest in history.
June set a temperature record.
Now the weather corresponds to the middle of November or March.
“Last year ’ s high temperature in the summer led to a decrease in the harvest.
Especially potatoes.
On the other hand, now the duration of the warm period affects December.
It is possible to grow the second and third crops, to breed new heat-loving crops.
Peaches and persimmons are already growing in the Kiev region.
Successfully ripen grapes and eggplants, "- said the weather forecaster.
According to her, the amount of precipitation for the year almost does not change, but their structure changes.
It is mostly rain, not snow.
And the rivers feed on it.
If we lose snow, the amount of water decreases.
This affects the moisture content of the soil and the availability of fresh water for irrigation during the warm period.
“The problem of fresh water is relevant not only for the southern regions.
It is even in Polesie, where until recently drained swamps.
There's sand in there.
And if the rainfall is not enough, it becomes arid.
The area can later turn into a desert.
In some places rain fell (last year - "Apostrophe") with a two-month rate of precipitation.
And then it was dry for two months.
Such changes lead, on the contrary, to an increase in aridity.
Heavy rains wash out the crop, increase soil erosion.
Water doesn ’ t help plants because it drains quickly, ” Balabuh says.
As previously reported “Apostrophe ”, on Thursday, January 23, the Spanish city of Malaga suffered because of the powerful storm“ Gloria ”.

title: Hamas Leader Opposes ‘ Deal of the Century ’
text:
The leader of the radical Palestinian movement Hamas, Ismail Haniyeh, opposed the American “deal of the century ”, considering it the goal of eliminating the Palestinian national project.
He said this in a telephone conversation with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Tuesday, January 28, reports WAFA.
Haniyeh said the Palestinians should oppose the scheme to eliminate the country ’ s national project, noting that its citizens should also adhere to the president ’ s position, which rejects the “deal of the century. ”
Abbas praised Haniyeh ’ s initiative, stressing that the rejection of the project to eliminate the Palestinian plan is based on the national unity of the state.
According to Al Mayadeen, Abbas and Haniyeh agreed on joint steps to counter the American plan.
"Our position remains unchanged: we reject the so-called 'deal of the century' and will oppose its implementation on all fronts, welcoming actions in this direction in Palestine and abroad," Abbas said.
Abbas also said the deal would not pass without the consent of the Palestinian people, warning of "dire consequences for the entire region if the plan is implemented."
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at a press conference with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday called the United States ’ proposed plan to resolve the Palestinian-Israeli conflict a realistic path to peace.
According to him, the plan will give Israel a permanent eastern border, and the whole world a long-term truce in the region, because as a result of its implementation no one will be kicked out of the house.
He added that Hamas would be disarmed and the Gaza Strip should be demilitarized.
In turn, Trump said at a press conference about the need for the Palestinian authorities to stop supporting Hamas, the banned Palestinian Islamic Jihad group in Russia and refuse to compensate the families of suicide bombers, TASS reports.
Earlier in the day, the American leader announced the terms of the “deal of the century ”.
According to the plan, it is planned to make Jerusalem the indivisible capital of Israel, and Palestine to allocate the capital in East Jerusalem.
According to the American president, this will allow the Palestinian side to double its territory.
Before Trump announced the terms of the deal, sources in The New York Times reported that the plan involves the transfer of most of the Jordan Valley to Israel.
Relations between Palestine and Israel escalated in May 2018, after the US moved its embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, which Israel considers its indivisible capital and Palestine claims the eastern part of the city.
The development of the “deal of the century ” began in 2017.
In June 2019, the United States unveiled the economic part of the “Peace to Prosperity ” plan, which refers to the development of Palestine.

title: Palestine will not accept Trump ’ s “deal of the century ”
text:
The Palestinian authorities refused to participate in the “deal of the century ” announced by US President Donald Trump.
The proposed conditions in Palestine were regarded as a "conspiracy".
"We reject the 'deal of the century', - reports TASS the comment of the head of Palestine Mahmoud Abbas on the conditions proposed by Washington and approved by Israel. - Our position has not changed in two years, and today it will not change: we give priority to the resistance front to disrupt Israeli plans."
Abbas said the rights of the Palestinian people, which "will not be neglected."
“Jerusalem is not for sale, and your conspiracy will not pass, ” he said in response to the proposal to recognize the city as the capital of Israel.
Earlier, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praised the terms of the deal proposed by Washington and agreed to them.

title: Palestine rejects Trump's' deal of the century '
text:
Photo: Mahmoud Abbas (flickr.com / statephotos) Palestine ready for negotiations with Israel with the participation of international partners Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas rejected the proposed peace plan to resolve the conflict with Israel presented by US President Donald Trump.
According to Al Jazeera News.

"We will not allow the historical rights of the Palestinian people to be neglected, we are committed to the State of Palestine with Jerusalem as its capital," he said.

title: Unilateral plan: Trump announced the “deal of the century ”
text:
Unilateral plan: Trump announced the “deal of the century ” US President Donald Trump unveiled the plan of the“ deal of the century ” to resolve the Palestinian-Israeli conflict.
According to the "plan", Jerusalem becomes the indivisible capital of the Jewish state, with the Palestinian capital being established in East Jerusalem.
In addition, Israel will have sovereignty over the Jordan Valley, and the territory of the Gaza Strip should be demilitarized.
Palestine has already rejected this initiative.
Experts point to the contradictions of the plan of the head of the White House.
According to analysts, such a deal “has no chance of success ”.
Key aspects of the “deal of the century ” – the plan to resolve the Palestinian-Israeli conflict of US President Donald Trump – were announced at a press conference of the American leader with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the White House.
Trump ’ s plan calls for the creation of two states — Jewish and Palestinian.
Jerusalem remains the “indivisible capital ” of Israel, but Trump promised the Palestinians a capital in East Jerusalem and an American embassy there, as well as a doubling of the territory occupied by the Palestinians.
In addition, according to the Trump plan, the United States and Israel are ready to officially recognize the territories of Palestine, areas that are now under the control of the Palestinians, but on the condition that they renounce terrorist acts.
Palestine will continue to operate facilities in the ports of Haifa and Ashdod.
Transport links will also be established in Palestine and the West Bank.
In addition, according to Trump ’ s idea, Palestinian refugees will be able to choose their place of residence: in the territory of future Palestine, in the territories of current residence, which will be integrated into Israel, or resettlement in a third country.
The plan also includes recognition of Israel ’ s sovereignty over major settlements in the West Bank (Judea, Samaria) and the Gaza Strip.
Under the deal of the century, Hamas would be disarmed and the Gaza Strip demilitarized.
The plan prescribes the preservation of the status quo of the Temple Mount with the mediation of Jordan.
It is noted that in the event of a settlement of the Middle East conflict, Palestine will receive $50 billion in assistance from the United States.
The American leader said that Palestine deserves a "better life", but did not rule out that the plan prepared by the United States may be the last chance for the Palestinians to find their own state.
Trump posted on his Twitter page a map that reflects the supposed borders of the two future states – Palestinian and Israeli.
It shows that two large areas along the Egyptian border will be added to Palestinian territory.
