title: The first step to colonizing Mars. NASA launches a new rover to the Red Planet
text:
On Thursday, July 30, NASA is going to launch its new Mars Rover Perseverance, which will be the first step towards colonizing the Red Planet.
This is reported by Space.com.
Perseverance will be launched on an Atlas V United Launch Alliance (ULA) rocket from the launch pad of the US Air Force Base at Cape Canaveral.
The rover will have to land at the bottom of the Martian crater Jezero on February 18, 2021.
The window for the strat was determined within 12: 00 to 14: 50 Kyiv time.
The live broadcast of the launch will be conducted by NASA, as well as ULA, which will begin 20 minutes before the launch.
The rover will be launched on an Atlas V rocket, which has been named the Dominator.
This Atlas V configuration is the second most powerful rocket on the market.
It is equipped with four solid-propellant rocket engines, as well as the upper stage of the Centaur.
The journey of Perseverance to Mars will take about 6.5 months and will end with a rather difficult landing, which NASA called “7 minutes of terror ”.
The rover will have to cope with this task on its own, without help from Earth.
After a successful landing, the rover will spend the next few years exploring the bottom of the crater 45 km wide, which billions of years ago was the delta of the lake and river.
Scientists from NASA suggest that this place was one of the most inhabited on ancient Mars.
Acting as a mobile geologist, the rover is equipped with a set of scientific tools designed to search for signs of life in the past on Mars.
Perseverance will also collect and pack 43 test tubes with samples that will be sent to Earth by another mission.
The $2.7 billion Perseverance mission, known as Mars 2020, is only the first part of the project to send samples from another planet to Earth for the first time.
NASA and the European Space Agency are going to return samples to Earth, possibly as early as 2031.
Perseverance is equipped with the same power system as the Curiosity rover, using a multi-purpose radioisotope thermoelectric generator.
The generator takes energy from nuclear decay and converts it into electrical energy, which the rover uses to power its systems.
Such a source of energy will be able to keep the rover in working order for at least 14 years after the completion of the planned mission.
In addition to collecting samples on the Red Planet, the rover will collect rocks and take a variety of photos.
The rover will also test several key technologies for future missions not only to Mars, but also to other planets in the solar system.
One such technology will be the Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment, or MOXIE for short.
The equipment will have to extract carbon dioxide from the thin Martian atmosphere and turn it into oxygen.
As NASA plans to send humans to Mars in the 2030s, it is necessary to figure out how future astronauts will be able to breathe on the Red Planet without carrying oxygen supplies with them.
"This is an important step towards sending humans to Mars.
We want to make sure that everything is working correctly, and robots will help with this before human lives are at stake, ” says one of NASA astronauts Zena Cardman.
The Perseverance rover is also part of NASA ’ s Luna-Mars plan, a research program that aims to return humans to the moon by 2024.
The mission is intended to be the first step towards sending humans to Mars.

title: From Cape Canaveral in the United States about an hour ago launched a rocket with the world ’ s largest rover
text:
It will look for signs of life on the Red Planet and will also conduct several experiments for the first time.
The name is already the fifth in the history of the United States rover - Perseverance (from English - "perseverance") - was given by one of the American schoolchildren in the framework of a special competition.
The device will have to explore one of the craters of Mars, where microorganisms may have been preserved.
In addition, it will collect rock samples and store them in special containers - it is planned that in about 10 years, a special mission of NASA and the European Space Agency will be able to take back to Earth.
But one of the main goals of the flight of the new rover is to understand whether it is possible to ensure the safety of people who can make an expedition to Mars in the future.
As part of the mission, in particular, there is an apparatus that will try to generate oxygen on the principle of photosynthesis from carbon dioxide on the planet.
True, in very small quantities, which are not yet enough for a person.
Also, for the first time in history, the rover will try to launch an aircraft: if it succeeds, it will explore future routes on the Red Planet.
Recently, China and the United Arab Emirates sent their probes to Mars for the first time.
The time is not chosen by chance: when launching vehicles this summer, the path to the Red Planet takes the least time.
All of them should arrive on Mars by February next year.

title: downed aircraft. Ukraine and Iran begin negotiations in Kiev on compensation for the families of the victims
text:

Ukraine and Iran began on Thursday in Kiev negotiations on compensation to the families of the victims as a result of the downing of a flight plane of Ukraine International Airlines (UIA) over Tehran.
This was announced by the Minister of Foreign Affairs Dmytro Kuleba, Ukrainian News reports.
“Today in Kiev began negotiations on compensation for the downing by Iran of Ukraine ’ s International Airlines flight PS752 with the participation of the Iranian delegation, ” he said.
According to him, the process will not be easy, but the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is working on the result - achieving justice.
"The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will make every effort to maximize the compensation," he said.
The Minister is confident that Ukraine will achieve justice, no matter how much time and effort it takes.
As reported by Ukrainian News, on January 8, shortly after departure from the airport of Tehran, the Boeing of the Ukrainian airline UIA flight PS752 crashed.
All 167 passengers and nine crew members were killed.
Among them were citizens of seven countries, including 11 Ukrainians.
On January 11, before the end of the work of the international commission of inquiry, Iran admitted that it shot down a Ukrainian plane with a missile.
At the same time, it was only at the end of July that Iran granted access to the aircraft ’ s flight recorders (“black boxes ”).
Until the end of the investigation, Ukraine is not ready to agree with Iran ’ s claim that the plane was shot down due to human error.

title: In Kiev began negotiations on compensation for the downing of the UIA aircraft by Iran
text:
Negotiations on compensation for the downing by Iran of Ukraine International Airlines flight PS752 with the participation of the Iranian delegation began today in Kiev.
This is reported by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
“Today in Kiev began negotiations on compensation for the downing by Iran of Ukraine International Airlines flight PS752 with the participation of the Iranian delegation.
We have long sought the start of the negotiating process, and I welcome the fact that things have finally moved on.
The process will not be easy, but we are working on the result.
And this is the achievement of justice, ” said Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba.
He added that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine will make every effort to ensure that the compensation was maximum.
“This will allow at least a little to alleviate the pain and grief of relatives, in which they have been living for more than six months.
We will achieve justice, no matter how much time and effort it costs, ” the foreign minister added.
The Boeing 737-800 of Ukraine International Airlines, en route from Tehran to Kiev, crashed on the morning of January 8 shortly after departure from the Iranian capital.
The victims of the disaster were all on board - 176 citizens of six countries.
Tehran said that the passenger Boeing was shot down by the Iranian side "accidentally".
According to the CAO, the displacement of the radar system of the air defense complex that shot down the Boeing was a key “human error ” that led to the disaster.
On July 18, the black boxes of the downed Ukrainian UIA aircraft arrived in France.
An international commission of 20 people studied the recorders of the downed plane in Iran.
According to the Minister of Foreign Affairs Dmitry Kuleba, the decoding of the black boxes was successful and the Iranian delegation announced that it was ready to come to Ukraine for negotiations on compensation.
Asked by LB.ua whether Ukraine would apply punitive mechanisms to Iran, Kuleba replied that "there is no need to hurry with this issue."

title: Families of UIA plane crash victims demand Iran
text:
Iran should tell the whole truth about the downing of the Boeing 737 passenger plane of Ukraine International Airlines near Tehran and bear responsibility, and then offer compensation.
This opinion is held by the relatives of those killed in the plane crash, in particular, the representative of the Association of families of victims of flight PS752 Hamed Esmaelion, reports “Radio Liberty ” (to watch the video, scroll the news to the end).
"They want to give the impression that families need compensation. This is not the case.
In our Association, there are almost 120 families of victims, and we are all united and say with one voice: compensation should go after the investigation and the establishment of justice, ” he said.
The Canadian lost his wife and daughter in a plane crash and says he is not thinking about compensation at all.
After all, first of all, he is concerned about what caused the tragedy, according to which his relatives will never return home.
“This is the main question for me, I can ’ t think about anything else.
And when they talk about compensation, it offends me because you can ’ t evaluate people, ” Esmaelion said.
A member of the Association of Families of Victims of the UIA Plane Crash noted that he would like a representative of his association to also participate in the investigation, as well as in the negotiations that are now underway in Kiev.
However, Esmaelion stressed, the Canadian Transport Safety Board refused to allow the organization to do so.
A similar opinion was expressed by the relatives of the Ukrainians who died in the plane crash.
In particular, the civil wife of the UIA flight attendant on PS752 Igor Matkov Kristina Alexandrovich says that compensation could help the parents of her husband who lost the breadwinner, but she wants to know the names of the perpetrators.
The relatives of the victims of the UIA plane crash in Iran demand a fair investigation and punishment of the perpetrators "I was not the official wife of Igor, so today I do not count on any compensation.
My opinion may not be indicative, but I have lost someone close to me and above all I want an investigation to take place...
For me, the most important thing is a fair trial and punishment for all who did this.
Because people did their job.
And they were killed, ” said Alexandrovich.
The widow of the pilot of the flight Vladimir Gaponenko Ekaterina also emphasizes that she does not believe in the statements of the Iranian authorities about “human error ” and wants those involved in the tragedy to be punished.
"The civilian plane was shot down by a military missile.
And this eliminates error, randomness, and the human factor.
It should be the responsibility of those who did it, ” she concluded.

"Late last night, the talks ended, they lasted 11 hours.
In general, they were held in a constructive spirit.
We note the spirit with which the Iranian delegation arrived to resolve the problem.
There is agreement and understanding that the most transparent and impartial technical investigation on the part of Iran is needed, ” the minister said.
According to him, the delegations went through the entire range of issues and discussed everything "as much as possible in detail, so it is possible to determine the three main results of yesterday's negotiations."
"Result number one - Iran joined the negotiation process to establish all the circumstances of the tragedy, bring the perpetrators to justice and pay all the necessary compensation.
The process started...
Secondly, Iran has agreed to fulfill all its obligations under the international conventions in the field of aviation to which it is a party.
This means that we can build the appropriate work constructively.
The third result is that we have agreed with the Iranian side on how to structure the further process of negotiations.
It will be held at several levels, investigators, technical experts, lawyers will say, in order to determine as much as possible all the circumstances, legal and technical nuances of this situation, and on the basis of this information it will be possible to calculate the amount of compensation, "Kuleba said.
Recall that flight PS752 "Tehran-Kiev" (Boeing 737-800) "International airlines of Ukraine" crashed shortly after departure from the airport of Tehran on January 8 early in the morning.
176 people were killed: citizens of Iran, Ukraine, Canada, Great Britain, Germany, Sweden and Afghanistan.
Iranian troops on January 11 said that the Ukrainian Boeing was shot down by accident, the fault was the human factor: the plane flew near a military facility of Iran and was mistaken for a “hostile target ”, namely a cruise missile, they said.
At the same time, Iran noted that it expected an attack from the United States, in connection with which the country ’ s air defense systems were brought into full combat readiness.
President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that he expects Iran to fully admit guilt, make an official apology, punish those responsible and pay compensation.
We add that the day before, in Kiev, the negotiations of Afghanistan, Great Britain, Canada, Sweden and Ukraine with representatives of the Islamic Republic of Iran on the plane crash of flight PS752 near Tehran ended.

title: The ship Crew Dragon Elon Musk just returned to earth: video
text:
It is broadcast on the NASA website.
Astronauts Douglas Hurley and Robert Benken are on board.
After a two-month mission, they landed in the ocean off the coast of Florida.
Crew Dragon entered the Earth's atmosphere, released parachutes and splashed down in the area of Pensacola in the Gulf of Mexico.
After that, the ship and crew picked up a special rescue ship Go Navigator.
“Thanks for flying @ SpaceX. ”
Current Location: Planet Earth A 2: 48pm ET, @ AstroBehnken and @ Astro _ Doug splashed down, marking the first splashdown of an American crew spacecraft in 45 years.
# LaunchAmerica pic.twitter.com / zO3KlNwxU3 — NASA (@ NASA) August 2, 2020 Recovery teams are on their way to retrieve @ AstroBehnken and @ Astro _ Doug from where they have splashed down inside the @ SpaceX Dragon Endeavour.
# LaunchAmerica pic.twitter.com / J7XUIt7sPt — NASA (@ NASA) August 2, 2020 "Views of our recovery teams approaching the @ SpaceX Dragon capsule and gathering the parachutes in the water".
# LaunchAmerica pic.twitter.com / UEX3C5xxUM — NASA (@ NASA) August 2, 2020 Recall that the American space agency NASA and the Mask company on May 30, with the second attempt, launched the Crew Dragon spacecraft with astronauts to the ISS.
The spacecraft launched a Falcon 9 rocket into space.
Astronauts Douglas Hurley and Robert Benken went to the ISS.
About 19 hours after the launch of the rocket, they successfully docked to the space station.
After 63 days, the astronauts left the ISS and went back to Earth on the spacecraft Crew Dragon.
It is worth noting that the launch of Crew Dragon to the ISS (SpaceX Demo-2 mission) is historic for the United States.
This is the first American manned spacecraft launched from the United States since 2011 (when the shuttle program was discontinued).
In addition, it is the first ever launch of people into space on a private spacecraft.
SpaceX Demo-2 is the final stage of certification before the start of full-fledged regular operation of Crew Dragon.
In case of successful completion of the flight, the United States will refuse the services of the Russian Soyuz spacecraft, which usually sent astronauts from the Baikonur cosmodrome in Kazakhstan to the ISS.

title: European stock markets and US index futures fall slightly
text:
August 4 – Dow Jones.
Futures on the US indices are declining on Tuesday.
A number of leading companies reported financial results, some of which exceeded the low expectations associated with the coronavirus pandemic.
Futures on the S & P 500 at the time of writing decreased by 0.4%.
Pan-European Stoxx Europe 600 fell by 0.4%.
Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. pre-market securities in the US rose by 4.4% after the game publisher raised its financial forecasts for the year due to the growth in demand for video games during the pandemic.
Shares of game developer Activision Blizzard and US securities Sony Corp. gained 3.1% each.
In Europe, BP shares rose 6.7% after the British giant for the first time in 10 years reduced the quarterly dividend and presented a new strategy for a gradual departure from the oil and gas business.
EasyJet shares gained more than 8% thanks to a more positive than expected outlook.
More than three-quarters of S & P 500 companies have already released reports, and, according to UBS, most of them exceeded analysts ’ expectations.
Since the end of June, analysts' estimates for profit for the third quarter increased by 2.5%.
Favorable reporting by technology companies in recent weeks has supported growth in US stock markets.
The Nasdaq Composite set a new record on Monday.
Investors, fearing a slowdown in the economic recovery due to another surge in coronavirus in the past month, are closely watching the decline in the growth of new cases in recent times.
“One day ’ s statistics don ’ t mean anything, but I ’ ll be watching to see if it ’ s trending, ” said Fahad Kamal, senior market analyst at Kleinwort Hambros, Societe Generale ’ s private banking and wealth management division.
Meanwhile, according to Kamal, investors are still cautious in bond markets, and bond yields are falling despite the rise in stock indices.
The yield on 10-year US government bonds fell from yesterday ’ s 0.562% to 0.539%.
“The bond market is more reflective of reality, and yields are still at record lows.
There is clearly a sense of fear among investors that the risks of unlikely events will materialize, ” Kamal added.
Market participants are also monitoring talks between Democratic leaders and White House officials about another bailout package.
The parties are still unable to agree on whether to reduce the weekly additional $600 federal unemployment payments and provide assistance to affected states and communities.
“Investors assume that the US economy has not yet got on both feet.
It seems that everyone agrees that more support is needed, you just need to determine its form, ” said Hugh Jimber, an analyst at J.P. Morgan Asset Management.
Shares of alcohol maker Diageo fell 5.6% after it reported a drop in operating profit due to the coronavirus pandemic.
The company ’ s sales in North America reached a high level as consumers began to buy alcohol in stores instead of bars, but growth in this region could not compensate for the fall in other markets.
Shares of Bayer fell by 2.3% - the chemical and pharmaceutical company reported that it suffered a net loss in the second quarter of 9.55 billion euros.
Bayer has set aside funds for a multibillion-dollar settlement of the Roundup pesticide case.
The shares of IWG, a competitor to WeWork, fell by 5.5% after it reported a loss for the first half of the year after profit a year earlier and refused the dividend.
In the Asia-Pacific region, the Hong Kong Hang Seng index gained 2%, leading the increase in the region.
Japan ’ s Nikkei 225 is up 1.7%, while Australia ’ s S & P / ASX 200 is up 1.9%.
Walt Disney will report on the results after the regular session. — Written by Caitlin Ostroff, caitlin.ostroff @ wsj.com; translated by PRIME, + 7 (495) 645-37-00, dowjonesteam @ 1prime.biz (End) Dow Jones Newswires, PRIME

title: Turkish Invasion of Syria Works to Restore Ottoman Empire
text:
The Turkish operation in Syria has caused outrage in the West, and this can be explained not only by humanitarian considerations.
The territory that the Turkish army entered was formerly part of the Ottoman Empire.
There are a number of signs that Ankara cherishes dreams of recreating it.
It is also possible by armed means.
In addition to the United States, with its messianism and belief in its own omnipotence, there are very few countries that openly claim imperial thinking.
Turkey is almost the only one that embodies these ideas in practice.
Including by armed invasion of neighboring countries, threatening for the sake of their imperial ambitions to destroy relations with both traditional allies and with already familiar supranational institutions such as the European Union or NATO.
What's the point?
In 2011, Turkish Foreign Minister Ahmet Davutoglu published a book entitled “Strategic Depth.
The international position of Turkey ", which later became known under the abbreviated name" Strategic depth "(Stratejik derinlik).
It is this fundamental work that is considered the basis of the theory of neo-Ottomanism, although Davutoglu himself, for tactical reasons, denied this term.
And Ankara ’ s foreign policy followed these ideas long after the appearance of their written structured version.
Imperialism and neo-Ottomanism moved into the military plane in the same 2011, when Davutoglu ’ s work came out.
Then the Assad government in Syria was on the verge of collapse, and Turkey decided that for the first time was able to go on the offensive with minimal losses and only gain in its internal image.
For starters, Davutoglu invented the postulate of “zero problems with neighbors ”, which in practice should mean the maximum use of“ soft power ” against those neighbors of Turkey who previously entered the orbit of influence of the Ottoman Empire at the peak of its success.
It quickly became clear that “soft power ” in the classical sense is not enough, and the formula“ zero neighbors – zero problems ” went for a walk in Turkey.
This now meant interfering in the internal affairs of the shattered Ottoman Empire.
Davutoglu insisted on the theory of creating counterweights throughout the “post-Ottoman ” space, a gradual exit from the“ Western umbrella ” and the extraordinary role of Turkey in the declared region.
Recep Tayyip Erdogan ’ s Justice and Development Party was in dire need of such an ideology.
Erdogan needed to get rid of the dominant army in society, accelerate economic growth and consolidate the population.
Under all this perfectly suited the ideas of neo-Ottomanism.
Within Turkey, these ideas and slogans have found understanding and support, and now, according to various sources, the majority of the country ’ s population (except for part of the Kurds) fully supports expansionist and imperial plans.
Many years of propaganda, including even television series about the “descendants of Ertogrul ” and the“ golden age of Suleiman ”, convinced the Turks that new economic growth is possible only at the expense of external expansion.The theory of neo-Ottomanism was originally built on four foundations: blood, language, soil and Ottoman thinking.
Blood and language - this is more or less clear.
All Turkic-speaking peoples or their heirs fell into the orbit of attention.
First of all, these are the countries of Central Asia, the Russian Volga region, the Crimea, the Gagauz of Moldova, northern Cyprus, Azerbaijan, the Turkish minority in Bulgaria and Macedonia, the Turkomans of Syria and the historical influential Turkoman communities in Palestine and Saudi Arabia.
The then Prime Minister Turgut Özal inadvertently uttered the slogan “Great Turkey from the Mediterranean Sea to the Wall of China ”, which he later hailed.
The more careful and far-sighted Davutoglu who replaced him in this post did not say this, but he acted.
The Turkish “soft power ” has worked to the full.
Supporters of Erdogan ’ s party almost officially began to call themselves Osmanli torunu – “descendants of the Ottomans ”.
The first casualty was traditionally friendly relations with Israel, which until 2010 were seen as a strategic alliance between the only non-Arab, democratic and secular states in the Middle East.
After the 2008-09 Gaza war, Erdogan ’ s government openly sided with the Palestinians, up to and including the use of force against Israeli border boats in the Mediterranean.
And, surprisingly, it was during this period that Ankara ’ s relations with Iran, Iraq and Syria began to improve dramatically against the background of general hostility to Israel, and the imperial ambitions of the new Ottomans did not seem anything out of the ordinary at that time.
This is where the question of the other two foundations of Neo-Ottomanism arose: the soil and Ottoman thinking.
Under the soil began to understand all the lands to which the Ottoman Empire had ever reached.
There were sympathizers, especially Albanians.
The leader of Kosovo, Hachim Thaci, even said: “Turkey is Kosovo, Kosovo is Turkey. ”
He is partly right, because it was under the Ottomans that the mass migration of immigrants from northern Albania to the lands of Old Serbia began, which formed the Kosovo Albanians as a nation.
And at the peak of its dawn in the Ottoman Empire, up to 90% of the grand viziers, provincial governors, wali, bayraktar, silahdar and defterdar (in the modern way: district commanders, military ministers and finance ministers) were ethnic Albanians.
In the 18th century, the Albanian Köprülü family actually manipulated the Ottoman Empire, subjugating all major state and military positions.
Kemal Ataturk himself, the founding father of modern Turkey, was half Albanian, half Macedonian, and in his first government there was not a single ethnic Ottoman – only Albanians, Macedonians and Abkhazians.
In many ways, this determined the national policy of Ataturk, which banned at the state level all nationalities, except one, the new – the Turks.
And this ban is still in force, with some amendments to modern trends.
Turkey ’ s aggressive penetration of the Balkans became especially noticeable during and after the war in Bosnia.
The Turkish “soft power ” is concerned with the“ restoration of cultural heritage ”.
The Turks began to restore historical buildings in Bosnia and Macedonia, built under the Ottoman Empire, and they have no number.
The entire center of Sarajevo is a solid monument of Ottoman architecture.
At the same time, not only mosques were restored, but in general there was little religious component in this.
It was and is exclusively about the “secular memory ” of the Balkans of the“ golden age ” of Ottoman rule.
In Albania, one of the largest cities - Elbasan was built on an empty place by the Turks as an alternative to the fortress of Kruja, in which the European-minded and Genuz-funded Prince George Kastrioti (Skanderbeg) defended himself.
In Bulgaria, this renaissance did not happen, but the large local Turkish community began to receive serious political and financial support from Ankara.
A separate story with Georgia, in which the eye did not have time to blink, as the Turks turned out to be the main investors.
And mainly in Adjara, which is also considered to be part of the Ottoman orbit from the point of view of neo-Ottomanism, although the status of Adjara is guaranteed not by Georgia and its constitution, whatever it may be, but by Russian-Turkish peace agreements.
Azerbaijan, having gained financial independence as a result of the spike in oil prices, now prefers to ignore “historical ties ” with Turkey.
Moreover, physically the lands of modern Azerbaijan have never been part of the Ottoman Empire, and the proximity of the language is perceived rather as a complex incident.
“Azeri ”, the Azerbaijani accent in Turkey is not welcome, which naturally irritates the Azerbaijanis themselves.
Here the Turkish “soft power ” obviously failed.
Of all those neighbors with whom it was necessary to create "zero relations", were sharply against the Armenians and Greeks.
With the Armenians, everything is clear, and with the Greeks, the state of “neither war nor peace ” leads to the fact that Athens supports, where it can, everything that is anti-Turkish (primarily Kurds and the same Armenians).
By the way, the term “neo-Ottomanism ” first appeared in the Greek press after the Cyprus war of 1974.
Largely because of this, Ahmet Davutoglu did not risk saying this word in vain, so as not to cause unnecessary associations.
Now that one of the foundations of neo-Ottomanism has become the policy of maximum exclusion from Europe and the European Union, it is openly encouraged to talk about neo-Ottomanism in relation to Greece.
But attempts to offer their services (for example, in the restoration of mosques in Thessaloniki) lead to almost hysteria in Greece.
Despite the fact that these former mosques themselves are mostly Orthodox churches, to which the Turks attached minarets and mihrab (as happened with Hagia Sophia in Istanbul).
An additional stumbling block is the city of Edirne, ancient Andrianopol.
Edirne was the capital of the Ottoman tribe even before the capture of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmet and since then it is considered almost the main cultural and historical centers of the Ottomans.
There, as in Istanbul, are the tombs of sultans, great viziers and spiritual leaders, and for several centuries Edirne was the main military base on the European part of the Ottoman Empire and the headquarters of the Janissaries.
After the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, Kemal Ataturk almost begged the victorious coalition to leave Edirne to the Turks.
If the Greeks had won that war of 1919-22, then, of course, there would have been no Edirne, as there would have been Istanbul in its current version.
But now the preservation of Edirne as part of the Turkish state is considered perhaps the most important foreign policy success of Kemal Ataturk.
As well as the so-called "peaceful solution of the Iskenderun issue".
In 1922, the French army controlled not only the mandated territory of Sham (present-day Syria and Lebanon), but also Cilicia, in which by that time there were no Armenians physically left.
After the departure of the French from Cilicia, the province of Hatay, a coastal zone of the Mediterranean Sea adjacent to the Syrian province of Latakia with the city of Alexandretta, was included in the mandated part of Sham.
In 1921, a treaty was concluded in San Remo, according to which the province of Hatay was formed on the territory of the former Alexandretta Sanjak under the French mandate, since in addition to the Greeks and Armenians, many Turks lived there.
In 1937, the independent state of Hatay was formed in northern Syria.
It lasted a little more than a year, because in the autumn of 1939, under the guise, when the European powers were busy with other things, Turkey annexed Hatay and renamed Alexandretta Iskenderun.
After the Suez crisis of 1956, Syria concluded a military agreement with the USSR and declared its claims to Hatay, which terrified Ankara.
The UN debate stopped the threat of war.
But now by invading the territory of Syria on another part of the border, in Kurdistan, Ankara is actually again “suspending ” the issue of Iskenderun / Alexandrett – although in the current situation, war is hardly possible.
As in general, a significant part of the tasks posed to the Turks by the theory of neo-Ottomanism are poorly solvable in the modern situation.
But to reduce the current operation of Turkey in Syrian Kurdistan only with the eternal struggle against the terrorist part of the Kurdish national movement would be too narrow.
In modern Trotia, neo-Ottomanism is supported by the majority of society, and theoretically it can go very far.
Wherever possible, primarily in the Balkans, Ankara will continue to pursue a policy of “soft power ”, yielding to the Albanians and restoring historical buildings in Bosnia and Macedonia.
It is clear that all this is limited to Serbia and Hungary, which are more likely to mine everything (and Hungarians are already mining their borders from migrants) than to let the “soft Turks ” in.
But Erdogan ’ s recent visit to Belgrade, where he met not only with the Serbian leadership, but also with representatives of the Balkan countries of the “post-Ottoman space ”, showed that these ideas will not disappear from Ankara for a long time.
Turkey is now practically the only country on the planet that has elevated the idea of historical revanchism to the rank of a new state ideology.
So far, the Turks are throwing at the yatagan not at everyone around, but only at those who are weaker, but this list may well include, for example, Armenians and Greeks.
Omani revanchism is difficult to compare with the desire to unite divided peoples, as, for example, the Russians after the collapse of the USSR.
And it does not matter how the operation of the Turks in Syrian Kurdistan will end.
The main thing is not to go further, since now it can not be stopped.

title: Sales of Bayer prescription drugs fell by 9.7% amid pandemic « Russian Pharmaceuticals
text:
Sales of prescription drugs Bayer fell by 9.7% against the background of the pandemic The German company Bayer reported on financial indicators for the second quarter of 2020.
Total sales decreased by 6.2%, a quarterly loss of $11.2 billion against a profit of $475 million for the same period of 2019.
In the second quarter of 2020, sales of prescription drugs of the German company Bayer decreased by 9.7% and amounted to $4.7 billion.
Sales of the OTC division fell by 16.7% to $1.4 billion.
Total sales decreased by 6.2% to $11.9 billion.
As a result, the company ended the quarter with a loss of $11.2 billion against a profit of $475 million for the same period of 2019, FirstWord Pharma reports.
As noted in Bayer, the decline in sales of prescription drugs is due to procurement policy in China.
The OTC unit declined slightly after the growth in demand for products due to the pandemic in the first quarter.
Also, the company stressed that the restriction of contacts between doctors and patients against the background of the COVID-19 pandemic significantly affected the volume of sales of drugs for women's health, ophthalmic drugs and radiodiagnostics.
The quarterly loss is due to the fact that Bayer has reserved funds to settle claims for the potentially carcinogenic herbicide Roundup in the amount of $10.9 billion.
According to Bayer, in 2020, sales will be 50.5 – 51.7 billion dollars.
The early company had forecast $51.5 billion to $52.7 billion.
Profit is expected in the range of $14.2 billion against $14.4-14.8 billion projected earlier.
Earnings per share are projected at $7.87 – $8.10, which is $0.35 below the earlier forecast.
Ilya Dugin pharmvestnik

title: 235 illegal immigrants crossed the English Channel in one day: this is a record
text:
235 illegal immigrants crossed the English Channel in one day: this is a record 4 7 / 8 / 2020, 15: 13 1,984 Among those who arrived in Britain was a pregnant woman.
235 illegal migrants in 17 boats attempting to cross the English Channel from northern France were intercepted by British Coast Guard and Border Guard officers on Thursday, the Home Office said.
The previous daily record of 202 people was set a week ago.
In the boat, which reached the coast of Kent, were 15 people, including children and a woman in the last months of pregnancy.
There were 26 migrants on the other side.
On Friday, Air Force correspondent Simon Jones saw a kayak carrying 14 people, including a pregnant woman.
According to the interior Ministry, since the beginning of the year, 3,948 people have illegally crossed the English Channel on more than 300 ships.
The agency did not say how many of them were men and how many were women, or what nationalities they were.
Members of the British Parliament began an investigation because of the increase in the number of migrants trying to cross the English Channel from France.
Photo: SUSAN PILCHER The Home Affairs Committee of the House of Commons intends to find out how criminal groups involved in the transport of people operate, to determine the danger to which migrants are exposed, as well as to assess the activities of the authorities of France and Britain.
MPs want to find out what conditions migrants live in France, who often have to settle for makeshift camps, as well as what dangers children who cross the strait without parents are exposed to.
Immigration Minister Chris Philip said he shared "the public's outrage at the appalling number of attempts to cross the strait" on Thursday.
"They are unacceptable and unnecessary because France is a safe place.
We will work closely with France.
I will travel to Paris early next week to negotiate more vigorous measures with them, including interception and return [of migrants to France].
It simply cannot continue, ” he said.
French authorities said they intercepted and returned 23 migrants on their way to Britain by boat on Thursday.
A helicopter was involved in the operation.
According to Chris Philip, the only solution is to make the way through the English Channel “completely insurmountable ” so that no one tries to take advantage of it.
"I would not like to speculate on possible further measures," Finance Minister Rishi Sunak said on Sky News, commenting on reports of the government's plans to involve the Navy in patrolling the English Channel.
Eyewitnesses told the BBC that they saw three family groups and two single men on the beach in Danjnes Photo: SUSAN PILCHER "It is important that we work closely on this issue with our French allies.
Of course, France is a safe place for migrants, and we would like to see the number of these crossings reduced.
Based on the outcome of our negotiations [with France], we will decide on the next steps. ”
The government intends to investigate the reasons for the sharp increase in the number of attempts to cross the English Channel by illegal migrants - from about 200 in March to 1,100 in July this year.
The committee set up for this purpose will, inter alia, consider: the role of organized crime; possible measures by the British and French authorities to combat illegal migration and encourage legal ways to seek asylum; the conditions of refugees in northern France and the risks to which they are exposed; the treatment of arriving illegal migrants by the British authorities, especially children who are not accompanied by adults.

title: On the English Channel intercepted 13 boats with more than 130 migrants, including 23 children
text:

British border guards intercepted 13 boats on which more than 130 migrants arrived on August 7.

title: Britain is outraged by the increase in the number of illegal immigrants trying to get into the country from France
text:
Britain has announced an unacceptable increase in the number of boats that transport migrants through the English Channel, and promises to send illegal immigrants back to France.

title: “Take action ” – London is going to return illegal migrants to France
text:
“Take action ” – London is going to return illegal migrants to France 09.08.2020, 9: 39, News of the day The Minister of immigration control of Great Britain Chris Philp in his article for The Daily Telegraph spoke about the intention of the government to stop the flow of refugees and return to France those who have already managed to cross the English Channel.
The official believes that to solve the problem, Paris must block the way for boats with illegal immigrants and catch them off their shores: such harsh measures will help not only to avoid human casualties, but also to clear the north of the country from tent camps.
This week, an unacceptably large number of boats with migrants arrived in the UK from France: such a shameful situation cannot continue, and London cannot turn a blind eye to it, writes in a column for The Daily Telegraph the Minister of immigration control of the United Kingdom Chris Philp.
Noting that he shared the "anger and frustration" of the British, the official said he would visit Paris next week to strengthen cooperation between the countries to address this common problem.
According to Philp, crossing the English Channel is not only dangerous and illegal, but also “completely unnecessary ” idea: the EU countries are safe and have a well-developed system of shelters.
“Real refugees should seek asylum there, not risk their lives in the hands of violent criminals and not break the law trying to get into the UK illegally. ”
The Government of the country has made a firm decision to close this path with a double approach.
First, the French must first prevent illegal migrants from going to sea.
As Chris Philp points out, this is beneficial to them: with the disappearance of this possibility, the crowds of refugees will stop flooding the north of France, the number of tent camps and gangs that commit crimes with impunity on the French coast will decrease.
Paris must also make sure that migrants trying to cross the canal will not be able to repeat the attempts: they must be taken out of Calais and offered either to seek asylum in France or to return to their country.
If you take fingerprints before that, they will know that the second time they are waiting for serious consequences.
Secondly, those who were able to leave France should be detained, and those who were able to reach the shores of England should be returned.
The British minister of immigration control continues to insist that the French side is more attentive to the interception of migrants in their coastal waters.
He is going to again offer the French to conduct general exercises and demonstrate how to intercept illegal immigrants by boat and safely return to shore.
At the same time, the official emphasizes that the government intends to return as many illegal migrants as possible who arrived on this route.
In the coming days, flights are planned that will take them back to France, and in the future there will be even more.
According to Chris Philp, these two steps are the key to solving the problem, but they will not be easy to implement.
To do this, we will have to overcome legislative, legal and functional barriers, because the existing system of returning migrants does not meet the tasks set and violates the law.
In addition, the main priority during the interception of boats should be saving lives: the English Channel is one of the busiest straits in the world, and many people in despair are more likely to risk their lives and the lives of their children than to return to France.
In conclusion, the British Minister of Immigration Control expressed confidence that in Paris he will be able to confirm the mutual obligations of the two countries to stop illegal crossings of the English Channel.
“Frankly, this situation cannot continue.
“We are determined to stop these boats, ” Philp writes at the end of his article for The Daily Telegraph. – The British people have clearly shown that they want to regain control of their borders, and we must comply. ”

title: NASA ’ s Mars Rover Perseverance will turn CO2 into oxygen on the planet
text:
NASA ’ s Perseverance rover will turn CO2 into oxygen on the planet 09.08.2020, 20: 30, Miscellaneous NASA ’ s Perseverance rover, launched on July 30, equipped with a variety of advanced technological systems, will try to convert CO2 on the surface of the planet into oxygen.
This is a very important step towards detecting signs of life on Mars.
In translation, the name Perseverance means perseverance, perseverance.
The device was developed by specialists from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory of the California Institute of Technology.
In order to generate oxygen on the Red Planet, the rover was equipped with the experimental Mars Oxygen In-situ Resource Utilization Experiment or MOXIE.
The device was developed by scientists at the University of Massachusetts to produce from the atmosphere of the planet necessary for life gas.
Oxygen is very cumbersome for space transportation to Mars.
Experts doubt that the astronauts will be able to deliver it in the right number for people and refueling ships.
This problem will try to cope with the device MOXIE.

title: The UK is concerned about the increase in attempts to illegally cross the English Channel
text:
The UK government intends to find the reasons for the sharp increase in attempts of migrants to cross the English Channel by boat from France to the UK.
Lodon intends to strengthen cooperation with France and the French coastal patrol services in order to make the illegal crossing of the English Channel “impossible ”.
Home Secretary Preeti Patel appointed on Sunday a special commissioner for countering attempts to illegally cross the English Channel, former naval officer Dan O'Maconey.
Dan O ’ Maconey will “work closely with the French ” and bear“ primary responsibility for the impassability of the strait for small ships, ” the Home Office said.
According to the BBC, about 300 boats have crossed the English Channel since the beginning of the year, and about four thousand migrants have landed on the English coast.
Recently, due to favorable weather conditions, the number of attempts to cross the border between France and the UK has increased significantly, AFP notes.
More than 500 migrants have crossed the English Channel from the French to the English coast in just the last three days.
France, for its part, says that from January to July 2020, the number of prevented English Channel crossings increased more than fivefold compared to the same period in 2019, and four times more boats and equipment were found in the dunes than last year.
Last month, a "Franco-British intelligence unit" was set up to deal with people smuggling migrants, the French Interior Ministry said.
Sunday ’ s Sunday Telegraph published an article in which it writes that France demanded from the UK the sum of 30 million pounds (33.2 million euros) to organize control all along the coast of the Channel.
The Sunday Telegraph, citing a source in the British Foreign Ministry, claims that the final decision by the British government has not yet been made.
The French Foreign Ministry has not yet commented on this information, saying only that “next week France and the UK will discuss the issue of strengthening the bilateral struggle against the illegal crossing of the English Channel. ”
British Immigration Minister Chris Philip is expected to visit France on Tuesday.
