title: RAEC Director: Russia has more chances to attract Belarusian specialists than Poland
text:
French patrol ships in the English Channel do not turn the boats of migrants to the shore, but direct their ships towards the UK and there they are abandoned to their fate, writes The Daily Telegraph.
According to The Daily Telegraph, he traveled with a group of 16 Afghan refugees, including four women and two children.
At about seven o'clock in the morning, a crowded inflatable boat was struggling with the wind a mile from French territorial waters, when a patrol ship appeared on the horizon from the French side, reports Ino-TV.
However, instead of bringing a group of wet and trembling people on board, the French ship offered them bottled water and life jackets, and then escorted the boat to British waters and quickly turned around, leaving the migrants to their fate.
Despite repeated promises by the French president, the interior minister and other senior officials, there is no indication that France is cooperating with the British authorities.
Just ten days ago, Macron pledged to “step up ” cooperation with the United Kingdom to combat illegal migrants.
Meanwhile, British Prime Minister Boris Johnson said that the government intends to stop illegal traffic and prevent boats from landing on British shores.
The two countries agreed to “work together in a spirit of cooperation to address this issue. ”
On Wednesday, when Jamie Johnson was traveling through the English Channel, French ships left the migrants alone, not handing over to the British border service.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the United Kingdom claims that the coastal services were transferred information about the boat.
However, in response to a radio request from the captain of the ship on which the migrants were being ferried, they replied that they had not heard anything about it.
Despite the fact that the government spends millions of pounds on surveillance aircraft, drones and enhanced monitoring, it seems that only fishermen were able to alert the British authorities about migrants in distress: strong winds forced waves to sweep across the board, and people could fall overboard or drown.
The illegals' inflatable boat sailed without a captain, without a map and without any ideas when they landed on the shore.
Finally, on the horizon appeared the ship of the coast guard of the British border troops, which had no choice but to take on board illegal guests.
The captain of the ship told the journalist that otherwise they would have drowned.
"What the French have done is a disgrace," he said.
In response to a request from The Daily Telegraph, representatives of the French authorities said that “the actions of the maritime authorities are focused on the protection of human life and safe navigation in the Strait. ”
According to them, the priority is the assistance and rescue of each boat crossing the English Channel, but because of their large number, government agencies have to assess the level of emergency situation of each of them and make a choice depending on the needs and risks of each detected vessel.
It is noted that since the beginning of 2020, more than 6 thousand have arrived in the UK.
300 migrants – three times more than last year.
Earlier, British law enforcement officers detained 125 migrants in the English Channel who tried to illegally cross the border and enter the country.
From Eurostat data it follows that in 2018 the population of the EU countries became more solely due to migration, and not due to an increase in fertility In 2019, Europe was urged to prepare for a wave of “climate migration ”.
The newspaper LOOK wrote how Britain was covered by the “crisis of the homeless ”.

title: Squares and parks of the capital of Samotlor are being transformed for Vartovites
text:
Squares and parks of the capital of Samotlor are being transformed for citizens of Warsaw Summer 2020, as it is already clear, turned out to be difficult.
Russians do not pack suitcases in anticipation of departure to the overseas seas, and inside the country travel on vacation is still very limited.
And warm summer days still want to use in order to visit the air, to walk at least in his hometown.
This is especially true for people who are tired of self-isolation.
It turns out that the state of city parks, squares, walking areas becomes one of the priority tasks for the city authorities.
In Nizhnevartovsk, the improvement of urban recreation areas took care as soon as the weather allowed working in the open air.
Naturally, with all the restrictions imposed by the coronavirus pandemic.
To the construction of some public walking areas in the capital of Samotlor, the city authorities managed to attract local businesses.
For example, on the improvement of the Mother ’ s Square, which was asked to ennoble themselves by Vartovites, the mayor ’ s office signed an agreement between the authorities of the municipality and the heads of urban enterprises.
We agreed to create a recreation area near the intersection of Taizhnaya and Musa Jalil streets.
The area of the landscaped area is not small - more than 7 thousand square meters, here it is necessary to lay tiles and green about 3.8 square meters of territory.
As part of the implementation of the agreement with the municipality, Severavtodor Group JSC, Vort LLC, Gorodskoe Illumination CJSC and Pressplitkam Plant LLC bear the costs associated with the acquisition of the necessary materials and the implementation of works on the improvement of this territory.
The contractor here is JSC "GC" Severavtodor ", LLC" VORT ", LLC" Pressplitkam ", CJSC" City Lighting ".
Preparations are already underway at the site.
It is important that the workers intend to preserve the maximum number of existing trees on the territory.
Now surveyors work here, an excavator works, which removes the upper layer of land for future tracks.
Work on the site began exactly on time - June 10, and it is planned to complete everything in September this year.
“Mother ’ s Square is a working title.
It was proposed two years ago by our residents.
After the completion of the construction, we will once again appeal to the public, perhaps they have other ideas.
Already following the results of public discussion, it will be decided how the square will be called and what it will be filled with, ” said Viktor Sitnikov, Deputy Head of Nizhnevartovsk, Director of the Department of Construction of the City Administration.
It is worth noting that the course of the arrangement of this zone, and the improvement of other parks and squares of the city is under the control of the head of the city Vasily Tikhonov.
And when choosing specific sites for improvement and their priorities in Nizhnevartovsk, the opinion of citizens is necessarily taken into account.
"They (the future territories of improvement - from the editorial board) pass through a rating vote, in which all adult citizens take part.
Cosmonauts Square won in 2018, in 2019 it was supposed to be built.
However, the purchase took place twice, and the contractor refused to perform the work.
The municipal contract was terminated, the construction of the square was postponed to 2020 out of competition, "Ivan Siletsky, director of the Moscow State University" Department of Capital Construction of the City of Nizhnevartovsk, told Nakanune.RU.
Now the price of the contract for the Square of Cosmonauts is only 16.764 million rubles.
Of these, federal funds - 5.557 million rubles, district funds - 8.692 million rubles and from the city treasury - 2.515 million rubles.
Completion is scheduled for September 30, 2020.
The project provides for the construction of a sculptural composition, the installation of lighting poles, the laying of outdoor lighting networks, the arrangement of a tile coating around the sculptural composition and the landscaping of the square.
Of course, mandatory landscaping of the site and installation of a video surveillance system.
“We need to complete the whole set of improvements over the summer.
These are preparatory work, landscaping, laying tiles, installation of a model of the Soyuz spacecraft, which was operated in our country until 1985.
The model will be presented in real form in a ratio of 1: 3.
All materials for the future square ordered, paid.
As necessary, they are delivered to the facility, ” said Alexander Kornienko, General Director of MKAIR LLC.
"The project is being implemented within the framework of the national project" Housing and Urban Environment "and the municipal program" Formation of a Comfortable Urban Environment ", - said the director of the ICU" Department of Capital Construction of the City of Nizhnevartovsk "The head of the city of Nizhnevartovsk Vasily Tikhonov notes:" Vartovchanin Sergey Ryzhikov became the first Yugorsk cosmonaut.
We are rightly proud of this fact.
I am convinced that this must be recorded in the history of the city.
In addition, Nizhnevartovsk at different times visited another 7 cosmonauts: Beregovoy, Volynov, Lebedev, Lyakhov and others.
The square will be located in the Coastal Zone, at the intersection of 60 Years of October Street and Victory Avenue. ”
Deputy head of the city, head of the construction department Viktor Sitnikov told Nakanune.RU that in 2020, the city will smash three squares at once (Heroes of Samotlor, Cosmonauts and Sports Glory) and a boulevard on the embankment in the alignment of Chapaev - Khanty-Mansiysk streets within the framework of the national project "Housing and Urban Environment".
Financing the construction of all objects of improvement is "vskladchyna": the Federation, the district and the city.
The new square, the opening of which is timed to the 55th anniversary of the Samotlor deposit, was called the "Square of Samotlor Heroes".
It will be located near the oil fields.
Here will be installed a memorable star, which the Governor of Ugra Natalia Komarova last year presented to the legendary Samotlor for his contribution to the development of the region.
The price of the contract for the creation of the entire landscaping complex is 23.9 million rubles, of which: federal funds - 7.5 million rubles, district funds - 11.7 million rubles, and the local budget - 4.7 million rubles.
Builders of the contractor LLC "MKAIR" are already doing preparatory work here.
The chief engineer of the company "MKAIR", engaged in the construction of squares of Heroes Samotlor and Cosmonauts, Damir Khismatullin in a conversation with Nakanune.RU noted that there are no difficulties with the construction of these objects.
Any issues can be resolved at operational meetings.
It is assumed that the square of Heroes of Samotlor will become one of the main attractions of the city.
To improve this area previously offered residents of the nearest microdistricts.
Builders will have to create walking areas, install benches, urns, a video surveillance system, lighting and equip recreation areas and playgrounds.
Rosneft allocated 25 million rubles for this purpose as part of the implementation of the social agreement on cooperation with the government of Ugra.
It is planned to hand over the object, the creation of which will take place with the direct participation of representatives of Samotlorneftegaz JSC, before the end of summer.
The deputy head of the city, the head of the construction department Viktor Sitnikov explained to Nakanune.RU that design projects of public landscaped areas are developed by design organizations on the basis of concluded municipal contracts and approved at a meeting of the public commission of the city administration to ensure the implementation of the priority project "Formation of a comfortable urban environment".
And after the approval of design projects, the development of project documentation is carried out.
The project becomes a guide to action for contractors.
At the same time, the city authorities and public figures at almost all stages of the construction of public recreation areas are closely monitored.
“The deputies were instructed to take special control over the implementation of these projects, regularly hold meetings with representatives of contractors, field events to personally verify the work performed.
The main task is to deliver all the objects on time, and maybe earlier, but not to the detriment of quality, ” emphasizes the head of the municipality Vasily Tikhonov.
By the way, Vasily Tikhonov in matters of improvement of the capital of Samotlor, of course, is not only the head of the city, but also a caring Vartovchanin.
For example, the initiative of complete reconstruction and improvement of the Sports Glory Square came precisely from Tikhonov.
Sports in the city in general in honor.
More than 100 thousand people are engaged in physical culture and sports, about 12 thousand in sports institutions.
In 2018, at competitions of various levels, the athletes of the city managed to win 191 medals: 15 - at the world championships and championships, 17 - at the European championships and championships, 159 - at the championships and championships of Russia.
The winners of the district competition "Sports Elite - 2018" were 34 athletes and coaches of the city.
On the territory of the Park of Sports Glory is the monument "Stars of Nizhnevartovsk Sports" - a ball with stars.
The opening of the monument "Stars of Nizhnevartovsk Sports" took place on March 10, 2002 as part of the celebration of the 30th anniversary of the city.
Nizhnevartovtsy in this endeavor were pioneers - there is nothing like this in Russia.
The monument immortalized the names of people who became the pride of Russian sports.
It is made in the form of a large golden ball and installed at the entrance to the stadium "Central".
Each name is on a separate asterisk, which are arranged in 3 rows.
The price of the contract for the improvement of the square is 8,536 million rubles, of which: federal funds - 16,090 million rubles, district funds - 25,166 million rubles, the local budget - 7,280 million rubles.
The Square of Sports Glory for the contractor company turned out to be a difficult object.
Deputy Director of LLC "Stroytex", which builds the Park of Sports Glory, Alexander Mytsy in a conversation with Nakanune.RU noted that the object is "stuffed" with underground engineering communications.
“We have already been forbidden to build a road to the management of culture, we need to adjust the object.
Light supports are transferred.
This is the main difficulty.
There are already additional costs for the geodetic basis, changing the architectural composition, geometry, and they are not over.
Delivery of the object is on October 15, the technology does not imply construction at a later date.
No one is moving deadlines.
The speed after the preparatory stage will increase, ” says Alexander Mytsy.
Builders will have to lay engineering networks, install benches, urns, make parking on the side of adjacent streets, provide convenient access to the territory of the square to residents of the city from the category of people with limited mobility, organize functional and architectural lighting, put stands "Stars of Sports Glory" - they will continue to place the names of famous athletes of Nizhnevartovsk, Another square, which is almost created in Nizhnevartovsk in 2020, just by its name pays tribute to those who create the improvement of urban space - the Square of Builders.
It is located on one of the main streets of the city - Mira Street, almost in the central part of the city.
The total area of the square is 0.83 hectares.
The construction of two parametric galleries, the parametric monument “City ”, with flagpoles integrated into it, a stylized stage with a tribune for performances at events, which additionally provides for the installation of a monumental and decorative composition embodying construction activity, has already been completed here.
In addition, the open square of the square was significantly expanded, for holding solemn events.
In the center of the square there is a sundial with a diameter of 10 meters
In winter, this element of landscaping provides the possibility of installing Christmas spruce.
There are two types of sidewalks: “transit ” with a width of 2 meters and walking paths with a width of 3 meters.
The tracks are poured into the main circle of the square, along the edges of which benches with urns are located.
Each such path has a recreational pocket - a quiet recreation area with a flowerbed and parametric park sofas.
The shape of the pocket is a circle, with a diameter of 9 m. Also, on the lawn areas there are recreational zones, to which secondary paths from limestone in the grass lead.
Recreation areas, the open central area for events are made with a coating of paving slabs of different types and colors with a curb of side stone, covering secondary tracks with granite tiles (granodiorite).
As part of the project, night illumination of the entire territory with modern lamps was performed and a video surveillance system was installed.
Technical Director of IC LLC "Verso-Monolith" (the contractor for works in the Park of Builders) Emil Jabbarov said that all key activities at the facility have been completed.
It remains once again after the construction work to wash the tile, launch the lighting and you can transfer the square for maintenance to the Department of Housing and Communal Services.
The grand opening is scheduled for the beginning of August - the Day of Builders.
“Earlier we decided to take the square into municipal ownership.
I am sure that after the reconstruction it will become another place of attraction of the townspeople.
There is enough room for rest.
It is necessary to make Wi-Fi points.
Without modern elements it is impossible to imagine such objects.
Each new recreation area in the city should include several elements: the possibility of comfortable pastime for residents of all ages, landscaping, video surveillance and access points with Internet access, ” said the head of the city Vasily Tikhonov.
In the square of the Builders plan to hold various events.
The nearest possible date is June 24, when the Victory Parades will be held in cities across the country on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the Victory in the Great Patriotic War.
The head of the city asked the builders to use the square to organize any memorable events here.
And by the day of the builder, a kind of alley of glory will be opened here.
On special stands will be placed portraits of Heroes-builders, leaders of the construction industry.
In general, a constant dialogue with caring Vartovites is already a tradition in the capital of Samotlor.
Public activist Mikhail Plisko noted in a conversation with Nakanune.RU that the reception of certain spaces is an ordinary job for him and his colleagues.
At the same time, all comments of the builders are eliminated.
“Previously, squares and other spaces were built according to plan, and now the options are put to the vote, ” Plisko said.
“The project is interesting.
When planning the renewal of this territory, first of all thought about the builders, it was important what they themselves wanted to see here.
It is necessary to perpetuate the memory of our builders, because the city began with them.
The reconstruction project was chosen, public discussions were held.
What matters is what the residents decide.
First of all, it is necessary to take into account the opinion of industry workers, veterans of the construction business - people who built Nizhnevartovsk, raised Samotlor ", - summarizes the head of the city Vasily Tikhonov.

title: Alley of Ural masters opened in Polevskoe
text:
Shopping arcades, benches and a square with bas-reliefs of fairy-tale characters appeared on the landscaped territory.
Photo: Information Policy Department of the Sverdlovsk Region.
Deputy Minister of Energy and Housing of the Sverdlovsk region Alexey Rubtsov opened the reconstructed Alley of Ural masters in Polevskoye.
Shopping arcades, benches and a square with bas-reliefs of fairy-tale characters appeared on the landscaped territory.
During the opening ceremony of the alley, Alexey Rubtsov congratulated the residents of Polevsky on behalf of the Governor of the Sverdlovsk region Evgeny Kuyvashev and the government on this event.
“Today, using the example of Polevskii, we see how improvement projects transform territories and how significant they are for people.
Thank you all for being an active participant in this difficult but necessary process.
I am sure that the alley of masters is the step that will set the tone and dictate the further directions of development of your urban environment, ” said the deputy head of the Ministry of Housing and Communal Services of the region.
According to the information policy department of the Sverdlovsk region, five functional zones were created in the center of the city.
So, on Troyan Street there were platforms for shopping arcades, and on Karl Marx Street there were covered stopping complexes, benches, flower beds and parking lots.
Pavel Bazhov Square was transformed into a so-called pocket park, where you can see bas-reliefs depicting characters of your favorite fairy tales and the "dry" fountain "Stone Flower".
On the territory of the Archives, a green zone with a reading room was arranged, and on the square near the Center for Culture and Folk Art - a platform for holding mass events.
In addition, paving slabs, lighting, benches and urns were updated on the Alley of Ural masters, as well as the territory was ennobled with new trees and flower beds.
In total, 125 million rubles were allocated for the reconstruction of the alley, of which 85 - a grant for the victory in the All-Russian competition of the best projects for the formation of a comfortable urban environment in small towns and historical settlements.
Recall that today the Governor of the Sverdlovsk region Evgeny Kuyvashev and the Minister of construction and housing and communal services of the Russian Federation Vladimir Yakushev opened in Verkhoturye long-awaited square in the city center, which was spent almost 200 million rubles.
The renovated square will delight local residents with children ’ s and sports areas, as well as places for recreation and mass events.

title: How to stop the creation of a new Ottoman Empire
text:
In the world: How to stop the creation of a new Ottoman Empire 08.10.2020, 17: 33, News of the day The events in Nagorno-Karabakh have become one of many examples of Turkey ’ s aggressive foreign policy in recent years.
President Erdogan clearly makes it clear that he harbors specific plans to dramatically increase the political influence of his country – and maybe territorial acquisitions.
What can hinder the implementation of these plans?
Everyone remembers the scene from “12 chairs ”, when“ Ostap was carried, he felt a surge of new strength and chess ideas ”, and then told the residents of Vasyukov about the prospects of becoming New Vasyuki.
“And there, as you know, maybe eight years from now, the first interplanetary chess tournament in the history of the universe will take place in Vasyuki, ” the son of a Turkishman told the stunned Vasyuki.
The main current Turkish – Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan – can also be called a great combinator.
After all, it tells the people of Turkey – a regional state whose resources are very limited – tales of how to achieve global greatness with the help of Islam, weapons, historical heritage and aggression.
On all fronts, the format of this grandeur is known.
The minimum program is to turn Turkey into a leader, or rather, the master of the “Turkic world ” consolidated by it.
A huge territory, including the Caucasus, Central Asia, part of the Russian Federation (Crimea, the North Caucasus, the Volga region, Siberia).
The optimal program is to add to the Turkic world the space of the former Ottoman Empire, that is, the Middle East and North Africa.
Erdogan ’ s maximum program (and even his ambitions have a limit) is to achieve the status of the caliph of the 21st century – the leader of the entire Muslim world.
At the same time, the difference between Recep Erdogan and Ostap Bender is that the Turkish president is a real big politician.
And he does not just talk about the greatness of Turkey, but goes along the path of achieving it, not hesitating to use force to reformat someone else ’ s space into his own.
It is enough to look at the map and see that in all the conflicts from Morocco to Kyrgyzstan and from Georgia to Somalia there is a Turkish trace.
To work there, Erdogan applies a whole set of different methods: military, ideological, economic, political and even terrorist.
Thus, Ankara uses the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict in order to squeeze out all alien forces from the Caucasus.
First, remove the Western countries in the face of France and the United States (for which Erdogan offers Russia to solve the Armenian-Azerbaijani issues tete-a-tete on the principle of how Moscow and Ankara manage the situation in Idlib), and then move Russia with Iran.
Part of Syria continues to be under Turkish occupation – and it is not clear how and on what terms the Turks will leave from there.
But the Syrian territories are not enough for Ankara – Turkey squeezes out the territorial waters of Greece and encroaches even on the Greek islands.
Not for the sake of land, but in order to control the entire Eastern Mediterranean with the help of Libya (with which there is a treaty on the division of water spaces) and cut it off from the Western Mediterranean.
In Libya itself, Turkey is imposing a vassal regime, viewing the country as a source of hydrocarbons and a gateway for African migrants to Europe (which can be opened or closed at Ankara ’ s request).
Turkey penetrates into other countries of West Africa (primarily Muslim), from where it displaces France and even the ubiquitous China.
On the other side of the Black Continent, Somalia, close to the most important oil trade routes, is a Turkish military base.
The Turkish military is also present in Qatar, posing a threat to Saudi Arabia and protecting Turkish interests in the Persian Gulf.
And the support of Hamas and other Islamic terrorist organizations not only threatens Israel ’ s security, but wins for Turkey the sympathy of the Arab street.
Finally, Turkey is established in Central Asia.
Through investments, TV series (promoting Turkish meanings and cultural images) and Islamists, seriously straining China and Russia.
A nightmare of coalitions?
International relations theorists may think that Recep Erdogan is making two serious mistakes in his political jihad for leadership.
First, it fights on multiple fronts at once, dispersing its country ’ s limited resources.
Second, he makes too many enemies.
And we are not talking about small states such as Armenia, Cyprus or Greece, whose opinion can be ignored.
Erdogan turned against himself regional leaders (Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Iran) as well as great powers like Russia, the United States, France and a little China.
As a result, before the Great Combiner of the 21st century, a scenario may materialize that the Great Combiner of the 19th century, Chancellor of the German Empire Otto von Bismarck called the “nightmare of coalitions ”.
Managing the greatest power of the time, Bismarck was well aware that German aggression could consolidate peace against Berlin, and then even a great Germany would break down.
Which, by the way, happened when the aggressive behavior of the heirs of the “Iron Chancellor ” consolidated other great powers against the Empire.
Theorists are opposed to practice.
They will point out that yes, there are pockets of resistance.
The French send troops to help Greece, Saudi Arabia imposes an embargo on Turkish goods.
However, these hotbeds do not unite, and there is no “nightmare of coalitions ”.
Perhaps because Erdogan is not opposed to Bismarck.
The elites of most of the states whose policies Erdogan opposes are of such low quality that they are not even able to realize the full danger of the Turkish threat.
Turkey is attacking Greece – and Germany wants to negotiate with it.
Paris fits in with Athens – but instead of creating a common anti-Turkish front with Moscow, it calls on the whole of Europe to accept anti-Russian sanctions because of the fake “Navalny case ”.
And the Americans do support Erdogan ’ s actions against Russia, China and Europe – and do not understand that the consolidation of the Islamic world under the rule of Turkey can lead to the expulsion of Americans from the Middle East, Central Asia, North Africa and, perhaps, even Europe.
It is not surprising that the elites of all these countries pass before the Turkish boldness, aggressiveness and game of diplomatic poker (when Turkey sharply raises the stakes and the heat of hysteria, forcing the opponent to pass).
So, no one can stop Erdogan?
The Turkish leader himself is sure of this, but he is wrong.
Yes, the elites of most countries are not eagles, but they make beautiful vultures.
They may be humiliated in front of the eastern dictator, the same Gaddafi, who broke a tent near the Elysee Palace in Paris.
But when this dictator finds himself in a difficult situation, he is simply swept away and starved.
They are also catching up with Erdogan.
After all, the entire strategy of the Turkish Akela, who has become convinced of his own power and behaves more and more aggressively and risky every time, can collapse after the first miss.
This blunder may turn out to be a situation where a single power will give back and demonstrate to the whole world (as well as to the Turkish population, who tolerate Erdogan also because of his victories) the extremely modest limits of Turkish capabilities.
We can talk about the strike of a great power – for example, Russia, which will decide with the help of precision weapons to nullify the Turkish “Bashibuzuks ” (Syrian mercenary terrorists), entrenched in Azerbaijan and threatening the Russian North Caucasus.
A strengthened regional power can also strike – the same Israel, which is not used to ceremonial with the sponsors of terrorism.
Finally, a small country can respond, which Erdogan will drive into a corner with his irrepressible aggression.
And as soon as Erdogan can not answer (and bluff is good only as long as the words do not turn into action) and retreat, vultures will immediately attack him from all sides - to finish and bite.
After that, the internal opposition of Turkey is sharply activated, which consolidates the Turkish population against the “loser president ”.
As a result, the entire house of cards of Erdogan ’ s policy will fall apart, and he risks repeating another famous scene of 12 chairs.
It was a lunar evening.
Ostap raced along the silver street easily, like an angel, starting from the sinful earth.
In view of the failed transformation of Vasyukov into the center of the universe, it was necessary to flee not among palaces, but among log houses with external shutters.
There were chess fans in the back. ”

title: NASA has postponed the first operational flight of the spacecraft Crew Dragon (Crew-1) until November
text:
Click here to share content on Facebook.
The first operational and second manned flight of the spacecraft Crew Dragon (C207 Resilience) of SpaceX will take place not on October 31, as planned, but in early to mid-November.
About the transfer reported the press service of NASA.
NASA has decided to postpone the mission to change the crew of the ISS Crew-1, also known as USCV-1 (US Crew Vehicle 1), in connection with the investigation of a problem with the turbo pump of one of the engines of the first stage of the Falcon 9 rocket when trying to launch the GPS III-04 satellite.
The launch of Crew-1 is expected to take place in early to mid-November 2020.
We � re now targeting NET early-to-mid November for launch of @ NASA � s SpaceX Crew-1 mission to the @ Space _ Station.
The extra time will allow SpaceX to resolve an unexpected observation during a recent non-NASA launch attempt.
More: https: / / t.co / sheWOD74m6 pic.twitter.com / YLq1Tb4LfN — Kathy Lueders (@ KathyLueders) October 10, 2020 Crew-1 — one of six planned SpaceX missions to send people to the ISS as part of an ongoing contact with NASA and its Commercial Crew Program, aimed at supporting commercial space transport companies.
As noted above, this is the first operational flight of the Crew Dragon spacecraft after the first manned mission SpaceX Demo-2.
The Crew-1 crew was announced back in July — three NASA astronauts (Michael Hopkins, Victor Glover and Shannon Walker) and JAXA astronaut (Soichi Noguchi) will go to the ISS.
They will join the ISS-64 expedition.
The duration of this mission will be 210 days.
On how the flight of Crew-1 will depend on the decision to reuse the ships Crew Dragon and the first stages of the Falcon for manned missions under the contract Commercial Crew Program.
It was expected that the C206 Endeavour will be used in the future mission Crew-2, scheduled for spring 2021.
Elon Musk ’ s company has been using already flying ships and the first stages of the Falcon 9 rocket for cargo delivery under the Commercial Resupply Services contract for a long time (in December 2017, the first launch took place as part of the CRS-13 mission, in which both the launch vehicle and the ship were reused simultaneously - SpaceX maximum launched the same ship three times).

title: Bahrain and Israel establish diplomatic relations
text:
Bahrain and Israel established diplomatic relations 18.10.2020, 23: 00, News of the Day October 18 in Manama Bahrain and Israel signed a joint communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic, peaceful and friendly relations, the official Bahraini news agency BNA reported.
Memorandums of understanding were also signed in the fields of economic and trade relations, telecommunications, trade, air traffic, movement of citizens, banking and financial services and cooperation between the ministries of foreign affairs.
“Today ’ s historic signing brings together two friends and partners of America in the Middle East.
The Kingdom of Bahrain and the State of Israel will join the United States in advancing a strategic agenda of peace and prosperity in the Middle East. ”
The parties will continue their efforts to achieve a “just, comprehensive and lasting settlement of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, ” the agency said.
The signing of the communique was observed by the special envoy of the White House, US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin.
The head of the Israeli delegation, national security adviser Meir Ben-Shabbat told reporters that in the morning the participants in the talks were just friends, and broke up with relatives, writes the Times of Israel.
The publication notes that, perhaps, the documents signed in Bahrain will be subject to ratification by the Israeli parliament.
Bahrain became the fourth Arab state with which Israel established formal diplomatic relations (after Egypt, Jordan and the UAE).
On September 11, a statement was released saying that King Hamad bin Isa Al-Khalifa of Bahrain, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, as well as US President Donald Trump in a telephone conversation came to the need to establish full-fledged diplomatic contacts between Bahrain and Israel.
On September 15, in Washington, Netanyahu signed the so-called Abraham Agreements with UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed al-Nahaya and Bahrain Foreign Minister Abdullatif al-Zayani.
Palestinian authorities condemned the deal to normalize relations between Israel and Bahrain, calling it another “stab in the back ” of the Arab state.

title: Israel and Bahrain officially establish diplomatic relations
text:
Israel and Bahrain have officially established diplomatic relations.
The corresponding agreement was signed on Sunday in the capital of Bahrain - Manama, reports The Times of Israel.
The document was signed by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ’ s National Security Advisor Meir Ben-Shabbat and Bahrain ’ s Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al-Zayani.
The U.S. delegation was headed by Steven Mnuchin.
In the document, both countries promised not to take hostile actions against each other and to oppose the hostile actions of third countries.
The parties also agreed to “continue their efforts to achieve a just, comprehensive and lasting settlement of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. ”
In total, the countries have signed eight memorandums of understanding and cooperation in various fields, including civil aviation, agriculture and technology.
Bahrain and Israel agreed to normalize relations in September with the mediation of the United States.
Bahrain is the fourth Arab state to establish diplomatic relations with Israel.
In mid-August, with the support of the United States, the United Arab Emirates agreed on peace with Israel.
The parties later signed formal agreements at a ceremony at the White House in Washington.
The Palestinian leadership declared its strong rejection and condemnation of these agreements and called them “a betrayal of Jerusalem, Al-Aqsa and the Palestinian cause. ”

title: Some relatives of those killed in the downed UIA plane filed a lawsuit against Iran in the United States
text:
Some relatives of the dead passengers of the UIA flight PS752, shot down by the Iranian military, filed a lawsuit against Iran in the Federal Court in Washington.
According to Evropeiskaya Pravda, this is stated in a press release of the law firm Herischi & Associates, located in Washington, which will provide legal support for the case.
The lawsuit was initiated by the relatives of several Americans who died in the downed Boeing.
It is being filed against the Iranian government and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
In the lawsuit, they are accused of failing to protect the lives of civil aviation passengers, silencing the facts and concealing and destroying key evidence.
It is noted that the lawsuit was prepared in coordination with other similar lawsuits against Iran.
“The plaintiffs hope that this case will be an effective step to bring the perpetrators to justice.
Unfortunately, the relatives of the victims have no confidence in the investigation of this crime by those who committed it, and the ability of the Iranian judicial system to administer justice, "the law firm said in a statement.
Ukraine, as a state, is negotiating with Iran along with other countries whose citizens died on board the downed plane, but cannot prevent the relatives of those killed in the Boeing from filing such claims if they want to do so.
At the same time, it is legally impossible to file a personal claim and count on compensation following negotiations at the state level.
Recall that today in Iran began the second round of negotiations over the downed UIA aircraft.
Ukrainian aircraft Boeing-737 airlines UIA, following flight PS 752 Teheran-Kiev, was shot down on the night of January 8, 2020 shortly after takeoff.
There were 167 passengers and nine crew members on board, all of whom died.

title: Israel and UAE agree on practical cooperation
text:
Israel and the United Arab Emirates have signed agreements on visa-free travel, scientific and technical cooperation, investment protection and the establishment of air links.
The ceremony was held at Tel Aviv airport with the participation of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, UAE Finance Minister Obaid Humaid Al Tayer and US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin.
Netanyahu stressed that the parties are counting on long-term fruitful cooperation: “My staff prepared a couple of lines for my speech, they began with these words:“ Today we are witnessing the creation of history. ”
I said that's not the case at all.
It is we who are creating history today – unchanged for many generations.
This is the first official visit of representatives of the United Arab Emirates to Israel.
For the first time since the signing of the historic agreement at the White House, the governments of Israel and the UAE are concluding concrete practical cooperation agreements.
Representatives of the governments of Israel and the UAE during the ceremony stressed that the signed documents are only part of a large program to normalize bilateral relations.
UAE Finance Minister Obaid Humaid Al Tayer spoke about the importance of this step for the Emirates: “I am pleased that we have made significant progress in relations between our governments since the signing of the historic Abraham Peace Accords.
The UAE will maintain its leadership in the region in matters of economic reform, openness and international trade, as well as political stability and peacemaking. ”
After signing the agreement, Netanyahu held talks with the US and UAE finance ministers.
At the same time, members of the governments began a series of meetings dedicated to the future of bilateral cooperation.
The Abraham agreements were signed in Washington between Israel, the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain with the mediation of the United States.
Netanyahu called the reconciliation a “turning point in history ” that“ will help put an end to the Arab-Israeli conflict once and for all. ”
The Arab agreement with Israel was condemned, in particular, by representatives of the Palestinian Authority, viewing it as a betrayal.

title: Israel pacifies for Qatar before the rest of the Arabs - I. Subbotin
text:
Israel pacifies for Qatar before other Arabs - I. Subbotin 00: 53 22.10.2020 Israel has found its place in Arabia The Jewish state can reconcile Qatar with its Arab neighbors Igor Subbotin International columnist under the editor-in-chief of NG 21.10.20 In relations between Qatar and Israel, there is a tendency to improve.
Such estimates are given by Israeli officials.
After the Jewish state normalized relations with the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Bahrain, they said, it could be seen by the Qatari leadership as a possible mediator in the inter-Arab dispute that led to the blockade of Doha three years ago.
The opinion of officials of the Jewish state without naming leads the 13th channel of Israeli television.
The impression that the Qatari ruling house is ready to take a step towards rapprochement with a long-standing regional adversary remained with the Israelis after a recent visit to Doha to resolve issues related to the Gaza Strip.
Qatar mediates regular conflicts around the Palestinian enclave and provides its administration with financial resources, including salaries.
The latest meeting in Doha left the Israeli delegation with the impression that relations with the monarchy are improving.
According to them, the ruling house may consider contacts with Israel as a way to regain the favor of neighbors in the Arabian Peninsula.
In 2017, the emirate became the object of a tough boycott, which was introduced by Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain and Egypt, in retaliation for an independent foreign policy agenda.
The Quartet put forward to Doha a whole list of demands that related not only to foreign policy, but also to the sphere of freedom of speech.
The Qatari side considered it offensive and decided to compensate for the effect of the blockade by strengthening ties with Iran and Turkey.
Qatar, unlike other countries of the Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Persian Gulf (GCC), was the least inclined to cooperate closely with Israel.
The emirate remained aloof from the close coordination in the field of intelligence exchange that was established between the competent departments of the Arabian monarchies and the Jewish state.
This process actually predetermined the restoration of diplomatic relations.
In a conversation with Nezavisimaya Gazeta, associate professor at Qatar University Majed al-Ansari said that the priority for Qatar remains the resolution of the Palestinian issue.
It is for this purpose that the emirate contacts with the authorities of the Jewish state.
“There is no other communication between the Qatari and Israeli governments, ” the analyst said, noting that this position does not affect sports and academic contacts between the countries ’ non-governmental delegations.
According to al-Ansari, Qatar believes that the deal to normalize Israel ’ s relations with the UAE and Bahrain weakens the position of the Palestinian movement and in fact legalizes “settlement activity and aggression against the Palestinians. ”
The fact that one of the main drivers of the so-called Abraham agreements was the search for mutual benefits was proved by the signing of a protocol of intent by the Israeli pipeline company Eilat – Ashkelon to transport raw materials from the Persian Gulf to the Mediterranean.
As follows from the document, the transit of oil will be handled by the Emirates-based company MED-RED Land Bridge (MRLB), which is owned by the private oil company Petromal (Abu Dhabi), Gibraltar ’ s Lubber Line Capital and Israel ’ s AF Entrepreneurship.
In the implementation of the agreement, the Trans-Israel oil pipeline connecting the Mediterranean Sea with the Red Sea will be involved.
As noted by Bloomberg, most likely, other countries of the Arabian Peninsula can join the project.
Nevertheless, one of the GCC leaders, Saudi Arabia, is in no hurry to clarify its position on the need to restore relations with Israel, which, like Qatar, points to the need for a more attentive attitude to the Palestinian problem.
Nezavisimaya Gazeta sources in the GCC pointed out that an obstacle to the possible normalization of relations between Israelis and Saudis remains the position of the older generation of the highest echelons of Saudi power: King Salman looks at the situation more conservatively than his heir Crown Prince Mohammed.
As for the Qataris, it is important for them to resolve the inter-Arab crisis, but not at the cost of serious concessions in foreign policy, Nezavisimaya Gazeta interlocutors say.
According to them, several years of the Qatari blockade have shown that the emirate can do without interaction with its neighbors, focusing on the tactical regional bloc that Turkey and Iran formed.

title: Experts: the proximity of houses to ponds and green areas increases their value (PHOTO)
text:
The proximity of residential buildings to water objects and green areas increases their value in the eyes of buyers, said Nikolai Skladnev, Chief Construction Director of KORTROS Group of Companies at 100 + Forum Russia.
Experts who participated in the session "Urban Embankments", came to the conclusion that in the conditions of the pandemic, when it became more difficult to get out on vacation in other countries, the value of natural objects in the urban space only increases.
The theme of improvement of embankments in the environment of the metropolis was discussed during the session "Comfortable urban environment" at the forum 100 + Forum Russia.
The KORTROS group of companies has several residential development projects in close proximity to water bodies: this is Royal Park in St. Petersburg, Zarechnaya Sloboda in Ivanteevka, Headliner and Serebryany Bor in Moscow and, of course, Akademichesky on the bank of Patrushikha in Yekaterinburg.
Therefore, the company ’ s specialists have seen from their experience: people in large cities are attracted by the proximity to water and nature - this allows you to escape from the hustle and bustle at any time and relax.
“We have a headliner in Moscow City.
In the quarter is a very fast pace of life, people are used to the fact that at any time of the day they run - from work to work.
But the proximity of the Headliner to the river allows residents at least for a short time to move away from the bustle, walking along the embankment, ” said Nikolai Skladnev, General Director of the United Customer Service of the KORTROS Group of Companies.
Landscaped green areas attract residents of the Academic.
On the bank of Patrushikha, the improvement of the Preobrazhensky Park continues, more recently new trees have been planted there, paths have been arranged.
According to the experts of the GC "KORTROS", it is simply necessary to invest money in the development of embankments and natural zones.
At the same time, it is important to hear the opinions of residents and focus on making them comfortable.
“It is necessary to have feedback with people in order to hear their wishes.
And you have no idea how many meetings we have with residents, how many surveys we conduct!
We even have various quay test drives: can a woman with a stroller walk out comfortably?
Because if she doesn't get through with the stroller, she won't go out there with the kids.
And we are constantly interacting with residents to hear feedback, ” Nikolai Skladnev said.
As noted by environmentalists who participated in the session “Comfortable urban environment ”, this year, when the coronavirus pandemic began and many could not leave the city, such public spaces – embankments with green zones – became even more popular among residents of megacities.
“There are large-scale studies of the European branch of the WHO, which confirm that green areas improve air quality, reduce stress, improve social interaction between people.
People ’ s contact with nature is an important component of healthy cities, ” said Veronika Edemskaya, environmentalist, consultant for green certification and sustainable development, HPBS.
The only question that has not yet been resolved by the builders is how to make embankments in Russia all-season?
In winter, according to experts, much less people walk near the water than in summer.
However, this issue may be resolved in the future.
Anna Ivanova, Head of the Urban Environment Design Workshop at the Genplan Institute of Moscow, said that the possibility of making heated coatings in some reconstructed spaces is already being considered in the capital.
“It ’ s expensive, and we haven ’ t started yet, but maybe one day it will become more accessible, ” said the participant of the session.
Nikolai Skladnev added that developers are also ready to consider different options for attracting people to the embankment in winter.
And not only for skating on ice – such examples of space use, of course, already exist: for example, in the Academic on Patrushikha in winter there is a skating rink.
But we have to look for other options.
Ekaterinburg, Olga Tarasova Ekaterinburg.

title: Trump said about the possible desire of Palestine to normalize ties with Israel
text:
US President Donald Trump believes that the state of Palestine would also like to take some steps to normalize relations with Israel.
He said this on Friday, October 23, in the presence of journalists during a telephone conversation with the leaders of Israel and Sudan.
Earlier, it was officially announced that the two countries had reached an agreement on normalizing ties through the mediation of the United States.
Thus, Sudan became another country to join the “Abrahamic Agreements ”.
“By the way, the Palestinians, if you ask about the Palestinians, want to do something about it.
They've never seen anything like it.
They want to do something.
I am sure that this will also be done, "TASS quoted the head of the White House as saying.
According to the American leader, now “at least five ” Muslim countries want to sign agreements on the normalization of relations with Israel.
And as Trump added, there will soon be many more.
Earlier in October, the Knesset of Israel approved an agreement on the normalization of relations between the Jewish state and the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain.
The agreements on normalization of relations were signed on September 15 at the White House by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan and Bahraini Foreign Minister Abdel Latif al-Zayani.
The event was held at the White House in the presence of US President Donald Trump, his wife Melania and invited guests.
One of the points of the “Abraham accords ” implies a suspension by Israel of the extension of its sovereignty to Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
This condition is spelled out in Washington ’ s plan to resolve the Palestinian-Israeli conflict.
The signing of the agreements was condemned in Palestine.
They recalled their ambassador to the UAE and called Abu Dhabi ’ s actions an aggression against its people and a disregard for their rights and shrines.
The Arab Peace Initiative adopted in 2002, on which Palestine is based, provides for the possibility of concluding peace agreements and establishing good-neighbourly relations between the Arabs and Israel, but only if the Jewish State withdraws from the territories it occupied in 1967, including the Golan Heights and the Shab'a farms, and recognizes the State of Palestine in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, with East Jerusalem as its capital.

title: Biden ’ s answer: Trump took up the conflict in Karabakh before the US elections
text:
US President Donald Trump has promised to resolve the conflict in Nagorno-Karabakh.
Speaking to his supporters in New Hampshire, the American leader expressed confidence that it will be quite simple, although the confrontation in the region has been going on for almost 30 years.
Trump started talking about this after seeing several people with the flag of Armenia in a crowd of his associates.
“I call it an easy case.
We'll figure it out.
Go and tell it to your people...
It ’ s easy if you know what you ’ re doing, ” the president said.
According to him, the White House is working on this issue and may well succeed, as it has already settled the confrontation between Serbia and the unrecognized Kosovo, as well as helped to establish peace in the Middle East.
“Look at the Armenians, they are incredible people.
They fight like hell.
And you know we're gonna do something.
We will solve these problems, we will fix it, ” Trump continued.
The US president also reminded his supporters that he has been nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize three times, and he should definitely get it at least for his actions on Syria.
The peacekeeper president?
Trump ’ s ambitious plans to receive the award, which was awarded to his predecessor Barack Obama, have long been known, but the Norwegian Nobel Committee is not in a hurry to reward the American leader.
This year ’ s award went to the UN World Food Programme, although Trump was also on the list of nominees for the award.
At the same time, the attempts of the head of the White House to resolve conflicts in different parts of the world cannot be called as successful as Trump himself says.
For example, if we consider the Middle East, Trump actually hints at the end of the Arab-Israeli conflict due to the agreement on the normalization of relations between Israel and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
The parties concluded the treaty with the active mediation of the United States, and it really has special significance.
Arab states have long refused to recognize Israel until all of its disputes with Palestine have been resolved.
The departure of the UAE from this installation, in fact, destroys the unified position of the Arab world on this issue and sets the tone for recognition of Tel Aviv by other states.
Most of all, this creates problems for Palestine, as it loses much needed support, which could force the authorities to go for the “deal of the century ” – another initiative of Trump, namely a plan to resolve all disputes between Palestinians and Israelis.
The agreement has a serious bias in favor of Israel, in particular, does not take into account the key demand of the Palestinians to establish the capital of the future state in East Jerusalem.
In contrast, the US plan recognizes the city as an indivisible part of the Jewish state.
In such circumstances, it is difficult to talk about peace in the Middle East thanks to Trump ’ s initiatives.
From the point of view of a number of experts, the split of the Arab world is unlikely to have positive consequences for the region, especially due to the desire of the United States to create an anti-Iranian coalition, primarily to implement its policy of “maximum pressure ” on Tehran.
If we consider the deal between Serbia and Kosovo, then there is no need to talk about any end of the confrontation.
So far, Belgrade has agreed only to restore economic relations with Pristina, but continues to consider the region its territory.
As Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic said, Serbia ’ s position on the Kosovo issue has not changed since the signing of the agreement on the normalization of economic relations in Washington.
“It is obvious that we have a very long, difficult, even, I would say, painful search for a compromise, if at all possible, ” the Serbian leader stressed.
By the way, at a rally in New Hampshire, Trump did not mention another of his achievements, which he had previously actively promoted as worthy of the Nobel Prize – a treaty with North Korea.
Two years ago, the US President went to talks with the leader of the DPRK Kim Jong-un, making an attempt to resolve the inter-Korean crisis and launch the process of denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula.
The very fact of negotiations and the achievement of preliminary agreements, the White House actively promoted as a stop to nuclear war, but it was not possible to move beyond the meetings.
The discussion of denuclearization is at an impasse, in part because of Washington ’ s reluctance to make concessions to Pyongyang, at least to lift some of the sanctions.
The DPRK refuses to continue dialogue with the United States.
Most likely, that ’ s why Trump decided to bypass this topic.
However, the attention of the US President to the Karabakh conflict at his rally is important.
First, in the election aspect, it is a response to criticism from Democratic candidate Joe Biden.
He accused the White House and Trump of a passive position and the transfer of the “palm ” to resolve the conflict in Russia.
In addition, Biden lamented Washington ’ s loyal attitude to Turkey and Iran, which interfere in the armed confrontation between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
Secondly, Trump ’ s statement on the conflict can be regarded as Washington ’ s bias in favor of Yerevan in this matter.
Thirdly, the words of the US President about the easy settlement of the confrontation is a controversial statement.
Washington plays an important role in this matter as one of the co-chairs of the OSCE Minsk Group, within the framework of which relevant negotiations have been conducted for 28 years.
However, so far the efforts of Washington, as well as other states, have not yielded serious results.
The conflict escalated at the end of September and has since failed to establish a full-fledged ceasefire in the region.
Agreements are consistently violated, which the parties accuse each other of.
On the morning of October 26, the third ceasefire, concluded directly with the mediation of the United States, began to operate, but it was also disrupted.

title: Coronavirus pandemic exacerbates Japan's demographic crisis
text:
Home » Latest News » World news » The coronavirus pandemic exacerbates the demographic crisis in Japan The coronavirus pandemic exacerbates the demographic crisis in Japan The coronavirus pandemic exacerbates the demographic crisis in Japan Close Send The fall in the number of pregnancies and marriages in Japan during the coronavirus pandemic is likely to exacerbate the demographic crisis in a rapidly aging country.
Japan is the oldest society in the world: it is expected that by 2050, more than 35% of its population will be aged 65 years and older, which poses risks to economic growth and drains public finances, enovosty.com / news reports.
“I believe that the spread of coronavirus makes many people worry about pregnancy, childbirth and raising children, ” Tetsushi Sakamoto, Japan ’ s minister of fertility response, said at a press conference on Friday.
Recently published official data showed that the number of registered pregnancies for three months decreased by 11.4% compared to a year earlier, and the number of marriages for the same period decreased by 36.9%.
The sharp decline in the number of marriages matters because most children in Japan are born married.
“This is very serious because the negative effects could persist and the economic downturn would lead to fewer marriages and then fewer children being born, ” said Hideo Kumano, chief economist at the Dai-ichi Life Research Institute.
Scientists have identified the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on human fertility The pandemic has exacerbated a pre-existing downward trend in fertility that former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe called a “national crisis. ”
The birth rate in 2019 decreased by 5.8% to 865,000 babies, which is the lowest figure ever.
The Japanese Pediatric Association has warned that the decline in fertility could be accelerated by a decade due to a pandemic — a trend that could not only destroy pediatric medicine but also have far-reaching consequences.
The International Monetary Fund forecasts the global economy to grow at 5.2% in 2021, but expects Japan to grow at 2.3%.
A recent survey conducted by the Nikkei newspaper showed that most of the 22 economists surveyed expect that the Japanese economy will not return to pre-pandemic levels until 2024.
Politicians are struggling to cope with the crisis by covering infertility treatment with medical insurance and doubling the upper limit of a one-time state allowance for newlyweds to 600,000 yen ($5,726).
“There are different predictions about what will happen if fertility continues to fall, but one thing is for sure.
Existing systems, including the social security system, will no longer work, ” Masaji Matsuyama, a former minister overseeing the issue of declining fertility, told Reuters.
"It will be a crisis in which the very existence of the nation as we know it will be at stake."
Source: Reuters

title: Experts: By the middle of the century Belarus will warm up to 41 ° C
text:
While Belarus is only losing from global warming – watermelons and grapes do not yet compensate for the losses from climate change.
In a couple of decades, according to scientists, the climate of Belarus will change significantly.
Over the past 25 years, it has already become different - a new agro-climatic zone has appeared in the country, but the upcoming changes will be even more interesting.
At the round table “Belarus and global climate change ”, organized by the United Nations Development Programme, various consequences of changes were discussed, and the results of what has already happened were also presented.
According to Viktor Melnik, a senior researcher at the Institute of Nature Management of the National Academy of Sciences, over the past 25-30 years, the average annual temperature in Belarus exceeded the climate norm by 1.3 degrees.
Precipitation increased by about 5%.
“At the same time, the increase in precipitation did not lead to significant improvements in agriculture, since precipitation began to fall more in winter, and in summer, due to the increase in temperature, moisture evaporation increased, that is, agriculture, on the contrary, began to suffer more from the number of droughts, ” said Victor Melnik.
The greatest increase in temperature, according to scientists, occurred in the winter and spring months.
Negative factors of the impact of climate change Viktor Melnik called the increasing number of hot days, periods of drought, heat waves in cold periods, an increase in the intensity of precipitation.
Because of the above, the following negative processes are observed in agriculture: weakening of hardening of plants, their damage as a result of soaking and temperature drop, infectious diseases due to warm winters.
Forests and peatlands burn more often, the level of groundwater falls.
Summer in the south of Belarus now lasts 100 days in the north and up to 120 days in the south.
On the one hand, utility costs are reduced in winter - snow removal, heating, etc., on the other hand, in the summer, electricity consumption increases due to the operation of air conditioners.
In addition, it is possible to include an increase in the duration of the growing season of plants and an increase in the efficiency of crop production, if we talk about thermophilic crops that are new for Belarus.
According to scientists, due to adverse and dangerous weather phenomena associated with warming, Belarus annually loses about $100 million.
According to the head of the Department of climate study Belhydromet Natalia Klevets, by 2050-2059 the absolute maximum air temperatures in the country will increase to plus 39-41 ° C, "now the absolute maximum is + 38.9 degrees in Gomel, on average - from 35 to 38 degrees in the country."
In winter, the air temperature minus 25 ° C and below will be anomalous cold.
“By the middle of the century, the duration of the heating season may be reduced by 15-20 days, ” said Natalia Klevets.
Rainfall will also increase by 30 millimeters in winter by 2050.
In accordance with the Paris Agreement to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, which Belarus signed in 2016, by 2030 the country should reduce greenhouse gas emissions by at least 28% to the level of 1990.
The Strategy for Long-term Development with Low Greenhouse Gas Emissions until 2050 has been approved.
A national action plan for adaptation to climate change is being prepared.
One of the most successful ways to reduce CO2 emissions is to restore degraded wetlands.
To this end, the “Wetlands ” project is being implemented in the country, which continues a series of similar ones launched by UNDP and Belarusian partners in 1999.

title: Bayer reported a bad quarter due to the pandemic and lawsuits « Russian Pharmaceuticals
text:
Bayer reported an unsuccessful quarter due to the pandemic and lawsuits Bayer published a report for the third quarter, according to which revenue and sales of the company decreased.
The pharmaceutical industry of the corporation tried as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic and legal proceedings.
German chemical-pharmaceutical transnational corporation Bayer published a report for the third quarter of 2020 fiscal year, which states that the manufacturer of medicines suffered due to the coronavirus pandemic, resulting in net losses of the company amounted to $3.2 billion, and revenue decreased by 4.2% to $36.8 billion.
In general, Bayer sales in the third quarter fell by 13.5% compared to the same period of 2019 - to $9.9 billion.
Sales in the pharmaceutical sector decreased by 6.1%, reaching $4.9 billion.
Among the positive aspects, we can note the increase in sales of oral anticoagulant "Xarelto" by 13.8%, which has a special demand in Germany and Russia; ophthalmic drug "Eilea", actively sold in China; anti-cancer drug "Stivarga" by 17.5%, especially in the United States.
COVID-19 is said to have exacerbated the problems Bayer faced after its acquisition of agricultural company Monsanto two years ago.
This summer, the pharmaceutical company pledged to pay $10.9 billion in court compensation for cancer patients from the herbicide Roundup, which went to Bayer from Monsanto.
More than 125,000 people filed their claims.
However, it has not yet been established whether this herbicide causes cancer.
Bayer said it would need an additional $750 million to pay off the debt.
Against the background of litigation, the shares of the drug manufacturer fell to record low values (by 43% since the beginning of the year).
In the second quarter, net losses amounted to $11 billion due to the need to pay compensation.
The company has already paid off its debt in 80,000 lawsuits.
Bayer CFO Wolfgang Nickle stressed that the third quarter was difficult mainly due to problems in the agricultural sector of the corporation.
The company is gradually restoring its position in the field of production of medicines.

title: Due to crop failure in Western Europe increased demand for Russian wheat
text:
Against the background of climate change, the regions of the Black Earth region, Central Russia and even the North-Western Federal District are beginning to play an increasing role in the development of the Russian agro-industrial complex.
In these areas, yields are growing, due to which the all-Russian indicators for the collection of grain (more than 130 million tons) exceeded the level of 2019 (about 120 million), even despite the damage from drought and frost in the south of the country.
So, the expectations of farmers were not justified in the Stavropol region and the Kuban, partly in the Rostov region, although it still turned out to be the leader in grain, threshing 11.7 million tons against more than 12 million in 2019.
The high indicator was maintained due to a large territory and an increase in the area under winter crops.
Meanwhile, increased yields were observed in the Voronezh, Tambov, Lipetsk, Moscow, Bryansk, Smolensk and Tula regions.
In general, the trend of shifting harvests to the north is not the first year.
Traditionally, the black earth regions were distinguished against the general background - at the expense of more fertile soils.
However, after climate change began to increase yields, for example, in the Tver and Yaroslavl regions, in the North-Western district.
This is facilitated by the introduction of modern agricultural technologies - with the use of fertilizers and plant protection products, good equipment and new business models.
Holdings, which worked mainly in the granaries of Russia, began to enter the territory where grain was not so actively engaged.
And the Stavropol Territory and its neighboring regions, we will eventually begin to perceive, relatively speaking, as Spain, that is, as a place where intensive farming technologies will be associated primarily with artificial irrigation.
Drought in the south continues during the sowing period of winter crops, which causes alarm among farmers regarding the harvest-2021.
However, the key role should play the amount of moisture in the spring.
But in Central Russia, due to climate change, the risk of death of winter crops was minimized.
According to the forecasts of our experts, the development of abandoned lands will be expanded in these regions.
Moreover, the Rosselkhoznadzor fines the owners of such territories, calculating the amount of recovery based on the cadastral value of the site.
If, three years after the discovery of abandoned land, nothing changes, the legislation allows them to withdraw.
Prices for some types of agricultural products in Russia have already increased markedly or may rise during the year.
For example, in 2020, we can expect a rise in the price of buckwheat again.
Moreover, this is not due to crop failure, nor to increased demand, nor to prices in world markets.
For the cultivation of this culture is characterized by swings: when the buckwheat is threshed good, the prices of cereals fall, in response, farmers reduce the sown area, the volume of products on the market decreases, and prices go up again.
A similar situation, although not so noticeable for the end user, is developing in the Russian market with peas.
Producer selling prices may rise by 20-30 percent compared to the level of 2019.
In retail, the mark-up, and much higher, can be set by packers, wholesalers, and retail chains.
Due to the general crop failure, the cost of potatoes rises, onions, carrots and beets can rise in price.
In addition to not the most favorable weather conditions, in 2020 the price should be affected by the shortage of labor, which due to the pandemic developed during the cultivation, and most importantly - harvesting of open ground vegetables.
The construction of modern warehouses that allow farmers to store high-quality crops while waiting for prices to rise can also affect prices.
It is more profitable for farms to sell their products after the mass trade ends "from the field" and from outdated warehouses.
Wholesale prices for sugar today are twice as high as last year ’ s A special situation is with sugar beets.
Due to the decrease in crops and yields, wholesale sugar prices more than doubled compared to last year.
We have been overproducing this product for a long time.
Agrarians are still inclined to reduce the sowing of this crop, which is often accompanied by underloading or closing of sakhzavod.
As for the world markets, due to the failure of the grain harvest in Western Europe, the high price was established for Russian wheat.
Consistently expensive rapeseed and sunflower.
World prices for oilseeds are pushing up the increase in consumption.
The scope of application of oilseeds is constantly expanding.
They produce not only food, but also paint products, and biofuels.
Farmers are largely oriented to the foreign market.
But in Russia, oil plants are developing intensively, whose owners, taking care of the loading of capacities with affordable raw materials, advocate for export quotas.
This can happen with the sunflower for the first time.
With potatoes, the situation is the opposite: we almost do not export it, but domestic processing is not developed.
So a significant part of French fries and chips is made from imported raw materials.
Farmers are very much looking forward to the development of enterprises working on domestic potatoes.
We predict further growth of areas under cereals, soybeans and rapeseed.
Sunflower crops will increase by three to five percent per year.
There are not so many suitable lands, and the share of this crop in crop rotation should not be too high.
Farmers are showing increased interest in horticulture and viticulture, as well as rice cultivation, thanks to subsidy programmes.

title: SpaceX has received from NASA a license for manned flights
text:
After completing all the checks, NASA issued SpaceX official permission to fly to the ISS with people on board.
This is the first such certification issued by the US space agency in 40 years since the launch of the Space Shuttle program in 1981.
The first flight of the certified ship Crew Dragon to the ISS will take place this Sunday.
NASA has announced the official readiness of the Crew Dragon capsule and the Falcon 9 rocket for flights with astronauts on board to orbit and back.
This is an event of historic significance for both the agency and private space company SpaceX – over the past six years, NASA has provided most of the money for the development of the Crew Dragon spacecraft and conducted hundreds of tests.
Do not miss SpaceX is preparing to launch Crew Dragon: the crew arrived at the spaceport, the ship on the launch table "Thanks to NASA for the continuous support of SpaceX and partnership in achieving this goal.
I am proud of every SpaceX employee and all of our suppliers who have worked tirelessly to develop, test and launch the first commercial manned spacecraft in history certified by NASA.
This is a huge honor that gives confidence in our plans to return to the moon, flight to Mars and, ultimately, the transformation of man into an interplanetary species, ” said Elon Musk.
The certification took place after the agency and SpaceX completed the analysis of the trial mission Demo-2, which took place in the summer, and clarified all the nuances of the future Crew-1, scheduled for November 15.
This time from the spaceport in Florida will take off three Americans - Mike Hopkins, Victor Glover and Shannon Walker and one Japanese astronaut Soichi Noguchi.
They will spend six months on the ISS.
The rocket and the ship for the mission had already been installed on the launch pad.
Crew Dragon in the framework of the mission Crew-1, starting on November 15 / Photo NASA Now NASA will be able to increase the contingent of its astronauts on the ISS from six to seven.
This means more research and experimentation for US science.
Falcon 9 rocket with the ship Crew Dragon on the launch table / Photo SpaceX When the launch of Crew-1 The launch is scheduled for November 14, 2020 at 7: 49 am local time (Kiev time the launch will take place on November 15 at 02: 49).
Astronauts have already managed to come up with the name of the ship - Crew Dragon Resilience, which means "stability".
During the Demo – 2 mission, astronauts on the way to the ISS named their spacecraft Crew Dragon Endeavour in honor of the last space shuttle.
At first, the Crew-1 mission was supposed to start on October 31, but was postponed to November at the request of NASA to complete the hardware testing and data analysis necessary to assess the non-invasive mode of operation of the first stage of the gas generators of the engine of the first stage of the Falcon 9 rocket, recorded during the recent launch of the rocket.
NASA plans to deliver astronauts to the ISS Since the termination of the Space Shuttle program in 2011, the United States has paid Russia from 55 million to 80 million dollars for a place on the Soyuz spacecraft, which goes to the ISS.
The certificate, obtained by SpaceX, gives the United States the opportunity to abandon the services of Roscosmos and save $25 million on each astronaut delivered to the ISS.
In addition, Boeing is also developing its space capsule, so NASA plans to use the services of two private companies that will compete with each other.
The Crew-1 mission was initially scheduled to launch on October 31, but was rescheduled to November at NASA's request to complete hardware testing and data analysis needed to assess the non-invasive first-stage gas generator operation of the Falcon 9 first-stage engine during a recent rocket launch.
