title: Launch of SpaceX Crew Dragon: online broadcast of the Crew 1 mission
text:
SpaceX launches the Crew Dragon Resilience spacecraft.
The first in the history of SpaceX, as well as in the history of space technology, the flight of four astronauts aboard the Crew Dragon spacecraft as part of the Crew-1 mission is about to start.
Tell us everything you need to know about the mission.
Preparations for the flight were particularly active.
Engineers and technicians have previously checked the readiness of all systems, according to Channel 24.
Do not miss SpaceX received from NASA the first ever license for manned flights Broadcast launch Crew-1 Stream NASA Stream SpaceX All you need to know about the flight Unlike the historic Demo-2 mission, which aimed to demonstrate the technical ability to deliver people to the ISS using the Crew Dragon spacecraft, the Crew-1 mission is the first full-fledged manned mission of NASA and SpaceX.
As part of the mission to the ISS will go the first for Crew Dragon international crew of four astronauts: Michael Hopkins, Shannon Walker, Victor Glover and Japanese Soichi Noguchi.
Crew Dragon Resilience Crew Crew Crew Crew Dragon Resilience Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Dragon Resilience Crew Crew Crew Crew Dragon Resilience Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew Crew
He is not new to orbit and has already been to the ISS, where he spent 166 days.
Of these, Hopkins spent 12 hours 58 minutes outside the station while performing tasks that required spacewalks.
Crew Dragon ’ s pilot is astronaut Victor Glover, who joined NASA in 2013 and was selected as a pilot for the Crew-1 mission in 2017.
Mission specialist Shannon Walker is an experienced astronaut who joined NASA in 2004 and flew the shuttles to the ISS.
The Crew-1 mission for Walker will be the second flight into orbit.
Mission specialist Soichi Noguchi is a Japanese veteran astronaut who has been with JAXA since 1996.
He is the only one on the team and the third astronaut in history to fly into space on three different ships: the shuttle, the Soyuz and the Crew Dragon.
The mission's task is to support the commander and pilot during the flight.
They monitor the status of the systems at launch and return, and are also responsible for the work schedule, telemetry and stocks on the ship.
As the Crew Dragon is flying for the first time with four people on board, mission specialists will help determine how best to organize and distribute tasks in such conditions.
Take a peek at the crew making their way through the crew access arm and adding their signatures to "the white room."
# LaunchAmerica pic.twitter.com / nySGwC47H0 — NASA (@ NASA) November 15, 2020 Flight plan Under favorable weather conditions, the rocket will start on November 16 at 2: 27 Kyiv time.
The ship will reach the ISS on November 17 at 06: 00 in Kiev and in the autonomous mode docks with the node IDA-2 module "Harmony".
There is also a manual docking mode in case of an emergency.
Launch Timeline -45: 00 SpaceX Launch Manager confirms readiness for refueling the rocket fuel -42: 00 Sleeve retraction for landing astronauts -37: 00 Dragon emergency rescue system is ready -35: 00 RP-1 (rocket fuel-1, kerosene) -35: 00 The first stage of the rocket begins refueling with liquid oxygen -16: 00 Start refueling second stage of the rocket with liquid oxygen -07: 00 The cooling of Falcon 9 engines begins before the start -05: 00 Dragon is transferred to internal power -01: 00 The onboard computer begins the final pre-launch check -01: 00 The fuel tanks are pressurized to the flight pressure level -00: 45 The SpaceX launch manager confirms the readiness for launch -00: 03 The command is given to ignite the engines -00: 00 Start Falcon 9 00: 58 MaxQ - Maximum aerodynamic pressure on the rocket 02: 37 Shutdown of the first stage engines 02: 40 Separation of the first and second stages 02: 48 Shutdown of the second stage engine 07: 29 Shutdown of the first stage engines upon re-entry 08: 50 Shutdown of the second stage engines 08: 59 Shutdown of the first stage engines for landing 09: 29 Landing of the first degree to the floating platform Just Read The Instructions 12: 03 Separation of Dragon from the second stage 12: 48 Opening of the nose fairing Dragon After docking, the Crew Dragon team will meet with the crew of the ISS cosmonauts Sergei Ryzhikov, Sergei Kud-Sverchkov, and astronaut Kate Rubins.
It is worth noting that after that, the ISS crew will increase to 7 people, and this is the first time in almost ten years, when there will be more than six people in orbit on the ISS.
By the way, the station has only six beds: four in the American segment of the station and two in the Russian, which means that someone will have to sleep on the ship Crew Dragon.
Most likely, the place in the ship will be taken by Captain Michael Hopkins, according to the old tradition of astronauts from the time of the shuttle flight.
Subsequently, another cabin will be delivered to the ISS.
In general, the Crew-1 mission will last five and a half months.
All this time, astronauts will spend on research, experiments and work on servicing the station, including spacewalks.
It is interesting that in the framework of one of the tasks, the astronauts will have to "repark" the Crew Dragon from the docking node IDA-2 to IDA-3.
This will happen in early 2021 – before the arrival of the Boeing Starliner, which will have to dock with the IDA-2.
Return to Earth is scheduled for spring 2021.
By this Crew-1, most likely, will have time to cross with Crew-2, so there is every chance to see two ships Crew Dragon at once on the station.
Interesting fact.
The launch of Crew Dragon was previously scheduled for November 15, but it was postponed due to adverse weather conditions, due to which the Just Read The Instructions floating platform could not reach the landing zone in time.
This is an important point, as NASA expects to use the first stage of the Falcon 9 rocket again when launching the Crew-2 mission.
The updated Crew Dragon Ship on which the crew of the Crew-1 mission will go to the ISS, has received some changes compared to the previous version.
The fact is that during the flight of the Demo-2 mission, it turned out that several heat-shielding tiles were subjected to more degradation than expected.
SpaceX noted that this did not threaten the crew.
The problem was solved by replacing the necessary heat-shielding plates with a more stable option.
In addition, experts have replaced the ship's atmospheric pressure sensor, which is used to determine the height.
Last time, the opening of the parachutes occurred somewhat later than the technicians expected (however, within normal limits).
Finally, the new Dragon capsule of the Crew-1 mission was named Resilience.
The crew dedicated this name to the employees of SpaceX, NASA, their loved ones and all the people who show resilience during the global pandemic.

title: radio3.ru
text:
17 November 2020 "In the midst of the bustle and routine of paper in every fate arises Once..."
Once upon a time in Harem...
Translated from Arabic, the word “harem ” means a forbidden, sacred place.
In the time of the sultans, the so-called closed and guarded residential part of the palace or house in which the wives of Muslims lived.
Thanks to literature and painting, the harem gradually acquired its fantastic image of a separate world, a closed environment immersed in luxury and secrets, a forbidden part of the culture of the East, which you certainly want to touch.
From early childhood, I felt a special awe from Eastern music and dance.
From the first minute I fell in love with the Turkish film “The King is a songbird ”.
With excitement followed the fate of Feride and Kamran (the main characters of the novel).
In my youth, Tarkan became my idol, a little later Mustafa Sandal.
Once in my life there was an opportunity to spend a vacation abroad, the country did not have to choose for a long time.
I was able to instill my love for Turkey in all members of my family.
When my daughter was a child, the whole world revolved around her.
Proper nutrition, timely rest, close attention in everything.
Vacation was no exception, regardless of the rich cultural programs and the desire to “stand out ” the child was always in the first place.
Time flew by unnoticed, the daughter became a student of the university and this fall could not make us company.
This year, my husband and I went for the first time to rest alone.
September was coming to an end when our plane landed at Antalya International Airport.
We flew “from plus ten degrees Celsius ” and landed“ at plus thirty-five. ”
After going through all the customs formalities, we went to a hotel modelled on Topkapi Palace in Istanbul in the style of the Great Ottoman Empire.
At the reception we were greeted by a smiling employee, checked in at the hotel and warned about the upcoming meeting with the guide of the tourist company of the host party, which was to take place the next morning.
Tired after a tedious journey, but happy, we went after a thin boy who kindly offered to carry our numerous suitcases.
The rooms in the hotel were located in separate buildings, topped with turrets, united with each other by alleys, entwined with flowering trees and plants.
The hotel immediately plunged us into the atmosphere of the palace town.
Reaching the room, I jumped out onto the balcony and saw fabulous buildings decorated with colorful mosaics, a huge swimming pool and a beautiful turquoise sea.
Squealing with joy, I offered to quickly change clothes and go “to explore ” our place of rest.
People walked around leisurely, singing unusual birds.
My husband and I differed sharply from other vacationers in the color of the skin, which was sour cream and white, as well as the tension in the face and body, which had not yet plunged into a full rest.
The end of the day was as if in one breath.
The sun quickly disappeared behind the horizon, by dinner it was already dark on the street.
We decided not to stay on the evening program, because we fell from our feet with fatigue and a wave of pleasant emotions.
In the room we were waiting for a huge bed, covered with snow-white crispy linen with the aroma of sandalwood.
The dream took us into its arms as soon as the heads touched the soft pillows.
In the morning we were waiting for a meeting with the guide, which was warned by the girl from the reception.
Having collected the necessary documents, we went to the conference room.
Around were girls, waitresses, dressed in national costumes, everywhere there were fresh flowers.
A young cheerful guy named Dima introduced himself as our guide, told about the rules of conduct in the hotel and the country, the plan for placing bars and restaurants, the nuances of using insurance.
Then he went on to demonstrate the excursion program.
Bright pictures, video screensavers, accompanied by well-learned emotional text and the opportunity to get a chic discount today, have done their job.
Without thinking, my husband and I decided to go on a short trip to the Mediterranean Sea on a luxurious multi-deck yacht under the mysterious name “Harem ”.
The eastern interiors of the ship beckoned with their beauty.
Animation program, photo shoot in national costumes, foreign drinks, visiting the most beautiful and huge waterfall, swimming in the open sea foreshadowed the opportunity to spend a wonderful day.
Dima easily gave us tickets, took cash and offered another day to visit the historical center of Antalya.
Being in a state of euphoria, we picked up on this idea and bought another opportunity to touch the history of the country that I had been in love with since early childhood.
The next few days were spent in an endless feast of soul and body.
The sea of ​ ​ fresh milk temperature and the bright, but not merciless sun gave our skin a ruddy shade, blurring the line between us and other vacationers.
Live music in the evenings, delicious cocktails, thoughts that were further removed from work, plunged our souls into peace.
The opportunity to be close to a loved one, with whom we almost did not see before the holiday, gave my heart delight.
The day came when the yacht "Harem" was supposed to reveal all the secrets of Eastern culture.
At the appointed time, we went to the reception, showed the tickets and began to wait for the bus to come for us.
The transport was late.
We noticed that other tourists began to worry next to us.
The man, who, like us, was concerned about the delay of the bus, had a black curly hair and a huge black beard, was dressed in shorts and a loose T-shirt.
Next to him was another man and two women dressed in long dark dresses.
The women ’ s heads were covered with black scarves.
There was a girl around four years old.
When I listened, I realized that tourists speak Russian.
The morning sun was gaining strength, the air temperature began to rise.
Looking at the women, I felt sorry for them, because even in shorts I was getting hot.
But the women were chatting about something, not paying attention to the approaching heat.
Fifteen minutes later, a huge bus pulled up behind us.
In fact, there are almost no places left in it.
We hardly found places in the tail and went to the sea station, where we were waiting for the long-awaited yacht.
The guide on the bus usually tells us about the place where we go, the customs of the country or the latest news.
But then we had no idea how unexpected our mini-journey would be.
The guide girl decided to break all the templates as much as possible and began the story about the series “The Magnificent Century ”.
Then she interrupted herself and clarified that the historical events in this film are seriously distorted.
Soon she returned to the last events in the life of the film Sultan Suleiman and Hürrem.
My beloved husband looked at me questioningly, because he had never seen this film, and I only shrugged my shoulders in response.
A moment later, I noticed that he had fallen asleep sweetly, swaying in his chair under the tedious squeaky voice of a guide retelling the story of a film that was unlikely to ever be seen.
Half an hour later, we were there.
When we got off the bus, we followed the guide.
To enter the territory of the seaport, it was necessary to overcome the metal detector frame.
The smile was caused not by the fact that the frame did not make any sounds at all, but by the fact that there was not a single worker near it, and it could easily be bypassed.
Abandoning the irony, we boldly moved towards new sensations, but, coming closer, to put it mildly, we were stunned.
Before us flaunted a species of vessel - a catamaran with the inscription "Harem".
At first, I didn ’ t even believe that it could fit about forty people.
Climbing the flimsy bridge, I realized that we had been deceived a little, but, calling my optimism, did not panic ahead of time.
Seeing the deck, my hopes for comfort began to melt like the first snow.
To sit on the sofas, first you had to wipe them thoroughly from the dirt.
It is good that we always take wet wipes with us.
For the photo shoot, instead of national clothes, a large, beautiful, multi-colored parrot was proposed.
Foreign drinks were replaced by locally produced drinks.
However, the wine offered on the way, even to such an unspoiled connoisseur as I seemed to be made from polyethylene waste.
Tea we did not even dare to try, because it was served in disposable dishes, re-washed in the basin with a strange color liquid.
There was no water in the toilet quickly.
The shower hoses needed to wash the salt off the face and body after swimming in the sea were missing.
The gun, intended for a foam party, according to staff, mysteriously disappeared on the eve of the trip.
The animation program was replaced by noisy club music mixed with cheerful Jewish songs.
We looked at each other and couldn ’ t say a word.
But in the eyes of my husband, I saw that familiar light, which foreshadowed great health problems with the guide Dima.
I was bitter that I insisted on the tour, and offended for such a “stupid divorce ”.
However, our compatriots from other hotels, having drunk wine, having refreshed themselves with a dubious dinner, to which we did not dare to go, had fun to glory.
They sang loudly and danced chaotically, without falling into the beat of the music.
The last chance to correct the unpleasant sensations of the trip was to contemplate the largest and most beautiful city waterfall.
But as soon as we got close to him, it became clear that there was no more chance.
A huge jet of light brown color fell from a rock located on the outskirts of Antalya, and with a noise fell into the beautiful turquoise Mediterranean Sea.
The unusual color of the waterfall, located within the city, without further ado convinced us that it is part of the sewage of the resort city.
People rushed to photograph the "charms" of nature.
Later, for a fee, several tourists moved to a motorboat to take a closer look at the streams of fresh impure water.
Water dust with sewage covered the bow and middle part of the vessel with a thin layer.
Now it became clear why the surfaces of tables and chairs are so sticky.
Passengers were then asked to swim.
It seemed that everything around was a bad dream, in which everyone but us, for some reason, is good and fun.
The husband agreed to the tour only because of swimming in the open sea, but now in his eyes I saw only the flames of indignation.
Getting away from the noise and demonic races of drunk fellow citizens, we decided to sit on the nose of the yacht "Harem", which for a few hours really turned into a place where it was impossible to get out.
This captivity should have lasted for a few more hours.
Traditionally wiping wet wipes from dirt chairs, we sat down, but soon found that our clothes became wet from small splashes and also exuded an unpleasant smell.
The views of the beautiful sea calmed us a little, and the return to the seaport gave indescribable joy.
My husband helped me get off the ladder and we went to our bus.
Arriving there early, we took the opportunity to choose a more comfortable place than the one we got on the way to the seaport.
So did our hotel neighbors.
It was noticeable that the man with the beard was just as indignant as my husband.
Their views met.
Almost in unison, they offered to deal with the guide Dima, since he had the same claims as us.
The man sat in the front seat, the rest of his companions were located further behind him.
At this time, other tourists came to the bus.
In the air instantly smelled of vinegar and alcohol.
Discovering that one front seat is occupied, a drunk man in his thirties offered a man with a beard to make room, because he wanted to sit with his wife, allegedly in the bus he was rocking.
A man with a beard correctly explained that he also does not tolerate vehicles.
Despite the fact that the young man was in the company of his wife, parents and three-year-old son, he behaved boorishly.
On the ship, he had too much hot drinks, and he wanted “adventure. ”
Angry passenger guide offered to stay in the next front seat, and the rest of the family to go to the empty seats.
This idea did not like the young busotera, but the influx of people from behind did not leave time for a full-fledged scandal.
The girl remained to sit in front, and her husband went to the tail of the bus, where his parents and son were waiting for him, sobbing wildly from the fact that he fell in the doorway of the bus at the second door, when the parents were trying to take the front seats.
When the tension subsided, the driver closed the door to set off.
As soon as the bus started, the Russian at the age of about forty-five suddenly saw from the next chair that his wife was not nearby.
He began to rush on the bus, loudly called her and demanded to open the door.
I looked out the window and saw a woman wearing swimming trunks and a stretched short T-shirt.
She smiled stupidly and could hardly move.
The man jumped out of the bus and, intricately nooping, rushed to meet her.
The lovers found each other.
On the second attempt, we finally left the marina.
The soft bus moved quickly, it seemed as if the driver himself wanted to get rid of the company of heavily drunk cheerful Russian tourists.
However, traffic lights were an obstacle to our rapid separation.
On one of them, the bus stopped abruptly, everyone had to grab the handrails.
The driver apologized and went on.
At this moment, the drunken compatriot, who was constantly watching his wife from the tail of the bus, it seemed as if a man with a beard stroked his beloved hand.
He jumped out of his seat, ran to the offender, and hit him in the arm and face with all his might.
Everyone was surprised, except for the woman in black clothes.
She was the wife of a man with a beard.
A small, fragile Muslim woman, like a kite, attacked a thirty-year-old fighter, clung to his hair and began to scream loudly.
It was only in feature films that I saw the rage of Oriental women willing to die for their husbands.
There was a brawl on the bus.
Children, women shouted, the father of the instigator of the fight was involved in a brawl.
It turned out that after a sharp stop, the man with a beard only grabbed the armrest of the next chair and was not going to show any signs of attention.
But the angry family did not listen.
She took revenge on the bearded man for not giving up his place.
The frightened driver stopped the bus and, together with the guide, jumped out into the street and started calling someone.
Screams did not stop, turning into mutual insults, profanity and an offer to go outside to figure it out.
The situation became increasingly tense.
“Well, that ’ s it, ” my husband said and got up from his chair.
In a loud, well-posed voice, he ordered everyone to shut up and sit in their seats.
It was quiet for a second, and then the fight started again.
“I said let ’ s go! ” he shouted even louder.
Even I was scared.
There was so much power and firmness in his voice that it was impossible to disobey him.
The instigator of the fight was taller, much younger and seemingly stronger.
But suddenly he fell, retreated and returned to his place.
His mother started crying and crying loudly.
Charged with determined energy, my husband ordered a woman to follow her son and stop acting like a drunk woman.
A wave of indignation from a drunken family descended on my husband.
A man with a grudge in his voice began to make claims to my husband for not helping him finish off the bearded peasant from among the chocks that flooded our country.
The husband slowly turned to the young man, I realized that now there will really be a fight.
I grabbed my husband ’ s hand and asked him to calm down.
He looked at me and said in an icy tone, “Don ’ t worry, I ’ m calm. ”
He approached the 30-year-old scandalist and told him to shut his filthy mouth because he had not seen anything in his life.
His mother demanded to calm his family and give everyone the opportunity to get to the hotels normally.
There was a sudden silence on the bus.
The husband called the driver and the guide to return to the bus.
The frightened driver sat in his chair.
Until the end of the journey, the silence rang in my ears.
When I got to the hotel, my boyfriend met the owner of a black beard.
He was a resident of Dagestan, the brother of a world-famous athlete, a successful businessman, a wonderful family man.
He came on vacation with his wife, daughter and sister ’ s family.
His wife, a nice pretty fragile woman again behaved very modestly, walked behind her husband and almost all the time was silent.
The men went to Dima ’ s guide.
The women went to the numbers.
We knew we shouldn't get into men's conversations.
Of course, the guide is still alive.
Our men acted civilly and wrote a claim.
But the money was not returned to us, citing the fact that all vacationers like this tour very much.
An unpleasant aftertaste from an unsuccessful trip for some time spoiled the impression of a long-awaited holiday, but a chic hotel, wonderful drinks and an endless magical sea can wash away even the most unsuccessful excursions.
From the excursion to the historical center of Antalya, we refused, visiting it without a guide, and at the same time received a charge of wonderful emotions.
Turkey has not lost its charm for me, but, as everywhere, you need to be careful when choosing places where everyone is ready to make money on you, and be able to keep your face so that you are not ashamed of yourself and your country.
I also saw how courage, combined with a strong and determined spirit, was more important than physical strength.
Arisha WINTER

title: NEWSru.co.il:: The Palestinian Authority is restoring relations with Israel
text:

We extend our hand and propose to hold an international conference under the auspices of the Quartet to work out a settlement mechanism, "Abbas said on June 24.
Israel has reported renouncing the annexation of Palestinian territories in normalization agreements with the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain.
The leaders of these countries declared their support for the principle of “two states ”, but noted that they do not intend to wait forever until the Palestinians agree to peace with Israel.
The Abraham Accords were perceived by the Palestinian side as a stab in the back.
Attempts to confront them have demonstrated the growing isolation of the Palestinians.
Even the Arab League refused to support them.
The rupture of relations with Israel led to the deterioration of the economic situation in the PA.
On the eve of the US presidential election, it was suggested that in the event of the victory of Democratic candidate Joe Biden, the Palestinian leadership would hurry to declare the restoration of relations, since the Palestinians themselves suffer from the rupture.

title: Britain and France signed an agreement to stop the flow of illegal immigrants
text:
Britain and France have signed an agreement that would make crossing the strait "unviable" for illegal migrants.
This illegal route has already been used by more than eight thousand people this year, compared to 1,835 in 2019.
British Home Secretary Priti Patel and her French counterpart Gerald Darmanen have agreed on an expanded package of surveillance technologies with drones, radar equipment, cameras and optical-electronic binoculars.
This equipment will help the French send officers to the right places to detect migrants and stop them before they go to Albion.
Ministers agreed to double the number of French police patrolling the 150-kilometer stretch of coastline that is the target of human smuggling networks.
The agreement also includes measures to support migrants to settle in France and measures to improve border security at ports in the north and west of the Fifth Republic.
The document builds on previously agreed measures, according to which the proportion of intercepted and stopped migrants from their total estimated flow rose from 41 per cent last year to 60 per cent in recent weeks, according to the Home Office.
According to Patel, the new agreement with France “will increase these figures. ”
French authorities in 2020 stopped the entry into the United Kingdom of more than five thousand migrants and made hundreds of arrests, largely due to increased coordination between law enforcement agencies of neighboring states.
The Home Office said the number of migrants crossing the border had risen exponentially in 2020, partly due to good weather, and accused the gangs of human traffickers of “facilitating dangerous journeys. ”
“We must not lose sight of the fact that illegal migration exists for one fundamental reason, because there are criminal gangs – human traffickers – that facilitate this trafficking, ” Patel said.

title: France and the United Kingdom sign a new treaty to control illegal migration through the English Channel
text:
Since 2018, attempts by migrants to cross the English Channel on board inflatable or homemade boats have become more frequent. From December 1, a new Franco-British agreement on strengthening control of the English Channel coast, signed on Saturday, November 28, will enter into force.
On Sunday, November 29, the Maritime Prefecture of the English Channel and the North Sea, announced the rescue of another 45 migrants who tried to illegally get to England on board a homemade boat.
In a statement, the prefecture said that on board the boat were a pregnant woman and children, several migrants were “in a state of hypothermia ”, but all“ alive and well. ”
Recall that at the end of October, four people were killed and three were missing during an illegal crossing, which is by far the most tragic incident in the English Channel, where attempts to cross by boat have become more frequent since 2018.
In September, French authorities said they had intercepted more than 1,300 people trying to reach Britain using rubber boats, oars, kayaks and even life jackets.
Since the beginning of the year, the number of people wishing to try their luck in this way has exceeded 6 thousand people.
The issue of control over the English Channel has long been actively discussed during the Franco-British negotiations, with Britain accusing France of a lack of preventive measures.
According to the agreement signed on the eve of December 1, 2020, the number of French patrols will be doubled, they will also receive drones and radars.
Home Secretary Priti Patel welcomed the agreement, saying it would allow the two countries to "share a mission to prevent the passage of the English Channel."

title: A way to extract oxygen and hydrogen from salt water on Mars found scientists – space news
text:
A method for extracting oxygen and hydrogen from salt water on Mars has been found by scientists.
Photo: https: / / racurs.ua / n147222-sposob-dobychi-kisloroda-i-vodoroda-iz-solenoy-vody-na-marse-nashli-uchenye.html Rakurs Scientists want to extract fuel and oxygen from salt water on Mars.
From this water even just can not get oxygen and hydrogen in the process of electrolysis will be broken down dissolved in water salts, and not H2O molecules.
But researchers at Washington University in St. Louis have found a way to get oxygen and hydrogen from salt water.
This is reported on the web resource Pnas.
Now to the “red planet ” is moving the Rover Perseverance, which carries on its board a device called MOXIE, which will allow scientists to get oxygen from carbon dioxide in the Martian atmosphere.
Scientists plan that the new device will allow you to get 25 times more oxygen at the same size and weight.
It is noted that the new electrolyzer consists of a pyrochlor anode of lead ruthenate, as well as a carbon cathode coated with a layer of platinum.
This design, combined with the dissolving of perchlorate in the target system, allowed the scientists to obtain oxygen and hydrogen from water with a high salt content without the need for purification and heating.
Earlier it was reported that the colonization of Mars by earthlings will occur with the development of new materials that will be suitable for the atmosphere and soil of the planet.

title: Oxygen and hydrogen on Mars proposed to get from brine
text:
Scientists have developed a method for producing oxygen and hydrogen from a liquid saline solution in Martian lakes using electrolysis.
A feature of the experiment was the use of lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst for oxygen production.
The production of oxygen using such an installation was 25 times more energy efficient than in the case of MOXIE, launched to the Red Planet as part of the Mars 2020 mission, and the size and weight of the device for life support based on the described technology will be less than that of analogues.
The article was published in the journal PNAS.
Conditions on Mars are far from favorable for humans: the atmosphere is rarefied and 95 percent consists of carbon dioxide, and temperature changes exceed 100 degrees Celsius with an average temperature of minus 63 degrees.
Therefore, colonization of the Red Planet is impossible without the creation of a life support system that would be able to provide people with oxygen for breathing and fuel (for example, hydrogen) for energy supply and, ideally, return flight.
To solve the first problem, NASA created MOXIE (Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment) - an experimental installation for obtaining oxygen from atmospheric carbon dioxide by electrolysis.
To test the effectiveness of such a method in the field, the installation became part of the Mars Rover Perseverance, which was launched on July 30, 2020 as part of the Mars 2020 mission.
An alternative source of not only oxygen, but also hydrogen on Mars can be water, the first direct evidence of the existence of which on the red planet was obtained in 1971.
Particularly attractive for use in applications, however, would be the reserves of salt water, impurities in which would allow it to remain in a liquid state even at low temperature and pressure.
The first traces of such brine (liquid salt solution) with magnesium perchlorate as the main component were found on Mars in 2015, and in 2018, a reservoir with a diameter of about 20 kilometers was found under the polar ice of the planet, which could have been formed due to volcanic activity.
Later, planetary scientists confirmed that such lakes on Mars really exist and can be numerous.
Now Pralay Gayen (Pralay Gayen) from the University of Washington in St. Louis together with colleagues created an installation for obtaining oxygen and hydrogen from a saline solution close in composition and temperature to that in Martian lakes.
As a brine in the experiment, a solution of magnesium perchlorate in water with a concentration of 2.8 mol per liter was used, cooled to minus 36 degrees Celsius and blown by carbon dioxide (the latter played the role of the Martian atmosphere).
As an electrocatalyst for the production of oxygen, the scientists used lead-ruthenium oxide Pb2Ru2O7-δ, the effectiveness of which they previously showed for alkaline solutions.
The electrocatalyst for hydrogen production was platinum on activated carbon - the standard catalyst in this case, and a commercially produced anion-exchange membrane was used as a separator.
Installation diagram.
In the red region, oxygen is produced, in the blue - hydrogen.
Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS In the course of the study, scientists showed that lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst is indeed several times more effective than the ruthenium oxide commonly used in such installations.
After the behavior of the created installation was studied in a wide range of temperatures from − 36 to 21 degrees Celsius and saw no radical fluctuations in the efficiency and rate of production.
The current output of the experimental installation was 70 percent, and the energy efficiency was in the range between 36 and 70 percent (depending on the voltage applied to the plates).
In addition, the installation was resistant to degradation of the catalyst: scientists were not able to find traces of ruthenium in the solution after 300-minute operation of the device.
The rate of production of oxygen (blue dots) and hydrogen (red dots), depending on the density of the cathode current.
Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Also, the researchers compared the achieved rate of oxygen production with MOXIE values of 10-22 grams per hour: it turned out that with the same energy supply, the created installation produces 25 times more oxygen than the experiment on the Mars Rover “Perseverance ”.
To have the same rate of oxygen production as MOXIE, the device would have to have electrodes with an area of ​ ​ 28-62 square centimeters, and to ensure the vital activity of a sleeping and actively moving person, this parameter would have to be 375 and 1235 square centimeters, respectively.
At the same time, the mass and volume of the installation will be less than if you use the technology inherent in MOXIE.
Moreover, the developed method of obtaining oxygen does not require its subsequent purification, while during electrolysis in MOXIE, carbon monoxide is also produced, which must be filtered.
Dependence on the power consumption of the rate of oxygen production of the installation (blue line), as well as its capes and volume to ensure various modes of human life (black lines).
The blue dot is the power and rate of oxygen production at MOXIE.
Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Previously, we talked about another method of obtaining oxygen from carbon dioxide in the Martian atmosphere (like MOXIE): scientists proposed to do this using low-temperature plasma.
And what is the role of the Mars Rover “Perseverance ” in addition to checking the method of oxygen production, you can read in our material“ Mars, there and back ”.
Nikita Kozyrev

title: New technology will be able to produce hydrogen and oxygen from salty Martian water
text:
In space launches, weight matters a lot, so the less we have to take with us, the better.
Now engineers at St. Louis University have developed a new electrolysis device that can convert very salty Martian water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen for fuel.
As you may remember from school, water electrolysis is the process of using electricity to break down water into its constituent hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
These gases can then be collected for use, so in theory electrolysis could be a way for astronauts to produce their own oxygen and hydrogen on the Red Planet.
The problem is that it doesn ’ t work well with brackish water, and that ’ s all you can find on Mars.
First, it is necessary to reduce the high salt content, which is a complex process in this inhospitable alien environment.
Therefore, for the new study, scientists have developed a new electrolysis system that can work with salt water in the extreme cold of the Martian atmosphere.
The key change is in two electrodes: the team created an anode from lead ruthenate pyrochlor and a cathode from platinum on the coal.
To test the new electrolyzer design, scientists modeled the Martian atmosphere, which required cooling to -36 ° C — and it worked.
The researchers say that at the same input power, the new electrolyzer produces 25 times more oxygen than MOXIE, the instrument aboard the Mars Rover Perseverance, which squeezes oxygen from carbon dioxide in the air.
While this technology has intriguing potential uses for astronauts, it ’ s worth remembering that water on Mars is a fairly rare commodity, so it ’ s probably better to use for drinking, although it also requires removing salt first.
Instead, the technology could first find application here on Earth.
"By demonstrating these electrolyzers in challenging Martian conditions, we also intend to deploy them in much milder conditions on Earth to use salt water to produce hydrogen and oxygen, for example by electrolysis of seawater," Pralai Gayen, a co-author of the study, said in a statement.
The study was published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

title: Tokamak HL-2M nuclear reactor launched in China
text:
At a conference on thermonuclear energy.
which took place in China in 2019 reported plans to launch a new generation tokamak HL-2M in 2020.
The launch of the reactor was successful, and now scientists hope that this device will open access to a powerful source of clean energy.
The HL-2M Tokamak project started several years ago, and in June 2019 it reached the finish line after the successful installation of electromagnetic coils.
Now the HL-2M Tokamak reactor is the largest research tool in the direction of nuclear fusion in China, according to Phys.org.
Scientists have found hints of "new physics" in the relic radiation of the Universe New installation HL-2M doubled the temperature of the plasma in the reactor.
So, if previous experiments (installations) heated ions to 50 million ° C, and electrons to 100 million ° C, the new toroidal installation for magnetic plasma retention heats ions to 150 million ° C, and electrons to 200 million ° C.
Note that the temperature of the core of the Sun is 15 million ° C.
It is believed that for successful fusion ions need to be heated to temperatures of more than 100 million ° C or 7 times more than the heated core of the Sun.
Whether this is true or not, further experiments with HL-2M will be shown, which should be carried out before the end of 2020.
Chinese scientists plan to use the reactor in collaboration with scientists working on the ITER International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor, the world ’ s largest nuclear fusion research project in France, which is expected to be completed in 2025.
It is this project that now demonstrates the most confident steps towards artificial thermonuclear fusion.

China has launched a quantum supercomputer.
A group of scientists from China under the leadership of physicist Pan Jianwei created a prototype of a super-fast quantum computer “Jiuchang ”.
As Xinhua reported on Friday, this device, which has a quantum computing advantage, also known as “quantum superiority, ” is able to solve problems that are not available to classical computers.
Scientists have demonstrated the computational abilities of the Jiuchang photon computer with the help of a special algorithm GBS (Gaussian boson sampling), which he coped with 100 trillion times faster than the most powerful of existing supercomputers.
Chinese developers said that the computational ability of their device is 10 billion times faster than the speed of the 53-qubit quantum processor Sycamore (“Sycamore ”), developed last year by the American company Google (“ Google ”).
“The quantum computing advantage is a kind of threshold, ” said Lu Chaoyang, a professor at the University of Science and Technology in China.“ The fact that the new prototype quantum computing machine has computing power exceeding the most powerful traditional computer in a certain task proves that it has the ability to make a breakthrough in many other areas. ”
Chinese scientists noted that the capabilities of their development have potential applications in areas such as graph theory, machine learning and quantum chemistry.
Their work was published in the American scientific journal Science (Science).
In October 2019, Google announced that it had managed to build a 53-qubit Sycamore quantum processor and demonstrate “quantum superiority ” over conventional computers.

“We need to be smart about the progress we ’ ve made.
In terms of number, the United States has superpower.
For China, the space for raising the general level in the field of supercomputers is wide. "- believes the deputy head of the GCSE Zhu Xiaoqian.
ANC employee Zhang Yunquan noted that competition in the field of supercomputers in the world is extremely intense.
It will be very difficult for Tianhe-1A to maintain its leading position in the rating for more than a year.
To date, investment in Tianhe-1A has reached 600 million yuan ($90.4 million).
It has 14,396 thousand Intel CPUs, 7168 NVidia GPUs, as well as 2048 domestically produced Faiten CPUs.
Zhang Yunquan said overseas processors play a crucial role in Tianhe-1A.
Next year, China will use more processors of domestic production.
In the next one or two years, another 2-3 billion yuan will need to be invested in the field of supercomputers.
According to Qian Depei, who is in charge of the program for implementing important projects in the field of high-performance computers, known as the 863 program, China remains weak in CPU technologies, system software and method of calculation.
“In order for supercomputers to become a powerful element for improving performance, we need to plan for the future in a timely manner, ” said Qian Depei.

title: COVID-burnout: how to “burn out ” from coronavirus?
text:
2020 is in many ways a year of unpleasant surprises, of which the new coronavirus has become the most unexpected and massive.
And if before the beginning of the second wave of the pandemic, the main priority of mankind was the preservation of physical health, then this autumn many famous doctors began to talk about preserving mental health.
There is even a new term – “COVID burnout ”, that is,“ caused by coronavirus emotional burnout ”.
What characterizes this state?
During and immediately after the first quarantine (which lasted 55 days from March 17 to May 11, 2020), French therapists and psychiatrists noted an increase in anxiety and panic attacks in their regular patients.
The number of prescribed antidepressants, anxiolytics and sleeping pills has also increased.
According to the report of the scientific group for the study of drugs (GIS-Epi-Phare) at the National Agency for the Safety of Medicines (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament, ANSM), this spring doctors have issued 1.1 million more prescriptions for psychotropic drugs such as Xanax, Lexomil or Valium, which reduce anxiety, and 18 million more. 7,000 more prescriptions for antidepressants.
Doctors prescribed 480,000 more sleeping pills than usual during this period of the year.
In general, this increase in volume (only 5%) is considered small, since France is one of the “champions ” in Europe in the consumption of anxiolytics and antidepressants, but, as Mahmoud Zureik, a professor of epidemiology at the University of Versailles, notes,“ these figures do not accurately reflect the reality, since during the quarantine period and immediately after it many patients did not consult doctors, even if they needed it. ”
This hypothesis is confirmed by the fact that at the beginning of the epidemic, the number of consultations on diseases other than COVID-19 sharply decreased - patients, fearing to get infected with coronavirus, sought help from doctors only in emergency cases.
Professor Marion Leboye, who works as a psychiatrist at Henri-Mondor Hospital in the Paris suburb of Creteil, believes that "in the coming weeks and even months, the need for treatment of mental disorders will increase greatly."
This statement she made on the occasion of “mental health day ”, which is celebrated on October 10.
Special attention of psychiatrists is occupied by cases of depression of medical workers directly faced with the epidemic, and elderly people who found themselves in complete isolation.
In some countries, the number of suicides that psychiatrists associate with the COVID-19 epidemic has increased.
So, in Japan, after several years of decline in the number of suicides, since the summer of 2020, they have increased by 16%.
The increase in anxiety states is often associated with events occurring in society.
Thus, in France, the number of calls to specialists increased during the financial crisis of 2008.
After the terrorist attacks of 2015 and 2016, experts noted an increase in panic attacks, especially in public places and transport.
However, COVID-19 has brought its own specificity to the mental state of people.
As practice has shown, the period of summer holidays this year did not bring people the long-awaited rest and recuperation.
Therapists note that since the beginning of the school year, many patients have more physical health problems, as well as frequent states of general anxiety, sleep disorders and chronic fatigue.
In children, this manifests itself in great emotional instability and poor concentration.
The increase in anxiety was noted in the period of the first quarantine, and, experts have identified several reasons: - The unknown - the lack of information about the coronavirus, which gives rise to many unfounded fears.
Anxiety related states were characteristic during the first wave of the coronavirus, there is now much more information about this disease, and the promises of an emergency vaccine give rise to hope. - Fear of losing work and fear for the economic situation of your family and the country as a whole.
According to psychologists, these fears are now much more pronounced, as people began to understand that the coronavirus epidemic will last at least a few more months.
The level of anxiety associated with the fear of infecting loved ones over time remained at the same level as at the beginning of the epidemic, experts say.
In addition, as the first experience of quarantine showed, sitting at home causes a new type of stress - either from working at a distance, or from the constant presence of household members.
Domestic violence and divorce have become more common, first seen in China.
However, such situations were typical for families where the situation before the outbreak was dysfunctional.
Most of the same coped with the “spring solitude ” more or less successfully.
By the way, stress was more common in the post-quarantine period. Why?
“Exit from quarantine marked a second wave of uncertainty.
Believing that the threat of infection still existed, we had to get out of our homes and face it in our daily lives.
The instinct of self-preservation more or less consciously told us to remain vigilant, but at the same time (and especially at work) life forced us to catch up.
During this period, the fear of not succeeding, whether professionally or personally, prevailed, ” French psychiatrist Franck Belivier told Le Parisien.
The second wave of coronavirus and the second quarantine combine all previous stresses and fears.
This wave can be accurately described as “social burnout due to COVID-19. ”
The term “burnout ”, which is also called“ burnout syndrome ”, is most often used in relation to a person ’ s professional activities.
More broadly, it applies to situations where fatigue and feelings of depression are combined (for example, in the case of “maternal burnout ”).
This syndrome is determined by three cumulative criteria: - Constant physical fatigue and emotional exhaustion.
A person feels that his strength is “running out ”, he is exhausted, devastated.
Such fatigue causes anxiety and a growing sense of anxiety, which is why his sleep is disturbed, which further causes fatigue.
Such physical exhaustion has emotional consequences: the mood becomes unstable, the person may cry at the mention of the slightest difficulty.
Consciously or not, a burnout person develops a “negative discourse ”: he often complains about everything and everyone, he has a desire to quit everything, there are suspicions of conspiracy, aggressiveness, his reactions become too impulsive.
Even in people who are usually unperturbed, emotional peaks arise suddenly: they become impatient and irritable. – Decreased personal assessment: in a person suffering from burnout, a sense of his own helplessness is combined with the idea of ​ ​ lack of development prospects, and, absolutely in all spheres of life.
Usually during severe life trials, if one spectrum of life (personal or professional) is affected, others remain unaffected.
It is the care in other areas of activity that helps a person to survive – the motivation coming from other projects gradually pulls the person “up ”.
It is more difficult to find motivation for a burnout sufferer, and the current conditions of the health crisis only aggravate this situation.
Quarantine and social distancing have affected almost all aspects of our lives – many are demotivated, they have the impression that there is no “way out ”.
To such “classic ” signs of“ burnout ” is added a new one caused by a pandemic.
It affected absolutely everyone, even the most persistent and not experiencing financial or social difficulties.
French psychologist and sophrologist Laurence Roux-Fouillet calls it “the loss of carelessness. ”
The carefree ease of being with which we used to be able to plan life no longer exists.
Unexpectedly leave for the weekend, surprise a friend, prepare a birthday party, improvise dinner in a restaurant, suddenly go to the theater or cinema or just walk around the city - now any action requires careful preparation.
In addition to our own safety, we need to think about the safety of our loved ones
In such circumstances, spontaneity became almost impossible.
According to the psychologist, this criterion “presents the greatest problem ” because, if we can accept quarantine for a short time, the idea that the pandemic situation will last for an indefinite time binds us, giving us a sense of hopelessness.
It is our voluntary agreement to give up a number of personal freedoms for the sake of our own health or the public good that makes us feel the impossibility of the former "carelessness".
It seems as if joy and pleasure are forbidden to us – and for an indefinite period.
Hope's gone.
And if the virus affects several people around it, then this burnout affects absolutely everyone, even if the person did not have to directly encounter the virus, ” Laurence Ru-Fouillet told RFI.
In the most extreme cases, due to the pandemic, people have had to abandon long-awaited, carefully planned projects (personal or professional), some of which will never come to fruition again.
If a person notices the appearance of such signs, then he is most likely better to consult a doctor.
However, some manage to cope on their own - previously known methods of relaxation work in the case of "covid-burnout".
However, these are only auxiliary methods of dealing with symptoms that do not eliminate the main cause of the syndrome: the coronavirus will remain with us for some time.
At the moment, it is very difficult to focus on the positive, it has become necessary for us, like oxygen without a protective mask.
For lack of opportunity to get new positive feelings in the world around us and narrowed down to a distance of several tens of kilometers, there is only one, but perhaps the most correct way out - you need to look for new opportunities within yourself.
It can be anything from learning foreign languages to sports training, so long as the activity brings pleasure and shows that a person is gradually achieving concrete results.
This will allow us to go through a difficult time until events give us the opportunity to regain full freedom to choose our actions.
It is no coincidence that for many, this pandemic has become an opportunity to “return to themselves ”: as experts have noted, most people ’ s sense of anxiety caused by uncertainty and sitting in quarantine, quickly replaced by a sense of security inside their own home.
“Apart from the stress of working at a distance, combined with the attention that needs to be paid to your loved ones at the same time, the initial fear of uncertainty goes away quite quickly. ”
Many were able to see in this “home bubble ” a return home and a return to themselves, says Laurence Ru-Fouillet.

title: GLOBAL NUCLEAR PLAN | The countries of the world and the EU plan to create the Sun on Earth. Estonia is also involved.
text:
The International Experimental Thermonuclear Reactor (ITER) Treaty was signed in 2006 between the EU and China, India, Japan, Korea, Russia and the United States.
“The tasks are global: to create a solar-type thermonuclear reactor on Earth.
If the plan is implemented, we will have an almost eternal and inexhaustible source of energy, ” said Ott Rebane, coordinator of production relations for Estonia.
The main problem that scientists have to solve is that a temperature of at least 150 000 000 degrees is required to carry out the necessary reaction.
The only way to achieve this is to perform all the necessary manipulations in a vacuum and control them using a magnetic field.
"At this temperature, substances simply decay into electrons and atomic nuclei.
The only way to keep this plasma from decay is by continuously correcting the magnetic field to control the flow of particles from all directions, ” Rebane explained.
Experiments on the process have been going on for 50 years and are continuing now.
The reactor is already 70% ready Foto: ITER The goal is to get ten times more energy as a result of the reaction than was invested.
The project team hopes to start real plasma production within 10 years.
The global project will cost tens of billions of euros.
The main problems of traditional nuclear power are nuclear waste and depletion of uranium reserves.
A fusion reactor in this sense is safer because the materials are irradiated, but their activation is several times less and the nuclear fusion reaction can not get out of control, because it ends as soon as the plasma comes into contact with something.
Some tragicomic situation consists in the fact that we will reach only half of the received electricity.
“As a result, huge steam generators will have to be used as an intermediate link and only 48% of the heat generated will be used, ” Rebane said.
But at the same time, a lot of energy is generated and it is safe.
