A possible reason is the increased burden on working mothers and the number of cases of domestic violence.

title: How to cope with depression and not go to suicide?
text:
Suicide rates have risen sharply in Japan in 2020.
The numbers have been a record for the past 10 years.
Also, a surge in child suicide occurred in St. Petersburg.
Incidents were increasing amid the pandemic and restrictive measures.
Psychologists believe that the problems that have arisen have become for many the last straw on the way to the decision to commit suicide.
There are always options for dealing with depression.
The Ministry of Health of Japan reported that in 2020, 20,919 people committed suicide.
This figure was 3.7% higher compared to the previous year.
Over the past 10 years, the number of suicides has been on the decline.
At the same time, 3.4 thousand people died from coronavirus in the country.
During the pandemic in Japan, the number of suicides among women and children has increased.
In just eight months, more than 300 cases of suicide of children in primary, secondary and high schools were recorded.
This is almost 30% more than it was in the same period of 2019.
“Students are worried about their future.
They don't know what to do.
They used to be able to relieve stress by talking to friends, and now they can ’ t even go to karaoke, ” said Akiko Mura, a consultant at the Tokyo Suicide Prevention Center.
Experts attribute the sharp jump in suicides to the pandemic and restrictive measures.
Many faced unemployment, and women had an additional burden at home.
In Japan, however, household responsibilities are often unevenly distributed among families.
The increase in suicide among children occurred not only in this country.
Commissioner for the rights of the child in St. Petersburg Anna Mityanina said that in the city has sharply increased the number of suicides of minors.
“Today, to my horror, law enforcement agencies note that there has been a sharp increase in juvenile suicides in St. Petersburg.
For the entire period of 2019, three people suffered from suicide, for the nine months of 2020, these children have already 10, ” she said.
The Ombudsperson noted that these children were in almost all cases from good families.
Most often, the causes of suicide were quarrels with parents, overload from training or conflicts with peers.
People decide to commit suicide for the same reasons that collectively push them to such a step, explained “360 ” psychologist Pavel Zhavnerov.
A person does not make a decision at one time, but thinks about it for a long time.
He may not see any other way out.
The first is that a person does not enjoy life for a long period of time.
Second, he may not have any attachments, that is, there is no responsibility for someone.
Third: a person has emotional problems – disturbing reactions, a lot of negative emotions, ” the expert listed.
He added that such a person throughout his life could have situations that negate all positive things.
It can be violence, bankruptcy, imprisonment and other moments that give the impression that life is a very bad thing.
Source: pixabay.com “To gain courage, a person can drink alcohol, because it reduces the criticality of thinking, that is, the person is less aware of the consequences.
He needs to overcome the instinct of self-preservation, which requires many reasons, ” said Zhavnerov.
According to the psychologist, during the pandemic, people who were 95% close to suicide faced new challenges.
They could lose their jobs, go into debt, lose their money and their prospects.
This added another 5%.
“Here are those who were at the level of 95%, now they have 100% – everything, they are ready.
In people who had 90, 85% and so on, it only worsens their overall standard of living, but it does not provoke the act itself.
It only provokes those who were already on the verge of committing suicide, ” Zhavnerov explained.
He stressed that suicide is always a conscious choice of a person based on his life experience.
People commit suicide when there are more reasons to leave life than to continue it.
How to deal with depression?
In order not to bring yourself to sad consequences, you need to understand that in fact the meaning of life is the same for all people.
“The meaning of human life is to live joyfully, comfortably and happily.
With all our actions, we strive for this.
Just when a person does not realize this, he is looking for some roundabout ways, ” the psychologist said.
Such a person can try to please others in order to feel joy due to this.
Or he can do what society thinks is right.
Because of this, a person feels his significance and feels joy.
If people start doing something every day that increases their happiness and joy in life, they will become happier every day.
But there are two limitations: you can not be happy today at the expense of future happiness and you can not be happy at the expense of other people Pavel Zhavnerov psychologist.
The specialist advised every day to think about how to live it as happily as possible.
If you think about it every day and strive for it, you will begin to notice that each new day becomes more pleasant.
For a person, life will not be a series of trials, tragedies and losses, but a large amusement park, where he just rides, has fun and has fun every day.
This allows a person to love life, get pleasure from it, and he will never have a desire to say goodbye to it Pavel Zhavnerov psychologist.
According to Zhavnerov, there are many ways to cope with depression.
Sometimes a person is not ready to contact a specialist, so it is important to find a convenient solution for yourself.
Someone may be suitable for listening to an audiobook on psychology, and someone will find a way out after subscribing to a blogger psychologist.
“The main thing here is to choose the most suitable solution for yourself at the moment.
But the most important thing in any case - some decision to choose.
Inaction here is the worst, ” the expert said.
Many people often think that the problem will resolve itself, but this is not the way to treat it.
It is not about the disease, but about the way of thinking and other things that only get worse over time.
The sooner a person begins to do at least something, the better he will protect himself from the risk of going into an acute state.

title: “The average check per person is more than $300. ” Dentists earned almost a million dollars on foreigners for the year
text:
In 2018, Belarus earned more than $43 million on the export of medical services.
Every year this item of income is increasing, and already this year more than 46 million are expected from foreigners who turned to Belarusian doctors. - Analysis since 2010 shows that the average check per foreign patient is growing every year, - said Dmitry Kalistratov, head of the Department of the Ministry of Health on the air of the TV channel "Belarus 1". - If in 2010 we had a check of about $85, today it is more than 300.
The most popular medical services among foreigners are oncology, traumatology, orthopedics, cardiology, dentistry and cosmetology.
Dentists alone earned over a year about a million dollars on foreign patients.
Most often, this is not the treatment of caries, but more serious operations - prosthetics, implantation. - In Moscow, for four dental implants, I counted 4 thousand euros.
This is not the cheapest clinic, but on average the price of the issue is about 80 euros for one implant, - said the Muscovite Maria. - In Minsk, it cost me almost two times cheaper.
Even with travel costs, living is still profitable.
And the training of Belarusian doctors is very good.
I want this year to do blepharoplasty in Minsk (surgery to change the shape of the eyelids. - Ed.).
We have it costs about a thousand euros, in Minsk I found a clinic where I will do it for 200.
Last year, the Minsk Scientific and Practical Center for Surgery, Transplantology and Hematology earned more than $7 million on the export of services.
Of these, 66.44% came from surgery and organ transplantation.
We have already written that doctors emphasize: earning on foreign patients, they make even more affordable quality care for Belarusians. - Having performed one of the most difficult operations for a foreign citizen, we can additionally cure five or six citizens of Belarus, - said the director of the center Oleg Rummo. - It is very important for us that the patient who lives in Narovl, Bykhov, Shchuchin, Volkovysk - small Belarusian cities, - received medical care of the same level as a patient who lives in Minsk.
And above all, surgical, because it is needed in situations where a person is between life and death.
Prices for medical services for foreigners and citizens of Belarus in public medicine differ significantly.
For example, in one of the largest medical institutions, smoothing wrinkles on the forehead with a drug based on botulinum toxin costs 172 rubles for foreign patients, and for Belarusians - 84 rubles.
Popular today plastic labia - 218 rubles. and 79 rubles. respectively.
If a Belarusian decides to do a mastectomy for the prevention of breast cancer (remove the mammary gland), it will cost 97 rubles. on the one hand, and a foreign patient - 1864 rubles.

title: 9 myths about famous writers, in which it is time to stop believing
text:
Non-standard facts about celebrities are always perceived with interest and spread, attracting the attention of more and more people.
And then suddenly it turns out that some episode has nothing to do with the one to whom it was attributed.
We at AdMe.ru decided to find common statements about famous world writers who turned out to be ordinary fake.
Some of them were invented, others were the result of incorrect interpretations of documents or stories of contemporaries.
Ernest Hemingway and his shortest story How many times have we read on the Internet that Hemingway created the most touching and short story: “Baby shoes for sale.
The unworn. "
Legend has it that the writer argued with his friends that he would write a story that contained a plot, climax and ending, but was very short.
And he succeeded.
But there is no evidence that this work has anything to do with Hemingway.
Researchers say that most likely the story began to spread after the death of the writer.
First, it was printed in the magazine in the article “How to sell your works ”, then she went for a walk in different publications.
People believed that the story was written by Hemingway, because it perfectly corresponded to his signature “telegraph ” style.
But who actually wrote these lines is unknown. 2.
Of course, Leo Tolstoy was an extraordinary person, but some actions were attributed to him in vain.
For example, the fact that he loved to walk in peasant clothes and barefoot.
This myth was spread by Ivan Repin.
When the artist painted Tolstoy barefoot, the writer got angry and said: “It ’ s just not possible that I would be depicted without a pan ­ talon. ”
He preferred comfortable shoes.
And the clothes he wore in the estate were simple, but excluded the comparison with the peasant.
Entering society, the novelist wore a coat, starched shirts - that is, everything that was accepted.
As for his relationship with his wife, the stories that he cheated on her are fiction.
In the diaries of the writer there are many references to relationships with women and an illegitimate child.
But Tolstoy denied that he had deceived Sophia Andreevna.
He had other women, but only when Sophia was not his wife, that is, before marriage.
The myth of infidelity gave rise to his story “The Devil ”, but it describes events from the life of a completely different person.
Tolstoy ’ s biographer and his friend Pavel Biryukov mentioned that after 25 years of marriage, the writer shared with him that “it is convenient for him to convene, that neither on his part nor on the part of his wife there was not the slightest infidelity, and they lived an honest and clean family life. ” 3.
Almost all portraits of Gogol have dark hair, and in the films about him we even see him as a burning brunette.
If you turn to the statements of contemporaries, they remember the writer as blond.
Another thing is that the true meaning of this word is “light brown ”.
This is the hair that Gogol had.
Portraits have darkened from time to time, but some of them still show that the writer ’ s hair is really brown.
“Low, dry, with a very long, pointed nose, with strands of blond hair, often falling on the little squinted eyes, Gogol redeemed this unsightly appearance with courtesy, inexhaustible fun and glimpses of his wonderful humor, which sparkled his conversation in a friendly circle. ”
Ivan Aivazovsky 4.
Ivan Krylov and his death from overeating K.P. Bryullov.
Portrait of the fabulist I.A. Krylov.
Fable writer Ivan Krylov really loved to eat, was a complete person, often neglected the rules of etiquette, was distinguished by sloppiness and on this occasion was often ridiculed by colleagues.
They wrote anecdotes about him and told each other stories: “Krylov ’ s rooms look more like a den of a bear than the dwelling of a decent person. ”
Most often discussed his gluttony.
When the writer died, sarcastic writers spread a rumor that overeating was the cause of death.
However, this is not the case: a diagnosis of pneumonia has been made in the official report.
Agatha Christie and her disappearance On the evening of December 3, 1926, Agatha Christie left her home in an unknown direction.
Her car was found the next day, but the woman was not there.
Thousands of people were looking for a writer.
She was in a spa hotel, where she settled under a false name.
It was believed that Christie was hiding specifically to investigate an unsolved crime.
In fact, Agatha did this when she quarreled with her husband, who stated that he wanted a divorce.
Moreover, in the hotel she registered under the name of the mistress of the spouse.
Christie said she had no memory of the previous 11 days.
The amnesia was confirmed by Dr. 6.
The story that Remark ’ s real name is Kramer (Remark vice versa) was often mentioned even in his biography.
However, this legend was spread by enemies to indicate that the writer is not a German, but a descendant of French Jews.
But the documents confirm the origin of Remarque.
The propaganda campaign against the prose writer was based on changing the spelling of his surname from Remark to Remarque (in the French manner).
The relationship between Akhmatova and Gumilev can hardly be called simple: there has always been a professional rivalry between them.
After reading the poems of Anna Andreevna, contemporaries decided that her husband is very bad to her and even beats.
They were led to this idea by the lines “My husband is an executioner, and his house is a prison ”,“ It ’ s like you are arrogant and evil ” and finally “My husband whipped me with a patterned, double-folded belt ”.
Gumilev was very upset that the suffering of the lyrical heroine Akhmatova is taken for her personal: “After all, I, think, because of these lines, was known as a sadist! ”
But after parting with her husband, the heroine of poetry still continued to torment.
Charles Dickens and his meeting with Fyodor Dostoevsky Fyodor Dostoevsky admired the work of Dickens, and some biographers mentioned that the two great novelists met.
They were based on an excerpt from a letter that seemed to have been written by Dostoevsky.
In it, Fyodor Mikhailovich recalled his meeting with Dickens in July 1862 in the editorial office of the literary magazine All the Year Round.
However, one of the biographers had doubts, he conducted an investigation and found that most likely the letter was falsified.
Nevertheless, the literary critic did not rule out the possibility of meeting two writers.
So, it is known that in 1862 Dostoevsky came to London and communicated with Alexander Herzen, who, like Dostoevsky, was a fan of Dickens.
Herzen could arrange a meeting of prose writers, but it is unlikely that they could communicate freely, because Fyodor Mikhailovich did not know English.
Mark Twain and his childhood in the novel "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" is often called an autobiography, suggesting that many of Tom's tricks are the pranks of the writer himself.
However, Mark Twain himself said that the book has his childhood impressions, but Tom Sawyer is not written off from one person, but is a combination of the characters of the three boys he knew.
Interestingly, in Twain ’ s time, children ’ s books were more rigorous and instructive, and such a light style of storytelling was considered completely innovative.
Mark Twain himself noted that his work is written more for adults who need to remember their childhood.

title: Suicide rates rise in 2020 for the first time in 11 years: coronavirus and suicide among women
text:
In 2020, the usual lifestyle suddenly changed, it became more difficult to make plans for the future.
All of this has probably contributed to the rise in suicide rates, and it has been particularly high among women.
According to preliminary data, there were 20,919 suicides in Japan in 2020, which is 750 (3.7%) higher than the result of the final calculation for 2019.
Suicide rates have fallen for a decade in a row, but in 2020 they increased compared to the previous year for the first time since 2009, after the Lehman Brothers crisis.
The suicide rate (number per 100,000 population) also increased for the first time in 11 years to 16.6.
Compared to the previous year, the number of suicides among men decreased by 135 people, amounting to 13,943, a decrease observed for the 11th year in a row.
On the other hand, the number of female suicides increased by 885 to 6,976.
The psychological burden associated with the increase in the number of people infected with the new coronavirus, as well as changes in the living environment and anxiety about the future - for example, about the possibility of finding or continuing work.
Monthly statistics show that for the first half of 2020, suicides were less than in the previous year, but began to exceed the 2019 figures from June for women and from August for men, in October the number of suicides of men and women was 2199, exceeding the number for October 2019 by 660.
It is possible that this was affected by a series of suicides of celebrities in the summer and autumn.
The suicide rate for the prefectures was highest in Yamanashi and Iwate at 22.3, and the lowest in Kanagawa at 13.5.
In Tokyo, it was 16.1, in Osaka - 15.7.
The annual suicide rate in Japan stood at 20,000 for many years until 1997, but since 1998 it has exceeded 30,000 for 14 consecutive years, peaking at 34,427 in 2003.
After that, each year there was a decrease in the number of suicides compared to the previous year for 10 consecutive years, the economic recovery continued, and regional suicide prevention measures, such as the expansion of the counseling system, expanded.
According to the definition of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare of Japan, suicide is a social problem, which in many cases is caused by the fact that people have reached a deadlock, and which is often preventable, for which integrated measures are developed in the fields of health, medical care, social welfare, education, labor and other fields.
The Mamoro yo Kokoro page provides accessible information on how you can discuss your problems over the phone or through social networks such as LINE, as well as on measures to combat suicide.

title: Ukraine will ask Canada for an audio recording of the likely deliberate shooting down of the UIA aircraft by Iran
text:
Earlier in Canada, they said that they had received a secret audio file that could indicate a deliberate crash of a Ukrainian plane.
Ukraine sent a request to Canada with a request to transmit an audio recording of a conversation allegedly by the Iranian Foreign Minister about the plane crash of the UIA.
This is reported by the Attorney General ’ s Office.
According to Deputy Prosecutor General Gunduz Mammadov, this will be the fourth request from Canada.
“We hope that Canada will provide Ukraine with the available records of the negotiations, which were published in the media, without unnecessary expectations.
We expect to receive an audio file, since the recording research and phonetic examinations can be launched in parallel: in Canada and in Ukraine, ” Mammadov said.
He added that this could help speed up the truth and restore justice.
The Canadian government and security agencies are studying an audio recording in which a man whose voice resembles Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif discusses the possibility of issuing an attack on flight PS 752 for a deliberate act that the authorities have nothing to do with.
Recall that on January 8, 2020, the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps shot down a plane of Ukraine International Airlines in the sky over Tehran.
Two missiles were fired.
All 176 people on board were killed, including 138 people associated with Canada.
Canada will continue to work to bring Iran to justice for the downing of the Ukrainian plane.
It will require him to compensate the relatives of the victims and the States involved.
This is stated in the report of the Deputy of Parliament and special adviser to the Prime Minister Ralph Goodale, published in December last year.
The report contains all the information available at that time about the disaster and its causes, the course of international negotiations, and the actions of the parties.
It describes in detail the response of the Government of Canada to the news of the tragedy.
The document also contains questions that Canada has put to the Iranian side.
In February, relatives of the victims of the tragedy in Canada filed a class action lawsuit in which they seek compensation in the amount of $1.1 billion.
The defendants are the state of Iran, its leader and spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and high-ranking military officials.

title: In Japan, the position of the Minister of loneliness

title: Scientists have found organisms that can give rise to life on Mars
text:
Scientists have found organisms that can give rise to life on Mars 16.02.2021, 14: 58 They are able to grow and multiply in the conditions of the red planet.
New experiments have shown that cyanobacteria, also known as blue-green algae, can successfully grow in Martian atmospheric conditions.
Of course, a few more ingredients will be needed, but when humans get to Mars, they will be able to create life support systems based on cyanobacteria for the human habitat, writes nv.ua.
"Here we show that cyanobacteria can use the gases available in the Martian atmosphere, at low overall pressure, as a source of carbon and nitrogen," said astrobiologist Cyprien Verso from the University of Bremen in Germany.
"Under these conditions, cyanobacteria retained their ability to grow in water containing only Martian dust, and they could be used to feed other microbes.
This can help make long-term missions to Mars sustainable, ” the authors of the study believe.
All types of cyanobacteria produce oxygen as a byproduct of photosynthesis, and even today they are an invaluable source of it.
For several years, scientists have speculated whether we could use the ability of cyanobacteria to produce oxygen to live on Mars.
This will bring additional benefits.
The atmosphere of Mars consists mainly of carbon dioxide (95 percent) and nitrogen (3 percent), which are fixed by cyanobacteria, turning them into organic compounds and nutrients, respectively.
However, atmospheric pressure on Mars is a big problem.
The total pressure there is less than 1% of Earth ’ s — from 6 to 11 GPa: this is too small for the presence of liquid water, while the partial pressure of gaseous nitrogen — from 0.2 to 0.3 GPa — is not enough for their metabolism.
But recreating the atmosphere, like on Earth, would be too expensive: gases would have to be imported.
So the researchers were looking for a middle ground: an atmosphere close to Martian, which allows cyanobacteria to grow well.
The authors have developed a bioreactor called Atmos, which has an atmospheric pressure of about 10 percent of Earth ’ s, but uses only what can be found on Mars, albeit in inverted proportions: 96 percent nitrogen and 4 percent carbon dioxide.
The bioreactor also included water that can be obtained on Mars from melting ice, which in some places is abundant on the surface, and a simulator of Martian regolith, a mixture of minerals created here on Earth using only what can be found on Mars.
The team chose the type of nitrogen-fixing cyanobacteria that preliminary trials showed was most likely to thrive under these conditions, Anabaena sp.
PCC 7938, and tested it in a variety of conditions.
The researchers concluded that nitrogen-fixing, oxygen-producing cyanobacteria can be grown on Mars at low pressure under controlled conditions using exclusively local ingredients.
From cyanobacteria, sugar, amino acids and other nutrients can be obtained to feed other crops, which can then be used for other purposes, such as the production of medicines.
Atmos was designed to test whether cyanobacteria can be grown under certain atmospheric conditions rather than for maximum efficiency, and the parameters of the bioreactor will depend on many factors in the mission to Mars, including the payload and mission architecture.
However, now that the concept has been proven, the team can begin work on optimizing the bioreactor system that could one day save us life on Mars.

title: Perseverance lands on Mars: everything you need to know about NASA ’ s mission on the Red Planet
text:
NASA ’ s Mars rover called Perseverance, which launched on July 30, 2020, covered the distance from Earth to Mars and is ready to land on the Red Planet.
How exactly will NASA put Perseverance on Mars and what tasks are before the rover, read about all this in our material.
The journey of the Rover Perseverance lasted 7 months, and during the landing of the rover on the surface, he, like the NASA team, will have to survive even “seven minutes of horror ”, because landing the rover on the surface of another planet is far from an easy, although proven, task.
The first photo of Mars recorded interplanetary station "Hope" What is "seven minutes of horror", or how Perseverance will land on Mars Source: NASA At a distance of about 100 kilometers to Mars, preparations will begin for the process of descent of the rover to the planet, when the descent capsule for the first time touches the highly rarefied atmosphere of the red planet.
An important point to understand the complexity of the landing is that by this point the speed of the capsule will be 20,000 km / h, and in less than 400 seconds, the landing system of the module will reduce the speed of movement to less than 1 meter per second.
At this point, the temperature overboard the capsule will be more than 1,000 degrees Celsius and rapidly decline, but the thermal shields that will protect the rover will play a crucial role at this stage of the descent.
After passing the upper layer of the atmosphere, the capsule with the rover will reduce the speed to 1200 km / h and release a 22-meter parachute.
A further decline will take a little more than a minute, during which the speed of the capsule will continue to fall.
"Heavenly Crane."
When the capsule reaches 2 km above the surface of the planet at a speed of about 360 km / h, it will first reset the heat shield, and then a special probe “Sky Crane ” together with the rover will separate from it.
It is fixed above the rover and equipped with a set of eight jet landing engines.
It is with their help that the "Heavenly Crane" will hover over the surface of Mars and gently descend on it a rover on special cables.
When the rover touches the surface, its computer will immediately send a signal to Sky Crane, which will release the cables and fly away from the landing site Perseverance for disposal at a safe distance.
Stages of landing Perseverance on Mars / Photo NASA "Seven minutes of horror" Actually, the entire above-described process of landing from entering the upper atmosphere to landing on the surface of the planet and there are these "seven minutes of horror" that you need to survive the Rover Perseverance, as did its predecessors.
This stage was called so because the descent of the device occurs completely automatically (due to a delay in the signal between Mars and Earth, which lasts 700 seconds) and during these seven minutes, NASA specialists will not know whether the landing of the device was successful or not.
A similar landing Curiosity NASA is not the first time to land on Mars the device in this way.
For eight years, the Curiosity spacecraft has also descended to the surface of the planet.
The entire process of descent and landing of the Rover Perseverance with brief explanations to NASA specialists can be viewed on a special video that demonstrates each of the stages of the mission to land the Rover on the Red planet.
How Perseverance will land on Mars: watch the video If you missed Hope Mars successfully entered the orbit of the red planet Why Perseverance sits in the crater of the Ezers Source: Astronomy A few billion years ago, Mars collided with a huge asteroid, which left a trace.
Today we call it the Isis basin, which is 1200 kilometers wide.
Subsequently, another asteroid, already somewhat smaller, hit this place, and it was he who formed the Jezero crater.
Studying the crater, scientists came to the conclusion that once it was filled with water with a depth of up to 500 meters, that is, in fact, it was a lake in which rivers fell and this is confirmed.
Space photos show former estuaries of rivers and even a whole delta, where researchers hope to find traces of the presence of microorganisms.
After all, the formation of deltas is accompanied by a number of processes, in particular, the discharge of sedimentary rocks, which leads to the formation of different media.
The crater got its name in honor of the small town of Jezero, which is in Bosnia and its diameter is about 45 kilometers.
The robotic apparatus is equipped with cameras and microphones with which to record the landing.
After the landing, these files will be sent to Earth, which will confirm the successful launch of the research mission.
In addition, Perseverance will be the first rover, the descent of which will be recorded using a special microphone.
The recording will tell about the entry into the atmosphere, landing and descent of the rover.
The recording will travel to Earth, allowing us to hear how the red Planet reacts to the new occupant.
What Perseverance will do on Mars The main task of the rover will be to search for biosignatures on the surface of Mars.
These are markers that indicate the existence of microbial life on the planet at some stage of its development.
To this end, the rover will travel around the crater to find rocks that, in fact, form in the aquatic environment.
In general, the task of the rover is to assess whether the environment on Mars is suitable for survival.
Samples collected by the spacecraft will return to Earth as part of another mission, which will be joined by ESA (European Space Agency).
That is why the Perseverance mission is so important, because it actually precedes the landing of a person on Mars, and the collected samples and information will help in this.
For the study of the Martian surface, the device has a number of tools and a small companion, but more on it later.
For equipping the rover with seven ultra-modern tools, NASA has allocated a huge budget of $130 million.
Scientific instruments Perseverance: Mastcam-Z is a system of advanced modern video cameras that have the ability to capture panoramic and stereoscopic images with approximation.
- a system of advanced modern video cameras that have the ability to capture panoramic and stereoscopic images with approximation.
SuperCam is a complex unit for photofixation, chemical and mineralogical analysis of the composition of collected samples.
The device is equipped with two lasers and four spectrometers.
– complex installation for photofixation, chemical and mineralogical analysis of the composition of the collected samples.
The device is equipped with two lasers and four spectrometers.
Planetary Instrument for X-ray Lithochemistry is a powerful X-ray fluorescence spectrometer equipped with a high-resolution camera.
The instrument will determine the small-scale chemical composition of the material elements from the surface of Mars. - A powerful X-ray fluorescence spectrometer is equipped with a high-resolution camera.
The instrument will determine the small-scale chemical composition of material elements from the surface of Mars.
Scanning Habitable Environments with Raman & Luminescence for Organics and Chemicals is a spectrometer for small scale imaging with an ultraviolet laser to determine small scale mineral composition.
With this instrument, the rover will search for organic constituents – a spectrometer, for small-scale imaging with an ultraviolet laser to determine small-scale mineral composition.
With this tool, the rover will look for organic components.
The Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resources Utilization Experiment - the device will try to produce oxygen in situ from carbon dioxide, which is contained in the atmosphere of Mars.
- the device will try in situ to produce oxygen from carbon dioxide, which is contained in the atmosphere of Mars.
Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer is a set of special weather station sensors that will record temperature, wind speed and direction, pressure, humidity and dust particle size.
– a set of special sensors of the meteorological station, which will record the temperature, wind speed and direction, pressure, humidity and dust particle size.
Radar Imager for Mars' subsurface experiment (RIMFAX) - a special radar that will study the geological structure of subsurface layers.
This tool is specially developed by the Norwegian Institute for Defence Studies.
In addition, 23 cameras are installed on the bike, with the help of which the NASA team will be able to record everything that happens on the surface of Mars around the rover.
The Insight probe stopped trying to measure the temperature under the surface of Mars Mars Ingenuity As part of the Perseverance rover, a specially designed Ingenuity helicopter will also land on the surface.
In general, his first and main mission is just to work.
NASA specialists previously tested the performance of Ingenuity in a special camera that simulated the atmosphere on Mars.
Therefore, Ingenuity must: survive the launch from Cape Canaveral and get to Mars; safely land with the rover on the surface and separate from it; survive the cold Martian nights; operate autonomously and charge the batteries with solar panels.
After that, there will be the first attempt of autonomous flight.
If it is successful, engineers plan to make 30 Martian sols before four launches.
If it succeeds, then in the coming years, the American agency may develop other aircraft on its basis.

If the helicopter manages to prove its ability to operate, it will be engaged in reconnaissance of territory for Perseverance.

This was reported on Thursday by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).
We've just received information that Perseverance is functioning on the surface of Mars, "the broadcast manager said.
The landing lasted about seven minutes.
All operations during it were carried out in automatic mode.
As noted by the specialists of the department, to reduce the speed of movement of the device opened its parachute, then the casing of the rover, designed to protect it from the effects of high temperatures, will be separated.
NASA experts expect with the help of Perseverance to detect traces of life on Mars in the distant past.
The device is equipped with equipment to collect soil and search for possible traces of living organisms that once could exist on Mars, writes telegram channel mash.
Also, the rover will have to check how people in the future will be able to produce oxygen there and use it both for breathing and as fuel.
To do this, Perseverance is an experimental installation MOXIE.
As planned, it will receive oxygen from carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of Mars.
A drone is also installed on the device.
It will have to test the possibility of flying in the rarefied atmosphere of the red planet.
If all goes well, it will also be used to photograph Mars.

title: Residents of St. Petersburg and the Leningrad region took a course to the suburbs: in COVID-19 low-rise housing gained popularity
text:
Residents of St. Petersburg and Leningrad region took a course to the suburbs: in COVID-19 low-rise housing gained popularity Residents of St. Petersburg and the Leningrad region increasingly began to give preference to apartments in low-rise buildings.
As it turned out, not the last role in the popularization of such housing was played by COVID-19 - people wanted fresh air and proximity to nature.
Experts see this as a new trend and advise officials to pay more attention to such objects.
Experts note that the number of offers of apartments in houses no higher than five floors increased significantly last year.
The demand for such housing increased by 68% compared to last year.
“The leading object was the residential complex“ Green Quarter on Pulkovo Heights ”.
For 2020, 2.7 thousand transactions were made in the facility - this is 2.4 times more than in 2019.
Thus, the share of the residential complex amounted to 34% of all transactions concluded in low-rise projects for this period, ” said Olga Trosheva, head of the St. Petersburg Real Estate consulting center.
According to the company "Petersburg real estate", now in the Northern capital opened sales in 24 low-rise complexes, and in the suburbs - in 19.
These are houses whose height does not exceed four floors.
Not the last role in the emergence of a new trend was played by coronavirus infection, as well as the period of self-isolation.
People felt the benefits of country life.
“Many have revised their priorities and now prefer life in the fresh air of the city bustle, however, not everyone has the opportunity to afford suburban housing, so, yes, we can say that low-rise residential complexes have every chance to become a new trend, ” said the Vice-President of the Association of Realtors of St. Petersburg and the Leningrad region Valery Vinogradov.
Another reason for popularity is the price.
The fact is that the average price per square meter in low-rise projects in St. Petersburg is 120.5 thousand rubles, which is 19% lower than high-rise buildings.
In the suburbs, the difference is 15%.
So far, in the volume of demand in St. Petersburg and separately the Leningrad region, the share of low-rise residential complexes is 8%.
Low-rise construction is not as much in demand as multi-storey projects.
Among buyers there is an opinion that such LCD are at a great distance from the city center.
However, experts disagree with this.
According to them, some residential complexes for the development of transport infrastructure can compete with high-rise complexes.
Among them is the Setl Group complex "Green Quarter" on the Pulkovo heights.
From the metro station "Moskovskaya" it is separated by 20 minutes.
During the same time from the complex you can get to Pulkovo and the Ring Road.
Transport accessibility is not the only advantage of such a LC.
“The big advantage of such facilities is fresh air, video surveillance, proximity to shops and not too many neighbors, unlike multi-storey complexes, which have already been called“ anthills ”.
The advantage is also the better transport accessibility of areas with low-rise buildings compared to areas such as, for example, Kudrovo, ” Valery Vinogradov explained.
There is no need to worry about social infrastructure.
In such complexes as the Green Quarter, above-ground and underground parking lots are designed, shops, bakeries and a bank branch are planned on the first floors, and two schools and two kindergartens are operating in the quarter.
Low-rise buildings are also ideal for the elderly and young families with children - special attention is paid to recreational areas for walking when designing such residential complexes.
Maple, apple, lilac and cherry alleys will appear in the Green Quarter residential complex.
In the center of the quarter will be a square with a spruce square.
Along the houses will break the front gardens, and you can get into them directly from the apartments on the first floor.
Such an organization will create the atmosphere of a country house.
Another advantage of low-rise complexes is a safe and comfortable environment for children.
In particular, in the "Green Quarter" will appear exclusive sites SetlKids.
Their projects were developed with the participation of child psychologists.
The equipment of these playgrounds takes into account the needs of children of different ages and contributes to harmonious mental and physical development.
“Such projects represent a new lifestyle, close to the European one.
Their popularity is due to the low density of the population: in such conditions, it is easier to create good neighborly relations.
Human-sized and comfortable living environment, more space for development and rest, high level of security, calm and measured pace of life.
A narrow circle of neighbors will make everyday life more comfortable and give a sense of privacy, which is sometimes so lacking in the metropolis, ” explained Olga Trosheva.
Low-rise residential complexes also depart from standard layouts, the space in them can resemble country houses with wide windows and spacious balconies.
On the last floors in the Green Quarter, apartments with attics and terraces are thought out.

title: Mission Perseverance: Persistent desire to conquer the sky to go underground
text:
The Perseverance rover and, next to it, the first extraterrestrial helicopter, Ingenuity.
Similar to him in the future can be used to study the huge Martian caves.
For the second time in its history, humanity will launch an aircraft under a strange sky - and for the first time in history it will be heavier than the local "air".
In addition, Perseverance will be able to clarify a number of issues that are of significant importance for the study and even colonization of Mars.
However, it is possible with a great deal of certainty to predict what he will not be able to: solve the question of “whether there is life on Mars ”.
But this is no longer his fault, but the general problem of unmanned expeditions to this planet.
We know the details.
In July 2020, NASA sent a new rover to Mars, and on February 18, 2021, it finally reached the surface of the Red Planet.
The landing point was the crater Jezero - in the past a fairly large lake, next to which you can still see the dried delta of the river that once flowed into this lake.
The name of the crater is similar to the Russian word "lake" because it was named in 2007 in honor of the city of Jezero from the b / Yugoslavia, and the word means "lake".
Hopes for the discovery of life: a purely theoretical landing site chosen not so much because there was a body of water.
On Mars, in general, there are many former lakes, seas and rivers, and previously the same Curiosity has already passed through such places.
But Ezero has something that is rare elsewhere – NASA ’ s orbital images showed that carbonate rocks are on the edge of this crater.
On Earth, such rocks are often a trace of former life.
So, in the artist ’ s view, the Martian lake Jezero looked billions of years ago Image source: NASA / JPL-Caltech It is known that in theory, cyanobacteria can exist in Martian conditions.
In the past of the Earth, they often formed cyanobacterial mats – they are also called “stromatolites ”.
On our planet, their age reaches 3.7 billion years, and sometimes the wind exposes sediments above them so that traces of ancient cyanobacteria are almost on the surface.
In theory, a similar event in Ezero could allow Perseverance to explore the remains of ancient Martian life.
Unfortunately, this is a theory, and in practice, the ancient carbonate rocks exposed “outside ” can be so much changed by wind erosion (bombardment by dust and grains of sand), as well as by cosmic radiation, that their study will not allow to unambiguously interpret the find of quite real stromatolites.
The current situation with the crater of Ezeoro.
Image source: NASA / JPL-Caltech Of course, nearby, literally under tens of centimeters of sand, there may be well-preserved traces of ancient life.
But there is nothing to “get ” to them: the tools available to Perseverance, as well as his twin brother Curiosity, banal do not allow you to dig deeper into the ground more than a few centimeters.
How is it different from Curiosity?
We mentioned that the systems for drilling surface rocks of the new rover are the same as those of the old, still working on Mars 9 years after the landing.
But there are new cars and differences – and very interesting.
First of all, it is the heaviest planetrover ever created by humans.
If Curiosity weighed 900 kilograms, the new device - 1025 kilograms.
The main weight gain is the result of changing the six wheels of the machine.
At Curiosity, aluminum rims were chosen not quite correctly: too thin.
As a result, the local soil quickly made holes in it.
It is still possible to move, but the passability from this, of course, has not improved, and the energy consumption during movement has increased.
The Perseverance wheels themselves, to increase all the same passability, added in diameter - 525 millimeters against 500 millimeters in Curiosity.
The spokes of the wheels were left titanium, but bent to raise the overall strength of the wheels.
All this is not an empty reinsurance: the main reason for the death of all planetary vehicles is their stuck in the ground.
Therefore, improving the reliability of the wheels is of great importance.
Image source: Wikimedia Commons Another important difference: the device MOXIE, which was not on the old rover.
MOXIE will conduct an experiment to decompose CO2, the main gas in the Martian atmosphere, into CO and O2 (carbon monoxide and hydrogen).
The theoretical benefit of the experiment is obvious: it will show whether it is possible to get oxygen directly from the Martian “air ”, where there is practically no oxygen of its own.
MOXIE should produce up to 22 grams of O2 per hour for 1230 hours – approximately this amount of oxygen per unit of time is absorbed by a person under regular physical exertion.
It would seem that this will help future manned expeditions.
Almost everything is not so colorful.
To extract oxygen from the extremely rarefied local atmosphere is much more energy-consuming than with the banal decomposition of water into oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
The 15-kilogram MOXIE consumes 300 watts at peak load (however, short-lived).
Almost all planners of future manned expeditions believe that they should be planted where water ice is close to the surface of Mars.
Decomposing its water, will get oxygen much easier.
Aluminum plates of MOXIE electrodes are covered with a thin layer of gold Image source: NASA / JPL-Caltech That's just the rover can not dig.
Therefore, he, as a victim of intoxication with ethyl alcohol from an anecdote, has to "look for the keys not where he lost, but under the lamp, where it is lighter" - to put not the experiment that is most useful for future expeditions, but the one that allows the very limited possibilities of terrestrial planetary rovers.
The third important difference from Curiosity: the Russian neutron water detector DAN, developed by the Institute for Space Research of the Russian Academy of Sciences, is replaced here by the RIMFAX radar, pointing downwards and emitting at a frequency of 150-200 megahertz.
It, unlike a neutron detector, does not see water bound in minerals.
But it should distinguish between water years and traces of liquid water at a depth of up to 10 meters.
This is a very important device: DAN saw water no deeper than a couple of meters.
And the deeper, the higher the temperature and the higher the probability of the presence of liquid salt water.
However, water-saturated minerals it is much more difficult to distinguish, unlike a neutron detector.
In theory, some of the samples collected by Perseverance in 2026 could be taken by the next NASA rover and then sent to Earth.
The point here is that the “transport ” rover will be easier than the“ universal ” one.
And the delivery of samples from Mars to our planet will require an expedition with a huge landing mass: to take off from the Red Planet, fuel will have to be brought from Earth.
Finally, there is one difference that you will not notice with your eyes, but it still warms the soul of the American side.
Perseverance has replaced the source of energy: on board it is not Russian plutonium-238, but its American counterpart, the production of which in recent years has finally been established in the United States.
The power of the radioisotope generator on this plutonium remained the same: just over a hundred watts, about like a powerful incandescent bulb.
Separate mission: the second aircraft under the alien sky Perseverance carries with it a light drone Ingenuity.
Technically, this is a coaxial helicopter, such as "Kamov".
The span of the blades there is 1.2 meters, the weight is only 1.8 kilograms.
The speed of rotation of the blades will be up to 40 revolutions per second.
Such a huge size and speed of rotation are needed because the atmosphere of Mars in density is 100-150 times inferior to the Earth.
Experiments in the pressure chamber have shown that with smaller parameters, the device there simply will not take off.
Image source: Wikimedia Commons The power of the drone is up to 350 watts, more than the power source of the rover.
Therefore, the mini-helicopter first accumulates a charge in the on-board lithium battery by 0.27 kilograms, and then flies, but no longer than three minutes.
In order not to leave Ingenuity without charge, it will not be released from the rover further than a hundred meters.
However, for future missions, the situation may change somewhat.
In the case of studying the descents into the lava tubes of Mars, the drone is potentially almost indispensable.
The fact is that robots are extremely poorly moved on complex ground surfaces (which killed many rovers even on the plain).
But flight is a relatively homogeneous occupation, where even without human intelligence, the survival of the device is more likely.
Therefore, drones are almost the only real way to explore the Martian lava caves.
It is believed that there is a lot of water ice.
And away from the entrance can be much warmer than on the surface.
It would be nice to test both of these hypotheses, because heat and water are good harbingers of possible life.
By the way, a number of scientists are sure that it should be found on Mars in such tubes.
Of course, Ingenuity is only the first step on this path.
For a full exploration of the caves will require much larger devices, but first you need to check whether there is at least a small, “training ” drone.
If Ingenuity takes off successfully, it will be a huge achievement.
Until now, the device, designed for a long flight under the sky of an alien planet, flew only from the USSR, and for a very, very long time - already in 1984 (the Vega-1 and Vega-2 missions).
More than 36 years have passed, and it is time to finally renew that long-standing achievement.
Vega mission balloon, a copy from Earth tests Image source: Wikimedia Commons To sum up.
Perseverance is not too expensive (about $2.5 billion) automated mission, which is likely to be able to work on Mars for many years.
Like all mobile space machines, it is not universal enough to solve the question of “whether there is life on Mars. ”
Even after walking literally a meter above the subsoil bacterial colony, Perseverance will not be able to reach it: it does not have a normal drill.
The flight scheme of the first atmospheric aircraft created specifically for other planets, the Soviet balloon of the Vega mission Image source: Wikimedia Commons But this is not its feature: modern planetary vehicles in principle are deprived of such capabilities.
Even motionless NASA Insight landers cannot successfully dig more than tens of centimeters deep.
However, the limited capabilities of missions to Mars are not forever.
With a high probability in the next ten years, there will go a carrier with the capabilities of Starship – a much larger landing platform than anything ever created by mankind.
If that happens, there will be humans on Mars.
And these creatures, of course, will get to dig into Martian subsurface life – if it is there.
After all, unlike robots, their limbs are much more universal, and the mind is much more flexible.

title: Iran completes investigation into UIA plane crash
text:
Iran has completed the investigation of the crash of the UIA 20.02.2021, 19: 10, News of the day ✔ Subscribe to our Telegram channel “News without censorship ” - t.me / ryb24 In Iran, the military prosecutor ’ s office has completed the investigation of the crash of the plane“ International airlines of Ukraine ”, an indictment is being prepared, the case will soon be transferred to court.
This was reported on February 19 by Radio Farda.
The head of the judicial administration of the armed forces of Iran Shokralla Bahrami said that there will be a preliminary trial with the presence of the defendants, after which the trial will begin.
He did not say when the trial would begin or whether it would be open.
The Iranian prosecutor ’ s office accuses 10 people of involvement in the UIA disaster, among them, according to the military prosecutor of Tehran Golam-Ali Turki, there are top military commanders of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
He is in custody alone.
A passenger plane Boeing 737-800 flight PS752 of Ukraine International Airlines, which was en route from Tehran to Kiev, crashed on January 8, 2020 near the capital of Iran.
There were 167 passengers and nine crew members on board.
No one survived.
Among the dead were 11 citizens of Ukraine.
Most of the passengers were citizens of Iran and Canada.
Iranian authorities, initially claiming that the plane crashed due to a technical malfunction, on January 11, under pressure from Western leaders, admitted that flight PS752 was shot down by an Iranian missile by mistake.
On July 23, Deputy Foreign Minister of Ukraine Yevgeny Yenin said that the decryption of the black boxes, which was completed in France, confirmed the illegal interference in the work of the passenger liner.
On August 23, the Civil Aviation Organization of Iran released a series of data obtained from the onboard voice recorder and flight data recorder of the UIA aircraft.
According to the records, the crew knew about the emergency situation and tried to control the plane to the last.
Iran said it agreed to pay compensation for the downed Ukrainian passenger Boeing.
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Abbas Mousavi said that the issue “will take time and has various aspects from a technical and legal point of view, ” and Gholamreza Soleimani, head of Iran ’ s Central Insurance Organization, said UIA should not receive compensation from Iran because the Boeing shot down by the Iranian military was insured by European companies.
On December 8, Yenin reported that Iran had withdrawn a proposal to pay compensation to the families of those killed in the disaster.
In late December, Iranian media reported that the country ’ s authorities are ready to pay $150,000 to each family of those killed in the crash.
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine Dmytro Kuleba stressed that this statement was made public only in the media and the Ukrainian side did not receive any official confirmation from Iran.
On February 9, CBC News sources said that a man with a voice similar to that of Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif spoke in Farsi about the possibilities to explain the downing of the plane.
He said that the truth about the tragedy will not be revealed at the level of the government and the armed forces of Iran.
Later, the speaker of the Iranian Foreign Ministry, Said Khatibzadeh, denied the information of the channel about the presence of the audio recording.

title: Covid and suicides in Japan. Why there are more victims among women
text:
Covid and suicides in Japan.
Why among women victims more Rupert Wingfield-Hayes BBC News, Tokyo Suicides in Japan are recorded faster and more accurately than anywhere else in the world.
Unlike most countries, reporting is done on a monthly basis.
And during the Covid-19 pandemic, these statistics turned out to be more alarming than before.
In 2020, for the first time in 11 years, the number of suicides in Japan increased.
However, although the number of suicides among men decreased slightly, the increase among women was almost 15%.
In October alone, the suicide rate among women in Japan jumped more than 70% compared to the same month last year.
What's going on?
And why does the pandemic seem to affect women far more than men?
A young woman (her BBC identity unknown) met Rupert Wingfield-Hayes in Yokohama A face-to-face meeting with a young woman who repeatedly tried to commit suicide is not a pleasant experience.
I have a deep respect for people who work on suicide prevention.
I'm sitting in Yokohama's red light district in a center run by a suicide prevention charity called the Bond Project.
Anyone can enter here, no pre-registration is required.
At the table opposite, a 19-year-old woman with a short haircut is sitting motionless.
Quietly, without any emotion in her voice, she begins to tell me her story.
She said it all started when she was 15.
Her older brother began to harass her.
She eventually ran away from home, but the pain and loneliness didn ’ t go away.
Suicide seemed like the only way out.
“I ’ ve been to the hospital many times since that time last year, ” she tells me.“ I tried to kill myself many times, but I didn ’ t succeed.
It seems that attempts to die will have to be abandoned. ”
The Bond Project intervened in her life.
His staff found her a safe place to live and began intensive psychotherapy.
June Tachibana is the founder of the Bond Project, a tough woman in her 40s and a tireless optimist.
Joon Tachibana hopes the Bond Project will provide women with the help they need "When girls are in big trouble and hurt, they really don't know what to do," she says.
"We are ready to listen to them, to tell them - we are with you."
Tachibana says Covid-19 seems to be pushing vulnerable people to make a fateful decision.
She describes some of the calls her employees have received in recent months.
“We often hear ‘ I want to die ’ and ‘ I have nowhere to go, ’ ” she says.
They say, "It's so painful, I'm so lonely, I want to disappear."
The pandemic has made life much more difficult for those who are physically or sexually abused.
“The girl I spoke to the other day said her father was sexually harassing her, ” Tachibana tells me.“ But because of the covid, her father doesn ’ t work much and spends a lot of time at home, and she manages to escape from him. ”
If you look at previous crisis moments in Japan, for example, the banking crisis of 2008 or the collapse of the Japanese stock market and the real estate bubble in the early 1990s, the effect was felt mainly by middle-aged men.
During these periods, there were sharp spikes in the number of suicides among men.
A pandemic is a different story.
It affects young people, especially young women.
The reasons for this are very multifaceted.
At one time, Japan had the highest suicide rate among developed countries.
Over the past decade, it has been reduced by about a third.
Professor Michiko Ueda is one of Japan ’ s leading experts on suicide.
It tells me how alarming the growth dynamics have become over the past few months.
“This scenario leading to female suicide is very, very unusual, ” she says.
“In all the time I ’ ve been doing research on this topic, I ’ ve never seen such significant growth.
The peculiarity of the pandemic is that the industries in which many women are employed - tourism, retail trade and the food industry - have suffered the most. "
In Japan, there are more and more unmarried women living on their own.
Many of them prefer such a life to marriage, which still assumes quite traditional gender roles.
Professor Ueda says that young women are much more likely to find themselves in a state of so-called "casual employment."
Professor Michiko Ueda said: “Many women are no longer married, they have to earn a living, but they don ’ t have a regular job.
So when something happens, of course, they suffer a lot.
The number of lost jobs among non-permanent workers has increased significantly over the past eight months. ”
One month stands out.
In October last year, 879 women committed suicide.
This is more than 70% higher than in October 2019.
Newspapers are alarmed.
Some even compare the total number of suicides (both men and women) in October - 2,199 - with the total number of deaths in Japan from the coronavirus at that time - 2,087.
Something strange has happened.
On September 27 last year, a very famous and popular actress named Yuko Takeuchi was found dead in her home.
It was later reported that she had committed suicide.
Photo caption: 40-year-old Japanese actress Yuko Takeuchi was found dead in her home Yasuyuki Shimizu, a former journalist.
Today, he runs a non-profit organization dedicated to suicide in Japan.
“From the moment it becomes known about the suicide of any celebrity, the number of suicides increases and remains at this new level for about 10 days, ” he says. – For example, for the suicide of Takeuchi on September 27 in the next 10 days, 207 women committed suicide. ”
If you count the number of suicides of women about the same age as Yuko Takeuchi, the statistics become even more obvious.
"Of all age groups, Takeuchi's death has had the greatest impact on women in their 40s and 50s," says Yasuyuki Shimizu. "Suicide rates have more than doubled in this age group."
Other experts also agree that there is a link between celebrity suicides and the spike in suicides in the days that followed.
This phenomenon is not unique to Japan, and this is one of the reasons why reporting suicides is not easy.
The more celebrity suicide is discussed in the media and on social media, the more it affects other vulnerable people, especially in the early days.
Mai Suganuma works for the Shimizu organization.
Her father killed himself when she was a teenager.
Now it helps to support the families of those who have voluntarily passed away.
The pandemic makes the lives of suicide families much more difficult.
“Members of the suicide family often blame themselves for what happened, ” says Mai Suganuma. – I also blamed myself for not being able to save my father.
And now they say, "Stay at home."
I fear that this will increase the sense of guilt.
The Japanese don ’ t usually talk about death.
We don ’ t have the habit of talking about suicide. ”
Japan is now experiencing a third wave of the epidemic, and the government has declared a state of emergency for the second time.
Most likely, it will last until the end of February.
More and more restaurants, hotels and bars are being quarantined, and more people are losing their jobs.

title: Iran completes investigation into its attack on UIA airliner
text:
Iran ’ s military prosecutor ’ s office has completed an extensive investigation into the crash of a Ukrainian UIA plane that was shot down early last year.
This was stated by the head of the judicial bodies of the Armed Forces of Iran Shokrolla Bahrami, IRNA news agency reports.
Bahrami said that the case is at the stage of drawing up an indictment.
According to him, the trial begins after a preliminary trial with the participation of the defendants and the families of the victims in court.
Earlier, on February 10, an audio recording was reported, in which the Iranian Foreign Minister is probably discussing the possibility that the destruction of flight PS752 was a deliberate act.
Recall that the crash of flight PS 752 Teheran-Kiev UIA occurred on January 8, 2020 in Iran.
The plane had 167 passengers and nine crew members, all of whom died.
A few days later, Iran admitted that it shot down a passenger plane.
It was alleged that the military mistakenly mistook the airliner for a hostile target after a US drone strike that killed a senior Iranian military general in Iraq.
“Country ” told how its investigation of the disaster near Tehran a year later and why the families of the victims of the crash are not paid compensation.

title: Hermits in the crowd. Why Japan ’ s Minister of Solitude
text:
https: / / ria.ru / 20210222 / odinochestvo-1598184746.html Hermits in the crowd.

The tragedy could not be prevented.
The husband told about the emotional torments - after the woman committed suicide.
“I ’ m sorry I caused trouble, ” she wrote in a suicide note.
The pandemic has exacerbated an already difficult situation - many Japanese voluntarily die.
Epidemiological conditions affect mental health, and there are great fears that the country will again be covered by a wave of suicides.
Last year, twenty thousand Japanese killed themselves, six times less died from the coronavirus - an eloquent example.
Traditionally, middle-aged men are at risk.
Woe they often poured in pubs and bars and now left alone with a bottle.
However, the past year has revealed a gloomy trend: more and more women, adolescents and children are taking their lives.
Women in a traditionally patriarchal society are financially less stable, in addition, young Japanese women are increasingly not getting married, because marriage sometimes means giving up career ambitions.
For some reason, it was October that became especially dark: suicide among women jumped by 70 percent compared to the previous year.
Suicide rates also increased among students in junior, middle and high schools.
In total, 479 children voluntarily said goodbye to their lives, 140 more than in 2019.
Every new tragedy is investigated, the explanations are all the same: anxiety, poor academic performance, difficult relationships with parents.
Depression has also increased in the pandemic.
The trouble is that there is no one to share the grief with - many Japanese suffer from loneliness, there is no one to support them in a difficult moment.
In bitter irony, it was the solitary lifestyle and lack of social contacts that partially restrained the spread of the virus.
Total lockdown and strict restrictions, as in European countries, in Japan was not introduced.
However, against the background of the corona-crisis, another problem has worsened - kodokushi (translated as "lonely death") among the elderly.
How many old people died in 2020, did not specify, but the situation clearly worsened: social services could not visit the elderly, and they themselves did not have the opportunity to communicate with each other.
In Tokyo, they decided that this topic requires a thorough approach - and created a new position in the government.
Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga has appointed Tetsushi Sakamoto, a minister with no portfolio for regional development, as the chief anti-loneliness officer.
Raising the birth rate is also his responsibility.
Strictly speaking, a separate ministry did not appear, Sakamoto simply expanded the functionality.
The task was not trivial.
“Women feel more isolated, and suicide is on the rise, ” said Minister Yoshihide Suga.“ I would like you to explore this issue and present a strategy. ”
Whether Sakamoto is the ideal candidate is hard to say – he has a wife and children, in addition, according to rumors, he has a mistress, a child from whom he hides.
In short, the minister does not suffer from loneliness.
Whether his rich personal life will help to resolve the situation with forced hermits is a big question.
Sakamoto is not alone in the field warrior.
The problem is old, closely related to Japanese culture, and will be taken seriously.
The task is to carefully study and strategically plan everything, but first determine the terminology.
Without this, the work will not be effective, said Takako Suzuki, one of the members of the research team, which a year ago was created by young parliamentarians – members of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party.
The opposition supported them.
“We need to figure out how to collect data on isolation to build policies based on concrete information, ” said Yuichiro Tamaki, leader of the opposition Democratic Party for the People.
Sakamoto will convene an urgent forum before the end of February, where representatives of the action teams will speak and share their thoughts.
How to apply them in practice will be decided by the special secretariat.
Loneliness of the Japanese can be compared to an iceberg: hidden from the eyes a whole range of problems that are rooted in different spheres of life and long-standing trends in society.
International journalist Maxim Krylov, who lives in Japan, notes that there are many couples with children on the streets of Tokyo, although the capital is a very young city.
“Indirectly, the fear of loneliness can be seen in the unprecedented boom of partner search apps.
About 70 percent of advertising in Japanese YouTube now occupy them, ” — draws attention Krylov.
According to statistics, more than a third of households in the country consist of one person.
Every fifth person is “lonely for life ” – at an older age, there is practically no chance of finding a spouse.
One in three marriages in Japan ends in divorce.
And although celibacy itself does not mean loneliness and Japan is far from the leaders of developed countries in this indicator, 15 percent of residents do not communicate with people outside the family circle at all.
Forecasts are disappointing: by 2040, almost half of households will be owned by single people.
And the number of complete families with children will continue to decline. In the Land of the Rising Sun there is also such, for example, the phenomenon of hikikomori.
Literally, the term means "to be in solitude."
This is the name of people who avoid contact and live as recluses.
According to various sources, Hickey in Japan - from 613 thousand to two million.
Most are men.
Two years ago, the Tokyo authorities included in the municipal health care system social services that work with such “hermits ”.
Raising the birth rate, which Sakamoto had previously been responsible for, is no easy task either.
Due to the high demands of employers, women, who are fewer than men in the country, choose a career.
About 70 percent of women and 60 percent of men aged 18 to 34 are unmarried, and more than 40 percent of Japanese have never had an intimate relationship.
“The birth rate in marriage in Japan is quite at the level of developed Western countries.
But outside of marriage, it is extremely low, which exacerbates the picture. ”
Solving the problem, he said, is almost impossible.
"Therefore, state support for fertility" is looking under the lamp. "
It is aimed at families and boils down to three whales: an attempt to make kindergartens more accessible, to stimulate — in words — maternity leave for men and, the only new initiative of the Cabinet, to subsidize infertility treatment, ” explains Krylov.
An example could be taken from the UK.
The Loneliness Ministry was created in 2018 when it was found out that 13 percent of the population is lonely and this probably brings the country 32 billion pounds ($44 billion) in losses annually.
The British mobilized local authorities and attracted volunteers who help the most vulnerable – for example, the unemployed and adolescents.
However, in Japan, the problem of loneliness affects many social and age groups and is rooted in the specifics of culture.
It is unlikely to fight the phenomenon following the example of the Western monarchy, because it is necessary to change not only politics, but also the whole way of life.
There is no limit to one ministry.

title: The energy of stars on Earth: the EU has allocated to the “artificial sun ” €5.6 billion
text:
Energy of stars on Earth: EU allocated €5.6 billion for "artificial sun" 22.02.2021 16: 25 Ukrinform The EU Council announced the allocation of 5.61 billion euros in the framework of the international project to create an International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER).
Such a statement was published on Monday on the website of the European Council.
“The Council of the EU today adopted a decision that ensures the continuation of European funding for this project (ITER) within the framework of the Multi-Year Financial Outlook (MFF) for 2021-2027.
The European contribution to the project during 2021-2027 is defined in the amount of 5.61 billion euros at current prices ”, – stated in the message.
This decision of the Council of the EU will enter into force immediately after publication in the Official Journal of the EU.
According to the forecast of the European Commission, the first achievements in the production of energy using plasma will be achieved in December 2025, and the project should reach full capacity by 2035.
Fusion is not expected to become a source for commercial energy production until at least 2050.
As reported, the ITER agreement was concluded in November 2006 with the participation of the European Agency “Euroatom ”, the United States, Russia, Japan, China, South Korea and India.
Euroatom plays a key role in the implementation of the project.
The ultimate goal of thermonuclear research is to make the “energy of stars ” available on Earth by carrying out a fusion reaction of hydrogen nuclei.
Thermonuclear energy is almost inexhaustible (because the fuel is a common element in the universe), its production does not form any carbon dioxide, methane, or long-lived radioactive waste.
Unlike conventional nuclear power, a thermonuclear reactor has what is known as internal safety, since the chain reaction characteristic of fission reactors is not possible here.
Based on materials: Ukrinform

title: The UN announced numerous violations of Iran in the case of the downed UIA aircraft
text:
Iran has violated a number of human rights in the context of the downing of UIA flight PS752 and the events that occurred after the disaster.
This is stated in the letter of the UN special rapporteur, fragments of which were published on February 23, writes “European truth ”.
“The discrepancies in the official explanations appear to be intended to cause maximum confusion and minimal clarity.
They look far-fetched in order to be confusing, ” said Agnes Callamard, Special Rapporteur on extrajudicial and arbitrary executions.
See also Ukraine will ask Canada for an audio recording of the likely deliberate downing by Iran of the aircraft UIA Callamar notes that the mistakes made by Iran indicate a frivolous attitude to standard procedures and precautions, "which should be involved to the maximum extent, given the circumstances and the fact that the air defense unit was near a civilian airport."
The Rapporteur notes that in December 2020, she addressed the Iranian government with her observations and questions about the downing of the plane, but is still waiting for an answer.
“In situations of significant military tension, the best way to prevent attacks against civil aviation is to close the airspace.
If Iran, well aware of the risk of escalation from the United States, had closed its airspace to civilian aircraft that evening, those 176 people would not have died.
In her opinion, Iran ’ s explanation of why the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps mistakenly hit a civilian plane contains many contradictions.
In particular, Iran claims an erroneous determination of the target, but does not explain how this radar error occurred; why the military did not use standard aircraft verification procedures such as flight altitude, angle of climb or descent, speed, size, etc.; what was the communication with the military on civilian aircraft.
"Contrary to the claims of the commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Air Force that the military had only 10 seconds to decide to open fire, it turns out that in fact they had 45 seconds or more to assess the target.
No information was provided on why the other aircraft that took off that evening before flight PS752, did not hit, ” said Callamard.
She further points out that Iran for three days did not recognize the fact of the downing of the plane, and then, instead of proper investigation, prevented the collection of evidence, but did not secure the crash site, did not take care of the proper treatment of the bodies and belongings of the victims.
Earlier, the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in Iran, Javaid Rehman, drew attention to the treatment of the families of some of the victims who tried to achieve justice, including threats.
